rows.meaningZh: 矢车菊（Centaurea cyanus）；本例取该植物义
rows.en: A single blue bachelor's button stood out among the white daisies in the vase.
rows.zh: 一枝蓝色矢车菊在花瓶里的白色雏菊间格外显眼。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 背部支具；支撑背部的穿戴装置（本例不指机械后撑）
rows.en: Her back brace fitted beneath a loose shirt and was barely visible.
rows.zh: 她的背部支具藏在宽松衬衫下面，几乎看不出来。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 反手击球（本例为网球动作，不限定为向后射门）
rows.en: Her backhand shot landed just inside the baseline.
rows.zh: 她的反手击球刚好落在底线内。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 细菌滤床；使污水接触空气和微生物的砂砾滤层
rows.en: Wastewater trickled over the bacteria bed while air circulated through the gravel.
rows.zh: 污水缓缓淋过细菌滤床，空气则在砾石间流通。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 烘焙用巧克力（本例为固体巧克力，不是可可浆）
rows.en: He chopped the baking chocolate into small pieces before melting it.
rows.zh: 他先把烘焙用巧克力切成小块，再将其融化。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 须鲸（须鲸类的统称，不专指长须鲸）
rows.en: The guide identified it as a baleen whale by the plates hanging from its upper jaw.
rows.zh: 向导根据它上颌垂下的鲸须板，认出那是一头须鲸。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 善于抢球、截球的球员（通常写作 ball hawk 或 ballhawk，不是抢断动作）
rows.en: Their best ball hawk intercepted the pass and started a counterattack.
rows.zh: 他们最擅长抢球的球员截下传球，发起了反击。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: （球类运动）善于接球、抢断的动作或本领
rows.en: Her ball hawking forced three turnovers in the final quarter.
rows.zh: 她在最后一节积极抢断，迫使对手三次失误丢球。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 钟形椅座；某些18世纪椅子的钟形座面
rows.en: The restorer traced the curved outline of the balloon seat before cutting new upholstery.
rows.zh: 修复师先描出钟形椅座弯曲的轮廓，再裁剪新的包面料。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 危害冷杉的绵状球蚜（Adelges piceae）
rows.en: The forester examined a fir twig for balsam woolly aphid before approving the saplings for transport.
rows.zh: 同意运送这些幼树前，林务员先检查一根冷杉枝条上是否有绵状球蚜Adelges piceae。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 观赏蕨类Coniogramme japonica；羽状叶宽大、深绿色
rows.en: A bamboo fern spread its dark green fronds across the shaded corner of the conservatory.
rows.zh: 温室阴凉的一角，一株Coniogramme japonica舒展开深绿色的蕨叶。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 香蕉运输船（本例不指化妆品牌或水上娱乐设施）
rows.en: The old banana boat arrived with its cargo still green.
rows.zh: 那艘旧香蕉运输船抵港时，所载的香蕉还没有熟。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 邦迪牌创可贴（Band-Aid 为商标名称；本例为实物义）
rows.en: There was a Band-Aid over the small scratch on his hand.
rows.zh: 他手上那道小划伤上贴着一片邦迪创可贴。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 榕树（本例为植物义，不指酒店品牌）
rows.en: The banyan tree spread its branches over most of the courtyard.
rows.zh: 那棵榕树的枝条覆盖了院子的大部分地方。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 经常泡酒吧的人（口语，常带贬义；不据此判断是否酒精成瘾）
rows.en: The novel's barfly knows the regular customers at every pub on the street.
rows.zh: 小说里那个常泡酒吧的人，认识这条街上每家酒馆的熟客。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 酒吧陪侍女；受雇陪伴男性顾客的女子
rows.en: Working as a bar girl, she was expected to keep male customers company at their tables.
rows.zh: 做酒吧陪侍女时，她的工作是到桌边陪伴男性顾客。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 小节线（乐谱中划分小节的竖线）
rows.en: The teacher drew a bar line after the fourth beat.
rows.zh: 老师在第四拍后画了一条小节线。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 非婚生身份；庶出身份（比喻用法）
rows.en: The novel's hero feared that the bar sinister would keep him from marrying into the family.
rows.zh: 小说的主人公担心，自己的非婚生身份会阻碍他与那个家族联姻。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 理发椅（本例不指伐木时的椅状劈裂）
rows.en: The barber chair could be raised without disturbing the customer's position.
rows.zh: 那把理发椅可以升高，而不影响顾客的坐姿。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 去尽肉的骨头；不带肉的骨头
rows.en: The dog carried a bare bone out of the bushes and dropped it by the gate.
rows.zh: 狗从灌木丛里叼出一根不带肉的骨头，把它丢在门边。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 仓鸮；本例取Tyto alba义
rows.en: A barn owl slipped through the open doorway and vanished into the dark loft.
rows.zh: 一只仓鸮从敞开的门口飞入，消失在黑暗的阁楼里。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 白颊黑雁（Branta leucopsis）；本例指该雁种
rows.en: The barnacle goose kept close to the flock as it crossed the wind-swept field.
rows.zh: 那只白颊黑雁穿过风中的田野时，一直紧跟着雁群。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 热带美洲蕨类Nephrolepis pectinata；叶片细分，常作观赏植物（本例取该义）
rows.en: The basket fern's finely divided fronds spilled over the rim of its hanging pot.
rows.zh: 吊盆里的Nephrolepis pectinata伸出细碎的蕨叶，垂过盆沿。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一年生植物Centaurea americana；花头下的苞片形似小篮（本例取该义）
rows.en: Before the basket flower opened, its woven-looking bracts already caught his attention.
rows.zh: Centaurea americana还没开花时，那些像编织物般的苞片就已引起他的注意。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 紫穗槐（Amorpha fruticosa）；一种常见于河岸的灌木（本例取该义）
rows.en: The bastard indigo along the riverbank was covered in dark purple flower clusters.
rows.zh: 河岸边的紫穗槐开满了深紫色花簇。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美西部寄生性植物Comandra pallida的俗名；有浅白小花（旧分类名）
rows.en: Small pale flowers covered the bastard toadflax among the low shrubs.
rows.zh: 低矮灌木丛间的Comandra pallida开满了浅色小花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 犹太教女孩承担宗教责任的成人礼（本例取仪式义）
rows.en: Hannah's family gathered for her bath mitzvah on a bright spring morning.
rows.zh: 一个明媚的春日早晨，Hannah的家人聚在一起，参加她的犹太教女孩成人礼。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 私制杜松子酒（常用于美国禁酒时期语境；不表示一定在浴缸里酿造）
rows.en: The detective in the film discovers bottles of bathtub gin hidden behind a false wall.
rows.zh: 影片里的侦探发现了藏在假墙后的一瓶瓶私制杜松子酒。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 海滨沙地上生长的草（不是水生植物）
rows.en: The beach grass bent in the wind along the edge of the dunes.
rows.zh: 沙丘边缘的海滨草随风弯下了身子。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 蒿属观赏植物Artemisia stelleriana；叶灰白色
rows.en: Grey leaves of beach wormwood softened the edge of the gravel path.
rows.zh: Artemisia stelleriana灰白色的叶片，让碎石路的边缘显得柔和起来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 西印度群岛等地的小乔木Ormosia monosperma（本例取该植物义）
rows.en: The guide pointed to a bead tree and showed us its red-and-black seeds.
rows.zh: 向导指着一棵Ormosia monosperma，给我们看它红黑相间的种子。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 小熊猫（Ailurus fulgens）；本例取该动物义
rows.en: The bear cat curled its long tail around its body before settling on the branch.
rows.zh: 小熊猫安顿在树枝上之前，先把长尾巴圈在身旁。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 芳香多年生草本Monarda didyma（本例取该植物义）
rows.en: Bees crowded around the bee balm beside the garden gate.
rows.zh: 花园门边的Monarda didyma周围聚满了蜜蜂。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 蜂房；容纳蜂箱的棚屋（本例不是整个养蜂场）
rows.en: The beekeeper checked the roof of the bee house after the storm.
rows.zh: 暴风雨后，养蜂人检查了蜂房的屋顶。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 花形似蜂的欧洲兰花Ophrys apifera
rows.en: From a distance, the flower of the bee orchid looked like a small bee resting on a petal.
rows.zh: 远看，Ophrys apifera的花像一只停在花瓣上的小蜂。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 牛肉清汤；用牛肉熬成的汤（不是肉汁或浓稠浇汁）
rows.en: She added noodles and sliced mushrooms to the beef broth.
rows.zh: 她往牛肉清汤里加入面条和切片蘑菇。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 牛肉高汤（烹饪义；本例不是肉牛）
rows.en: The rice absorbed the beef stock as it simmered.
rows.zh: 米饭在小火炖煮的过程中吸收了牛肉高汤。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 有近圆肉质叶、叶背带红色的秋海棠园艺植物（Begonia erythrophylla）
rows.en: She turned a leaf of the beefsteak begonia to show me its red underside.
rows.zh: 她翻过这株Begonia erythrophylla的一片叶子，给我看它红色的叶背。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 结有易黏衣物的刺状小坚果的一类植物（本例取植物义）
rows.en: Prickly fruits of the beggar's lice had fastened themselves to the cuffs of my trousers.
rows.zh: 俗称beggar's lice的植物，其带刺小坚果牢牢挂在了我的裤脚上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 钟形椅座；某些18世纪椅子的钟形座面
rows.en: A split in the bell seat had loosened the fabric along its curved edge.
rows.zh: 钟形椅座裂开了一处，沿着弯曲边缘的包面料也松脱了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 钟形；类似钟的外形（本例不指扬声器零件）
rows.en: The skirt kept its bell shape even when she sat down.
rows.zh: 即使她坐下来，那条裙子也保持着钟形轮廓。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 纹章上的逆斜带；按观者所见，从盾牌右上方延伸至左下方
rows.en: The illustrator drew the bend sinister from the shield's upper right to its lower left as the reader saw it.
rows.zh: 插画师按读者看到的方向，从盾牌右上方到左下方画了一条逆斜带。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: β辐射；由高速电子或正电子构成的辐射
rows.en: The textbook distinguishes beta radiation from electromagnetic gamma radiation.
rows.zh: 课本区分了β辐射与属于电磁辐射的γ辐射。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 北美大棕蝠（Eptesicus fuscus）
rows.en: A big brown bat circled the porch light while insects gathered around the bulb.
rows.zh: 昆虫聚集在灯泡周围时，一只北美大棕蝠在门廊灯旁盘旋。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 比基尼式三角短裤（复数；本例指内裤）
rows.en: She bought plain bikini pants to wear under the fitted skirt.
rows.zh: 她买了素色的比基尼式三角内裤，穿在那条合身的裙子里面。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 双系继嗣；同时追溯父系和母系的亲属关系（不是遗传学的双亲遗传）
rows.en: The chapter explains bilateral descent by tracing a person's relatives through both parents.
rows.zh: 这一章通过追溯一个人父母双方的亲属，解释双系继嗣。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 舭龙骨；装在船舭外侧、用于减小横摇的纵向鳍板
rows.en: Barnacles had gathered along the bilge keel, making its edge hard to inspect.
rows.zh: 藤壶附着在舭龙骨上，让它的边缘难以检查。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 稗属栽培谷草Echinochloa frumentacea的农业俗名
rows.en: The farmer reserved one field for billion-dollar grass to provide extra forage.
rows.zh: 农场主留出一块田种植Echinochloa frumentacea，以增加饲草供应。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 金槌花类；具球状金黄色花头的Craspedia属植物（本例取植物义）
rows.en: Three stems of billy buttons added bright yellow dots to the otherwise green bouquet.
rows.zh: 三枝金槌花给原本一片绿色的花束添上了亮黄色的点缀。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Bing 品种的甜樱桃（不是所有樱桃的统称）
rows.en: The grower picked a ripe Bing cherry and compared it with fruit from the neighbouring cultivar.
rows.zh: 种植者摘下一颗成熟的 Bing 品种甜樱桃，与旁边另一个品种的果实作比较。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 可生物降解的污染；污染物能被自然生物过程分解的污染
rows.en: The report traced the biodegradable pollution to organic waste from the processing plant.
rows.zh: 报告查明，这种可生物降解的污染来自加工厂排放的有机废物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （数学，旧用语）四次幂；平方的平方
rows.en: Each term in the sum is the biquadrate of a different integer.
rows.zh: 这个和中的每一项，都是一个不同整数的四次幂。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 桦木风味汽水（本例为不含酒精的软饮料，不是啤酒）
rows.en: He ordered a birch beer instead of an alcoholic drink.
rows.zh: 他没有点酒，而是要了一杯桦木风味汽水。
rows.author: root
rows.decisionEncoding: Membership in the original explicitly named supported/accepted collection, not a new approval.

rows.meaningZh: 伯奇特里；美国密苏里州的一座城市
rows.en: By dusk, we had reached Birch Tree, Missouri, and stopped for the night.
rows.zh: 黄昏时，我们到了密苏里州的伯奇特里，并在那里住了一晚。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 鸟足；鸟的脚（本例取解剖义）
rows.en: A strand of fishing line had tightened around the bird's foot.
rows.zh: 一根钓鱼线紧紧缠在了那只鸟的脚上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 兽脚类恐龙的一个英语别称（本例取词典theropod义）
rows.en: The bird-footed dinosaur in the drawing balanced on powerful hind legs, its short arms held close to its chest.
rows.zh: 图中的兽脚类恐龙用强壮的后肢支撑身体，短小的前肢收在胸前。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 双性恋者；会对不止一种性别的人产生情感或性吸引的人（不指身体性征）
rows.en: The interviewee described herself as a bisexual person, correcting the reporter's assumption that she was straight.
rows.zh: 受访者说自己是一名双性恋者，纠正了记者以为她是异性恋的假设。
rows.author: root
rows.decisionEncoding: Membership in the original explicitly named supported/accepted collection, not a new approval.

rows.meaningZh: 每英寸比特数；线性记录密度单位（不是每平方英寸）
rows.en: The specification gives the recording density in bits per inch rather than bits per square inch.
rows.zh: 规格说明用每英寸比特数而不是每平方英寸比特数表示记录密度。
rows.author: root
rows.decisionEncoding: Membership in the original explicitly named supported/accepted collection, not a new approval.

rows.meaningZh: 碎米荠属植物（Cardamine）；本例取该植物群义
rows.en: Bitter cress had sprung up between the paving stones after the rain.
rows.zh: 雨后，铺路石的缝隙间冒出了碎米荠属植物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 烟煤（煤的一种，不泛指未经加工的原煤）
rows.en: The geologist compared a sample of bituminous coal with a piece of lignite.
rows.zh: 地质学家将一块烟煤样品与一块褐煤作比较。
rows.author: root
rows.decisionEncoding: Membership in the original explicitly named supported/accepted collection, not a new approval.

rows.meaningZh: 高山及环北极矮灌木Arctostaphylos alpina；秋叶红，果实黑或蓝黑色（旧录名）
rows.en: The black bearberry's leaves had turned red, but a few dark berries still remained.
rows.zh: Arctostaphylos alpina的叶子已变红，枝上还留着几颗深色浆果。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 澳大利亚南部的黑鲷类海鱼Acanthopagrus butcheri（本例取该种义）
rows.en: The angler released the black bream beside the jetty after taking a quick photograph.
rows.zh: 钓鱼人匆匆拍了张照片后，在码头旁放走了那条Acanthopagrus butcheri。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 黑猫（本例为普通动物，不指软件名称）
rows.en: A black cat slipped through the garden gate ahead of us.
rows.zh: 一只黑猫先于我们溜过了花园门。
rows.author: root
rows.decisionEncoding: Membership in the original explicitly named supported/accepted collection, not a new approval.

rows.meaningZh: 雄黑琴鸡；黑琴鸡的雄鸟
rows.en: We watched a black cock stride across the open moor.
rows.zh: 我们看着一只雄黑琴鸡大步走过开阔的荒原。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美山核桃树Carya tomentosa（本例取mockernut hickory义）
rows.en: The black hickory shaded the picnic table through the hottest part of the afternoon.
rows.zh: 在下午最热的那段时间，那棵Carya tomentosa为野餐桌遮住了阳光。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 黑瘤病；李、樱桃等树枝形成黑色瘤状物的病害
rows.en: The gardener spotted black knot on a plum branch while pruning the tree.
rows.zh: 园丁修剪李树时，在一根枝条上发现了黑瘤病。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 黑橄榄（本例为食用果实，不指其他同名树种）
rows.en: She removed the stone from a black olive before adding it to the salad.
rows.zh: 她先去掉一颗黑橄榄的核，再把它加进沙拉。
rows.author: root
rows.decisionEncoding: Membership in the original explicitly named supported/accepted collection, not a new approval.

rows.meaningZh: 美国大西洋沿岸海鱼Centropristis striata
rows.en: The black sea bass hovered above the reef before slipping between two rocks.
rows.zh: 那条Centropristis striata先悬游在礁石上方，随后钻进两块岩石之间。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 黑色含血呕吐物；可见于黄热病等病症的表现（本例取症状义）
rows.en: An old case report listed black vomit alongside fever and jaundice.
rows.zh: 那份旧病例报告把黑色含血呕吐物与发热、黄疸一起列入症状。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 领航鲸的俗称（本例取pilot whale义）
rows.en: The black whale remained close to its calf as the boat drifted past.
rows.zh: 船漂过时，那头领航鲸始终守在幼崽身旁。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 从牛肩胛部切下的整块烤肉用肉；肩胛部牛肉块
rows.en: He browned the blade roast before adding onions and stock to the pot.
rows.zh: 他先把那块肩胛牛肉煎至上色，再往锅里加入洋葱和高汤。
rows.author: role

rows.zh: 夜里，发光叩甲身上的亮点在黑暗的树皮衬托下格外显眼。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 地肤（Bassia scoparia，亦作Kochia scoparia）；本例取秋季叶色变红的草本植物义
rows.en: By October, the fire bush beside the gate had turned a deep red.
rows.zh: 到了十月，门边那株地肤已经变成了深红色。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 射击壕；专供以轻武器射击的战壕，并非防火沟
rows.en: Rainwater had collected at the bottom of the abandoned fire trench.
rows.zh: 废弃射击壕的底部积了雨水。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 赤足踏火者；赤脚走过燃烧炭火的人
rows.en: The audience watched the fire walker step onto the glowing coals.
rows.zh: 观众看着赤足踏火者踏上烧红的炭火。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 天人菊（Gaillardia pulchella）；本例选择植物义，非焰火轮
rows.en: The gardener planted a fire wheel for its bright yellow and red flowers.
rows.zh: 园丁种了一株天人菊，看中的正是它鲜艳的黄红双色花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 肩扛式人员搬运法；把人横扛在肩上搬运，本例为救援训练义
rows.en: In the training exercise, the rescuer used a fireman's carry to move the dummy.
rows.zh: 训练演习中，救援人员用肩扛式搬运法转移了假人。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 用于修削、开榫等工作的木工凿；本例为木工工具义
rows.en: The carpenter reached for a firmer chisel to pare the wooden joint.
rows.zh: 木匠伸手拿起木工凿，准备修削木接合处。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 乘坐头等舱；以头等舱方式旅行（本例为飞机旅行义）
rows.en: After years of crowded overnight buses, Rosa finally flew first class.
rows.zh: 多年乘坐拥挤的夜间巴士之后，罗莎终于乘头等舱坐了飞机。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 先发核打击；率先对另一个拥有核武器的国家使用核武器的攻击
rows.en: The treaty debate focused on the danger of a nuclear first strike.
rows.zh: 条约辩论集中讨论了先发核打击的危险。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 一类邮件；本例为美国邮政寄送信件、明信片等的邮件类别，不等同于特快邮件
rows.en: The clerk sent the signed letter by first-class mail.
rows.zh: 工作人员把那封签过字的信按一类邮件寄出。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鱼蛉类昆虫；本例指齿蛉科中与dobsonfly有别的fishfly成虫
rows.en: A male fish fly rested on the window with its feathery antennae spread.
rows.zh: 一只雄性鱼蛉停在窗上，张开了羽毛状的触角。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 渔人结；用相互套住的单结或双单结连接两根绳端的绳结
rows.en: He checked the fisherman's knot where the two cords were joined.
rows.zh: 他检查了两根绳子的接头处所打的渔人结。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 玉带海雕（Haliaeetus leucoryphus）；本例取这一物种义
rows.en: The fishing eagle lifted a fish from the lake and carried it towards the reeds.
rows.zh: 那只玉带海雕从湖中抓起一条鱼，带着它朝芦苇丛飞去。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 渔具；用于捕鱼、垂钓的器材（明确改正旧释义“鱼具”的不规范用字）
rows.en: He checked the fishing gear for damage after the storm.
rows.zh: 暴风雨过后，他检查了渔具有没有损坏。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 传统帆船式渔船；本例为以帆航行的smack型渔船
rows.en: The fishing smack returned to harbour with its sails wet from the rain.
rows.zh: 那艘捕鱼帆船驶回港口，船帆被雨水打湿了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 作鱼饵的蚯蚓；本例取陆生蚯蚓义，而非水生饲料生物的泛称
rows.en: Mia found a fishing worm under the damp board.
rows.zh: 米娅在潮湿的木板下面找到了一条可作鱼饵的蚯蚓。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 五百的；本例为基数词作数量定语，非纸牌游戏名称
rows.en: They printed five hundred programmes for the opening ceremony.
rows.zh: 他们为开幕式印了五百份节目单。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 固定吞噬细胞；留驻肝、脾、骨髓等组织而不在血液中循环的吞噬细胞，补全旧释义缺失的“吞”字
rows.en: The diagram labels the cell in the liver tissue as a fixed phagocyte.
rows.zh: 示意图把肝组织中的那个细胞标为固定吞噬细胞。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 对数的小数部分（尾数）；所引词典中mantissa的同义称呼
rows.en: She wrote the fixed-point part of the logarithm in a separate column.
rows.zh: 她把对数的小数部分单独写在一列中。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 小麦等禾本科作物的秆黑粉病；本例取侵害叶、茎的flag smut病害义
rows.en: The agronomist recorded flag smut in the wheat survey.
rows.zh: 农艺师在小麦调查中记录了秆黑粉病。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 彩叶草类植物；本例指Coleus属中具有彩色观赏叶的植物
rows.en: The flame nettle brought a patch of vivid colour to the shady courtyard.
rows.zh: 那株彩叶草给阴凉的庭院添上了一片鲜艳的色彩。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 猛地摔下；把东西重重地甩下（较少见的动词短语用法）
rows.en: He threatened to flap down the ledger and walk out.
rows.zh: 他扬言要把账本猛地摔下，然后走人。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 机场的停机维护区；包括停放飞机及维修机库的区域，非航线
rows.en: The ground crew towed the aircraft back onto the flight line.
rows.zh: 地勤人员把飞机拖回了停机维护区。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 不能飞行的鸟；本例为鸟类本身不具飞行能力，非暂时伤翼
rows.en: We watched a flightless bird run across the enclosure instead of taking off.
rows.zh: 我们看到一只不会飞的鸟跑过围场，并没有起飞。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 飞快地写出；轻易而迅速地写成（本例取写作义）
rows.en: She could fling off a lively paragraph even on a noisy train.
rows.zh: 即使在嘈杂的火车上，她也能飞快地写出一段生动的文字。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 湿地桉树；若干生长于湿地或冲积土壤的澳大利亚桉树的俗称，本例不擅定具体树种
rows.en: A tall flooded gum shaded the creek beside the campsite.
rows.zh: 一棵高大的湿地桉树为营地旁的小溪遮荫。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 花部变态叶；构成花的一部分的特化叶，非斑叶植物的叶片
rows.en: The botanist compared the floral leaf with an ordinary foliage leaf.
rows.zh: 植物学家把花部变态叶与普通营养叶进行了比较。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 侵害面粉或储粮的甲虫；本例取flour beetle类成虫义，非黄粉虫幼虫
rows.en: A flour weevil crawled along the seam of the flour sack.
rows.zh: 一只侵害面粉的甲虫沿着面粉袋的接缝爬行。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 花簇；一簇花形成的花序，本例不限定为伞形花序
rows.en: One flower cluster had opened, while the others were still in bud.
rows.zh: 其中一簇花已经开放，其余花簇还含苞待放。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 观花灌木；主要以花朵为观赏特点的灌木，改正旧释义“灌水”误字
rows.en: A flowering shrub hid the bare wall behind a mass of pink blossom.
rows.zh: 一株观花灌木开满粉红花朵，遮住了后面光秃秃的墙。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 流利型失语；口语流利程度相对保留的失语症类别，不仅限于一种失语症亚型
rows.en: The lecture used two recordings to compare fluent aphasia with a nonfluent form.
rows.zh: 讲座用两段录音比较了流利型失语和一种非流利型失语。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 荧光灯具；使用荧光灯作为光源的灯具，非泛指各种支架灯
rows.en: The caretaker replaced the damaged fluorescent fixture above the sink.
rows.zh: 管理员更换了水槽上方损坏的荧光灯具。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （美俚）考试或课程不及格；考砸，保留所引词典的短语动词用法
rows.en: To keep the scholarship, Jo needed to pass chemistry and could not afford to flush it.
rows.zh: 为了保住奖学金，乔必须通过化学课，不能考砸。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 磁通量单位；本例取韦伯Wb，不指磁通密度单位或普通流量单位
rows.en: The table uses the weber as its flux unit.
rows.zh: 这张表以韦伯作为磁通量单位。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （棒球）腾空球；被击向空中的球，非机械飞锤
rows.en: The outfielder lost sight of the fly ball against the evening sky.
rows.zh: 外野手在暮色中的天空背景下看丢了那记腾空球。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 靠可见地标目视驾驶飞机；与依靠仪表飞行相区别的用语
rows.en: The old training manual required students to fly contact before learning to fly by instruments.
rows.zh: 那本旧训练手册要求学员先学会目视飞行，再学仪表飞行。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美落叶灌木Lonicera canadensis，开黄白色花；本例明确选择该种忍冬
rows.en: A fly honeysuckle was flowering at the edge of the woodland.
rows.zh: 林缘的一株Lonicera canadensis正在开花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 继续飞行；飞往更远处（本例为持续飞行义）
rows.en: The geese will fly on until they reach the lake.
rows.zh: 雁群会继续飞行，直到到达湖边。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 船身式水上飞机；以船形机身直接浮在水面上的飞机，区别于浮筒式飞机
rows.en: The flying boat taxied across the sheltered bay before taking off.
rows.zh: 那架船身式水上飞机起飞前在避风海湾的水面上滑行。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 飞行炸弹；本例指V-1一类带翼、无人驾驶的喷气式飞行炸弹，而非所有飞弹
rows.en: The exhibition displayed the casing of a wartime flying bomb.
rows.zh: 展览陈列了一枚战时飞行炸弹的外壳。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 上层驾驶台；船上驾驶室上方的小型导航甲板，非浮桥
rows.en: The captain climbed to the flying bridge for a clearer view of the harbour.
rows.zh: 船长登上上层驾驶台，以便更清楚地观察港口。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 飞机场；供飞机起降的场地，本身不限定私人所有
rows.en: The flying field was quiet until the first training aircraft arrived.
rows.zh: 直到第一架教练机到来，那个飞机场才打破了寂静。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 豹鲂鮄科海鱼（Dactylopteridae），具有宽大的扇状胸鳍；修复旧释义罕字损坏
rows.en: The flying gurnard spread its broad pectoral fins above the sandy bottom.
rows.zh: 那条豹鲂鮄在沙质海底上方展开了宽大的胸鳍。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 摔跤中的一种过肩摔动作；本例为flying mare抛摔义
rows.en: The coach demonstrated a flying mare on the practice mat.
rows.zh: 教练在训练垫上示范了一个过肩摔动作。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 局灶性发作；从脑部一侧某一区域起始的癫痫发作，非癫痫疾病诊断本身
rows.en: The neurologist asked whether awareness had changed during the focal seizure.
rows.zh: 神经科医生询问，那次局灶性发作期间患者的意识是否发生了变化。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 民间词源说；大众流传但错误的词源解释（本例取解释义）
rows.en: The guide repeated a folk etymology that the linguist had already disproved.
rows.zh: 导游重复了一种已被语言学家证伪的民间词源解释。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 食用色素；用于使食品着色的物质，而非着色动作
rows.en: The blue food coloring left a stain on the baker's apron.
rows.zh: 蓝色食用色素在面包师的围裙上留下了一块污渍。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 追逐饮食时尚的人；常常转向不同新式饮食法的人
rows.en: As a food faddist, he was eager to try the latest fashionable diet.
rows.zh: 作为一个追逐饮食时尚的人，他急着尝试最新流行的饮食法。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 旧时罚学生戴的圆锥形纸帽；本例取dunce cap义，非弄臣帽
rows.en: An old classroom photograph showed a pupil wearing a paper fool's cap.
rows.zh: 一张旧教室照片里，一名学生戴着受罚用的圆锥形纸帽。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 有毒草本植物Aethusa cynapium，外形似欧芹；并非所有中文称“毒芹”的植物
rows.en: The herbarium kept the fool's parsley specimen separate from the edible parsley.
rows.zh: 标本馆把这份Aethusa cynapium标本与食用欧芹的标本分开存放。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 跑步比赛；以跑步方式竞赛，而非竞走
rows.en: The school held a short foot race across the playing field.
rows.zh: 学校在操场上举办了一场短距离跑步比赛。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 足球比赛；本例选择英式足球赛事这一名词义
rows.en: The football game ended with a penalty shoot-out.
rows.zh: 那场足球比赛以点球大战决出胜负。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 简直；完全（用于比较，表示看起来、听起来等恰似某物）
rows.en: In the mist, the old shed looked for all the world like a stranded boat.
rows.zh: 雾中，那间旧棚屋看起来简直像一艘搁浅的船。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 国外汇票；在一国开立、在另一国付款的汇票，本例不限定票面币种
rows.en: The bank checked which country the foreign draft was payable in.
rows.zh: 银行核对了这张国外汇票应在哪个国家付款。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 词类；按词在语法结构中的功能划分的一类词
rows.en: The exercise asks students to assign each underlined word to a form class.
rows.zh: 这道练习要求学生把每个画线词归入一个词类。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 向前传球者；美式橄榄球中尝试通过向前传球推进的持球队员
rows.en: The forward passer spotted an unmarked receiver near the sideline.
rows.zh: 向前传球的持球队员发现边线附近有一名无人盯防的接球队员。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 寄养兄弟；与自己在同一家庭照料下长大、但非亲生兄弟的男性，非同奶兄弟
rows.en: Her foster brother kept in touch after they left the same foster home.
rows.zh: 他们离开同一个寄养家庭后，她的寄养兄弟仍与她保持联系。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （棒球）界外球；明确修正旧释义标错的运动项目
rows.en: The foul ball landed in the empty seats behind home plate.
rows.zh: 那记界外球落在本垒后面的空座位上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （常作the Four Hundred）一座城市的上流社交圈；名流群体（社交称谓，非普通数量词）
rows.en: The city's Four Hundred gathered for the winter charity ball.
rows.zh: 城里的名流齐聚冬季慈善舞会。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美狐松鼠（Sciurus niger）；本例为物种名而非其他松鼠的黑色型
rows.en: A fox squirrel carried a walnut across the lawn.
rows.zh: 一只北美狐松鼠叼着一颗核桃穿过草坪。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 猎狐梗犬；特定梗犬类名称，而非泛指所有猎狐小狗
rows.en: A fox terrier waited by the gate with a ball in its mouth.
rows.zh: 一只猎狐梗叼着球，在门边等候。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蕨类植物Cystopteris fragilis，叶片细薄、柄茎易折；并非骨脆症
rows.en: A fragile fern grew from a crack in the limestone wall.
rows.zh: 一株Cystopteris fragilis从石灰岩墙的裂缝中长了出来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 大学兄弟会的住宅或宿舍；指房屋而非联谊组织本身
rows.en: A burst pipe flooded the kitchen in the frat house.
rows.zh: 一根水管爆裂，淹了兄弟会宿舍里的厨房。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 自由燃弧的；本例指非约束式自由电弧放电，非泛指材料易燃
rows.en: The researchers photographed the free-burning arc between the electrodes.
rows.zh: 研究人员拍摄了电极之间自由电弧的照片。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 自由重量器械；不连接固定器械、靠手臂举放的训练重物
rows.en: She returned the free weight to its rack after the last repetition.
rows.zh: 完成最后一次动作后，她把那个自由重量器械放回了架上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 犬吻蝠科（Molossidae）蝙蝠，其尾端伸出股间膜之外
rows.en: A free-tailed bat emerged from under the roof tiles just after sunset.
rows.zh: 日落后不久，一只犬吻蝠科的蝙蝠从屋瓦下钻了出来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鲜豆；未成熟时鲜食的豆类，本例为鲜嫩豆荚，不限定刀豆这一物种
rows.en: The cook snapped a fresh bean in half to check its tenderness.
rows.zh: 厨师把一根鲜豆荚掰成两半，检查它是否还嫩。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Gentianopsis属的龙胆类植物，花冠裂片边缘呈流苏状
rows.en: A fringed gentian opened its blue flower beside the wet meadow path.
rows.zh: 湿草甸的小径旁，一株花冠边缘呈流苏状的龙胆开出了蓝花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 不知从何处；突然地（本例为突然出现义）
rows.en: A delivery cyclist seemed to appear from nowhere and rang his bell.
rows.zh: 一名送货骑手仿佛不知从哪儿冒了出来，按响了车铃。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 客厅；住宅中供人坐下交谈、休息的起居室
rows.en: They moved the armchairs into the front room before the visitors arrived.
rows.zh: 客人到来前，他们把扶手椅搬进了客厅。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 小鳕鱼；本例取北美tomcod义，即Microgadus属鱼类
rows.en: The angler released the frost fish after checking its size.
rows.zh: 钓者量过大小后，把那条北美小鳕鱼放回水中。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （比喻）极为愤怒；气得口沫横飞
rows.en: He began to froth at the mouth when the meeting was cancelled.
rows.zh: 会议一取消，他就气得口沫横飞。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蛋奶冻冰淇淋；以煮制蛋奶糊为基底的冷冻甜品
rows.en: We bought frozen custard from the little shop opposite the pier.
rows.zh: 我们在码头对面的小店买了蛋奶冻冰淇淋。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 修正因子；为调整结果或补偿测量、估算中的不确定性而引入的数值
rows.en: The reviewer questioned the unexplained fudge factor in the cost estimate.
rows.zh: 审阅者质疑了成本估算中那个没有说明依据的修正因子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 燃油系统；给发动机供给燃料的设备系统
rows.en: The mechanic checked the fuel system before trying to restart the engine.
rows.zh: 机械师先检查了燃油系统，再尝试重新启动发动机。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 全成形针织的；按衣片形状编织制成的
rows.en: The shop displayed a fully-fashioned cardigan with neatly joined seams.
rows.zh: 商店陈列着一件按形编织后拼缝的开襟毛衣，接缝整齐。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 完全长成的；已达到成年体型的
rows.en: The fully grown cat was still smaller than the puppy.
rows.zh: 那只已经长成的猫，体型仍比小狗小。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 功能性文盲的；读写能力不足以应付日常实际需要的
rows.en: The course was designed for adults who were functionally illiterate but had years of practical work experience.
rows.zh: 这门课程面向读写能力不足以应付日常需要、但已有多年实际工作经验的成年人。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 斜桁顶帆；张设于斜桁上方的三角形纵帆
rows.en: The crew lowered the gaff topsail as the wind strengthened.
rows.zh: 风力增强时，船员们降下了斜桁上方的顶帆。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 缺音音阶；少于七个音的音阶，如五声音阶
rows.en: The composer used a gapped scale to give the melody a sparse, open sound.
rows.zh: 作曲家采用了省略部分音级的音阶，让旋律显得疏朗开阔。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 垃圾堆放场；用来倾倒垃圾的地点
rows.en: The old garbage dump was fenced off while the council planned its restoration.
rows.zh: 市政部门规划修复方案期间，旧垃圾堆放场被围栏封了起来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 茄（Solanum melongena）；本例取食用茄果义
rows.en: She sliced a garden egg and added it to the stew.
rows.zh: 她把一个茄子切片，放进炖菜里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 酸模（Rumex acetosa）；本例选择这一食用酸味叶菜植物义
rows.en: She added a few leaves of garden sorrel to the soup for a sharp flavour.
rows.zh: 她在汤里加了几片酸模叶，让汤多些酸味。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 庭园网螟Achyra rantalis的幼虫；会在植物叶上结网的毛虫
rows.en: The gardener found a garden webworm feeding inside a webbed leaf.
rows.zh: 园丁在一片被丝网裹住的叶子里，发现了一条Achyra rantalis幼虫正在取食。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 瑞香属灌木Daphne cneorum；低矮、常绿，开粉红花
rows.en: The garland flower covered the rockery with small pink blossoms.
rows.zh: 这株Daphne cneorum开出小小的粉红花朵，铺满了假山石园。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 韭菜（Allium tuberosum）；本例取植株义
rows.en: A garlic chive grew through a gap between the paving stones.
rows.zh: 一株韭菜从铺路石之间的缝隙里长了出来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蒜味酱；本例取以大蒜调味的蛋黄酱aioli义
rows.en: She whisked crushed garlic into the mayonnaise to make garlic sauce.
rows.zh: 她把捣碎的大蒜搅进蛋黄酱里，调成了蒜味酱。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 旅行衣物袋；可展开悬挂衣物的行李袋，本例不限定塑料材质
rows.en: He unzipped the garment bag and hung the suit in the wardrobe.
rows.zh: 他拉开旅行衣物袋的拉链，把西装挂进衣柜。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 搓板针；平织时每行均织下针、形成横向凸棱的针织组织
rows.en: She chose garter stitch for the scarf because it produced a ridged texture.
rows.zh: 她选择用搓板针织围巾，因为它能织出带凸棱的纹理。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 汽车油量表；显示油箱中剩余汽油量的仪表，采用gage拼法
rows.en: The gas gage showed that there was little fuel left in the tank.
rows.zh: 汽车油量表显示，油箱里剩下的燃油已经不多。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 汽车油量表；显示油箱中剩余汽油量的仪表，采用gauge拼法
rows.en: She glanced at the gas gauge before choosing the longer route.
rows.zh: 她在选择较长的路线之前，看了一眼汽车油量表。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 气体弹发射枪；本例指发射气体弹的枪，而非导气式自动枪
rows.en: An old gas gun stood in the museum's collection of crowd-control equipment.
rows.zh: 博物馆的防暴装备藏品中陈列着一支旧式气体弹发射枪。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （美）汽车加油机；供给汽油的加油设备
rows.en: A delivery van blocked the only working gas pump.
rows.zh: 一辆送货货车堵住了唯一还能用的加油机。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 遗传禀赋；个体继承的遗传特征或遗传构成
rows.en: The study considered both genetic endowment and the conditions in which the children grew up.
rows.zh: 这项研究同时考虑了遗传禀赋和孩子们成长的环境条件。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 地理英里；所引词典用作nautical mile（海里）的同义名称，本例不指定换算值
rows.en: The navigator used a geographical mile as the distance unit in the logbook.
rows.zh: 领航员在航海日志中以地理英里作为距离单位。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 婆婆纳属植物Veronica chamaedrys，通常开蓝白色花
rows.en: Blue germander speedwell flowered along the woodland path.
rows.zh: 林间小路旁的Veronica chamaedrys开着蓝花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （非正式）发生性关系
rows.en: The scene implies that the two adults get it on, then cuts to the next morning.
rows.zh: 这一幕暗示两个成年人发生了性关系，随后镜头切换到次日清晨。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 开始；着手做事
rows.en: Let's get started before the light fades.
rows.zh: 趁天色还没暗下来，我们开始吧。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 抢先；抢在他人之前采取行动或取得优势（常接on）
rows.en: They hoped to get the jump on rival teams by testing the equipment early.
rows.zh: 他们希望通过提早测试设备，抢先于其他队伍。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 听闻；得知（多指偶然得知某事）
rows.en: If the neighbours get wind of the surprise, the whole plan will be ruined.
rows.zh: 如果邻居们听说了这个惊喜安排，整个计划就泡汤了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 幽灵词；由误读、误印等错误产生、又被当成真实词流传的词形
rows.en: The lexicographer traced the ghost word to a misread handwritten note.
rows.zh: 词典编纂者追查发现，这个幽灵词源于对一张手写便条的误读。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 日本蜘蛛蟹（Macrocheira kaempferi）；本例选择这一物种义
rows.en: The aquarium's giant crab moved its long legs slowly across the tank floor.
rows.zh: 水族馆里的日本蜘蛛蟹缓慢地移动长腿，沿着水槽底部爬行。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 欧洲大胡蜂（Vespa crabro）；本例选择该物种义
rows.en: The giant hornet paused on the fallen apple before flying back into the trees.
rows.zh: 那只欧洲大胡蜂在落地的苹果上停了一会儿，然后飞回树间。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 科莫多巨蜥（Varanus komodoensis）；本例取物种义
rows.en: Visitors watched the giant lizard walk past the keeper's shelter.
rows.zh: 游客们看着那只科莫多巨蜥从饲养员的遮棚旁走过。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 巨型雪纳瑞犬；一种大型雪纳瑞犬品种
rows.en: The giant schnauzer rested beside its handler after the obedience exercise.
rows.zh: 服从训练结束后，那只巨型雪纳瑞犬在训导员身边休息。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 大型天蚕蛾类的幼虫；本例取天蚕蛾科毛虫义，非成蛾
rows.en: The giant silkworm gripped the twig while it chewed a fresh leaf.
rows.zh: 那条大型天蚕蛾幼虫抓住细枝，啃着一片新鲜叶子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 白得的礼物或好处；常用于look a gift horse in the mouth这一习语
rows.en: We weren't going to look a gift horse in the mouth when the theatre offered us free rehearsal space.
rows.zh: 剧院愿意免费借给我们排练场地，我们可不会再挑三拣四。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 礼品包装纸；用于包装礼物的纸张
rows.en: She cut a sheet of silver gift wrap for the box.
rows.zh: 她剪下一张银色礼品包装纸，准备包盒子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （口语，略粗俗）在乎；关心（常用于否定句）
rows.en: I don't give a damn about the colour as long as the chair is comfortable.
rows.zh: 只要椅子坐着舒服，我一点也不在乎它是什么颜色。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 提供照护；照料人
rows.en: The charity recruited more volunteers to give care to older residents.
rows.zh: 慈善机构招募了更多志愿者，为年长居民提供照护。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 向人眉目传情；投去含情或诱惑的目光（旧式说法）
rows.en: He tried to give the glad eye to the pianist.
rows.zh: 他试着向钢琴演奏者眉目传情。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 宣泄；表达情绪（常接to）
rows.en: She used her diary to give vent to feelings she could not express at work.
rows.zh: 她用日记宣泄那些在工作中无法表达的情绪。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 断气；本例比喻机器彻底停止工作，采用通常分写形式give up the ghost
rows.en: We replaced the kettle before it could give up the ghost completely.
rows.zh: 我们趁那只水壶还没彻底坏掉，就换了新的。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 锦葵科草本Napaea dioica；原产北美，掌状叶、白色小花
rows.en: The glade mallow rose above the other plants in the damp meadow.
rows.zh: 潮湿草甸里的Napaea dioica长得比周围的植物都高。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蛇蜥类蜥蜴；身体细长似蛇，尾长而易断
rows.en: The glass snake moved through the dry grass beside the path.
rows.zh: 那只蛇蜥穿过小路旁的干草丛。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 金莲花属（Trollius）植物，具有近球状的黄色花
rows.en: A globe flower opened its yellow bloom beside the pond.
rows.zh: 池塘边的一株金莲花属植物开出了黄色的花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 光泽蛇（Arizona elegans）；鳞片表面有光泽的夜行蛇
rows.en: The glossy snake's scales reflected the light from the torch.
rows.zh: 那条光泽蛇的鳞片反射着手电筒的光。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 金链花（Laburnum anagyroides）；开下垂黄色花串的观赏树
rows.en: The golden rain beside the gate was covered in hanging clusters of yellow flowers.
rows.zh: 门旁那棵金链花挂满了一串串下垂的黄花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 加利福尼亚植物Bloomeria crocea，具有狭长叶片和黄色花朵
rows.en: Yellow blossoms of the golden star rose above its narrow leaves.
rows.zh: 这株Bloomeria crocea的狭长叶片上方开出了黄色小花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Bloomeria crocea的俗名，指一种开黄色花的加利福尼亚植物
rows.en: The meadow was dotted with golden stars after the spring rain.
rows.zh: 春雨过后，草地上点缀着一簇簇Bloomeria crocea的花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 黄森莺（yellow warbler）；所引词典使用旧学名Dendroica petechia
rows.en: A golden warbler sang from a willow beside the stream.
rows.zh: 一只黄森莺在溪边的柳树上鸣叫。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鸣锣浮标；装有受波浪运动而敲响的锣片的助航浮标
rows.en: We heard the gong buoy clanging beyond the harbour entrance.
rows.zh: 我们听见港口入口外的鸣锣浮标铛铛作响。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 对你有益的；尤指对健康有积极作用的（形容词短语义）
rows.en: Even a short break from the screen can be good for you.
rows.zh: 即使短暂离开屏幕休息一下，也可能对你有好处。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （美，非正式，常带批评意味）重视圈内人情互助的美国南部保守白人男子
rows.en: Critics portrayed the mayor as a good old boy who always gave his friends a place at the table.
rows.zh: 批评者把这位市长描绘成典型的南方保守派圈内人，总给自己的朋友留一席之地。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鹅颈藤壶；具有柔软柄部、可附着于浮木等物体上的有柄藤壶
rows.en: A goose barnacle clung to the underside of the driftwood.
rows.zh: 一只鹅颈藤壶附着在浮木底面。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鹅颈藤壶；本例取附着于浮木等物体上的有柄藤壶义
rows.en: A cluster of gooseneck barnacles hung from the waterlogged branch.
rows.zh: 一簇鹅颈藤壶垂挂在那根浸透水的树枝上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 囊地鼠挖出的地洞
rows.en: The gardener's boot sank into a gopher hole hidden by tall grass.
rows.zh: 园丁一脚踩进了一个被高草遮住的囊地鼠洞。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 政府发放的物资；本例指配发的毯子
rows.en: The old blanket was government issue, with a faded number stitched into one corner.
rows.zh: 那条旧毯子是政府发放的物资，一角缝着一个褪色的编号。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 成绩绩点；用于计算平均成绩的数字分值，可与课程学分结合加权
rows.en: The spreadsheet lists the grade point value next to each letter grade.
rows.zh: 电子表格在每个字母成绩旁列出了相应的绩点数值。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 西印度群岛树木Brya ebenus，又称granadillo或cocus tree，可提供优质木材
rows.en: The gardener left room for the granadilla tree to spread its branches.
rows.zh: 园丁给这棵Brya ebenus树留出了伸展枝条的空间。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Brya ebenus树的木材（cocuswood），可用于制作乐器
rows.en: The instrument maker inspected the granadilla wood for cracks before cutting it.
rows.zh: 乐器制作师在切割这块Brya ebenus木料前，先检查了有无裂纹。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 抓钩；通常连在绳索上、用来抓住或固定物体的多爪钩
rows.en: An old grappling hook hung from the beam in the boathouse.
rows.zh: 船屋横梁上挂着一只旧抓钩。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 界定不清的领域或问题；处于不同类别之间的模糊地带
rows.en: Who owns the training data is still a gray area in the contract.
rows.zh: 训练数据归谁所有，在合同中仍是一个界定不清的问题。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 雌黑琴鸡；黑琴鸡的雌鸟，gray为美式拼法
rows.en: The gray hen disappeared into the heather as the hikers approached.
rows.zh: 徒步者走近时，那只雌黑琴鸡钻进了石南丛。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 杨属杂交树Populus × canescens，叶背灰白；gray为美式拼法
rows.en: The gray poplar's pale leaf undersides flashed as the wind turned its branches.
rows.zh: 风吹动枝条时，这棵Populus × canescens灰白的叶背闪现出来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 灰鲸（Eschrichtius robustus）；本例指一头鲸，而非科名
rows.en: The gray whale surfaced once before vanishing into the mist.
rows.zh: 那头灰鲸浮出水面一次，随后消失在雾中。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 城堡或宅邸的主大厅，可用于宴饮或集会
rows.en: Guests gathered around the long tables in the great hall.
rows.zh: 宾客们围聚在主大厅里的长桌旁。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 槭树Acer pseudoplatanus，又称sycamore maple，原产欧亚
rows.en: A fallen leaf from the great maple lay on the garden bench.
rows.zh: 花园长凳上落着一片Acer pseudoplatanus的叶子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 梣属乔木Fraxinus pennsylvanica，英文称green ash
rows.en: The green ash beside the fence cast a long shadow across the lawn.
rows.zh: 篱笆旁那棵Fraxinus pennsylvanica在草坪上投下长长的影子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 绿豆；绿豆植物的食用种子
rows.en: She soaked the green gram overnight before making a thick soup.
rows.zh: 她先把绿豆浸泡一夜，再熬成浓汤。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 农产品市场；销售蔬果等农产品的露天市场
rows.en: We bought fresh peas at the green market in the town square.
rows.zh: 我们在小镇广场的农产品市场买了些新鲜豌豆。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美绿蛇；本例取Opheodrys属体色绿色、主要食虫的小蛇义
rows.en: A green snake lay almost invisible along the leafy stem.
rows.zh: 一条北美绿蛇伏在带叶的茎上，几乎看不出来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 细纹斑马（Equus grevyi）
rows.en: An adult Grevy's zebra stood apart from the rest of the herd.
rows.zh: 一头成年细纹斑马站在离群体里其他斑马稍远的地方。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 杨属杂交树Populus × canescens，叶背灰白；grey为英式拼法
rows.en: A young grey poplar had taken root near the edge of the field.
rows.zh: 一棵幼小的Populus × canescens在田边扎下了根。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 装食品杂货的购物袋
rows.en: The bottom of the grocery bag tore just as she reached the kitchen.
rows.zh: 她刚走到厨房，购物袋的底部就裂开了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 粗针绣；使用较大针脚在网眼底布上刺绣的针绣
rows.en: She used gros point for the broad blocks of colour in the cushion cover.
rows.zh: 她用粗针绣在靠垫套上绣出大块的色彩。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 毛利率；毛利占净销售收入的比率
rows.en: Despite higher sales, the bakery's gross profit margin fell from 35 percent to 30 percent.
rows.zh: 尽管销售额增加，这家面包店的毛利率仍从35%降到了30%。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 撒在水中诱鱼的饵料；窝料（名词）
rows.en: The ground bait was still in its bucket when the rain forced us to leave.
rows.zh: 雨势逼得我们离开时，窝料还留在桶里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 酸浆属Physalis植物，果实外包有膨大的囊状宿存萼
rows.en: A ground cherry grew between the tomato rows, its fruit enclosed in papery husks.
rows.zh: 一株酸浆属植物长在番茄行间，果实包在纸质囊状宿存萼里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 地下火；在林地腐殖质等地下有机层中燃烧的火
rows.en: Smoke from the ground fire continued to seep through the damp forest floor.
rows.zh: 地下火的烟仍不断从潮湿的林地表面渗出。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 石松类植物的俗名；本例取具匍匐茎和直立枝的石松义
rows.en: A patch of ground pine spread beneath the birches.
rows.zh: 白桦树下，一片石松类植物向四周蔓延。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 地佛法僧；马达加斯加主要在地面活动、取食昆虫等小动物的鸟类
rows.en: A ground roller slipped across the trail and vanished into the undergrowth.
rows.zh: 一只地佛法僧穿过小径，消失在灌木丛中。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （网球）落地击球；球弹地一次后作出的击球
rows.en: Her first ground stroke landed deep near the baseline.
rows.zh: 她第一记落地击球打得很深，落在底线附近。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 欧洲荚蒾（Viburnum opulus）；开白花的落叶灌木
rows.en: White flowers covered the guelder rose by the gate.
rows.zh: 门边那株欧洲荚蒾开满了白花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 澳大拉西亚的黄花常绿攀援藤本，亦称guinea flower
rows.en: A guinea gold vine climbed over the sunny side of the pergola.
rows.zh: 一株黄花常绿藤本攀上了花架向阳的一侧。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （俚语，旧用语）黑帮成员的女友或情妇
rows.en: In the crime film, the gun moll hides the gangster's letters in a hatbox.
rows.zh: 那部犯罪片里，黑帮成员的女友把他的信藏进帽盒。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 英国军舰上供海军候补军官及低级军官使用的舱室
rows.en: The diary describes supper in the gun room with the other junior officers.
rows.zh: 日记记载了与其他低级军官一起在军官舱室用晚餐的情景。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （美，旧用语）仅获准电召或预约载客、却沿街揽客的出租车；称呼可能被认为不妥
rows.en: Although licensed only for bookings, the gypsy cab was cruising for fares outside the station.
rows.zh: 这辆出租车虽只获准接受预约，却仍在车站外兜揽乘客。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美忍冬属植物Lonicera hirsuta，具有毛茸叶片和黄橙色花
rows.en: The hairy honeysuckle twined through the shrubs at the woodland edge.
rows.zh: 林缘的Lonicera hirsuta在灌木间缠绕生长。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 飞扬草（Euphorbia hirta），具有毛茸茎的草本植物
rows.en: A hairy spurge had sprung up in a crack beside the steps.
rows.zh: 台阶旁的裂缝里长出了一株飞扬草。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 同父异母或同母异父的亲属关系；本例取关系义
rows.en: Under the old inheritance rules, kinship of the half blood was treated differently.
rows.zh: 按旧时的继承规则，同父异母或同母异父的亲属关系受到不同处理。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 半履带车辆；前部使用车轮、后部使用履带的机动车
rows.en: An abandoned half track stood beside the ruined bridge.
rows.zh: 毁坏的桥旁停着一辆被遗弃的半履带车辆。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 手捏奶酪；原来用手捏制成形的一类奶酪
rows.en: She cut the small round of hand cheese into four pieces.
rows.zh: 她把那块小圆形手捏奶酪切成了四份。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蕨类植物Blechnum spicant，英文称hard fern
rows.en: The hard fern remained green beneath a light covering of snow.
rows.zh: 薄薄的积雪下，那株Blechnum spicant仍是绿色的。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 硬壳蟹；近期没有蜕壳、因而外壳已经硬化的食用蟹
rows.en: The fishmonger weighed a hard-shell crab on the old metal scale.
rows.zh: 鱼贩用那台旧金属秤称了一只硬壳蟹。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 兔脚蕨类（Davallia属）；具有柔软毛茸根茎的蕨类
rows.en: The hairy rhizomes of the hare's-foot fern crept over the rim of its pot.
rows.zh: 这盆兔脚蕨毛茸茸的根茎伸展到了花盆边缘外。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鱼叉炮；发射鱼叉的炮或类似装置
rows.en: An old harpoon gun stood beside the whaling photographs in the museum.
rows.zh: 博物馆的捕鲸照片旁陈列着一门旧式鱼叉炮。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 管鼻果蝠类（Nyctimene属）；鼻孔呈分叉管状的果蝠
rows.en: The harpy bat's tube-shaped nostrils were clear in the close-up photograph.
rows.zh: 特写照片清楚显示了这只Nyctimene属果蝠管状的鼻孔。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 哈他瑜伽；结合身体姿势与呼吸练习的瑜伽体系
rows.en: The hatha yoga class began with a few quiet minutes of breathing.
rows.zh: 哈他瑜伽课以几分钟安静的呼吸练习开始。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 用车辆运走；拉走
rows.en: The council hired a truck to haul off the broken branches.
rows.zh: 市政部门雇了一辆卡车把折断的树枝运走。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 熟练掌握（常用have something down结构）
rows.en: Once I have the basic steps down, I'll try the faster version.
rows.zh: 等我熟练掌握基本步骤后，就会尝试速度更快的版本。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 猛鸮（Surnia ulula）；北方的鹰形鸮鸟
rows.en: The hawk owl watched the clearing from the top of a dead spruce.
rows.zh: 那只猛鸮站在一棵枯云杉的顶端，注视着林间空地。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 出售吸食大麻等所用器具及相关用品的商店
rows.en: The head shop displayed glass pipes and incense in the window.
rows.zh: 那家烟具用品店的橱窗里陈列着玻璃烟斗和熏香。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 夏枯草（Prunella vulgaris）；本例取植物义，不表示疗效
rows.en: Purple spikes of heal-all rose above the short grass.
rows.zh: 矮草丛上方长出了夏枯草的紫色花穗。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 健康检查；评估身体健康状况的体检
rows.en: The clinic offered a health check before the start of the training programme.
rows.zh: 培训项目开始前，诊所提供了一次健康检查。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 健身保健中心；提供锻炼设施的营业场所
rows.en: The health spa had a small exercise room overlooking the garden.
rows.zh: 那家健身保健中心有一间面向花园的小健身房。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 罗马天主教徒每年捐给教廷的捐金；Peter’s Pence的同义名
rows.en: Parish records list the hearth money collected for Rome that year.
rows.zh: 教区记录列出了当年为罗马教廷收取的捐金。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 加热过的；已经变热的
rows.en: Steam rose from the heated-up soup on the counter.
rows.zh: 柜台上热好的汤冒着蒸汽。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 已灭绝的北美草原松鸡，传统学名Tympanuchus cupido cupido
rows.en: For the exhibition, the museum borrowed a mounted heath hen.
rows.zh: 为举办展览，博物馆借来了一件这种已灭绝的北美草原松鸡的剥制标本。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 从Hedeoma pulegioides（American pennyroyal）提取的芳香挥发油
rows.en: The chemist kept the hedeoma oil in a tightly sealed amber bottle.
rows.zh: 化学师用密封严实的棕色瓶保存这种挥发油。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Echinocereus属的仙人掌，通常具有显著尖刺
rows.en: A hedgehog cactus grew between two sun-warmed rocks.
rows.zh: 两块被太阳晒暖的岩石之间，长着一株Echinocereus属仙人掌。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （较旧的说法）慌乱匆忙地；乱糟糟地
rows.en: The servants rushed heels over head to prepare for the unexpected guests.
rows.zh: 仆人们手忙脚乱地赶着为突然到访的客人做准备。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 自行取用；自取（常接to，尤用于食物等）
rows.en: Visitors are welcome to help themselves to apples from the basket.
rows.zh: 欢迎访客自行取用篮子里的苹果。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 唇形科植物Galeopsis tetrahit，具有硬毛和白色或淡红色花
rows.en: The hemp nettle grew taller than the young cabbages around it.
rows.zh: 这株Galeopsis tetrahit长得比周围的小卷心菜还高。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 丁型肝炎；由丁肝病毒引起、依赖乙肝病毒感染而发生的肝炎
rows.en: Her research focuses on hepatitis delta and its interaction with hepatitis B.
rows.zh: 她的研究聚焦于丁型肝炎及其与乙型肝炎的相互关系。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 草本茶；用草本植物的叶等冲泡的茶样饮料
rows.en: He offered me a cup of herb tea made with dried mint.
rows.zh: 他给我端来一杯用干薄荷泡的草本茶。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 菊科草本植物Filago germanica，具有棉絮状毛
rows.en: The botanist examined the woolly leaves of herba impia with a hand lens.
rows.zh: 植物学家用手持放大镜观察Filago germanica带绒毛的叶片。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 梯牧草（Phleum pratense）；本例取常栽作干草的牧草义
rows.en: The farmer cut the herd's grass before its long flower spikes had fully ripened.
rows.zh: 农民在梯牧草的长花穗完全成熟前收割了它。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 前桅挂横帆、后桅挂纵帆的双桅帆船；brigantine的同义称呼
rows.en: The painting shows a hermaphrodite brig entering the harbour under reduced sail.
rows.zh: 画中，一艘只张了部分帆的前横后纵帆式双桅帆船正驶入港口。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 寄居蟹；腹部柔软、常住在空螺壳中的甲壳动物
rows.en: At the slightest movement, the hermit crab withdrew into its shell.
rows.zh: 稍有动静，那只寄居蟹就缩回它寄住的贝壳里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 把英雄或名人当作偶像而强烈崇拜的人；worshiper为美式拼法
rows.en: As a young hero worshiper, he copied the runner's haircut as well as his training clothes.
rows.zh: 年轻时，他把那位赛跑运动员当作偶像，连发型和训练服都照着模仿。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 把英雄或名人当作偶像而强烈崇拜的人；worshipper为英式拼法
rows.en: The biographer was determined to be a critic rather than a hero worshipper.
rows.zh: 那位传记作者决心做一名批评者，而不做人物的盲目崇拜者。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 英雄双韵体对句；两行押韵的抑扬格五音步诗句
rows.en: He ended the stanza with a neat heroic couplet.
rows.zh: 他用两行工整的抑扬格五音步押韵诗句收住了这个诗节。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 山核桃属Carya树木的坚果，尤指北美山核桃
rows.en: The squirrel rolled a hickory nut across the porch.
rows.zh: 松鼠把一颗山核桃滚过了门廊。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 髋臼；与股骨头相接的髋关节窝部
rows.en: The diagram showed how the ball of the femur fits into the hip socket.
rows.zh: 图中展示了股骨头如何嵌入髋臼。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 雇来的农工；受雇在农场或牧场劳动的人
rows.en: The hired hand was already mending the fence when the farmer arrived.
rows.zh: 农场主到来时，雇来的农工已经在修篱笆。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 暂停招聘；某个雇主或机构暂时停止招收新员工的措施
rows.en: The museum announced a hiring freeze while it reviewed next year's budget.
rows.zh: 博物馆在审查来年预算期间宣布暂停招聘。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 工会经营的职业介绍或派工所，按资历或轮派等方式分配工作
rows.en: By six in the morning, dockworkers were waiting at the union's hiring hall.
rows.zh: 早晨六点，码头工人们已经在工会的派工所等候。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 组胺H2受体阻断剂；通过阻断H2受体来抑制组胺作用的药物
rows.en: The lecture compared two histamine blockers that act at H2 receptors.
rows.zh: 这堂课比较了两种作用于H2受体的组胺阻断剂。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 使人切实体会或充分理解；产生切身影响
rows.en: The cost of the delays hit home when we received the final invoice.
rows.zh: 收到最终账单时，我们才切实体会到延误造成的代价。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （旧俚语）纵酒；过量饮酒
rows.en: In the novel, he would hit it up at the same shabby bar after every payday.
rows.zh: 小说里，他每逢发薪后都会去同一家破旧酒吧狂饮一番。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （非正式）上床睡觉；就寝
rows.en: It was nearly midnight when I finally decided to hit the hay.
rows.zh: 等我终于决定去睡觉时，已经快半夜了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 灰毛豆属Tephrosia植物，具有羽状叶和扁平有毛的荚果
rows.en: The hoary pea's pale, hairy leaves stood out against the darker grasses.
rows.zh: 这株Tephrosia属植物灰白多毛的叶片，在深色草丛中格外显眼。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美柳属灌木Salix candida，叶片灰白多毛
rows.en: The hoary willow bent over a shallow pool at the edge of the marsh.
rows.zh: 沼泽边，一株Salix candida俯垂在浅水潭上方。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 给泥瓦匠搬运砖块、灰浆等材料的小工
rows.en: The hod carrier set down his load beside the bricklayers.
rows.zh: 给泥瓦匠运料的小工把搬来的材料放在砌砖工身旁。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 热带果树Spondias mombin的黄色果实，又称yellow mombin
rows.en: The ripe hog plum left a sharp, sour taste in her mouth.
rows.zh: 熟透的Spondias mombin果实在她嘴里留下了一股强烈的酸味。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 牢牢坚持；坚守（常接to）
rows.en: Despite the setbacks, she continued to hold fast to her original plan.
rows.zh: 尽管屡遭挫折，她仍坚持原来的计划。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 临时圈留牲畜的围场
rows.en: The cattle waited in the holding yard while the trailer was backed into position.
rows.zh: 拖车倒入指定位置时，牛群在临时围场里等候。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 在家修习的课程或学习方式，可采用函授等形式
rows.en: He completed the accounting course through home study while working nights.
rows.zh: 他一边上夜班，一边通过在家学习完成了会计课程。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 古德等积投影；用于世界地图的等面积投影，常采用分瓣形式
rows.en: The atlas uses a homolosine projection to compare the areas of continents.
rows.zh: 这本地图集采用古德等积投影来比较各大陆的面积。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 指蜜鸟；非洲和亚洲的鸟类，能取食蜂蜡等，部分种类会引人寻找蜂巢
rows.en: A honey guide called from a branch above the beekeeper.
rows.zh: 一只指蜜鸟在养蜂人头顶的树枝上鸣叫。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美牧豆树类植物Prosopis glandulosa，具刺和富含糖分的荚果
rows.en: The honey mesquite shaded the dry creek bed with its spreading branches.
rows.zh: 那株Prosopis glandulosa伸展着枝条，为干涸的溪床遮出一片阴影。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 以促进科学、艺术或文学等为宗旨的荣誉学会或学术团体
rows.en: The honorary society elected her for her contributions to marine science.
rows.zh: 这个学会因她对海洋科学的贡献而推选她为成员。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （拉丁语）出于荣誉；用于授予名誉学位
rows.en: The university awarded her a doctorate honoris causa.
rows.zh: 大学授予她名誉博士学位。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 会发出低沉hoot叫声的猫头鹰；本例不限定具体属种
rows.en: From the orchard came the low call of a hoot owl.
rows.zh: 果园里传来一只猫头鹰低沉的鸣叫。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 车轴草属Trifolium dubium，开淡黄色小花的三叶草
rows.en: Yellow hop clover flowered between the stones at the edge of the path.
rows.zh: 小径边的石缝里，Trifolium dubium开着黄色小花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 骑上；登上动物的背部
rows.en: She paused by the pony, then decided to hop on for a short ride.
rows.zh: 她在小马旁停了一下，随后决定骑上去走一小段路。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （非正式）增强动力；提高机器等的功率
rows.en: The mechanic hoped to hop up the engine without changing the car's outward appearance.
rows.zh: 那位机械师希望在不改变汽车外观的前提下提升发动机动力。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 插手；唐突地探问或介入别人的事
rows.en: He kept trying to horn in with questions about our private finances.
rows.zh: 他总想插进来，打听我们的私人财务状况。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 褐牛头鲇（Ameiurus nebulosus，旧名Ictalurus nebulosus），horned pout的一种常见用法
rows.en: The angler released the horned pout after measuring it.
rows.zh: 垂钓者量过那条褐牛头鲇后，把它放回了水里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 角蜥；北美西部具有角状头刺和棘状鳞片的蜥蜴俗名
rows.en: The photographer nearly missed the horned toad among the pebbles.
rows.zh: 那位摄影师差点没注意到卵石间的角蜥。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 角堇（Viola cornuta），花后有长距的堇菜属植物
rows.en: A horned violet flowered in the cracked pot on the windowsill.
rows.zh: 一株角堇在窗台上那只开裂的花盆里开着花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 角蝰；本例取北非和西亚Cerastes属沙地毒蛇义
rows.en: The horned viper was difficult to distinguish from the sand around it.
rows.zh: 那条角蝰很难与周围的沙子区分开来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 角蜥；horned lizard的俗称，指具有角状头刺的蜥蜴
rows.en: The child pointed to a horny frog hiding beside a stone.
rows.zh: 孩子指着藏在石头旁的一只角蜥。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 育马；马匹的繁育活动
rows.en: The valley became known for horse breeding long before it attracted tourists.
rows.zh: 早在吸引游客之前，这个山谷就已因育马业而闻名。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 决明属乔木Cassia grandis，开粉红色花的热带观赏树
rows.en: Pink blossoms covered the horse cassia at the far end of the courtyard.
rows.zh: 庭院尽头那棵Cassia grandis开满了粉红色花朵。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 忍冬科草本Triosteum perfoliatum，具有宽大叶片的北美多年生植物
rows.en: The horse gentian's broad leaves crowded the narrow woodland path.
rows.zh: 这株Triosteum perfoliatum的宽叶挤占了狭窄的林间小径。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蘑菇属真菌Agaricus arvensis，具有宽大的白色菌盖
rows.en: The mycologist sketched the gills of the horse mushroom in her notebook.
rows.zh: 真菌学家在笔记本上画下了那朵Agaricus arvensis的菌褶。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 家朱雀（旧学名Carpodacus mexicanus），一种北美雀鸟
rows.en: A male house finch sang from the gutter above the kitchen window.
rows.zh: 一只雄性家朱雀在厨房窗户上方的檐沟上鸣唱。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 欧洲毛脚燕（词典旧名Delichon urbica），常在房屋檐下筑巢的燕子
rows.en: House martins had built nests beneath the eaves of the village school.
rows.zh: 欧洲毛脚燕在村里学校的屋檐下筑了巢。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 住宅开工；开始建造一套住宅的事件，可用作开工统计单位
rows.en: The city recorded its first housing start of the year in March.
rows.zh: 该市在三月记录了当年的第一项住宅开工。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 人与人之间的关系；人际关系
rows.en: A human relationship cannot be reduced to the messages saved on a phone.
rows.zh: 人与人之间的关系，不能简单归结为手机里存下的那些消息。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蜂鸟蛾；能在花前悬停、以长喙吸蜜的天蛾类
rows.en: A hummingbird moth hovered at the honeysuckle for several seconds.
rows.zh: 一只蜂鸟蛾在忍冬花前悬停了几秒。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 胡恩松（Lagarostrobus franklinii，旧名Dacrydium franklinii），塔斯马尼亚针叶树
rows.en: The Huon pine leaned over the river, its fine foliage reflected in the dark water.
rows.zh: 那棵胡恩松倾向河面，细密的枝叶倒映在深色水中。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 冰上帆艇；装有滑刃、可在冰面借风航行的帆艇
rows.en: The ice yacht glided past the spectators on its steel runners.
rows.zh: 那艘冰上帆艇靠钢制滑刃从观众面前滑过。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 正多面体；柏拉图立体（本例取几何学义）
rows.en: The cube was the first ideal solid she built from folded card.
rows.zh: 立方体是她用折叠卡纸制作的第一个正多面体模型。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 汽车点火钥匙；操作发动机点火开关的钥匙
rows.en: He found the ignition key in the pocket of his raincoat.
rows.zh: 他在雨衣口袋里找到了汽车点火钥匙。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 点火锁；用钥匙控制发动机点火装置的锁
rows.en: The ignition lock was stiff in the cold, so she called the mechanic.
rows.zh: 点火锁在冷天里转动不顺，她于是打电话给修车师傅。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 离题论证；把证明了无关论点误当成证明了当前问题的逻辑谬误
rows.en: The reply was ignoratio elenchi: it showed that the plan was popular, not that it was affordable.
rows.zh: 这个回答犯了离题论证的错误：它说明计划受欢迎，却没有说明计划是否负担得起。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 帮倒忙；本想帮助他人、结果却造成损害的行为
rows.en: Trying to help, he did her an ill turn by revealing the surprise too soon.
rows.zh: 他本想帮忙，却过早泄露了惊喜安排，反而害了她。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （俚语）绝不；想得美（用作强烈否定）
rows.en: In a pig's eye the landlord will replace those windows before winter.
rows.zh: 房东才不会在冬天到来前更换那些窗户。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 在高度上；有……高（用于表示高度的介词短语）
rows.en: The stone marker measured only half a metre in height.
rows.zh: 那块石制标记只有半米高。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 因为；在于；就……这一点而言（引出解释或具体说明的从句）
rows.en: The proposal was unusual in that it required no new equipment.
rows.zh: 这个方案的特别之处在于，它不需要任何新设备。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （非正式）赤身裸体的；完全没穿衣服的
rows.en: The painting shows a man in the buff standing beside a river.
rows.zh: 画中，一名赤身裸体的男子站在河边。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 木蓝（Indigofera tinctoria），可提供靛蓝染料的豆科植物
rows.en: The dyer cultivated an indigo plant in a pot beside the workshop.
rows.zh: 染匠在作坊旁的花盆里栽培了一株木蓝。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 反向相关；负相关（所引词典中与negative correlation同义的术语用法）
rows.en: The old report described an indirect correlation: higher prices were associated with lower demand.
rows.zh: 那份旧报告描述了一种反向相关：较高的价格往往伴随较低的需求量。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 学校的工艺技术课程；教授工具、机械等的实际使用方法
rows.en: The industrial arts classroom smelled of freshly cut wood.
rows.zh: 工艺技术课的教室里弥漫着新切木材的气味。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 工厂；从事工业生产的厂房及设施
rows.en: The old industrial plant now houses workshops for local artists.
rows.zh: 那座旧工厂如今成了当地艺术家的工作室。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （旧称）定时爆炸装置；定时炸弹
rows.en: An engraving of an infernal machine appeared in the nineteenth-century newspaper.
rows.zh: 那份十九世纪报纸上刊有一幅定时爆炸装置的版画。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 印台；浸有印油、供橡皮图章取墨的吸水材料垫
rows.en: The inking pad had dried out during the office's long closure.
rows.zh: 办公室长时间关闭，印台已经干了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 驱虫剂；用来驱避昆虫的制剂
rows.en: She put the insect repellent back in her bag after the picnic.
rows.zh: 野餐后，她把驱虫剂放回包里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 重症监护病房；配备人员和设备提供密集监护的医院病区
rows.en: The hospital opened a new intensive care unit on the second floor.
rows.zh: 医院在二楼开设了一个新的重症监护病房。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 生前信托；委托人在生前设立的信托
rows.en: The textbook contrasts an inter vivos trust with a trust created by a will.
rows.zh: 教材把生前信托与通过遗嘱设立的信托作了对比。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 肋间静脉；引流胸廓肋间区域血液的静脉
rows.en: The anatomy chart labels the intercostal vein beside the artery.
rows.zh: 解剖图在动脉旁标出了肋间静脉。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 星系际空间；星系与星系之间的空间
rows.en: The simulation followed a cloud of gas moving through intergalactic space.
rows.zh: 这项模拟追踪了一团穿行于星系际空间的气体。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 摄氏温标（所引词典中Celsius scale的同义称呼）
rows.en: Temperatures in the old manual are expressed on the international scale, in degrees Celsius.
rows.zh: 那本旧手册的温度用国际摄氏温标表示，单位是摄氏度。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 表现性舞蹈；以动作表现情感或讲述故事的舞蹈形式
rows.en: Her interpretative dance traced the changing moods of the poem.
rows.zh: 她用表现性舞蹈呈现了诗中情绪的变化。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 内褶；褶量朝内收的倒工字褶
rows.en: The inverted pleat in her skirt opened slightly as she climbed the steps.
rows.zh: 她走上台阶时，裙子上的那道内褶微微张开。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 铁靴刑具；旧时用来刑讯足腿的器具（历史义）
rows.en: The catalogue described the iron heel as a device for torturing prisoners.
rows.zh: 目录把铁靴刑具描述为一种用于拷打囚犯的装置。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 波斯铁木（Parrotia persica），一种落叶乔木
rows.en: The iron tree's rounded crown shaded the bench at the garden's edge.
rows.zh: 那株波斯铁木圆圆的树冠，给花园边的长椅遮出了一片阴影。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 等轴测线；等轴测图中与某一等轴测轴平行的线
rows.en: The designer drew the vertical edge as an isometric line parallel to the upright axis.
rows.zh: 设计师把那条竖直边画成一条与竖轴平行的等轴测线。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （粗俗）手淫；自慰
rows.en: In the novel, the adult narrator says he would jack off when he couldn't sleep.
rows.zh: 小说里的成年叙述者说，睡不着时他会手淫。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 班克松（Pinus banksiana），北美两针一束的松树
rows.en: The jack pine's crooked trunk leaned away from the rocky ridge.
rows.zh: 那棵班克松弯曲的树干向着背离岩脊的方向倾斜。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 加拿大梭鲈（Sander canadensis，sauger）在密苏里等地的俗称
rows.en: A jack salmon darted beneath the boat as we drifted down the Missouri River.
rows.zh: 我们顺密苏里河漂流时，一条当地称为jack salmon的加拿大梭鲈迅速游到了船下。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 斑点蝠（Euderma maculatum）；北美具有大耳和斑点的蝙蝠
rows.en: The jackass bat's enormous ears were outlined against the evening sky.
rows.zh: 暮色的天空映出了那只斑点蝠巨大的耳朵轮廓。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鸡眼草（Kummerowia striata，旧名Lespedeza striata），一年生豆科草本
rows.en: The low mat of Japan clover survived the mower's first pass.
rows.zh: 那片低矮的鸡眼草躲过了割草机的第一遍修剪。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鸡眼草（Kummerowia striata，旧名Lespedeza striata），一年生豆科草本
rows.en: She pressed a sprig of Japanese clover between the pages of her field notebook.
rows.zh: 她把一小枝鸡眼草夹在野外笔记本的书页之间。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 难以言传的独特魅力或特质（源自法语）
rows.en: The cafe had a je ne sais quoi that no photograph could capture.
rows.zh: 那家咖啡馆有一种照片无法捕捉的独特魅力。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鹪鹩的俗称；本例取小型鹪鹩鸟义，不限定雌雄
rows.en: The jenny wren vanished into a gap beneath the garden wall.
rows.zh: 那只鹪鹩钻进了花园围墙底下的缝隙。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 颧骨点（jugale）；颧骨额突与颞突接合处的颅测量点
rows.en: The researcher marked the jugal point on the skull before taking the next measurement.
rows.zh: 研究人员先在颅骨上标出颧骨点，再进行下一项测量。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 红豆属乔木Ormosia monosperma，分布于西印度群岛和委内瑞拉东北部
rows.en: The botanist collected a fallen seed beneath the jumby tree.
rows.zh: 植物学家在那棵Ormosia monosperma树下捡起了一粒落下的种子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 拉线活动玩偶；拉动绳线时四肢可活动的人形玩具
rows.en: He pulled the string and made the painted jumping jack raise its arms.
rows.zh: 他拉动细绳，让那个彩绘活动玩偶举起双臂。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （职业拳击）轻中量级，又称超次中量级的拳击手
rows.en: After moving up a division, he won his first bout as a junior middleweight.
rows.zh: 升重一级后，他赢得了作为超次中量级拳手的第一场比赛。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （职业拳击）超轻量级拳击手；junior welterweight级别的运动员
rows.en: The unbeaten junior welterweight signed a contract for another fight.
rows.zh: 这位保持不败的超轻量级拳手签下了另一场比赛的合同。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 沙漠灌木Retama raetam；本例取圣经语境中juniper的旧植物名义
rows.en: The traveller rested in the shade of a juniper bush on the sandy slope.
rows.zh: 旅人在沙坡上的Retama raetam灌木荫下歇息。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 废物堆；一堆被丢弃的破旧物品
rows.en: He rescued a brass lamp from the junk heap behind the warehouse.
rows.zh: 他从仓库后面的废物堆里捡回了一盏黄铜灯。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 同样地；一样（本例用于just as…as…的程度比较）
rows.en: The smaller room is just as bright as the larger one.
rows.zh: 小房间和大房间一样明亮。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美Microdipodops属的沙漠小型啮齿动物，后足发达、善于跳跃
rows.en: Under the dim red light, a kangaroo mouse hopped between the stones.
rows.zh: 昏暗的红光下，一只Microdipodops属小鼠在石块间跳跃。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 使守规矩；控制……的行为（常用keep someone in line）
rows.en: The substitute teacher found it difficult to keep the class in line.
rows.zh: 代课老师发现，很难让全班守规矩。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 维护良好的；保养得当的（keep up的分词形容词）
rows.en: They rented a small, carefully kept-up cottage near the coast.
rows.zh: 他们在海边租了一间维护得很细致的小屋。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 由性伴侣提供金钱和住所、靠其供养生活的女子（旧式称呼）
rows.en: In the novel, she refuses to live as a kept woman and seeks work of her own.
rows.zh: 小说里，她拒绝依靠伴侣供养生活，转而寻找自己的工作。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （英）沿街慢速驾车寻找性交易对象的人
rows.en: Police identified the driver as a kerb crawler after several complaints from residents.
rows.zh: 居民多次投诉后，警方认定那名司机是在街头驾车寻求性交易的人。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 用检索表鉴定；按分类检索特征确定生物的身份
rows.en: The students used the leaf margins to key out the unfamiliar tree.
rows.zh: 学生们根据叶缘特征，用检索表鉴定那棵不认识的树。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 回纹；由重复的直角折线构成的装饰纹样
rows.en: A blue key pattern ran around the rim of the plate.
rows.zh: 盘沿四周饰有蓝色回纹。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （摩托车）脚踏启动装置，尤指脚踏启动杆
rows.en: The old motorcycle was missing its kick start.
rows.zh: 那辆旧摩托车少了脚踏启动杆。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 膝关节支具；戴在膝部用于支撑或稳定关节的装置
rows.en: The knee brace was still strapped around his leg when he arrived.
rows.zh: 他到达时，膝关节支具还绑在腿上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 护膝甲；铠甲中保护膝部的部件
rows.en: The conservator cleaned the knee piece before reattaching it to the suit of armour.
rows.zh: 文物修复师先清理了护膝甲，再把它接回整套铠甲上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （橄榄球）前拍；接球时使球向前碰落的失误
rows.en: The winger's knock-on ended a promising move, and the crowd groaned.
rows.zh: 边锋的一次前拍失误断送了大有希望的攻势，观众发出了叹息。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 连带影响；由前一事件引发的次生影响
rows.en: The factory closure had a knock-on effect on shops across the town.
rows.zh: 工厂关闭对全镇的商店产生了连带影响。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 击倒拳；使对手无法继续拳击比赛的一记重拳
rows.en: He won the bout with a knockout punch in the second round.
rows.zh: 他在第二回合用一记使对手无法继续比赛的重拳赢下了这场拳赛。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 熟悉内情；懂行；清楚实际情况
rows.en: A week in the newsroom was enough for her to know what's what.
rows.zh: 在新闻编辑室待上一周，就足以让她摸清其中的情况。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蕨类植物Cheilanthes gracillima，北美西北部的一种小型丛生蕨
rows.en: A lace fern clung to a shaded crack in the rock face.
rows.zh: 一株Cheilanthes gracillima蕨类长在岩壁背阴的缝隙里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 泪管；输送泪液的细管道
rows.en: On the model, the lacrimal duct was marked with a thin blue line.
rows.zh: 模型上，泪管用一条细蓝线标出。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 袋棍球比赛使用的球
rows.en: The lacrosse ball rolled beneath the bench before anyone could pick it up.
rows.zh: 还没等人捡起，那颗用于袋棍球比赛的球就滚到了长凳底下。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 善于吸引和追求许多女性的风流男子，常带调侃或不赞许意味
rows.en: In the comedy, he imagines himself a lady-killer, but his flirting only makes people laugh.
rows.zh: 在那部喜剧里，他自以为很受女人欢迎，调情却只惹得大家发笑。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （旧时委婉语）女性性工作者；妓女
rows.en: The novel introduces her as a lady of pleasure living near the theatre.
rows.zh: 小说将她介绍为一位住在剧院附近的女性性工作者。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 杓兰类兰花；本例取具有膨大囊状唇瓣的杓兰义
rows.en: He photographed the pouchlike lip of the lady's slipper.
rows.zh: 他拍下了那株杓兰囊状的唇瓣。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 碎米荠属草本Cardamine pratensis，亦称cuckooflower
rows.en: Pale flowers of lady's smock dotted the damp meadow.
rows.zh: 潮湿的草地上，点缀着Cardamine pratensis浅色的花朵。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 绶草属（Spiranthes）的兰花，花穗细长、花朵常呈螺旋状排列
rows.en: A slender spike of lady's tresses rose above the short grass.
rows.zh: 矮草丛上方，伸出一支细长的绶草花穗。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 陆封型大西洋鲑；生活在湖泊等淡水中的大西洋鲑
rows.en: The biologist tagged a lake salmon before releasing it back into the reservoir.
rows.zh: 生物学家给一条陆封型大西洋鲑加上标记，然后把它放回水库。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 灯室；容纳灯泡的外壳或腔室，如投影机中的灯泡外壳
rows.en: The replacement bulb fitted neatly inside the lamp house.
rows.zh: 替换灯泡正好装进灯室。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 七鳃鳗类无颌鱼的名称，具有圆形吸盘口
rows.en: An old natural-history book illustrated a lamper eel with its circular sucking mouth.
rows.zh: 一本旧自然史书里画着一条长有圆形吸盘口的七鳃鳗。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （英军）准下士；低于下士的军衔，本例指有该军衔的士兵
rows.en: The British lance corporal answered the recruit's question about the timetable.
rows.zh: 那位英军准下士回答了新兵关于日程安排的问题。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蜡蝉类昆虫（Fulgoridae科），常具有鲜明的翅部花纹
rows.en: The lantern fly spread its patterned wings when the photographer moved closer.
rows.zh: 摄影师靠近时，那只蜡蝉展开了带花纹的翅膀。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 落叶松；Larix属的针叶乔木，针叶会季节性脱落
rows.en: The larch tree beside the lake turned gold before shedding its needles.
rows.zh: 湖边那棵落叶松先变成金黄色，随后才落下针叶。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 笑鸥（Leucophaeus atricilla，旧名Larus atricilla），一种美洲鸥类
rows.en: A laughing gull called from a wooden post beside the fishing boats.
rows.zh: 渔船旁的木桩上传来一只笑鸥的叫声。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 冒……风险；把……置于可能受损的境地
rows.en: He would not lay his reputation on the line for an untested plan.
rows.zh: 他不愿为了一个未经检验的计划拿自己的声誉冒险。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 按手动作；把手按在他人身上的行为，本例指宗教礼仪
rows.en: The service included the laying on of hands as the new minister was welcomed.
rows.zh: 欢迎新牧师的礼拜中包括按手仪式。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 逐步引出；为……作铺垫（常接to）
rows.en: The opening anecdotes lead up to the main argument of the lecture.
rows.zh: 开头几则轶事逐步引出了讲座的主要论点。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （棒球）首位上场击球的活动或角色；本例为名词性活动义
rows.en: Leading off suited him better than batting in the middle of the order.
rows.zh: 担任首位击球手比在打线中段出场更适合他。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 引导转向的缰绳；用以引导马头向左或向右的缰
rows.en: The worn leading rein was replaced before the next riding lesson.
rows.zh: 下一堂骑术课前，磨损的引导缰被换掉了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 腐叶土；主要由腐解树叶形成的腐殖质土壤或园艺材料
rows.en: The gardener mixed leaf soil into the border before planting the bulbs.
rows.zh: 园丁在种球根前，先把腐叶土拌进花境的土里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 叶苔；具有茎状轴及细小叶状结构的苔类植物
rows.en: Under the lens, the leafy liverwort showed rows of tiny overlapping leaflike structures.
rows.zh: 在放大镜下，那株叶苔显出一排排细小、相互重叠的叶状结构。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 学习障碍；本例取美式教育语境中的特定学习技能困难义
rows.en: The school in Ohio arranged extra reading support for a pupil with a learning disability.
rows.zh: 俄亥俄州那所学校为一名有学习障碍的学生安排了额外的阅读支持。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （音乐）加线；五线谱上方或下方用于记写超出谱表范围音符的短线
rows.en: The high note sat on a ledger line above the staff.
rows.zh: 那个高音记在五线谱上方的一条加线上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 舞台左侧；演员面向观众时在其左手边的舞台区域
rows.en: The stage manager's plan divided the stage into left stage, centre stage, and right stage.
rows.zh: 舞台监督的平面图将舞台划分为演员视角的左侧、中央和右侧区域。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 法律关系；本例取受法律规范的律师与客户之间的职业关系义
rows.en: The retainer agreement set out the legal relation between the lawyer and her client.
rows.zh: 委托协议明确了律师与其客户之间的法律关系。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 立法会；本例指香港的立法机关
rows.en: The legislative council debated the housing proposal late into the evening.
rows.zh: 立法会讨论那项住房提案，一直持续到深夜。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 柠檬蛋白霜派；以柠檬馅为主体、表面覆有蛋白霜的派
rows.en: She spread the meringue over the lemon meringue pie before putting it in the oven.
rows.zh: 她把蛋白霜铺在柠檬派上，然后将派送进烤箱。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 小扁豆汤；以小扁豆为主要材料的汤
rows.en: A pot of lentil soup was simmering beside the kitchen window.
rows.zh: 厨房窗边，一锅小扁豆汤正用小火煨着。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 小食蚁兽；本例指Tamandua tetradactyla，具有可缠握的尾巴
rows.en: The lesser anteater curled its tail around a branch as it climbed.
rows.zh: 那只小食蚁兽攀爬时，把尾巴缠在了一根树枝上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 百金花属草本Centaurium pulchellum；RHS所用的lesser centaury植物义
rows.en: We found lesser centaury growing in a gap beside the path.
rows.zh: 我们在小径旁的一处空隙里发现了Centaurium pulchellum。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 放下；使物体降至较低位置的动作
rows.en: The slow letting down of the heavy curtain took several minutes.
rows.zh: 把那幅沉重的幕布缓缓放下，花了好几分钟。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 起重装置；用于举升重物的设备
rows.en: The lifting device raised the engine clear of the workshop floor.
rows.zh: 起重装置把发动机吊离了车间地面。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 轻蝇量级拳手（本例取传统业余拳击的类别名称）
rows.en: In the old tournament photograph, the light flyweight stands beside his coach.
rows.zh: 在那张旧拳赛照片中，这位轻蝇量级拳手站在教练身旁。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 光时；光在真空中传播一小时所经过的距离，是长度单位
rows.en: In the diagram, the probe was one light hour from Earth.
rows.zh: 图中，那艘探测器距离地球一光时。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 轻中量级拳手（本例取传统业余拳击的类别名称）
rows.en: The retired light middleweight still helped young boxers at the club.
rows.zh: 那位退役的轻中量级拳手仍在俱乐部帮助年轻拳手。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 轻次中量级拳手（本例取传统业余拳击的类别名称）
rows.en: A light welterweight from our club reached the final of the amateur tournament.
rows.zh: 我们俱乐部的一名轻次中量级拳手打进了那次业余拳赛的决赛。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 短莛山麦冬（Liriope muscari），具有草状叶的多年生草本
rows.en: The gardener planted lily turf along the edge of the shaded path.
rows.zh: 园丁沿着林荫小径的边缘种下了短莛山麦冬。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 柔枝松（Pinus flexilis）；北美西部一种枝条柔韧的松树
rows.en: The limber pine's flexible branches bent under the fresh snow.
rows.zh: 那棵柔枝松柔韧的枝条在新落的积雪下弯了下来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 有限审阅；对财务信息提供有限保证、程序范围小于审计的业务
rows.en: The board requested a limited review of the financial statements before the annual audit.
rows.zh: 董事会要求在年度审计之前，对财务报表进行有限审阅。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 司线裁判；本例指美式橄榄球比赛中的场上裁判之一
rows.en: The line judge moved along the sideline as the football game continued.
rows.zh: 美式橄榄球比赛继续进行，司线裁判沿着边线移动。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 线形叶；狭长、两侧边缘大致平行的叶片
rows.en: Each linear leaf was narrow enough to slip between the bars of the fence.
rows.zh: 每片线形叶都很窄，能从栅栏的栏杆间穿过去。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 白头翁属植物Pulsatilla patens的一种英文俗名，亦称American pasqueflower
rows.en: The lion's beard opened its pale violet flowers in the spring sunshine.
rows.zh: 春日阳光下，那株Pulsatilla patens开出了淡紫色的花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 弟弟；年龄比自己小的兄弟
rows.en: My little brother kept the ticket from his first train journey.
rows.zh: 我弟弟一直保存着他第一次乘火车时的车票。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 妹妹；年龄比自己小的姐妹
rows.en: Her little sister drew a map to help us find the house.
rows.zh: 她妹妹画了一张地图，帮助我们找到那所房子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 小规格的北美硬壳蛤（Mercenaria mercenaria）；quahog的食用规格名称
rows.en: We ordered littleneck clams as a starter and shared a bowl between us.
rows.zh: 我们点了一碗小规格的北美硬壳蛤作前菜，一起分着吃。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 美洲常绿栎类树木；并非专指落叶的槲树
rows.en: The live oak kept its green canopy while the neighbouring trees stood bare.
rows.zh: 旁边的树木光秃秃的，那棵常绿栎树却仍然绿荫满冠。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 装卸货台；卡车或列车装卸货物的平台
rows.en: The driver backed the truck towards the warehouse loading dock.
rows.zh: 司机把卡车倒向仓库的装卸货台。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 角豆荚；角豆树的豆荚，内含种子和带甜味的果肉
rows.en: She split a dried locust bean to show the seeds inside.
rows.zh: 她掰开一条干角豆荚，展示里面的种子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （英式非正式用语）持停车示意牌、帮助学童过马路的女性护导员
rows.en: The lollipop lady held up her sign while the children crossed the road.
rows.zh: 孩子们过马路时，那位女护导员举起了停车示意牌。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Phegopteris connectilis；一种分布于北美和欧亚的蕨类植物，亦称northern beech fern
rows.en: A patch of long beech fern covered the bank beside the stream.
rows.zh: 溪流旁的坡岸上长着一片Phegopteris connectilis蕨。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 天牛；天牛科中身体较长、触角通常很长的甲虫
rows.en: A longicorn beetle crawled across the log, sweeping its long antennae ahead.
rows.zh: 一只天牛爬过圆木，长长的触角在前方摆动。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 观看；把目光投向某物、用视觉观察的活动
rows.en: The tutor encouraged careful looking at the painting before any discussion.
rows.zh: 老师鼓励大家在讨论之前，先仔细观察那幅画。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （非正式）失去情绪控制；发怒或崩溃
rows.en: She was afraid she would lose it if another customer shouted at her.
rows.zh: 她担心，如果再有顾客对她大喊大叫，她就会情绪失控。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 地中海地区的鼠李科灌木状落叶植物Ziziphus lotus
rows.en: The lotus tree's thorny branches formed a dense barrier beside the track.
rows.zh: 那株Ziziphus lotus带刺的枝条在小路旁形成了一道密密的屏障。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Abies grandis；北美太平洋沿岸的一种高大冷杉，亦称grand fir
rows.en: The lowland white fir rose above the smaller trees beside the river.
rows.zh: 河边，那棵Abies grandis冷杉高出了周围较小的树木。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 罗经基准线；船用罗经上用于指示船首方向的固定标线
rows.en: The helmsman read the heading where the compass card met the lubber's line.
rows.zh: 舵手在罗经刻度盘与船首基准线相交的位置读取航向。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 润滑物质；用于使接触表面滑顺、减小摩擦的物质
rows.en: A thin film of lubricating substance coated the metal surfaces.
rows.zh: 金属表面覆着一层薄薄的润滑物质。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 月球太阳日；月面同一地点相邻两次太阳升起的间隔，约为29.5个地球日
rows.en: The chart compares a lunar day, measured from one sunrise to the next, with an Earth day.
rows.zh: 图表对比了月球上从一次日出到下一次日出的太阳日与地球上的一日。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 月球登月舱；阿波罗计划中运送宇航员往返月面与月球轨道的飞行器
rows.en: The lunar excursion module carried two astronauts towards the surface while their colleague remained in orbit.
rows.zh: 登月舱载着两名宇航员前往月面，另一名同伴则留在轨道上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 机枪手；操作机枪的人员
rows.en: The veteran had served as a machine gunner before becoming a schoolteacher.
rows.zh: 那位退伍军人当教师之前，曾是一名机枪手。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 轻机枪；本例取所引词典中machine rifle的历史武器名称义
rows.en: The museum label dated the machine rifle to the early twentieth century.
rows.zh: 博物馆的说明牌把那挺轻机枪的年代标为二十世纪初。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 机缝针迹；由缝纫机形成的针迹
rows.en: The machine stitch was so even that she could barely see where the seam began.
rows.zh: 机缝针迹十分均匀，她几乎看不出缝线从哪里开始。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鱼鳞状云天；卷积云或小片高积云排列成行、呈鱼鳞状的天空景象
rows.en: A mackerel sky stretched above the fishing boats at dawn.
rows.zh: 黎明时，渔船上空铺展着一片鱼鳞状云天。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 以很高的学业荣誉；以优异成绩（用于毕业荣誉等级）
rows.en: She graduated magna cum laude while working evenings at the campus library.
rows.zh: 她以优异成绩毕业，在校期间晚间还在校园图书馆工作。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 大联盟棒球运动员；大联盟棒球队的队员
rows.en: The former major leaguer now coaches children on Saturday mornings.
rows.zh: 那位前大联盟棒球运动员现在每周六上午指导孩子们打球。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 特意做；刻意确保做到（常接of doing）
rows.en: I make a point of learning everyone's name before the first meeting.
rows.zh: 第一次开会前，我会特意记住每个人的名字。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 让路；腾出通道
rows.en: The crowd stepped back to make way for the ambulance.
rows.zh: 人群向后退，为救护车让路。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 莽吉柿；山竹树（Garcinia mangostana），果实可食的热带乔木
rows.en: The mangosteen tree shaded the courtyard beside the kitchen.
rows.zh: 厨房旁的院子里，那棵山竹树投下了一片树荫。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 肯塔拉麻纤维；由菲律宾栽培的龙舌兰类植物取得、可制粗绳的硬质纤维
rows.en: The rope maker twisted manila maguey into a coarse cord.
rows.zh: 制绳匠把肯塔拉麻纤维捻成了一根粗绳。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 持枪操练；按规定进行的步枪操练动作
rows.en: The recruits practised the manual of arms until their movements matched.
rows.zh: 新兵们反复练习持枪操练，直到动作一致。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 地图集；本例指装订成册的一组地图
rows.en: The map collection opened with a double-page view of the whole continent.
rows.zh: 这本地图集开篇是一幅横跨两页的全大陆地图。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 列队走出；本例指从狭窄通道行进到开阔地带
rows.en: The soldiers began to march out of the narrow pass onto the plain.
rows.zh: 士兵们开始列队走出狭窄的山口，进入平原。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 闭海；受单一国家管辖、对其他国家关闭的可航行海域
rows.en: The essay examines an old ruler's claim that the gulf was a mare clausum.
rows.zh: 这篇文章考察了一位昔日统治者关于该海湾属于闭海的主张。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 古罗马人对地中海的称呼，字面意为“我们的海”
rows.en: Roman merchants carried grain across mare nostrum to ports in Italy.
rows.zh: 古罗马商人把粮食运过他们所称的“我们的海”，送往意大利的港口。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 一团乱麻；混乱复杂的局面或杂乱的一堆事物
rows.en: The accounts were a mare's nest of missing receipts and contradictory totals.
rows.zh: 这些账目乱成一团：收据缺失，各项总数也互相矛盾。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 热带美洲山榄科果树Pouteria sapota（mamey sapote），并非通常所说的sapodilla人心果
rows.en: The marmalade tree in the orchard carried several large fruits.
rows.zh: 果园里的那棵Pouteria sapota树结着几个大果实。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Andromeda polifolia；生于酸性泥炭湿地的一种常绿小灌木
rows.en: Pink flowers hung from the marsh andromeda above the wet moss.
rows.zh: 湿润的苔藓上方，那株Andromeda polifolia垂挂着粉红色的花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Iva属的若干灌木状草本植物，常见于湿地，花小而带绿色
rows.en: The marsh elder grew in a dense patch near the tidal creek.
rows.zh: 潮汐溪流附近，Iva属湿地植物长成了密密的一片。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Swertia perennis；生于湿润地区的獐牙菜属多年生草本
rows.en: The botanist photographed marsh felwort beside a mountain spring.
rows.zh: 植物学家在一处山泉边拍下了Swertia perennis。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Ledum palustre；北欧至东亚湿地中的杜鹃花科灌木，本例不指茶叶饮品
rows.en: The marsh tea retained its narrow leaves through the cold season.
rows.zh: 寒冷季节里，那株Ledum palustre仍保留着狭长的叶子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 旧式高尔夫铁杆，用于把球打出较高的弹道；不在本例固定对应现代球杆号码
rows.en: He took an old mashie niblick from the bag and showed us its angled face.
rows.zh: 他从球包里取出一支旧式高尔夫铁杆，给我们看它倾斜的杆面。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 泥巢胡蜂；用泥土筑巢育幼的独居胡蜂类
rows.en: A mason wasp carried a small lump of mud to the wall.
rows.zh: 一只泥巢胡蜂衔着一小团泥飞向墙面。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 大众文化；通过大众传播媒介广泛传播的文化
rows.en: The seminar examined how mass culture shaped popular ideas about success.
rows.zh: 研讨课考察了大众文化如何影响人们对成功的普遍看法。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （神经科学史）总体活动原理；拉什利关于皮层整体活动及学习表现的理论
rows.en: The lecture presented the mass-action principle as one of Lashley's early ideas about cortical function.
rows.zh: 讲座把总体活动原理作为拉什利关于大脑皮层功能的早期观点之一予以介绍。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 自然而然或按常理可预期的事；不必然表示逻辑上不可避免
rows.en: For him, replying to a personal letter was a matter of course.
rows.zh: 对他而言，回复私人来信是自然而然该做的事。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 事实；可以作为事实加以证实的事情
rows.en: Whether the parcel arrived on Tuesday is a matter of fact, not personal preference.
rows.zh: 包裹是否在星期二送到，是一个可以查证的事实问题，而不是个人喜好的问题。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 法律问题；需要依照法律解释或适用来裁定的问题
rows.en: The judge treated the interpretation of that clause as a matter of law.
rows.zh: 法官把该条款的解释视为法律问题。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 床垫保护垫；铺在床垫上起保护作用的独立垫层
rows.en: She washed the mattress pad and left the mattress itself in place.
rows.zh: 她洗了床垫保护垫，床垫本身则留在原处。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 认错；对自己的错误或过失所作的承认
rows.en: His email began with a mea culpa for sending everyone the wrong timetable.
rows.zh: 他在邮件开头承认自己把错误的时间表发给了大家。
