rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 平太阳时；以假想平太阳的均匀运动为基础的计时系统
rows.en: The lesson explained why a sundial can disagree with a clock keeping mean solar time.
rows.zh: 这堂课解释了为什么日晷的读数可能与按平太阳时计时的钟表不同。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 肉店；出售肉类的商店（本例取字面商店义）
rows.en: The meat market on the corner opens before the nearby shops.
rows.zh: 街角那家肉店比附近的商店更早开门。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 医学界；具备行医资格的人员这一群体
rows.en: The medical profession debated the new reporting rules.
rows.zh: 医学界就新的报告规定展开了争论。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 有髓神经纤维；外有髓鞘包裹的神经纤维
rows.en: The diagram shows the sheath surrounding a medullated nerve fiber.
rows.zh: 图中显示了一条有髓神经纤维周围包裹的髓鞘。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 记忆中的视觉形象；类似视觉知觉的心理图像
rows.en: A vivid memory picture of the old kitchen returned when she smelled the bread.
rows.zh: 闻到面包的气味时，旧厨房的鲜明画面又浮现在她的记忆中。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （音乐）以较慢的速度；比此前稍慢地
rows.en: The ensemble played meno mosso as the melody passed to the violas.
rows.zh: 旋律交给中提琴时，乐团以较慢的速度演奏。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 金属镀层；沉积在物体表面的薄金属覆盖层
rows.en: The metal plating had worn away where the handle rubbed against the frame.
rows.zh: 把手与框架摩擦的地方，金属镀层已经磨掉了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 金属头木杆；杆头以金属制成的高尔夫木杆
rows.en: She chose a metal wood for the long shot across the fairway.
rows.zh: 她选择了一支金属头木杆，准备沿球道打出长距离的一杆。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 首选方法；最适合取得某一预期结果的方法
rows.en: For these fragile papers, digital photography became the method of choice.
rows.zh: 对于这些脆弱的纸张，数字摄影成了首选方法。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 公担；等于100千克的质量单位
rows.en: The ledger recorded ten metric hundredweights of grain delivered to the mill.
rows.zh: 账簿记载了送到磨坊的十公担粮食。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 美国中大西洋地区的；本例为美国地域义，非大西洋海面中部
rows.en: The report compared public transport in several Middle Atlantic states.
rows.zh: 报告比较了美国中大西洋地区几个州的公共交通。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 迁徙路线；本例指鸟类通常采用的季节性迁徙路径
rows.en: The wetlands lie along an important migration route for waterbirds.
rows.zh: 这片湿地位于水鸟的一条重要迁徙路线上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 军官委任状；正式授予军官身份或军衔的任命文书
rows.en: His military commission was kept in a frame beside a photograph of his regiment.
rows.zh: 他的军官委任状装在相框里，放在一张他所在团的照片旁边。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 军衔等级；本例取所引词典的军队级别义，非发动机额定功率
rows.en: The old register listed each man's military rating beside his name.
rows.zh: 那本旧名册在每个人的姓名旁列出了他的军衔等级。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 普通的；平常而无特别之处的
rows.en: The novel turns a mine-run family quarrel into a surprisingly moving story.
rows.zh: 小说把一场普通的家庭争吵写成了一个出人意料地感人的故事。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 仿盆景的人造装饰树（本例义）
rows.en: A plastic ming tree stood on the reception desk beside the telephone.
rows.zh: 接待台上，电话旁摆着一棵塑料仿盆景树。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 迷你品犬；德国起源的小型宾莎犬种（Miniature Pinscher）
rows.en: The miniature pinscher curled up on the folded blanket.
rows.zh: 那只迷你品犬蜷在折好的毯子上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 自然小调音阶；第二至第三音、第五至第六音之间为半音的七声音阶
rows.en: The student played an A minor diatonic scale using only the white keys.
rows.zh: 学生只用白键弹奏了一遍A自然小调音阶。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 小联盟棒球运动员；小联盟棒球队的队员
rows.en: The young minor leaguer hoped to earn a place on a major-league roster.
rows.zh: 那位年轻的小联盟棒球运动员希望争取到大联盟球队的一个名额。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 小手术；通常涉及较浅表结构、总体风险相对较低的外科操作，不排除局部麻醉
rows.en: The clinic booked her for minor surgery under local anaesthetic.
rows.zh: 诊所为她安排了在局部麻醉下进行的小手术。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 薄荷朱利酒；通常以波本威士忌、糖、薄荷和碎冰调成的鸡尾酒
rows.en: The crushed ice in his mint julep had begun to melt in the afternoon heat.
rows.zh: 午后的热气里，他那杯薄荷朱利酒中的碎冰开始融化了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Fritillaria affinis；北美西部一种开钟形花的贝母属植物（本例义）
rows.en: The mission bells hung among the grasses, their green-and-purple flowers facing downwards.
rows.zh: 草丛中的Fritillaria affinis垂挂着绿紫相间、花口朝下的花朵。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 斜切锯盒；引导手锯按预定角度切割木料的工具
rows.en: He placed the short strip of wood in the miter box before marking the cut.
rows.zh: 他把那根短木条放进斜切锯盒，然后标出切割位置。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 情态助动词；用于表达可能性、必要性等情态意义的助动词
rows.en: In this sentence, the modal auxiliary verb expresses possibility rather than certainty.
rows.zh: 在这个句子中，情态助动词表达的是可能性，而不是确定性。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 现代人；本例取生物学上的现代人类Homo sapiens义
rows.en: The exhibition compared the skull of modern man with those of earlier human relatives.
rows.zh: 展览把现代人的头骨与更早的人类近亲的头骨作了比较。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 磁体的磁矩；表征其磁性强弱与取向的矢量物理量，非转矩本身
rows.en: The graph plots the moment of a magnet against temperature.
rows.zh: 图中绘出了磁体磁矩随温度变化的曲线。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 货贝（旧学名Cypraea moneta）；其贝壳曾用作货币的一种宝贝类软体动物
rows.en: The curator placed a money cowrie beside the coins in the display case.
rows.zh: 策展人把一枚货贝放在展柜里的硬币旁边。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 船用轻便梯；本例指通往船上高处小平台的轻梯
rows.en: A sailor climbed the monkey ladder to the platform above the wheelhouse.
rows.zh: 一名水手沿着船上的轻便梯，爬到驾驶室上方的平台。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 智利南洋杉（Araucaria araucana）；枝叶形态独特的常绿针叶树
rows.en: The monkey puzzle's stiff, pointed leaves discouraged us from touching the branch.
rows.zh: 那棵智利南洋杉的叶子坚硬而尖，令我们不想去碰它的枝条。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 内心确信；基于内在信念、未必有客观证明的确信
rows.en: She felt a moral certainty that he was innocent, although she had no proof.
rows.zh: 尽管没有证据，她在内心却确信他是无罪的。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 多元文化；由多种文化成分组成、呈镶嵌状态的文化
rows.en: The city's mosaic culture was reflected in its neighbourhood festivals.
rows.zh: 这座城市的多元文化体现在各个社区的节庆活动中。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （常含贬意）过分依恋母亲的男孩或男子
rows.en: He resented being called a mother's boy simply because he phoned home every day.
rows.zh: 仅仅因为每天给家里打电话就被说成过分依恋母亲，他对此很不满。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 运动神经纤维；将神经信号向肌肉等效应器传送的神经纤维，并非整个神经元
rows.en: The diagram traces a motor nerve fiber from the nerve bundle towards the muscle.
rows.zh: 图中描出了从神经束通向肌肉的一条运动神经纤维。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Bauhinia variegata；一种开兰花状花朵的羊蹄甲属乔木
rows.en: The mountain ebony's flowers stood out against the pale wall of the courtyard.
rows.zh: 院子里，那棵Bauhinia variegata的花朵在浅色墙面前格外醒目。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Oreopteris limbosperma；欧洲山地一种叶片有柠檬或香脂气味的蕨类
rows.en: A clump of mountain fern grew beside the damp rocks on the slope.
rows.zh: 山坡潮湿的岩石旁，长着一丛Oreopteris limbosperma蕨。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 芒廷派恩（Mountain Pine）；美国阿肯色州地名
rows.en: We stopped in Mountain Pine on our way to the lake.
rows.zh: 我们去湖边的途中，在阿肯色州的芒廷派恩停留了一下。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美西部的一种禾本科牧草，所引词典学名为Oryzopsis hymenoides；非旱稻
rows.en: The seed heads of mountain rice trembled in the wind above the dry grassland.
rows.zh: 干燥草地上方，Oryzopsis hymenoides带籽的穗头在风中颤动。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 卷耳属Cerastium中若干小型草本植物的俗名（本例为一株植物，非属名本身）
rows.en: A mouse ear had taken root between the paving stones.
rows.zh: 一株卷耳属小草在铺路石的缝隙间扎了根。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鼠兔；小型、短耳的兔形目哺乳动物，本例不限定草原鼠兔这一物种
rows.en: A mouse hare called from a gap between the rocks, then disappeared from view.
rows.zh: 一只鼠兔在岩石缝隙里叫了一声，随后消失不见了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 卷耳属Cerastium中若干草本的俗名，通常开白色小花；本例不固定为单一物种
rows.en: Our seedlings were crowded by mouse-ear chickweed along the edge of the bed.
rows.zh: 苗床边缘的卷耳属草本挤占了我们幼苗的生长空间。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 菊科草本Pilosella officinarum，旧时归入Hieracium属，叶被柔毛
rows.en: A mouse-ear hawkweed spread its hairy leaves close to the ground.
rows.zh: 一株Pilosella officinarum贴着地面展开了被有柔毛的叶子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 来回移动；先向一个方向、再向相反方向移动
rows.en: The loose sign began to move back and forth in the wind.
rows.zh: 那块松动的标牌开始在风中来回摆动。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 与……很相似地；像……那样（本例为方式用法）
rows.en: She prepared the tea much as her grandmother had done, warming the pot first.
rows.zh: 她像祖母从前那样准备茶水，先把茶壶温热。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 美洲骨顶（Fulica americana）；北美的一种秧鸡科水鸟
rows.en: A mud hen paddled between the reeds, leaving a narrow trail on the water.
rows.zh: 一只美洲骨顶游过芦苇间，在水面留下了一道窄窄的水迹。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 泥螈Necturus maculosus；具有羽状外鳃的北美水生有尾两栖动物（本例义）
rows.en: The mud puppy remained under a flat rock in the stream.
rows.zh: 那只Necturus maculosus泥螈待在溪流中的一块扁石下面。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 泥龟类；栖息于美洲泥底淡水水域的龟类
rows.en: The mud turtle disappeared into the soft sediment at the edge of the pond.
rows.zh: 那只泥龟钻进了池塘边柔软的沉积物里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 肱三头肌；上臂后侧具有三个头的肌肉
rows.en: During the anatomy practical, she labelled the musculus triceps brachii on the model.
rows.zh: 解剖实习课上，她在模型上标出了肱三头肌。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蘑菇酱汁；本例取加入炒蘑菇的棕色酱汁义，非蘑菇酱油
rows.en: He spooned mushroom sauce over the roast before carrying it to the table.
rows.zh: 他把蘑菇酱汁浇在烤肉上，然后将肉端上餐桌。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 音乐教师；教授音乐的人
rows.en: The music teacher asked each pupil to clap the rhythm before singing.
rows.zh: 音乐教师请每个学生先拍出节奏，再开始唱歌。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 澳洲麝鸭（Biziura lobata）；本例指澳大利亚的这种水鸟，不指番鸭
rows.en: The musk duck dived beside the reed bed and resurfaced farther away.
rows.zh: 那只澳洲麝鸭在芦苇丛旁潜入水中，随后在更远处浮出水面。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 前膛枪；从枪口一端装填的旧式火器
rows.en: The museum's muzzle loader had a cracked wooden stock.
rows.zh: 博物馆里那支前膛枪的木制枪托上有一道裂缝。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 纳粹的；与德国国家社会主义运动或纳粹党有关的（历史政治用语）
rows.en: The exhibition traced the spread of national socialist propaganda through local newspapers.
rows.zh: 展览追踪了纳粹宣传如何通过地方报纸传播。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 新西兰树状倒挂金钟Fuchsia excorticata；可长成灌木或小乔木的植物
rows.en: The native fuchsia shaded the wooden footbridge beside the stream.
rows.zh: 那株新西兰Fuchsia excorticata为溪边的木制小桥遮出了阴凉。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 航海链；旧长度单位，本例取所引工程词典中15英尺的定义
rows.en: Her transcription preserved the distance in nautical chains rather than converting it to miles.
rows.zh: 她誊录时保留了以航海链表示的距离，没有把它换算成英里。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Hakea lissosperma；澳大利亚一种叶片坚硬呈针状的哈克木属灌木
rows.en: The needle bush's rigid leaves caught the sleeve of his jacket.
rows.zh: 那株Hakea lissosperma坚硬的叶子勾住了他的夹克袖子。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Eleocharis acicularis；荸荠属中茎细如针的一种湿地植物
rows.en: A thin carpet of needle spike rush spread across the shallow end of the tank.
rows.zh: 水缸浅水端铺开了一层细密的Eleocharis acicularis。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Hakea leucoptera；澳大利亚一种叶端尖锐、开乳白色花的灌木，非一般针叶木材
rows.en: Creamy flowers clustered among the pointed leaves of the needle wood.
rows.zh: 那株Hakea leucoptera尖锐的叶片间，簇生着乳白色的花。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Sarcocephalus latifolius非洲灌木的一种旧英文俗名；英文含过时、可能冒犯的种族用字
rows.en: The herbarium sheet labels the African shrub 'negro peach' in the collector's handwriting.
rows.zh: 那张植物标本签上，采集者亲笔用旧名“negro peach”标注了这株非洲灌木。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 一种叶片有毛、开暗紫褐色花的缠绕藤本的旧英文名；英文含过时、可能冒犯的种族用字（所引词典义）
rows.en: She replaced the outdated label 'negro vine' with the plant's scientific name in the exhibition.
rows.zh: 她把展览里过时的“negro vine”标签换成了该植物的学名。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 筑巢地点；适合鸟类等动物筑巢的地方
rows.en: The pair returned to the same nesting place beneath the bridge.
rows.zh: 那对鸟又回到了桥下同一个筑巢地点。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 神经胶质细胞；组成神经胶质的单个细胞
rows.en: The student outlined a neuroglial cell in the microscope drawing.
rows.zh: 学生在显微绘图中勾出了一个神经胶质细胞的轮廓。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （毒品俚语）价值五美元的一份毒品
rows.en: In the crime novel, the detective finds a nickel note in the suspect's coat pocket.
rows.zh: 那部犯罪小说中，侦探在嫌疑人的外套口袋里发现了一份价值五美元的毒品。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 夜间鸣叫的鸟的旧称或文学称呼；不限定为渡鸦
rows.en: In the poem, a night raven breaks the silence outside the ruined tower.
rows.zh: 诗中，一只夜间鸣叫的鸟打破了废塔外的寂静。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 天主教出版审查中表示未发现教义或道德方面妨碍的认可或声明（本例义）
rows.en: The title page carried a nihil obstat dated several years before the reprint.
rows.zh: 扉页上印有一项教会审查认可，日期比此次重印早了好几年。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 亚硝化细菌；把氨或有关含氨化合物氧化为亚硝酸盐的细菌类群
rows.en: The researchers measured nitrite production by nitrous bacteria in the soil samples.
rows.zh: 研究人员测量了土壤样本中亚硝化细菌产生的亚硝酸盐量。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 热带种甘蔗（Saccharum officinarum）；通常具有粗壮、多汁、高糖的茎
rows.en: The noble cane in the trial plot had thick, juicy stems.
rows.zh: 试验地里的Saccharum officinarum甘蔗长着粗壮、多汁的茎。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 不抗辩答辩；刑事被告不争辩指控、接受相应裁判处罚的答辩（法律术语）
rows.en: The transcript records a plea of nolo contendere rather than a plea of not guilty.
rows.zh: 庭审记录记载的是不抗辩答辩，而不是无罪答辩。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 不可由发行人任意提前赎回的债券；发行人在约定保护期间没有此类赎回权
rows.en: The issuer could not redeem the noncallable bond early merely because interest rates had fallen.
rows.zh: 发行人不能仅仅因为利率下降，就提前赎回这只不可提前赎回的债券。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Circus hudsonius；本例取现行分类中的北美鹞类猛禽，不与欧亚白尾鹞混同
rows.en: A northern harrier flew low across the marsh at dusk.
rows.zh: 黄昏时，一只Circus hudsonius贴着沼泽低飞。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 历史上将Icterus galbula与Icterus bullockii合并时使用的鸟名；现已重新区分两种
rows.en: The 1980 field notebook records a northern oriole in the cottonwoods by the river.
rows.zh: 1980年的野外笔记记载，河边的杨树上出现过一只当时合称为northern oriole的鸟。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 俯冲；飞机机头向下的急降动作
rows.en: The pilot pulled the aircraft out of a nose dive above the sea.
rows.zh: 飞行员在海面上方把飞机从俯冲状态中拉了起来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （口语）好啦；用于温和制止或劝慰的话
rows.en: 'Now, now, there's no need to shout,' the teacher said.
rows.zh: “好啦，好啦，没必要大喊大叫，”老师说。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Ginglymostoma cirratum；一种常在暖海浅水底部活动的鲨鱼，非grey nurse shark沙锥齿鲨
rows.en: A nurse shark rested on the sandy bottom beneath the pier.
rows.zh: 一条Ginglymostoma cirratum鲨鱼卧在码头下的沙底上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （俚语、贬义）精神病院；本例报告并批评这一侮辱性称呼
rows.en: The film's narrator calls the hospital a nut house, a label the review criticises as insulting.
rows.zh: 影片的叙述者把医院称作“疯人院”，影评批评这一称呼带有侮辱性。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 北美若干结可食松子的pinyon松类；不专指瑞士五针松
rows.en: Nut pines dotted the dry hillside above the village.
rows.zh: 村庄上方干燥的山坡上，点缀着一株株结松子的pinyon松。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Pelargonium odoratissimum；叶片芳香的一种天竺葵属植物（本例义）
rows.en: The nutmeg geranium released a scent when she brushed against its leaves.
rows.zh: 她碰到那株Pelargonium odoratissimum的叶子时，叶片散发出了一股香气。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 眼斑吐绶鸡（Meleagris ocellata，旧名Agriocharis ocellata）
rows.en: The ocellated turkey's tail feathers caught the light as it turned.
rows.zh: 那只眼斑吐绶鸡转身时，尾羽映出了光彩。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 古怪的人；行为或习惯与旁人不同的家伙（本例为普通人物义）
rows.en: The new caretaker was an odd fellow who collected broken clocks and named every stray cat.
rows.zh: 新来的看门人是个古怪家伙，既搜集坏钟，又给每只流浪猫取名字。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 油芫菁类甲虫；本例指Meloe属甲虫，可从足关节渗出油状防御液
rows.en: The oil beetle crawled slowly across the sandy track.
rows.zh: 那只Meloe属芫菁慢慢爬过沙质小路。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Pyrularia pubera灌木的油质核果，亦称buffalo nut（本例为特定植物的果实义）
rows.en: The oil nut lay among fallen leaves beneath the shrub.
rows.zh: 灌木下的落叶间，躺着一枚Pyrularia pubera的核果。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 世代传承的家族财富；老牌富裕家族的祖传财富
rows.en: Much of the town's old money was tied up in land rather than cash.
rows.zh: 镇上那些老牌富裕家族的财富大多在土地上，而不是现金。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 在它上面；在所指事物上（本例为方位状语用法）
rows.en: There was an empty table, so I set my bag on it.
rows.zh: 有张空桌子，我便把包放在了上面。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 保持警觉的；留心戒备的
rows.en: After the first alarm, even the sleepiest crew member remained on the qui vive.
rows.zh: 第一次警报过后，连最困倦的船员也一直保持警觉。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 在巡回演出中；在不同地点依次进行相关演出等活动
rows.en: The quartet rehearsed a new piece while on tour in Spain.
rows.zh: 那个四重奏乐团在西班牙巡演期间排练了一首新曲。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 一次性活动或尝试；只发生或进行一次的事（本例义）
rows.en: The workshop was a one-shot, rather than the start of a regular course.
rows.zh: 那次工作坊只是一次性活动，并不是常规课程的开端。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 有一次；在某一个时候
rows.en: One time, we missed the last bus and walked home under the stars.
rows.zh: 有一次，我们错过了末班车，便披着星光走回家。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 只有……才；仅当……时（表示必要条件）
rows.en: We will reopen the footbridge only if the inspection confirms that it is safe.
rows.zh: 只有检查确认安全，我们才会重新开放这座人行桥。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 循环信贷；偿还欠款后，可在授信额度内再次借用的信贷安排
rows.en: Repaying part of the balance restored some of her available open-end credit.
rows.zh: 偿还部分欠款后，她的循环信贷可用额度恢复了一部分。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 文章、故事等的开篇第一句或第一行
rows.en: The novel's opening line made me expect a comedy, but the next page changed my mind.
rows.zh: 小说的开篇第一句让我以为这是一部喜剧，但下一页就改变了我的看法。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 晚装披风；罩在晚礼服外的大披风（本例取披风义）
rows.en: She fastened her opera hood over the satin dress before the carriage arrived.
rows.zh: 马车到来前，她把晚装披风扣好，罩在缎子礼服外。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 技术系统按预定要求运行或完成任务的能力
rows.en: The test checked the robot's operating capability on a wet floor.
rows.zh: 这项测试检验了机器人在潮湿地面上的作业能力。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 鼩负鼠类；南美洲地栖、外形似鼩鼱的有袋动物
rows.en: An opossum rat nosed through the leaf litter beneath the shrubs.
rows.zh: 一只鼩负鼠在灌木下的落叶间用鼻子探寻。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 光盘；用光学方式读取或记录数字数据的盘片
rows.en: The archivist placed the optical disc in a padded case after copying its files.
rows.zh: 档案员复制完里面的文件后，把那张光盘放进了带衬垫的盒子。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 口服避孕；通过服用避孕药实现的避孕方法
rows.en: Her doctor discussed oral contraception during the appointment and answered her questions about the pill.
rows.zh: 就诊时，医生向她介绍了口服避孕，并回答了她有关避孕药的问题。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 奥兰治格罗夫；美国得克萨斯州的一座城市（Orange Grove）
rows.en: We stopped in Orange Grove, Texas, to buy groceries before continuing the drive.
rows.zh: 我们在得克萨斯州奥兰治格罗夫停下来买了些食品，然后继续开车赶路。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Bauhinia variegata羊蹄甲属树木；本例取该种义
rows.en: The orchid tree's pale pink flowers glowed against the grey wall.
rows.zh: 那株Bauhinia variegata的淡粉色花朵，在灰墙的映衬下格外鲜亮。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Acokanthera oppositifolia；南非的一种常绿灌木或小乔木（本例取该种义）
rows.en: Clusters of pale flowers covered the ordeal tree near the gate.
rows.zh: 门边那株Acokanthera oppositifolia开满了一簇簇浅色花朵。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 管风琴中音色相近的一组音管；本例取音管组义
rows.en: The organ builder spent the afternoon tuning the pipes of the new organ stop.
rows.zh: 管风琴制造师花了一个下午，为新添的那组音管调音。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Platanus orientalis悬铃木；本例取该种义
rows.en: A broad oriental plane shaded the café tables beside the river.
rows.zh: 一株树冠宽阔的Platanus orientalis悬铃木，为河边咖啡馆的桌椅遮出阴凉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Matteuccia struthiopteris蕨；羽状叶呈莲座状排列的大型蕨类
rows.en: The ostrich fern's tall green fronds hid the stone edging of the shaded bed.
rows.zh: 那株Matteuccia struthiopteris高高的绿色蕨叶，遮住了荫蔽花坛的石质镶边。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Leucanthemum vulgare；开白色舌状花、中央黄色的多年生菊科植物（本例取该种义）
rows.en: An oxeye daisy pushed up between the fence posts, its white flower facing the morning sun.
rows.zh: 一株Leucanthemum vulgare从篱笆柱之间长出，白色花朵朝着晨光。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 牛尾汤；用牛尾烹制的汤
rows.en: A bowl of oxtail soup steamed beside the basket of bread.
rows.zh: 面包篮旁，一碗牛尾汤正冒着热气。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 牡蛎壳；牡蛎的外壳
rows.en: She used an oyster shell as a dish for the tiny beads.
rows.zh: 她用一枚牡蛎壳盛放那些小珠子。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Vanessa virginiensis蛱蝶；又称American Lady的美洲蝴蝶
rows.en: The painted beauty settled on a purple flower and slowly opened its spotted wings.
rows.zh: 那只Vanessa virginiensis蛱蝶落在一朵紫花上，慢慢展开带斑点的翅膀。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Tanacetum coccineum；叶细裂、花呈菊状的多年生观赏植物
rows.en: After the rain, a painted daisy still held drops of water on its finely divided leaves.
rows.zh: 雨后，一株Tanacetum coccineum的细裂叶片上仍挂着水珠。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一把钳子；两臂铰接、用于夹持物体的手工具
rows.en: Mara held the bent nail with a pair of pliers as I straightened it.
rows.zh: Mara用一把钳子夹住弯钉，我则把钉子扳直。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Viola striata；北美东部开淡色紫纹花的堇菜
rows.en: Purple lines crossed the pale violet's creamy petals.
rows.zh: 那株Viola striata乳白色的花瓣上，带着一道道紫色细纹。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 圣木（Bulnesia sarmientoi，亦称Gonopterodendron sarmientoi）；阿根廷、巴拉圭干旱地区的一种树（本例取该种义）
rows.en: An old palo santo stood alone beyond the dry riverbed.
rows.zh: 干涸河床的另一边，孤立着一棵老圣木（Bulnesia sarmientoi）。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 睑结膜；覆盖眼睑内面的结膜部分
rows.en: The illustration shows the palpebra conjunctiva lining the inside of the eyelid.
rows.zh: 图中展示了覆盖眼睑内面的睑结膜。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 黍属（Panicum）的禾草；本例指植株
rows.en: Panic grass had spread across the field that was left uncut all summer.
rows.zh: 那片整个夏季都未割草的地里，黍属禾草已经蔓延开来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 船蛸（Argonauta argo）；雌体具有薄纸状螺旋卵壳的章鱼
rows.en: The female paper nautilus sheltered her eggs inside a thin, spiral case.
rows.zh: 那只雌船蛸把卵护在薄薄的螺旋状卵壳里。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 纸蜂；用纸状材料筑巢的一类社会性胡蜂
rows.en: The paper wasp returned to the papery nest beneath the shed roof.
rows.zh: 那只纸蜂回到棚屋顶下的纸巢里。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Narcissus papyraceus水仙；开白花、常作室内观赏的水仙
rows.en: The paperwhite on the windowsill opened its first white flowers in January.
rows.zh: 窗台上那株Narcissus papyraceus在一月开出了第一批白花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 抛物面反射镜；反射面呈抛物形的光学镜
rows.en: An engineer adjusted the parabolic mirror until the reflected beam reached the sensor.
rows.zh: 工程师调整抛物面反射镜，直到反射光束落到传感器上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 未完全精炼的石蜡；半精炼石蜡（本例取加工中间物义）
rows.en: The refinery stored paraffin scale separately from the fully refined wax.
rows.zh: 炼油厂把半精炼石蜡与完全精炼的蜡分开存放。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 芭菲甜点杯；杯身高而细、杯脚较短的玻璃甜点杯
rows.en: The parfait glass revealed neat layers of berries, cream and crumbled biscuits.
rows.zh: 那只芭菲甜点杯里，莓果、奶油和饼干碎一层层整齐可见。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （旧称）亚洲村落附近的无主、半野化犬
rows.en: A pariah dog slept in the shade of a cart outside the village market.
rows.zh: 村里的集市外，一只无主的半野化犬正在一辆车的阴影下睡觉。
rows.author: role
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different from Role author and Root initial reviewer

rows.meaningZh: 议会事务代理律师；在英国议会代办私人法案的专业律师
rows.en: The company hired a parliamentary agent to guide its private bill through the required stages.
rows.zh: 公司聘请了一名议会事务代理律师，协助其私人法案完成所需程序。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Chamaecrista fasciculata；美洲的一种豆科草本植物
rows.en: The partridge pea's yellow flowers stood out among the grasses along the track.
rows.zh: 小路旁的草丛中，Chamaecrista fasciculata的黄花格外醒目。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 党鞭；负责维持本党议员纪律、督促参加表决等事务的议员
rows.en: The party whip checked who would be present for the late-night vote.
rows.zh: 党鞭核对了哪些议员会出席深夜的表决。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美的一种森莺（Setophaga americana，亦称Northern Parula；旧名Parula americana）
rows.en: A parula warbler flitted between the branches above us, too high for a clear photograph.
rows.zh: 一只Setophaga americana森莺在我们头顶的枝条间穿梭，位置太高，拍不清楚。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 拼布被；用不同布片拼缝而成的被子
rows.en: Grandma spread the patchwork quilt over the guest bed and smoothed its corners.
rows.zh: 奶奶把拼布被铺到客床上，抚平四角。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 偿还债务的行为；还债（本例取名词性活动义）
rows.en: Paying back the loan became harder when his working hours were cut.
rows.zh: 工时被削减后，偿还那笔贷款变得更加困难。
rows.author: role
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different from Role author and Root initial reviewer

rows.meaningZh: 孔雀蛱蝶（Aglais io，旧名Inachis io）
rows.en: The peacock butterfly opened its wings, revealing four striking eyespots.
rows.zh: 那只孔雀蛱蝶展开翅膀，露出了四个醒目的眼斑。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 斑铜矿（bornite）；一种铜铁硫化物（本例取该矿物义）
rows.en: The specimen labelled peacock ore had a purple sheen on its weathered surface.
rows.zh: 那块标为斑铜矿的标本，风化后的表面泛着紫色光泽。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 剧院最上层或最靠后的廉价座区
rows.en: From the peanut gallery, we could see the orchestra pit but could barely make out the actors' faces.
rows.zh: 坐在最上层的廉价座位上，我们看得见乐池，却几乎看不清演员的脸。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 胸肌；胸前的主要肌肉之一
rows.en: The tutor coloured the pectoral muscle red on the chest diagram.
rows.zh: 导师在胸部示意图上，把胸肌涂成了红色。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 财力；可动用的金钱资产
rows.en: The charity's limited pecuniary resources could not cover the repairs to both buildings.
rows.zh: 这家慈善机构有限的财力，不足以支付两栋楼的修缮费用。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （女式）长及小腿的贴身裤装；七分裤
rows.en: She rolled up the picnic blanket and brushed the grass off her pedal pushers.
rows.zh: 她卷起野餐毯，掸掉了七分裤上的草屑。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 孔式照门；枪械后部带小孔的瞄准装置
rows.en: The museum label described the peep sight mounted at the rear of the rifle.
rows.zh: 博物馆标签介绍了安装在步枪后部的孔式照门。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 钉脚陀螺；带金属尖轴的木制陀螺
rows.en: The peg top hummed on the floor until it struck a chair leg.
rows.zh: 钉脚陀螺在地板上嗡嗡旋转，直到碰上椅腿。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 小赌注扑克；赌注很小的扑克游戏
rows.en: After supper, the neighbours settled down to a game of penny ante.
rows.zh: 晚饭后，邻居们坐下来，玩起了小赌注扑克。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 零钱储蓄罐；儿童用的存钱罐
rows.en: He emptied the penny bank onto the rug and counted the coins.
rows.zh: 他把存钱罐里的硬币倒在地毯上，数了起来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 胡椒粉撒料瓶；盖上有孔的胡椒瓶
rows.en: A dent in the base of the pepper box made it wobble on the table.
rows.zh: 胡椒粉瓶底部的凹痕，使它放在桌上时摇摇晃晃。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Pseudowintera colorata；叶常有红黄色斑块的灌木或小乔木（本例取该种义）
rows.en: The pepper shrub's red-blotched leaves brightened the shaded corner of the garden.
rows.zh: 那株Pseudowintera colorata灌木带红斑的叶片，为花园荫处增添了亮色。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 消化性溃疡病变；胃或十二指肠等处的消化性溃疡
rows.en: The report described peptic ulceration but did not identify its cause.
rows.zh: 报告描述了消化性溃疡病变，但没有说明原因。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 个人自我身份；作为同一个体而持续存在的独特自我
rows.en: The memoir explores how personal identity can persist through years of change.
rows.zh: 这本回忆录探讨了个人自我身份如何在多年的变化中保持延续。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Euphorbia peplus；原产旧大陆、常作杂草的一种大戟属草本
rows.en: Petty spurge had taken root in a crack beside the garden steps.
rows.zh: 花园台阶旁的一条裂缝里，已经长出了一株Euphorbia peplus。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: φ相关系数；衡量两个二分变量关联程度的指标
rows.en: The statistician used the phi coefficient to summarize the association between two yes-or-no responses.
rows.zh: 统计学家用φ相关系数概括两个是非题回答之间的关联。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 电话系统；传送语音的通信系统
rows.en: The office's phone system stopped working halfway through the morning.
rows.zh: 上午过了一半，办公室的电话系统突然停止了工作。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 由摄影底片印制的照片；摄影印相
rows.en: She slid the photographic print into a protective sleeve before putting away the negative.
rows.zh: 她先把那张印相照片放进保护套，再收好底片。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 图像表现；以摄影或绘画等方式作出的视觉呈现
rows.en: The museum used a pictorial representation of the harbour to explain how the shoreline had changed.
rows.zh: 博物馆用一幅港口图像，说明海岸线发生了怎样的变化。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 画面平面；绘画或素描中承载所描绘形象的平面
rows.en: The artist used a diagonal stripe to lead the viewer's eye across the picture plane.
rows.zh: 画家用一道斜向条纹，引导观者的视线扫过画面平面。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 镜下桌；放在壁镜下的矮桌
rows.en: A bowl of dried roses stood on the pier table beneath the mirror.
rows.zh: 镜子下方的矮桌上，放着一碗干玫瑰。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 灰背隼（Falco columbarius，亦称merlin）；一种小型隼
rows.en: The pigeon hawk swept past the ridge before we could raise our binoculars.
rows.zh: 我们还没来得及举起望远镜，那只灰背隼就掠过了山脊。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 枕头大战；互相用枕头拍打的嬉戏
rows.en: The pillow fight ended when a cushion burst and scattered feathers across the room.
rows.zh: 一个靠垫破开、羽毛撒满房间后，这场枕头大战才结束。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 枕上花边；在垫枕上以绕线筒编织的花边（bobbin lace）
rows.en: The craftswoman moved the bobbins aside to show us the pattern of the pillow lace.
rows.zh: 那位手艺人把绕线筒移到一旁，向我们展示枕上花边的纹样。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 电视剧等系列节目的试播片；用来展示拟拍系列并吸引赞助的样片
rows.en: The producers screened the pilot film for potential sponsors before making the rest of the series.
rows.zh: 制片方在拍摄系列的其余部分之前，先向潜在赞助商放映了试播片。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （尤指四足动物的）髋骨
rows.en: The vet marked the pinbone on the diagram of the cow's pelvis.
rows.zh: 兽医在牛的骨盆示意图上标出了髋骨。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 弹球游戏；在倾斜球台上操纵小球得分的游戏
rows.en: Our pinball game ended when the last ball slipped past the flippers.
rows.zh: 最后一个球滑过挡板落下后，我们的弹球游戏就结束了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Sceloporus undulatus；北美的一种小型刺蜥（亦称eastern fence lizard）
rows.en: A pine lizard darted from the warm stone into a gap in the fence.
rows.zh: 一只Sceloporus undulatus从温热的石头上窜进了篱笆的缝隙。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美金翅雀类小鸟（Spinus pinus，亦称pine finch）
rows.en: A pine siskin paused on the feeder while the larger birds argued over the seeds.
rows.zh: 一只Spinus pinus停在喂鸟器上，旁边的大鸟正为种子争抢。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 松蛇（本例指Pituophis melanoleucus）；美国东部的一种大型无毒蛇
rows.en: The pine snake slipped beneath the dry pine needles at the edge of the track.
rows.zh: 那条松蛇钻进了小路边干燥的松针下面。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 墨西哥的一种食用松子松（Pinus cembroides）
rows.en: The pinon pine beside the trail was low enough for us to examine its needles closely.
rows.zh: 步道旁那棵Pinus cembroides很矮，我们可以凑近观察它的松针。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 活塞室；活塞在其中运动的腔体或气缸
rows.en: The cutaway model showed the piston chamber and the rod passing through one end.
rows.zh: 剖面模型展示了活塞室和从其一端穿出的杆件。
rows.author: role
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; independent of Role author and Root initial reviewer

rows.meaningZh: 天然开采、未经筛分等处理的砾石；原坑砾石
rows.en: The contractor kept the pit-run gravel in a separate pile from the screened aggregate.
rows.zh: 承包商把原坑砾石与筛分后的集料分堆存放。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （高尔夫）高抛近距离击球；以较高弧线接近球洞的击球
rows.en: His pitch shot rose over the bunker and landed softly on the green.
rows.zh: 他的高抛近距离击球越过沙坑，轻轻落在果岭上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 横队转向时的基准队员；其他队员绕其转动的人
rows.en: During the rehearsal, the pivot man missed the command and the line lost its shape.
rows.zh: 排练时，担任转向基准的队员漏听了口令，整个横队顿时乱了队形。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （篮球）转身投篮；以一脚为轴转身作出的单手投篮
rows.en: Her pivot shot dropped cleanly through the basket just as the buzzer sounded.
rows.zh: 蜂鸣器响起时，她的转身投篮干净利落地落入了篮筐。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 领鹑（Pedionomus torquatus）；澳大利亚的一种地栖鸟，现常称plains-wanderer
rows.en: The plain wanderer vanished into the dry grass while the observer was still adjusting his telescope.
rows.zh: 观察者还在调整望远镜时，那只领鹑就消失在干草丛里了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 被视为毫无缺点的人；理想化的完人
rows.en: The biography presents her as a complicated person rather than a plaster saint.
rows.zh: 这部传记把她写成一个复杂的人，而没有把她塑造成毫无缺点的完人。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 筋疲力尽的；耗尽精力的
rows.en: By sunset, the hikers were completely played out and ready to rest.
rows.zh: 日落时，徒步者们已经筋疲力尽，准备休息了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 颈动脉丛；围绕颈内动脉的神经丛
rows.en: The anatomy plate showed the plexus caroticus surrounding the internal carotid artery.
rows.zh: 解剖图版展示了围绕颈内动脉的颈动脉丛。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 使长胖；使变得丰满或肥壮
rows.en: The farmer hoped the new feed would plump out the pigs before winter.
rows.zh: 农场主希望新饲料能让猪在入冬前长得更肥壮些。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 某项重要事务的牵头人；站在工作前线的人
rows.en: The mayor chose an experienced engineer as the point man for the bridge project.
rows.zh: 市长选了一位经验丰富的工程师，担任大桥项目的牵头人。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 无法回头的临界点；过后便难以撤回决定的阶段
rows.en: By the time the first wall came down, the renovation had reached the point of no return.
rows.zh: 第一堵墙拆下来时，这项翻修工程已经到了无法回头的阶段。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （冰球）捅球断球；用球杆捅开对方控制的球
rows.en: A quick poke check sent the puck away from the approaching forward.
rows.zh: 一次迅速的捅球断球，让冰球远离了逼近的前锋。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 警察部门；地方政府中负责执法和预防犯罪的机构
rows.en: The police department opened a temporary office while its main building was repaired.
rows.zh: 警察部门在总部大楼维修期间，设立了一个临时办公室。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 警务女看守；负责看管、陪同在押女性的女性工作人员
rows.en: The police matron accompanied the woman from the holding room to the interview room.
rows.zh: 警务女看守陪同那名女子从拘留室走到问询室。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 船尾楼甲板；船尾上层结构上的露天甲板
rows.en: From the poop deck, the passengers watched the harbour lights shrink behind the ship.
rows.zh: 乘客们站在船尾楼甲板上，看着港口灯火在船后渐渐远去。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Anagallis arvensis（琉璃繁缕类植物）的英文俗名；花常随阴雨天气临近而闭合
rows.en: A poor man's weatherglass grew beside the gate, its small scarlet flowers open in the sun.
rows.zh: 门边长着一株Anagallis arvensis，小小的鲜红花朵在阳光下开放着。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 突然出现；突然探出或冒出
rows.en: A child's face might pop out from behind the curtain at any moment.
rows.zh: 随时都可能有一张孩子的脸从窗帘后突然探出来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 腘动脉；膝后区域的一条动脉
rows.en: The lecturer traced the popliteal artery on the enlarged diagram of the knee.
rows.zh: 讲师在放大的膝部示意图上描出了腘动脉的走向。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 猪肉商贩；出售猪肉及其制品的人
rows.en: The pork butcher sold sausages as well as fresh cuts of meat.
rows.zh: 那位猪肉商贩除了卖新鲜分切肉，也出售香肠。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 以先后为因果的谬误；仅因一事发生在另一事之后，便认定前者由后者导致的逻辑错误
rows.en: The textbook's chapter on post hoc explains why sequence alone does not establish causation.
rows.zh: 教材关于“以先后为因果”谬误的那一章，解释了为什么仅凭时间顺序不能确立因果关系。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 阴唇后静脉；从大阴唇向后汇入阴部内静脉的静脉
rows.en: The medical illustrator labelled the posterior labial veins in blue on the diagram.
rows.zh: 医学绘图员在示意图上用蓝色标出了阴唇后静脉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Apios americana；结可食块茎的北美豆科藤本植物
rows.en: The potato bean climbed the rough wooden trellis behind the shed.
rows.zh: 棚屋后，那株Apios americana顺着粗木搭成的棚架攀爬。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 马铃薯块茎蛾（Phthorimaea operculella）的成虫
rows.en: A potato tuber moth rested on the outside of the storage-room window.
rows.zh: 一只马铃薯块茎蛾停在储藏室窗户的外侧。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 马铃薯块茎蛾的幼虫；Phthorimaea operculella的幼虫阶段
rows.en: The researcher found a potato tuberworm inside the damaged stem.
rows.zh: 研究人员在受损的茎内发现了一条马铃薯块茎蛾幼虫。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Symphyotrichum turbinellum（旧名Aster turbinellus）；美国中部开紫花的一种多年生紫菀类植物
rows.en: The prairie aster added a haze of violet flowers to the edge of the garden.
rows.zh: 花园边缘的Symphyotrichum turbinellum开满了紫色花朵，远看如一层薄雾。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美草原松鸡类；体羽有褐色斑纹的松鸡
rows.en: A prairie fowl disappeared into the tall grass before I could lift my camera.
rows.zh: 我还没来得及举起相机，一只草原松鸡就钻进高草丛里不见了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Salix humilis；生于北美干燥地区的一种灌木状柳树
rows.en: The prairie willow formed a low thicket along the sandy path.
rows.zh: 那种Salix humilis在沙地小路旁形成了一片低矮的灌丛。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （俚语）使怀孕
rows.en: He worried that he might prang up his girlfriend before they were ready for a baby.
rows.zh: 他担心两人还没准备好要孩子，就会让女友怀孕。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 早发性痴呆；症状在65岁以前开始的痴呆（presenile dementia为旧称）
rows.en: Families affected by presenile dementia took part in the interview study.
rows.zh: 受早发性痴呆影响的家庭参加了这项访谈研究。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 反复强调以使人明白或信服；有力地讲清
rows.en: The speaker used one final example to press home the need for reliable records.
rows.zh: 演讲者用最后一个例子，有力地强调了保存可靠记录的必要性。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 加压穹顶建筑；内部维持压力的穹顶形建筑物
rows.en: The technicians checked the pressure dome for leaks before anyone entered.
rows.zh: 技术人员在任何人进入之前，先检查了加压穹顶建筑是否漏气。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 压强；单位面积受到的力（本例指实际压力大小，非声压级）
rows.en: The pressure level in the chamber rose steadily during the test.
rows.zh: 测试过程中，腔室内的压强持续上升。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 哄抬价格；利用消费者缺少替代选择而索取过高价格的行为
rows.en: Residents accused the only shop still open after the storm of price gouging.
rows.zh: 风暴过后，居民指责唯一仍在营业的商店哄抬价格。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Pinus pungens；美国阿巴拉契亚山区的一种松树，球果鳞片有刺尖
rows.en: The prickly pine's old cones remained attached to a twisted branch.
rows.zh: 那棵Pinus pungens的老球果仍挂在一根扭曲的枝条上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 素朴艺术；由未受正规艺术训练者创作的艺术（本例取该词典义）
rows.en: The gallery's room on primitive art featured carvings by self-taught artists.
rows.zh: 画廊的素朴艺术展室中，陈列着自学成才的创作者雕刻的作品。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 简约原则；解释现象时避免引入不必要假设或实体的原则（奥卡姆剃刀）
rows.en: The researcher invoked the principle of parsimony when choosing between the two explanations.
rows.zh: 研究人员在两种解释之间作选择时，援引了简约原则。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 相对性原理；本例指物理学规律不因惯性参考系的匀速直线运动而改变的原理
rows.en: The lecturer used a smoothly moving train to introduce the principle of relativity.
rows.zh: 讲师用一列平稳行驶的火车，引入了相对性原理。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 按总体各层比例抽取的分层样本；比例分层样本
rows.en: The team drew a proportional sample so that each year group made up the same share of the sample as of the school.
rows.zh: 团队抽取了一个按比例分层的样本，使各年级在样本中所占比例与其在全校中所占比例一致。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 翼突；蝶骨向下伸出的骨性突起
rows.en: The student located the pterygoid process on the skull model before answering the question.
rows.zh: 学生回答问题前，先在颅骨模型上找到了翼突。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 主要依靠公众支持的慈善组织
rows.en: The public charity depended on hundreds of small donations to keep its shelter open.
rows.zh: 那家主要依靠公众支持的慈善组织，需要数百笔小额捐款才能维持收容所运营。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 公开披露；把问题或主题公诸于众、供公众讨论
rows.en: Public exposure of the proposal led to a lively debate at the town meeting.
rows.zh: 提案公开后，在镇民大会上引发了热烈讨论。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 膨化米；经膨化而变松脆的米粒
rows.en: She scattered puffed rice over the melted chocolate and left the tray to cool.
rows.zh: 她把膨化米撒在融化的巧克力上，然后把托盘放在一旁冷却。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 叫停；终止或阻止某项活动继续（惯用语）
rows.en: The council decided to pull the plug on the festival after its main sponsor withdrew.
rows.zh: 主要赞助商退出后，议会决定叫停那场节庆活动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 体外射精法；在射精前撤出的避孕做法
rows.en: The questionnaire listed pulling out separately from condom use.
rows.zh: 问卷把体外射精法与使用安全套分列为不同选项。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 拟八哥（Quiscalus quiscula）；本例取purple grackle的鸟类义
rows.en: A purple grackle landed on the wet lawn and began probing for food.
rows.zh: 一只Quiscalus quiscula拟八哥落在湿草坪上，开始探寻食物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 钱袋抽绳；用于束紧钱袋开口的绳子
rows.en: The purse string had snapped, spilling a handful of coins onto the path.
rows.zh: 钱袋抽绳断了，一把硬币撒在小路上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 给……施麻醉；使……进入麻醉状态（口语）
rows.en: The anaesthetist explained how she would put the patient under before the operation.
rows.zh: 麻醉师解释了她将在手术前如何让患者进入麻醉状态。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 欧洲山杨（Populus tremula）；quaking aspen的一个旧大陆树种义
rows.en: The European quaking aspen in the arboretum had begun to turn yellow.
rows.zh: 树木园里的那棵欧洲山杨（Populus tremula）已经开始变黄。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 生活质量；对自身生活状况的满意程度（本例取主观体验义）
rows.en: Having time for music and friends improved her quality of life.
rows.zh: 有时间欣赏音乐、与朋友相处，让她的生活质量提高了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 警戒状态；高度警觉（常用于on the qui vive）
rows.en: The unexpected knock put everyone on the qui vive.
rows.zh: 突如其来的敲门声，让所有人都警觉起来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Agropyron repens（词典所用学名）；靠匍匐根茎迅速蔓延的一种禾草
rows.en: Quick grass had sent new shoots through the edge of the vegetable bed.
rows.zh: 那种Agropyron repens已经从菜畦边缘钻出了新的枝芽。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 帝王鲑（Oncorhynchus tshawytscha，亦称chinook salmon）
rows.en: A quinnat salmon specimen lay on the measuring board beside the biologist's notebook.
rows.zh: 一条帝王鲑标本放在量鱼板上，旁边是生物学家的笔记本。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 槽隔圆凸线脚；以窄槽与相邻装饰面分开的圆凸线饰
rows.en: A thin layer of paint had filled the groove beside the quirk bead.
rows.zh: 一层薄薄的油漆填进了圆凸线脚旁的窄槽。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 带槽线脚；具有小凹槽的装饰线条
rows.en: The joiner used a small brush to clean dust from the quirk molding.
rows.zh: 木工用一把小刷子清理带槽线脚里的灰尘。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 带槽线脚；具有小凹槽的装饰线条（英式拼写）
rows.en: The replacement quirk moulding matched the groove on the old door frame.
rows.zh: 新换的带槽线脚与旧门框上的槽形相配。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Chrysothamnus nauseosus（词典所用学名）；美国西部开密集黄花的芳香灌木
rows.en: The rabbit brush beside the fence was covered in small yellow flowers.
rows.zh: 篱笆旁那株Chrysothamnus nauseosus开满了小黄花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 貉（Nyctereutes procyonoides）；面部有类似浣熊斑纹的犬科动物
rows.en: The raccoon dog paused at the edge of the reeds and sniffed the air.
rows.zh: 那只貉在芦苇边停下来，嗅了嗅空气。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 单人赛艇；由一名划手操纵的狭长竞赛艇（本例取single shell义）
rows.en: The racing skiff slipped away from the landing stage with a single rower aboard.
rows.zh: 那艘单人赛艇载着一名划手，轻轻滑离了登船台。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 竞赛用游艇；本例指参加比赛的帆船
rows.en: The racing yacht heeled sharply as it rounded the buoy.
rows.zh: 那艘竞赛帆船绕过浮标时，船身明显倾斜。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 桡静脉；前臂桡侧伴行桡动脉的静脉
rows.en: The anatomy tutor highlighted the radial vein on a diagram of the forearm.
rows.zh: 解剖学导师在前臂示意图上突出标出了桡静脉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 散热器格栅；让冷却空气通往汽车散热器的栅状部件
rows.en: A small dent in the radiator grille was the only visible damage to the car.
rows.zh: 散热器格栅上的一处小凹痕，是那辆车唯一看得见的损伤。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Lychnis flos-cuculi（词典所用学名）；通常开粉红色深裂花瓣的一种多年生草本
rows.en: The ragged robin's pink flowers nodded above the wet grass.
rows.zh: 那株Lychnis flos-cuculi的粉红花朵在湿草上方轻轻摇动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 插肩袖；袖片延伸至领口、袖缝斜向领部的袖型
rows.en: The jacket's raglan sleeve gave him room to reach for the top shelf.
rows.zh: 那件夹克的插肩袖让他有足够的活动空间，伸手够到最高一层架子。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 铁路车辆；行驶在铁轨上的车厢或车辆
rows.en: The empty railroad car rolled slowly into the repair shed.
rows.zh: 那节空铁路车厢缓缓驶入了维修库。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 苹果实蝇（Rhagoletis pomonella）的幼虫；railroad worm的一个虫名义
rows.en: The railroad worm left a brown tunnel through the apple's flesh.
rows.zh: 那条苹果实蝇幼虫在苹果果肉中留下了一道褐色虫道。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Echinocereus rigidissimus；具有彩色密刺的柱状仙人掌
rows.en: A rainbow cactus stood on the sunny shelf beside a row of clay pots.
rows.zh: 一株Echinocereus rigidissimus摆在向阳的架子上，旁边是一排陶盆。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 孔雀鱼（旧词典学名Lebistes reticulatus）；rainbow fish的一个淡水鱼义
rows.en: A male rainbow fish trailed his patterned tail through the water.
rows.zh: 一条雄性孔雀鱼拖着花纹鲜艳的尾巴，在水中游动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 彩虹胡瓜鱼（Osmerus mordax）；北美的一种胡瓜鱼
rows.en: The rainbow smelt specimen was kept on ice until the biologist could examine it.
rows.zh: 那条彩虹胡瓜鱼标本一直保存在冰上，等待生物学家检查。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 非正式讨论小组；聚在一起作坦率交流的一组人（本例取讨论会义）
rows.en: The rap group met in the common room to talk about the pressures of university life.
rows.zh: 那个非正式讨论小组在公共休息室碰面，谈论大学生活带来的压力。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 快速眼动睡眠；以眼球快速运动等为特征的一种睡眠阶段（REM睡眠）
rows.en: The sleep record showed several periods of rapid eye movement sleep.
rows.zh: 睡眠记录中出现了几段快速眼动睡眠。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 按份配给；定量分发
rows.en: The team leader had to ration out the remaining batteries.
rows.zh: 队长不得不按份配给剩下的电池。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Botrychium virginianum；孢子囊成簇、形似响尾蛇尾部的一种蕨类
rows.en: The guide pointed out a rattlesnake fern among the fallen leaves.
rows.zh: 向导指出了落叶间的一株Botrychium virginianum。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Eryngium yuccifolium；一种具刺叶的多年生刺芹属植物
rows.en: The rattlesnake master stood above the shorter plants in the prairie display.
rows.zh: 草原植物展示区中，那株Eryngium yuccifolium高出周围较矮的植物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 原毛；未经精炼或加工的羊毛
rows.en: The mill bought raw wool from three nearby farms.
rows.zh: 那家工厂从附近的三个农场收购了未经加工的羊毛。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （马等）抬起前腿、以后腿站立而向后仰起
rows.en: The pony began to rear back when the umbrella opened.
rows.zh: 雨伞一撑开，小马就开始抬起前腿、以后腿站立。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 隐性等位基因
rows.en: The worksheet represented the recessive allele with a lowercase letter.
rows.zh: 练习单用一个小写字母表示隐性等位基因。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 反复发生的事件；隔一段时间再次出现的事情
rows.en: Flooding had become a recurrent event in the riverside village.
rows.zh: 在那个河边村庄，洪水已成了反复发生的事。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 红山姜（Alpinia purpurata）；一种观赏姜科植物
rows.en: The florist added a stalk of red ginger to the arrangement.
rows.zh: 花艺师在插花作品中加入了一枝红山姜。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Mullus auratus；一种体色鲜红、体侧有浅色条纹的羊鱼科海鱼
rows.en: The diver watched a red goatfish move slowly over the pale sand.
rows.zh: 潜水者看着一条Mullus auratus在浅色沙底上缓缓游过。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 热狗；夹在面包里热食的法兰克福香肠（red hot的食物义）
rows.en: He bought a red hot from the stand outside the station.
rows.zh: 他从车站外的小摊买了一个热狗。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美圆柏（Juniperus virginiana，亦称eastern red cedar）；red juniper的一个树种义
rows.en: The red juniper sheltered several small birds during the snowstorm.
rows.zh: 暴风雪中，那棵Juniperus virginiana为几只小鸟提供了庇护。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （旧时、冒犯性称谓）北美原住民；带种族歧视意味的旧称
rows.en: The editor removed the phrase 'red man' from the modernized text because it was an offensive label.
rows.zh: 编辑从现代化改写的文本中删去了“red man”这个说法，因为它是一个冒犯性的称谓。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Abies amabilis；北美西部的一种冷杉（亦称Pacific silver fir）
rows.en: A red silver fir towered above the low fog in the valley.
rows.zh: 山谷里，一棵Abies amabilis高高地耸出低雾。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Lutjanus campechanus；北美大西洋及墨西哥湾的一种笛鲷（本例取该种鱼义）
rows.en: A red snapper swam slowly past the reef's outer edge.
rows.zh: 一条Lutjanus campechanus缓缓游过礁石外缘。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 玫瑰茄（Hibiscus sabdariffa）；red sorrel的一个木槿属植物义
rows.en: The gardener collected the fleshy red calyxes from the red sorrel.
rows.zh: 园丁从那株玫瑰茄上采下了肥厚的红色花萼。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 红蚯蚓；red worm的土栖蚯蚓义（非水生摇蚊幼虫）
rows.en: A red worm curled up as she lifted the damp leaf litter.
rows.zh: 她掀开潮湿的落叶层时，一条红蚯蚓蜷缩了起来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 参考书；供查阅可靠事实或资料的工具书
rows.en: The librarian kept the reference work behind the desk because several maps were loose.
rows.zh: 那部参考书里的几幅地图已经松脱，图书管理员便把它放在借阅台后。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 垃圾收集工；受雇收集、处理垃圾的人
rows.en: The refuse collector returned the empty bin to the pavement.
rows.zh: 垃圾收集工把空垃圾桶放回了人行道上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 收费出借藏书；图书馆等供读者付费租借的一批图书
rows.en: The library's rental collection included several new crime novels.
rows.zh: 图书馆的收费出借藏书中，有几本新出的犯罪小说。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 代表性抽样；旨在使样本反映总体特征的抽样（本例为抽样目标义，不限定一种设计）
rows.en: The report stressed representative sampling so that rural residents would not be overlooked.
rows.zh: 报告强调要进行能反映总体情况的抽样，以免忽视农村居民。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 科研场所；开展研究的中心或基地
rows.en: The research facility had space for two laboratories and a shared workshop.
rows.zh: 那处科研场所可容纳两个实验室和一间共用工作间。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 电阻单位；衡量电阻的单位（本例取欧姆）
rows.en: The chart labels the ohm as the resistance unit.
rows.zh: 图表把欧姆标为电阻单位。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 观叶秋海棠类；源自Begonia rex的一类杂交秋海棠
rows.en: The rex begonia's patterned leaves caught the light beside the window.
rows.zh: 窗边那株观叶秋海棠带花纹的叶片映着光。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 犀金龟类；头部常具角状突起的大型甲虫（本例取类群义）
rows.en: The rhinoceros beetle clung to the bark, its curved horn silhouetted against the lamp.
rows.zh: 那只犀金龟紧贴树皮，弯曲的角状突起在灯光下显出轮廓。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 以米发酵酿成的传统酒；本例指印度阿萨姆的米酿酒
rows.en: At the village feast in Assam, our host poured rice beer into small cups.
rows.zh: 阿萨姆的村宴上，主人把以米酿成的发酵酒倒进小杯里。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 骑马等离去；骑着车或马离开
rows.en: They watched the courier mount his horse and ride off toward the hills.
rows.zh: 他们看着信使跨上马，骑马朝山地远去。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （老式俚语，表示赞同）说得对；好极了
rows.en: "Right on!" Maya said when the group agreed to make the event free.
rows.zh: 小组同意让活动免费后，玛雅说：“太好了！”
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 筑路者；从事道路建设的人
rows.en: The road builder inspected the damaged culvert before work resumed.
rows.zh: 施工恢复前，那名筑路人员检查了受损的涵洞。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 烤猪肉；经烘烤制成的猪肉菜肴（本例取熟食义）
rows.en: The roast pork was sliced at the table and served with potatoes.
rows.zh: 烤猪肉在餐桌旁切片，配土豆一起上桌。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 欧亚鸲（Erithacus rubecula，亦称European robin）；红胸的小型鸣禽
rows.en: A robin redbreast followed the gardener along the freshly turned border.
rows.zh: 一只欧亚鸲跟着园丁，沿着刚翻过土的花境移动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Erigeron pulchellus；北美东部开紫色舌状花的一种多年生飞蓬属植物
rows.en: The robin's plantain formed a loose patch beneath the birch trees.
rows.zh: 那种Erigeron pulchellus在桦树下疏疏落落地长成了一小片。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 岩生小蕨；本例取矮小、落叶、附生于岩石上的蕨类义
rows.en: A rock brake grew from a narrow cleft above the stream.
rows.zh: 溪流上方的一条窄石缝里，长着一株岩生小蕨。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 刺龙虾；没有大型螯足、甲壳多刺的海生龙虾类（本例指活体）
rows.en: The rock lobster backed into a crevice, leaving its long antennae exposed.
rows.zh: 那只刺龙虾倒退着钻进石缝，长长的触角仍露在外面。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 欧洲石鸡（Alectoris graeca）；南欧山区的一种鹑鸡类鸟
rows.en: A rock partridge called from the scree above the walking trail.
rows.zh: 徒步小径上方的碎石坡里，传来了一只欧洲石鸡的叫声。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Talinum calycinum（词典所用学名）；美国西部岩地开粉红花的一种多年生植物
rows.en: The rock pink opened a few pink flowers between the stones.
rows.zh: 那株Talinum calycinum在石头间开出了几朵粉红色小花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 非洲岩蟒（Python sebae）；rock snake的一个大型蟒蛇义
rows.en: The rock snake lay coiled beneath a fallen tree, almost hidden by the shadows.
rows.zh: 那条非洲岩蟒盘在倒木下，几乎被阴影遮住。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美岩地的一种大型地松鼠（词典旧名Citellus variegatus）；本例指美国西南的岩地松鼠
rows.en: The rock squirrel sat upright on a boulder, watching the walkers below.
rows.zh: 那只北美岩地松鼠直起身坐在巨石上，望着下方的行人。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 视杆细胞；对弱光敏感的视网膜感光细胞
rows.en: The diagram showed a rod cell beside a cone cell in the retina.
rows.zh: 示意图在视网膜部分并列画出了一个视杆细胞和一个视锥细胞。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Macrodactylus subspinosus；北美的一种鳃金龟，成虫取食蔷薇等植物的叶和花
rows.en: A rose bug crawled across a damaged rose petal.
rows.zh: 一只Macrodactylus subspinosus正从一片受损的玫瑰花瓣上爬过。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Lychnis coronaria（词典所用学名）；具银白绒毛叶、开鲜红花的庭园草本
rows.en: The rose campion's bright flowers rose above a mound of silvery leaves.
rows.zh: 那株Lychnis coronaria鲜艳的花朵，开在一丛银白色叶片上方。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 大花马齿苋（Portulaca grandiflora）；rose moss的开花植物义
rows.en: The rose moss opened a line of bright flowers along the sunny path.
rows.zh: 向阳的小路边，那些大花马齿苋开出了一排鲜艳的花朵。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 旋翼头；旋翼中心的连接、支承组件（本例取自转旋翼机的旋翼头义）
rows.en: The instructor pointed to the rotor head on the gyroplane model.
rows.zh: 教员指了指自转旋翼机模型上的旋翼头。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 毛脚鵟（Buteo lagopus）；rough-legged hawk的本例鸟种义
rows.en: The rough-legged hawk hovered over the winter pasture before dropping toward the ground.
rows.zh: 那只毛脚鵟在冬日牧场上空悬停，随后朝地面俯冲。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 形状近圆的骨头；本例取描述形状的名词短语义
rows.en: The small round bone had been placed in a separate compartment of the display.
rows.zh: 那块小小的圆形骨头，被放在展柜中单独的格子里。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 搜寻后找到；翻找出
rows.en: I managed to rout up the missing receipt from a box of old papers.
rows.zh: 我翻找了一箱旧文件，总算找出了那张遗失的收据。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 凯撒鹅膏（Amanita caesarea）；鹅膏属的一种蘑菇（本例取该种义）
rows.en: The mycologist's sketch of a royal agaric included the cap, stem and base.
rows.zh: 真菌学家画的凯撒鹅膏素描，包括菌盖、菌柄和基部。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （较少见）温习；使记忆恢复的复习（名词）
rows.en: A short rub-up on the scoring rules helped her enjoy the match.
rows.zh: 简短温习了一遍计分规则后，她看比赛更有兴致了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 出走；未经允许离开本应待着的地方（本例为离家出走）
rows.en: The counsellor listened as the teenager explained his reasons for running away.
rows.zh: 辅导员听那名青少年解释自己离家出走的原因。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （汽车门下的）踏脚板；供上下车踩踏的窄板
rows.en: He wiped the mud off his boots on the old truck's running board.
rows.zh: 他在老卡车的踏脚板上蹭掉了靴子上的泥。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （美式橄榄球）跑球进攻；持球向前推进的进攻打法
rows.en: Their running game improved after the offensive line began creating more space.
rows.zh: 进攻线开始创造更多空间后，他们的跑球进攻也有了起色。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 跑鞋；为跑步设计的轻便鞋
rows.en: She found a pebble inside her left running shoe.
rows.zh: 她在左脚那只跑鞋里发现了一颗小石子。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 电动曲线锯；装有往复运动锯条的便携式电锯（本例取jigsaw义）
rows.en: The carpenter put the saber saw back in its case after finishing the curved panel.
rows.zh: 做完弧形板件后，木匠把电动曲线锯放回工具箱。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 安全门闩；不能从门的外侧拨动的门闩
rows.en: The safety bolt on the garden gate was stiff with rust.
rows.zh: 花园门上的安全门闩生了锈，推起来很涩。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 安全剃须刀；带有护挡的剃须刀（指整件工具）
rows.en: He packed his safety razor in a small case for the journey.
rows.zh: 他把安全剃须刀装进一个小盒子里，准备旅途使用。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 向下凹陷；下垂（本例取不及物用法）
rows.en: The canvas began to sag down as rainwater gathered in the middle.
rows.zh: 雨水积在中间，帆布开始向下凹陷。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Poterium sanguisorba（词典所用学名）；叶可作沙拉配料的园艺草本
rows.en: The gardener planted salad burnet beside the low stone wall.
rows.zh: 园丁在矮石墙旁种下了那种Poterium sanguisorba草本植物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 销售金融公司；折价购入零售商分期付款销售合同的融资公司
rows.en: The sales finance company reviewed the retailer's batch of instalment contracts.
rows.zh: 那家销售金融公司审核了零售商提交的一批分期付款销售合同。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 盐豆木（Halimodendron halodendron）；里海盐碱地及西伯利亚的一种具刺灌木
rows.en: A salt tree's silvery young leaves stood out against the dry brown ground.
rows.zh: 那株盐豆木银灰色的嫩叶，在干褐色地面衬托下格外醒目。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Allium scorodoprasum；欧洲的一种葱属植物（词典中的sand leek义）
rows.en: The gardener marked the sand leek with a separate label in the Allium bed.
rows.zh: 园丁在葱属植物花坛里，为那株Allium scorodoprasum插上了一块单独的标牌。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Leiophyllum buxifolium（词典所用学名）；北美东部开白花的低矮常绿灌木
rows.en: The sand myrtle was dotted with small white flowers along the edge of the path.
rows.zh: 小路边，那株Leiophyllum buxifolium点缀着许多小白花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 望星鱼科（Dactyloscopidae）的小型海鱼；眼位于头顶、常埋伏在沙中的鱼（本例指个体）
rows.en: The sand stargazer disappeared into the sand, leaving only its eyes exposed.
rows.zh: 那条望星鱼钻进沙里，只露出眼睛。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Abronia属植物（花形似马鞭草，常生于沙地）
rows.en: Sand verbena had spread over the dune beside the wooden steps.
rows.zh: 木台阶旁的沙丘上长满了Abronia属的沙地植物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 三明治拼盘；配有佐食的三明治餐盘
rows.en: The sandwich plate came with pickles and a small portion of potato salad.
rows.zh: 三明治拼盘配有腌黄瓜和一小份土豆沙拉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 卫生填埋场；采用覆土等措施处置垃圾的填埋场地
rows.en: The council plans to monitor groundwater around the sanitary landfill for another decade.
rows.zh: 市政委员会计划再对卫生填埋场周围的地下水监测十年。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 人心果（果实）
rows.en: She cut the sapodilla plum in half and scooped out its soft brown flesh.
rows.zh: 她把人心果切成两半，挖出柔软的褐色果肉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 锯材原木；可锯成板材的原木
rows.en: A red mark on the saw log showed where the damaged wood began.
rows.zh: 锯材原木上的一道红色标记指出了受损木材开始的位置。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 打鼾；呼呼大睡（口语）
rows.en: Dad began to saw logs before the opening credits had finished.
rows.zh: 片头字幕还没放完，爸爸就开始呼呼打鼾了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 红花槭；红槭（Acer rubrum）
rows.en: The scarlet maple outside the library was the first tree on the street to change colour.
rows.zh: 图书馆外的红花槭是这条街上最先变色的树。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 爵士拟声即兴演唱；用无意义音节模仿乐器的唱法
rows.en: During the scat singing, the pianist answered each of the vocalist's improvised phrases.
rows.zh: 在爵士拟声即兴演唱中，钢琴手对歌手即兴唱出的每个乐句都作出了呼应。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 学校附近供学生通行的人行横道
rows.en: A delivery van had stopped directly in front of the school crossing.
rows.zh: 一辆送货车正停在学校附近供学生通行的人行横道前。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 低手挑篮；以向上舀起的动作完成的投篮
rows.en: He slipped past the defender and finished with a scoop shot under the outstretched arm.
rows.zh: 他突破防守队员，从对方伸出的手臂下完成了一记低手挑篮。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 角鸮；具有耳羽簇的小型猫头鹰
rows.en: A scops owl peered out from the hollow trunk as we passed below.
rows.zh: 我们从树下经过时，一只角鸮正从空心树干里向外张望。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 童军团体；童军的组织单位
rows.en: Our scout group raised enough money to replace the leaking tents.
rows.zh: 我们童军团体筹到了足够的钱，可以更换那些漏雨的帐篷。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 羊颈瘦肉端；羊颈端肉（英式用语）
rows.en: The butcher suggested using scrag end for the slow-cooked lamb stew.
rows.zh: 肉贩建议用羊颈端肉来做慢炖羊肉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 灌木状矮栎；矮小丛生的栎类
rows.en: Beyond the fence, scrub oak formed a dense barrier along the dry hillside.
rows.zh: 围栏外，灌木状矮栎沿着干燥的山坡形成了一道浓密的屏障。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 弗吉尼亚松（Pinus virginiana）
rows.en: A young scrub pine had taken root in the abandoned field.
rows.zh: 一棵幼小的弗吉尼亚松在荒废的田地里扎了根。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 把……揉皱；把……挤成一团
rows.en: Don't scrunch up the tissue paper; we can use it to wrap the vase.
rows.zh: 别把薄纸揉成一团，我们可以用它包花瓶。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 海滨生菊科草本植物（Leptosyne maritima，旧名Coreopsis maritima）
rows.en: A sea dahlia was flowering beside the coastal path, its yellow heads bright against the grey rocks.
rows.zh: 一株海滨生菊科植物Leptosyne maritima正在海岸小径旁开花，黄色花头映衬着灰色岩石，十分醒目。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 象海豹
rows.en: The male sea elephant raised his head as another male approached the beach.
rows.zh: 另一只雄性靠近海滩时，那只雄象海豹抬起了头。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 补血草属植物（Limonium属）
rows.en: She hung the sea lavender upside down in the shed to dry its flower stems.
rows.zh: 她把补血草属植物倒挂在棚屋里，让花枝干燥。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 八角鱼科的小型鱼；体表有骨板的海鱼
rows.en: The sea poacher in the photograph had rows of bony plates along its narrow body.
rows.zh: 照片里的那条八角鱼科小鱼，狭长身体上排列着一行行骨板。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 某些鲨、鳐的角质卵囊
rows.en: An empty sea purse lay tangled in the seaweed above the waterline.
rows.zh: 一个空的鲨鳐角质卵囊缠在水线以上的海藻中。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 浪涌后的向海暗流；海底回流（旧称）
rows.en: The old coastal survey describes a sea puss beneath the breaking waves.
rows.zh: 那份旧海岸调查记述了碎浪下方的一股向海暗流。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 海蛞蝓；裸鳃类海生腹足软体动物
rows.en: The diver photographed a brightly coloured sea slug crawling across the rock.
rows.zh: 潜水员拍下了一只色彩鲜艳、正在岩石上爬行的海蛞蝓。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 海蜘蛛；皆足类海生节肢动物
rows.en: Under the magnifying lens, the sea spider's thin legs seemed much larger than its body.
rows.zh: 在放大镜下，那只海蜘蛛的细长腿显得比身体大得多。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 留作播种的优质谷物种子
rows.en: The farmer kept the seed grain in a separate bin, away from the grain intended for milling.
rows.zh: 农民把留作播种的谷种存放在单独的仓箱里，与准备磨粉的谷物分开。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 介形类小型甲壳动物；介形虫
rows.en: A seed shrimp moved between the grains of sand in the microscope's field of view.
rows.zh: 显微镜视野中，一只介形虫在沙粒之间移动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 留作种用的种子或块茎储备
rows.en: The cooperative distributed fresh seed stock after the flood ruined the stored tubers.
rows.zh: 洪水毁掉储存的块茎后，合作社分发了新的种用储备。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 自推进车辆；自带动力装置的车辆
rows.en: The cart is a self-propelled vehicle, but a driver still controls its speed and direction.
rows.zh: 这辆车自带动力装置，但速度和方向仍由驾驶员控制。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 运动觉；感知肢体与身体运动的能力
rows.en: With her eyes closed, the dancer relied on her sense of movement to repeat the arm sequence.
rows.zh: 舞者闭着眼睛，依靠运动觉重复那组手臂动作。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 测者地平圈；通过观测者眼睛、垂直于天顶—天底线的平面与天球相交形成的圆
rows.en: The instructor drew the sensible horizon at right angles to the observer's zenith–nadir line.
rows.zh: 教员画出了与观测者天顶—天底线垂直的测者地平圈。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 维修人员上门检修；上门服务
rows.en: The first service call revealed that the washing machine needed a new pump.
rows.zh: 第一次上门检修发现，洗衣机需要更换水泵。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 服务入口；供送货、工作人员等使用的入口
rows.en: The caterers brought the equipment through the service entrance behind the kitchen.
rows.zh: 餐饮服务人员从厨房后面的服务入口运进了设备。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 维修工；检修人员
rows.en: The service man found a loose wire inside the boiler's control box.
rows.zh: 维修工在锅炉控制盒里发现了一根松动的电线。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 家花楸（Sorbus domestica）；结可食果实的欧洲树木
rows.en: The nursery planted a service tree at the sunny edge of the orchard.
rows.zh: 苗圃在果园向阳的边缘种了一棵家花楸。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 石工凿；用于切凿石块或砖块的窄钢凿
rows.en: A set chisel lay beside the mason's partly shaped stone block.
rows.zh: 一把石工凿放在石匠尚未修整完的石块旁。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 绵羊虱蝇（Melophagus ovinus）；寄生于羊体表的无翅蝇
rows.en: The student identified the sheep ked as a wingless fly rather than a tick.
rows.zh: 学生辨认出绵羊虱蝇是一种无翅蝇，而不是蜱。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 庇护工场；为残障人士提供就业的工作场所
rows.en: The sheltered workshop supplied the hotel with handwoven table mats.
rows.zh: 庇护工场向这家酒店供应手工编织的餐垫。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 巴结；讨好（通常含不真诚之意）
rows.en: He tried to shine up to the director by praising every decision she made.
rows.zh: 他试图通过赞美主任的每一个决定来巴结她。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 船上高级船员；担任管理职务的船员
rows.en: A ship's officer checked the cargo list before allowing the truck onto the ferry.
rows.zh: 一名船上高级船员核对了货物清单后，才让卡车驶上渡轮。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 运输性肺炎；牛运输热相关的肺炎
rows.en: The veterinarian suspected shipping pneumonia in the calves that had arrived two days earlier.
rows.zh: 兽医怀疑两天前运来的小牛患了运输性肺炎。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 制鞋用皮革
rows.en: The supplier sent three samples of shoe leather for the designer to compare.
rows.zh: 供应商寄来了三份制鞋皮革样品，供设计师比较。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 玩掷骰子游戏craps
rows.en: On their night off, the crew gathered in the recreation room to shoot craps.
rows.zh: 休息的晚上，船员们聚在娱乐室里玩craps掷骰子游戏。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 供狩猎的管理区；在规定条件下允许狩猎的区域
rows.en: The map shows a shooting preserve beyond the public walking trail.
rows.zh: 地图显示，公共步道以外有一片供狩猎的管理区。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 短铁杆（高尔夫球）
rows.en: She chose a short iron for the high approach shot over the bunker.
rows.zh: 她选了一支短铁杆，以高球越过沙坑攻向果岭。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 短途运输线路；地方短途铁路
rows.en: The short line carries timber from the valley to the main railway junction.
rows.zh: 这条地方短途铁路把木材从山谷运往铁路干线交汇处。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 制铅弹丸用的铅基合金（含砷等硬化成分）
rows.en: The museum label identifies the sample as shot metal rather than pure lead.
rows.zh: 博物馆标签将这份样品标为制弹丸用铅合金，而不是纯铅。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 肩部臂章；缀在制服上臂靠近肩部的识别徽章
rows.en: The tailor sewed a new shoulder flash just below the sleeve's shoulder seam.
rows.zh: 裁缝在袖子的肩缝正下方缝上了一枚新的肩部臂章。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 用肩膀挤进去
rows.en: Two latecomers tried to shoulder in as the crowd moved toward the stage.
rows.zh: 人群朝舞台移动时，两名迟到的人试图用肩膀挤进去。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 低俗或令人不快的笑话；恶趣味玩笑
rows.en: His sick joke about the injured driver brought the conversation to an abrupt end.
rows.zh: 他拿受伤司机开的恶趣味玩笑，让谈话戛然而止。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 军中病员报诊集合；病号集合（英式用语）
rows.en: Three recruits reported for sick parade before the rest of the unit began training.
rows.zh: 全队开始训练前，三名新兵参加了病员报诊集合。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 台球桌长边中部的袋口；中袋
rows.en: She sent the blue ball into the side pocket with a gentle stroke.
rows.zh: 她轻轻一击，把蓝球送进了台球桌的中袋。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美西部的一种牧草（Oryzopsis hymenoides）
rows.en: Patches of silk grass remained green on the otherwise dry plain.
rows.zh: 在其余地方已干枯的平原上，几丛Oryzopsis hymenoides牧草仍然青绿。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 文定果树（Muntingia calabura，又称Jamaican cherry）
rows.en: The silk wood beside the gate was covered with small white flowers.
rows.zh: 门边的文定果树开满了小白花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种毛叶柳树（本例指Salix sitchensis）
rows.en: Silky willow grew along the stream, its pale leaves moving in the wind.
rows.zh: 溪流两岸长着Salix sitchensis柳树，颜色浅淡的叶子随风摇动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种银色小型石首鱼（Bairdiella chrysoura）
rows.en: The guide identified the fish as a silver perch from its photograph.
rows.zh: 向导根据照片辨认出，那条鱼是Bairdiella chrysoura，一种银色小型石首鱼。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 单螺旋桨飞机
rows.en: She logged her first solo flight in a borrowed single prop.
rows.zh: 她驾驶一架借来的单螺旋桨飞机，完成了首次单飞。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 单人赛艇；供一人划行的轻型赛艇
rows.en: The coach steadied the single shell while the rower stepped aboard.
rows.zh: 划手登艇时，教练扶稳了那艘单人赛艇。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 不祥的预感；忧虑不安的感觉
rows.en: I had a sinking feeling when the station lights went out and the last train was cancelled.
rows.zh: 车站灯光熄灭、末班车又被取消时，我心里升起一阵不安。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 用虹吸管抽走；以虹吸方式排出
rows.en: They used a narrow tube to siphon off the water above the sediment.
rows.zh: 他们用一根细管把沉淀物上方的水虹吸出来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 六瓶装或六罐装饮料
rows.en: We put a six-pack of canned ginger beer in the cooler for the picnic.
rows.zh: 我们把一组六罐装姜汁汽水放进冷藏箱，准备野餐时喝。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 车顶滑雪板架
rows.en: The skis were still strapped to the ski rack when the car reached the lodge.
rows.zh: 车开到山间旅舍时，滑雪板还绑在车顶的滑雪板架上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 共同储蓄会；成员定期集资、常于圣诞节分款的团体（英式旧称）
rows.en: Members of the slate club collected their savings at the pub just before Christmas.
rows.zh: 圣诞节前，共同储蓄会的成员在酒馆领取了各自积存的钱款。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 睡眠住宿设施；供睡觉的房间或住处
rows.en: The ferry fare includes sleeping accommodation in a shared cabin.
rows.zh: 渡轮票价包括共用船舱内的睡眠住宿设施。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 细身懒猴；Loris属的细长体型灵长类动物
rows.en: A slender loris reached from the branch to catch an insect.
rows.zh: 一只细身懒猴从树枝上探身去捉昆虫。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 沉沉地滑落；无力地滑坐下去
rows.en: Too tired to stand any longer, he let himself slide down against the wall.
rows.zh: 他累得再也站不住了，便靠着墙滑坐下来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 甩液环；将防冰液分布到螺旋桨叶片上的环形装置
rows.en: The maintenance crew inspected the slinger ring around the propeller hub.
rows.zh: 维修人员检查了螺旋桨桨毂周围的甩液环。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 轻快地脱下；迅速脱去
rows.en: You can slip off your muddy boots by the back door.
rows.zh: 你可以在后门旁脱下沾满泥的靴子。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 迅速穿上；轻便地套上
rows.en: I'll slip on a jacket before we go out to look at the stars.
rows.zh: 出去看星星前，我先套上件夹克。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 椎间盘突出；椎间盘脱出（通俗说法）
rows.en: The doctor explained the scan results and confirmed that he had a slipped disc.
rows.zh: 医生解释了扫描结果，确认他患有椎间盘突出。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 单层炮甲板的小型军舰；旧式轻型战舰
rows.en: The display included a model of a sloop of war with its gun ports open.
rows.zh: 展品中有一艘旧式轻型战舰的模型，炮门敞开着。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 止血马唐（Digitaria ischaemum）；一种禾本科杂草
rows.en: Smooth crabgrass had spread through the thin patches of lawn beside the path.
rows.zh: 小径旁草坪稀疏的地方已经蔓生了止血马唐。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 蜻蜓（美国方言俗称）
rows.en: My grandfather called the insect a snake doctor; I knew it simply as a dragonfly.
rows.zh: 祖父把那只昆虫叫作snake doctor，我只知道它就是蜻蜓。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 蜻蜓（美国中部方言俗称）
rows.en: In her childhood diary, she used snake feeder for the dragonflies above the creek.
rows.zh: 她在童年日记里用方言词snake feeder称呼小溪上方的蜻蜓。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 使用呼吸管的浮潜
rows.en: The sheltered bay was our favourite place for snorkel diving.
rows.zh: 那个有遮蔽的海湾是我们最喜欢的浮潜地点。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 大花猪牙花（Erythronium grandiflorum，一种黄花草本植物）
rows.en: A snow lily had opened its yellow flower beside the last patch of melting snow.
rows.zh: 最后一片融雪旁，一株大花猪牙花绽开了黄色花朵。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 银耳；白木耳（Tremella fuciformis）
rows.en: She soaked the dried snow mushroom before adding it to the dessert soup.
rows.zh: 她先把干银耳泡发，再放进甜汤里。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种鲜红色陆生有花植物（Sarcodes sanguinea）
rows.en: The snow plant stood out against the dark forest floor like a red candle.
rows.zh: 那株Sarcodes sanguinea有花植物像一支红烛，在暗色的林地上格外醒目。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种淡色树蟋蟀（Oecanthus fultoni）
rows.en: We heard a snowy tree cricket in the shrub but could not see it among the pale stems.
rows.zh: 我们听见灌木里一只淡色树蟋蟀的叫声，却没能在浅色枝条间找到它。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种北美龙胆（Gentiana saponaria）
rows.en: The botanist photographed soapwort gentian in the damp woodland beside the stream.
rows.zh: 植物学家在溪旁潮湿的林地里拍摄了Gentiana saponaria龙胆。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 社交活动
rows.en: The evening meal became a social activity as guests moved between the long tables.
rows.zh: 宾客们在长桌之间走动，让晚餐变成了一场社交活动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 套筒扳手
rows.en: He fitted a larger socket to the socket wrench before loosening the bolt.
rows.zh: 拧松螺栓前，他给套筒扳手换上了一个更大的套筒。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 所谓“软性毒品”；对被认为危害或成瘾性较低的毒品的非严格称呼
rows.en: The reporter questioned whether calling cannabis a soft drug made its risks sound trivial.
rows.zh: 记者质疑，把大麻称为“软性毒品”是否会让其风险听起来微不足道。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 软性政治捐款；美国政治筹款中联邦限制范围以外的非联邦资金（本例为历史用法）
rows.en: The historian compared the party's soft money receipts in the 1992 and 1996 campaigns.
rows.zh: 历史学家比较了该党在1992年和1996年竞选期间收到的软性政治捐款。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 软皮小面包；用酵母发起、外皮柔软的面包卷
rows.en: She split a soft roll and filled it with roast vegetables.
rows.zh: 她把一个软皮小面包剖开，夹进烤蔬菜。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 旧分类中的绿鹃类鸟名（本例指Vireo solitarius，今英文名blue-headed vireo）
rows.en: Her old field guide labels the blue-headed bird a solitary vireo.
rows.zh: 她的旧野外图鉴把那只蓝头的绿鹃类鸟标作solitary vireo。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 歌鸫（Turdus philomelos）
rows.en: A song thrush repeated its clear phrases from the top of the garden tree.
rows.zh: 一只歌鸫在花园的树梢上反复鸣出清亮的乐句。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 及时；在还来得及的时候
rows.en: We reached the station soon enough to catch the last train.
rows.zh: 我们及时赶到车站，赶上了末班火车。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 排序算法
rows.en: The sorting algorithm puts equal scores next to each other without changing their values.
rows.zh: 这个排序算法把相同分数排在一起，而不改变分数的数值。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 排序程序
rows.en: The sorting program arranged the archived letters by date.
rows.zh: 排序程序按日期排列了归档的信件。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 南美树木Caryocar nuciferum的大型坚果状种子
rows.en: The display included a souari nut with part of its thick shell removed.
rows.zh: 展品中有一颗Caryocar nuciferum的坚果状种子，厚壳被去掉了一部分。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 有声电影摄影机；能同步记录影像和声音的摄影机
rows.en: The catalogue explains how the sound camera keeps speech synchronized with the picture.
rows.zh: 目录介绍了这款有声电影摄影机如何保持说话声与画面同步。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 声学计量单位
rows.en: The table gives each sound unit beside the acoustic quantity it measures.
rows.zh: 表格把每个声学计量单位列在它所测量的声学量旁边。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 翅鲨；油鲨类的Galeorhinus galeus（soupfin shark）
rows.en: The tracking study followed a soupfin shark along the coast.
rows.zh: 这项追踪研究记录了一条Galeorhinus galeus翅鲨沿海岸活动的轨迹。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 酸面团面包；用持续发酵的老面种制成的面包
rows.en: The baker used rye flour for this loaf of sourdough bread.
rows.zh: 面包师用黑麦粉做了这条酸面团面包。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 苦苣菜属植物（Sonchus属）
rows.en: A sow thistle had grown through a crack beside the greenhouse door.
rows.zh: 温室门旁的裂缝里长出了一株苦苣菜属植物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 金丝瓜；熟后果肉可分成面条状细丝的瓜
rows.en: After roasting the spaghetti squash, he loosened the strands of flesh with a fork.
rows.zh: 把金丝瓜烤熟后，他用叉子拨松了丝状果肉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种含铜约74%的铜锍（旧冶金用语）
rows.en: The smelting report lists sparkle metal as an intermediate product rather than finished copper.
rows.zh: 这份冶炼报告把sparkle metal这种铜锍列为中间产物，而不是成品铜。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 特别法；仅适用于特定个人或地区的立法
rows.en: The legal history describes a special act passed for that district alone.
rows.zh: 这部法律史记述了一项仅为那个地区通过的特别法。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 精子；雄性生殖细胞
rows.en: The diagram shows a sperm cell beside an egg, with the two drawn to the same scale.
rows.zh: 示意图以相同比例画出了一枚精子和一枚卵细胞。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 山胡椒属芳香灌木（本例指Lindera benzoin）
rows.en: A spice bush beside the footpath was covered with small yellow flowers.
rows.zh: 小径旁的一株Lindera benzoin芳香灌木开满了黄色小花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 香料蛋糕；以肉桂等香料调味的蛋糕
rows.en: The warm spice cake filled the kitchen with the smell of cinnamon.
rows.zh: 温热的香料蛋糕让厨房里充满了肉桂香。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: Ophrys属的某些兰花（spider orchid所指的一类）
rows.en: The field guide distinguishes this spider orchid from the Brassia orchids grown in greenhouses.
rows.zh: 这本野外图鉴把这种Ophrys属兰花与温室栽培的Brassia属兰花区分开来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 抽穗；长出穗状花序
rows.en: The young plants should spike out once the warmer weather arrives.
rows.zh: 天气转暖后，这些幼株应该就会抽穗。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 纺纱机；牵伸、加捻并卷绕纱线的机器
rows.en: The spinning frame stopped when a strand of yarn broke.
rows.zh: 一股纱线断裂后，纺纱机停了下来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 珍妮纺纱机；早期多锭纺纱机
rows.en: The museum demonstration showed one worker operating several spindles on a spinning jenny.
rows.zh: 博物馆的演示展示了一名工人如何操作珍妮纺纱机上的多个纱锭。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 纺车轮钓竿；配合纺车式绕线轮抛饵的钓竿
rows.en: She packed a lightweight spinning rod for the fishing trip.
rows.zh: 她为钓鱼之行装好了一根轻巧的纺车轮钓竿。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 刺龙虾；无大螯、甲壳多刺的海生龙虾类
rows.en: A spiny lobster backed into the rocky crevice, leaving only its long antennae visible.
rows.zh: 一只刺龙虾倒退着钻进岩缝，只露出长长的触角。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 贴在额头或面颊上的小螺旋卷发
rows.en: A single spit curl lay flat against her forehead beneath the hat.
rows.zh: 帽子下，一小绺螺旋卷发平贴在她的额头上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 用海绵涂上；用海绵拍涂
rows.en: The artist plans to sponge on a second colour after the first coat dries.
rows.zh: 画家打算等第一层颜色干了，再用海绵拍涂第二种颜色。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 尚有希望的成功机会；颇有希望的获胜机会
rows.en: The extra practice gives our team a sporting chance against the league leaders.
rows.zh: 额外的训练让我们球队面对联赛领头羊时，也有了取胜的希望。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 休闲西装上衣；运动式便西装上衣
rows.en: He wore a checked sports coat with plain trousers to the dinner.
rows.zh: 他穿了一件格纹休闲西装上衣，配素色长裤去赴晚宴。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 春季赛前训练；春训
rows.en: Several young players joined the senior squad for spring training.
rows.zh: 几名年轻球员加入成年队，参加春季赛前训练。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种常绿瑞香属灌木（Daphne laureola）
rows.en: The spurge laurel under the trees had glossy leaves and clusters of yellow-green flowers.
rows.zh: 树下那株Daphne laureola瑞香属灌木叶片有光泽，开着一簇簇黄绿色的花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 熊草（Xerophyllum tenax）的旧称（名称含现被视为冒犯性的词）
rows.en: The old herbarium label uses squaw grass for the plant now labelled bear grass.
rows.zh: 旧植物标本标签用squaw grass称呼那种如今标作bear grass的熊草。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 对讲或广播系统的扬声器（口语）
rows.en: A crackling voice from the squawk box announced that the lift was out of order.
rows.zh: 对讲广播扬声器里传来带着杂音的声音，宣布电梯出了故障。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 松鼠跑笼；小动物在其中奔跑时可转动的圆筒形笼子
rows.en: The squirrel cage turned as the small animal ran inside it.
rows.zh: 小动物在里面奔跑时，圆筒形跑笼随之转动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种美国东部落叶灌木（Lyonia mariana）
rows.en: Stagger bush grew along the edge of the clearing, with pale flowers hanging below its leaves.
rows.zh: 空地边缘长着Lyonia mariana落叶灌木，浅色花朵垂在叶片下方。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 鹿角状分枝珊瑚；鹿角珊瑚
rows.en: The diver photographed a branch of staghorn coral growing from the reef.
rows.zh: 潜水员拍下了礁上长出的一枝鹿角珊瑚。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种石松类植物（旧学名Lycopodium complanatum）
rows.en: Staghorn moss spread beneath the conifers beside the narrow forest path.
rows.zh: 狭窄的林间小径旁，针叶树下蔓生着旧名Lycopodium complanatum的石松类植物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 捣矿机；以重杵反复捣碎矿石的设备
rows.en: The stamping mill filled the valley with a steady pounding as it crushed the ore.
rows.zh: 捣矿机粉碎矿石时，持续的捣击声响彻山谷。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 立式压印机；垂直施压的大型印刷压机
rows.en: The printer lowered the plate of the standing press onto the prepared sheet.
rows.zh: 印刷工把立式压印机的压板压向铺好的纸张。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 史前直立巨石；竖石
rows.en: The path ends at a standing stone on the ridge above the village.
rows.zh: 小径的尽头是村庄上方山脊上的一块史前竖石。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 单口喜剧演员；脱口秀喜剧演员
rows.en: The stand-up comedian turned a late audience member's apology into a running joke.
rows.zh: 那名单口喜剧演员把一位迟到观众的道歉变成了贯穿演出的笑料。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 起跑标杆；标示比赛起点的柱子
rows.en: The official tied a red ribbon to the starting post before the race.
rows.zh: 比赛前，工作人员在起跑标杆上系了一条红丝带。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 藏起；储存起来留待以后使用
rows.en: They managed to stash away enough blankets for the winter visitors.
rows.zh: 他们设法储存了足够的毯子，留给冬季到访的客人使用。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 警署值班警官；警署值班警长
rows.en: The station keeper entered the visitor's name in the duty book.
rows.zh: 警署值班警官把来访者的姓名记入值班簿。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 远离；避开；不接近
rows.en: The children were told to stay away from the damaged footbridge.
rows.zh: 孩子们被告知不要靠近那座受损的人行桥。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 立体照片；由两个略异角度的影像组成、观看时产生立体感的照片
rows.en: Viewed through the old viewer, the stereoscopic photograph made the street seem to recede into the distance.
rows.zh: 通过那台旧观片器观看时，立体照片中的街道仿佛向远处延伸。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 潜行狩猎；跟踪或埋伏猎物的狩猎方式
rows.en: Their still hunt ended when a snapped branch sent the deer running.
rows.zh: 一根树枝折断的声音把鹿惊跑了，他们的潜行狩猎也就此结束。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种叶片揉碎后有异味的常绿榧树（Torreya taxifolia）
rows.en: The botanical garden planted a stinking cedar beside its other rare conifers.
rows.zh: 植物园在其他珍稀针叶树旁种了一株Torreya taxifolia榧树。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 脚踏固定、用手往复操作的消防水泵；马镫式消防泵
rows.en: The volunteer held the stirrup pump steady with one foot while working the handle.
rows.zh: 志愿者用一只脚稳住马镫式消防泵，同时上下操作把手。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种欧地中海伞形科草本植物（Sison amomum）
rows.en: Stone parsley grew beside the lane, its small white flowers held in loose clusters.
rows.zh: 乡间小路旁长着Sison amomum伞形科草本植物，白色小花形成疏松的花簇。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 地中海地区的一种伞冠松树（Pinus pinea）
rows.en: A stone pine shaded the courtyard with its broad, spreading crown.
rows.zh: 一棵Pinus pinea松树用宽阔舒展的树冠为庭院遮阴。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 停止之处；适合结束当前活动的节点
rows.en: The end of this section is a sensible stopping point for today's rehearsal.
rows.zh: 这一节结束的地方适合作为今天排练的收尾节点。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 暴风警报锥；用于悬挂示警的锥形帆布信号
rows.en: The harbour keeper hoisted the storm cone above the signal station.
rows.zh: 港口管理员在信号站上方升起了暴风警报锥。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 直槽凿岩钻；槽沟为直线的凿岩钻具（旧用语）
rows.en: The old inventory lists a straight flute among the mine's rock-drilling tools.
rows.zh: 那份旧清单在矿场的凿岩工具中列有一把直槽凿岩钻。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （酒）经冰搅或摇匀后滤冰饮用的
rows.en: A straight-up martini arrived in a chilled glass.
rows.zh: 一杯经过冰镇并滤去冰块的马提尼，盛在冰过的杯子里端了上来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 奇异吸引子（非线性动力系统中的复杂吸引子）
rows.en: The Lorenz simulation traced a strange attractor instead of settling into a simple repeating orbit.
rows.zh: 洛伦兹系统的模拟描绘出了奇异吸引子，而没有稳定到简单的重复轨道上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 分层样本；将总体划分为层后分别抽取得到的样本
rows.en: The stratified sample included residents from every age group, selected at random within each group.
rows.zh: 这个分层样本包含各年龄组的居民，每组内都进行了随机抽取。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种灯笼状宿萼包果的酸浆属植物（本例指Physalis pubescens）
rows.en: The strawberry tomato in the school garden had papery husks around its yellow fruit.
rows.zh: 学校花园里的Physalis pubescens酸浆属植物，黄色果实外包着纸质宿萼。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 草莓树；Arbutus unedo常绿小乔木或灌木
rows.en: The strawberry tree carried both flowers and ripe red fruit beside the terrace.
rows.zh: 露台旁的草莓树上既有花朵，又有成熟的红色果实。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 链球菌性咽炎；A组链球菌引起的咽喉感染
rows.en: The throat culture confirmed strep throat after the rapid test was inconclusive.
rows.zh: 快速检测结果不明确，随后咽拭子培养确认了链球菌性咽炎。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 猛击；用力击打
rows.en: The drummer had to strike hard to make the final beat carry across the hall.
rows.zh: 鼓手必须用力击打，才能让最后一记鼓声传遍大厅。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 弦乐四重奏组；由两把小提琴、一把中提琴和一把大提琴组成的四人乐组
rows.en: The string quartette rehearsed in the library before the guests arrived.
rows.zh: 客人到来前，弦乐四重奏组在图书馆里排练。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 条纹鲈（Morone saxatilis）
rows.en: A striped bass broke the surface beside the pier and vanished again.
rows.zh: 一条条纹鲈在码头旁跃出水面，又消失了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 鲻鱼（Mugil cephalus）
rows.en: A school of striped mullet moved through the shallow water near the estuary.
rows.zh: 一群鲻鱼游过河口附近的浅水。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 东部花栗鼠（Tamias striatus）；北美东部的一种条纹啮齿动物
rows.en: The striped squirrel paused on the log with its cheek pouches full of seeds.
rows.zh: 那只东部花栗鼠停在倒木上，颊囊里装满了种子。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 酿番茄；填入馅料的番茄
rows.en: Each stuffed tomato was filled with rice and herbs, then baked until tender.
rows.zh: 每个酿番茄都填入了米饭和香草，再烤至软熟。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 超小型轿车；比紧凑型车更小的乘用车
rows.en: Their subcompact car fitted into the only parking space left on the street.
rows.zh: 他们的超小型轿车停进了街上剩下的唯一一个停车位。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 糖制硬糖；以糖熬制后冷却变硬的糖果
rows.en: The shopkeeper weighed the sugar candy into small paper bags.
rows.zh: 店主把糖制硬糖称好，装进小纸袋。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 糖棕（Arenga pinnata）
rows.en: A sugar palm shaded the path leading to the village house.
rows.zh: 一棵Arenga pinnata糖棕为通往村屋的小径遮阴。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 蓝鲸的旧称（Balaenoptera musculus）
rows.en: The nineteenth-century whaling account refers to the blue whale as a sulfur bottom.
rows.zh: 那份十九世纪的捕鲸记述把蓝鲸称作sulfur bottom。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 黄色或橙色的粉蝶类蝴蝶（sulfur类）
rows.en: A sulfur butterfly closed its yellow wings on the clover flower.
rows.zh: 一只黄色粉蝶在三叶草花上合拢了翅膀。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 黄色或橙色的粉蝶类蝴蝶（英式拼法）
rows.en: We watched a sulphur butterfly move from one flower head to the next.
rows.zh: 我们看着一只黄色粉蝶从一个花头飞到下一个花头。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 以最高学业荣誉；以最优异成绩（拉丁语）
rows.en: She completed the demanding degree summa cum laude while raising two children.
rows.zh: 她一边抚养两个孩子，一边以最高学业荣誉完成了这个要求严格的学位课程。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 即决判决；在不存在实质事实争议等条件下无需完整审判作出的判决
rows.en: The appeal challenged the summary judgement entered before the case reached trial.
rows.zh: 上诉对案件进入正式审判前作出的即决判决提出了异议。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 露天甲板；日光甲板
rows.en: We went up to the sun deck to watch the islands pass.
rows.zh: 我们登上露天甲板，看着船从一座座岛屿旁驶过。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 多年生羽扇豆（Lupinus perennis，特定植物种）
rows.en: Sundial lupine flowered along the sandy bank behind the cottage.
rows.zh: 小屋后方的沙质坡岸上，Lupinus perennis羽扇豆开花了。
