rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 下沉式篱障；由沟壕和挡土墙形成、较少遮挡视线的隔界
rows.en: The sunk fence kept the cattle out without blocking the view across the park.
rows.zh: 下沉式篱障挡住了牛，却没有遮挡横贯园地的视野。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 超重量级拳击选手
rows.en: The super heavyweight entered the ring after the lighter boxers had finished their bouts.
rows.zh: 较轻级别的拳手比完后，那名超重量级选手进入了拳台。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 最高统帅部；最高指挥层（指人员）
rows.en: The supreme headquarters approved the revised evacuation plan.
rows.zh: 最高指挥层批准了修订后的撤离计划。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美太平洋岸浅海的海鲫类鱼（surfperch）
rows.en: Several surf fish moved through the shallow water beyond the breaking waves.
rows.zh: 几条海鲫类鱼游过碎浪外侧的浅水。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 地面拖牵式滑雪升降设备；使滑雪者贴地上坡的拖牵装置
rows.en: The surface lift pulled us uphill with our skis still on the snow.
rows.zh: 地面拖牵设备拉着我们上坡，滑雪板始终贴着雪面。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 以露天方式开采；露天采矿
rows.en: The company hoped to surface mine the shallow deposit near the old quarry.
rows.zh: 该公司希望以露天方式开采旧采石场附近的浅层矿床。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: “请举心向上”的礼仪应答句；圣餐礼中的拉丁语呼句
rows.en: The choir's setting of the sursum corda begins with a single unaccompanied voice.
rows.zh: 合唱团演唱的“请举心向上”礼仪乐段，以一个无伴奏的人声开始。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 无商业赞助商的广播或电视节目；由播出机构自行承担费用的节目
rows.en: The station filled the empty time slot with a sustaining program of chamber music.
rows.zh: 电台用一档没有商业赞助商的室内乐节目填补了空出的时段。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 通过出汗减轻体重（常指短期失水，不等于减脂）
rows.en: His attempt to sweat off weight became a concern for the team doctor.
rows.zh: 他试图靠出汗减轻体重，让队医担忧起来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 甜罗勒；常作调味香草的罗勒（Ocimum basilicum）
rows.en: She tore a few leaves of sweet basil over the hot pasta.
rows.zh: 她把几片甜罗勒叶撕碎，撒在热意面上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美芳香树皮桦树（Betula lenta）
rows.en: The guide pointed out a sweet birch among the other trees on the slope.
rows.zh: 向导从坡上的树木中指出了一棵Betula lenta芳香树皮桦树。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 甜茅属（Glyceria）的湿生禾草
rows.en: Sweet grass grew thickly along the muddy edge of the pond.
rows.zh: 池塘泥泞的边缘密生着甜茅属湿生禾草。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 墨角兰（Origanum majorana）；一种芳香调味草本
rows.en: He added sweet marjoram to the beans just before serving them.
rows.zh: 临上桌前，他往豆子里加了些墨角兰。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 桤叶山柳（Clethra alnifolia）；开芳香白花的灌木
rows.en: The sweet pepperbush beside the pond scented the warm evening air.
rows.zh: 池塘旁的桤叶山柳让温暖的晚风带上了花香。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 香矢车菊类植物（本例指Amberboa moschata，旧名Centaurea moschata）
rows.en: The gardener planted sweet sultan near the gate for its fragrant pink flowers.
rows.zh: 园丁在门边种下Amberboa moschata香花植物，欣赏其芳香的粉红色花朵。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 须苞石竹；美国石竹（Dianthus barbatus）
rows.en: A row of sweet William added dense clusters of colour to the border.
rows.zh: 一排须苞石竹为花境添上了密集而鲜艳的花簇。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 大口喝下；大量喝下
rows.en: After the dusty journey, they stopped to swill down glasses of cold water.
rows.zh: 一路尘土飞扬，旅程结束后，他们停下来大口喝下一杯杯凉水。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 向外摆动；向外大幅扫动
rows.en: The crane's boom can swing out over the water to lift cargo from the boat.
rows.zh: 起重机的吊臂可以向水面外摆，从船上吊起货物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 使转向支持另一方；使改变立场
rows.en: The mayor hoped the new transport proposal would swing over the undecided councillors.
rows.zh: 市长希望新的交通提案能争取到尚未表态的议员支持。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 美国南部湿地的一种矮生竹（Arundinaria tecta）
rows.en: Switch cane formed a low thicket beside the flooded woodland.
rows.zh: Arundinaria tecta矮生竹在积水林地旁形成了一片低矮的竹丛。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 剑杖；内藏剑刃或匕首的手杖
rows.en: The museum displayed the sword stick with its blade partly drawn.
rows.zh: 博物馆展示了那根剑杖，里面的剑刃被抽出了一部分。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 美沙酮的一个别称（本义项；不指海洛因本身）
rows.en: The editor replaced synthetic heroin with methadone in the glossary to make the drug's identity clear.
rows.zh: 编辑把术语表中的synthetic heroin改为美沙酮，以明确所指的药物。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 计算机系统错误；操作系统无法识别或不允许的操作所致错误
rows.en: The installer stopped with a system error before it could copy the final file.
rows.zh: 安装程序还没来得及复制最后一个文件，就因系统错误停了下来。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 活人画；由真人摆出静止姿态构成的画面
rows.en: The actors held the tableau vivant until the curtain closed.
rows.zh: 演员们一直保持着活人画的静止姿态，直到幕布合拢。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 表格资料；以表格形式排列的内容
rows.en: The editor moved the tabular matter into an appendix to shorten the main report.
rows.zh: 编辑把表格资料移到附录中，以缩短报告正文。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 船闸或运河下游端的闸门；下闸门
rows.en: The lock keeper inspected the hinges of the tail gate before reopening the canal.
rows.zh: 运河重新开放前，船闸管理员检查了下闸门的铰链。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: （拳击手）假装被击倒；故意输掉比赛
rows.en: The screenplay centres on a boxer who is pressured to take a dive.
rows.zh: 这部剧本围绕一名被施压要求假装被击倒的拳手展开。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 遭受打击；蒙受损失
rows.en: The shop could take a hit while the bridge is closed for repairs.
rows.zh: 大桥封闭维修期间，这家商店可能会蒙受损失。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 悄悄溜走；不告而别（美式口语）
rows.en: The comic hero decides to take a powder just as the wedding guests arrive.
rows.zh: 婚礼宾客刚到场时，那位喜剧主角便决定悄悄溜走。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 拿起武器作战；开始进行武装斗争（较文学性）
rows.en: In the novel, the villagers take arms against the occupying army.
rows.zh: 小说中，村民们拿起武器反抗占领军。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 赚得；实得（工资或薪酬）
rows.en: With fewer shifts available, she expects to take home less this month.
rows.zh: 可上的班次减少了，她预计这个月实得的工资也会减少。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 登台亮相；成为众人注意的焦点
rows.en: The band will take the stage after the interval.
rows.zh: 乐队将在中场休息后登台亮相。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 全神贯注的；忙于某事的（常接with）
rows.en: She seemed entirely taken up with restoring the old piano.
rows.zh: 她似乎全神贯注于修复那架旧钢琴。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 高生毛茛（Ranunculus acris）
rows.en: Tall buttercup flowered above the shorter grasses in the meadow.
rows.zh: 草甸里，Ranunculus acris高生毛茛的花朵高出较矮的禾草。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 高生毛茛（Ranunculus acris，tall buttercup的别称）
rows.en: The old plant list uses tall crowfoot for the yellow-flowered Ranunculus acris.
rows.zh: 那份旧植物名录用tall crowfoot称呼黄花的Ranunculus acris毛茛。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 高燕麦草（Arrhenatherum elatius）；一种多年生牧草
rows.en: Tall oat grass leaned over the narrow verge after the rain.
rows.zh: 雨后，高燕麦草倒伏在狭窄的路边草地上。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美太平洋沿岸的一种常绿树（旧学名Lithocarpus densiflorus）
rows.en: The tanbark oak above the trail had large, leathery leaves.
rows.zh: 山径上方那棵旧名Lithocarpus densiflorus的常绿树，长着大而革质的叶片。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 流苏风信子类球根植物（旧名Muscari comosum）
rows.en: The tassel hyacinth carried a tuft of violet flowers above the rest of the flower spike.
rows.zh: 那株旧名Muscari comosum的球根植物，在花序顶端托着一簇紫色花朵。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 税收收入；政府从征税中取得的收入
rows.en: The town used part of its tax income to repair the public library roof.
rows.zh: 镇政府用部分税收收入修缮了公共图书馆的屋顶。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 税前扣除；可从应税收入中扣减的款项（通俗用语）
rows.en: The accountant asked whether the equipment purchase qualified as a tax write-off.
rows.zh: 会计询问，这笔设备购置支出是否符合税前扣除条件。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 电视休息室；供人观看电视的房间
rows.en: The guests gathered in the television room to watch the match.
rows.zh: 客人们聚到电视休息室里观看比赛。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 端着丝粒染色体；着丝粒位于末端的染色体
rows.en: The diagram places the centromere at the very end of the telocentric chromosome.
rows.zh: 示意图把端着丝粒染色体的着丝粒画在最末端。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 中音鼓；次中音鼓（打击乐器）
rows.en: The tenor drum answered the bass drum with a rolling phrase.
rows.zh: 中音鼓用一段滚奏回应了大鼓。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 特帕里豆（Phaseolus acutifolius）；一种耐热耐旱菜豆作物
rows.en: The growers compared several tepary bean varieties in the dry field.
rows.zh: 种植者在那块干旱的田地里比较了几个特帕里豆品种。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 行政区划单位；为行政管理划定的地区
rows.en: Each territorial division submitted its population figures separately.
rows.zh: 每个行政区划单位分别提交了人口数据。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 毛圈布；表面有未剪断线圈的毛巾织物
rows.en: The bathrobe was made from thick blue terry cloth.
rows.zh: 这件浴袍是用厚实的蓝色毛圈布做的。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 毛圈毛巾；以毛圈织物制成的浴巾或毛巾
rows.en: He wrapped the wet puppy in a warm terry towel.
rows.zh: 他用一条温暖的毛圈毛巾包住了湿漉漉的小狗。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 极难对付的东西；难办的事（口语）
rows.en: The last screw was the devil to remove without damaging the frame.
rows.zh: 想拆下最后一颗螺丝又不弄坏框架，真是难办。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 三牌猜牌游戏；常用作街头骗局的三牌游戏
rows.en: The guide warned us to walk past the three-card monte game without placing a bet.
rows.zh: 导游提醒我们径直走过那场三牌猜牌游戏，不要下注。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美东部的一种铁苋菜属杂草（Acalypha virginica）
rows.en: Three-seeded mercury had appeared in the disturbed soil beside the shed.
rows.zh: 棚屋旁翻动过的土壤里长出了Acalypha virginica铁苋菜属杂草。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美东部的虫蛇（Carphophis amoenus）
rows.en: A thunder snake slipped beneath the damp leaves as we lifted the fallen branch.
rows.zh: 我们抬起倒下的树枝时，一条Carphophis amoenus虫蛇钻进了潮湿的落叶下。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 票券簿；装订成册、可逐张撕下使用的票券
rows.en: The conductor tore a fresh ticket from the ticket book.
rows.zh: 乘务员从票券簿上撕下一张新票。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 结系工；负责将物料系结的工人（旧职业称谓）
rows.en: The old employment register lists her as a tier-up in a silk mill.
rows.zh: 旧雇员名册把她登记为丝织厂中负责系结的工人。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 虎甲；捕食其他昆虫的甲虫类
rows.en: The tiger beetle ran across the warm sand in short bursts.
rows.zh: 那只虎甲在温热的沙地上时跑时停。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 虎鲨；鼬鲨（Galeocerdo cuvier）
rows.en: The research team photographed a tiger shark beside the reef.
rows.zh: 研究团队在礁石旁拍摄了一条虎鲨。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 紧身的；贴合身体的
rows.en: The tight-fitting gloves made it difficult to pick up the tiny screws.
rows.zh: 紧身手套让拾起那些微小螺丝变得困难。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 跷跷板；支在支点上、两端可轮流升降的长板玩具
rows.en: The children took turns on the tilting board in the playground.
rows.zh: 孩子们轮流玩操场上的跷跷板。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 印度番泻植物；狭叶番泻类灌木（Senna alexandrina）
rows.en: The botanical collection included tinnevelly senna with yellow flowers.
rows.zh: 植物收藏中有一株开黄花的印度番泻灌木。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 补篮；将弹回的球轻拨入筐的投篮
rows.en: Her tip-in dropped through the basket just before the buzzer.
rows.zh: 蜂鸣器响起前，她轻拨补篮，球落入了篮筐。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 翻面桌；桌面可翻起至竖直位置的独柱桌
rows.en: The tip-top table stood against the wall with its top tilted upright.
rows.zh: 那张翻面桌靠墙放着，桌面翻起竖立。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 台式小电烤箱；可烤面包或加热食物的小型电烤箱
rows.en: The toaster oven was just large enough to warm two slices of pizza.
rows.zh: 这台小电烤箱刚好能加热两片比萨。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 烟草天蛾的幼虫（Manduca sexta）
rows.en: A tobacco hornworm was feeding on a leaf near the top of the plant.
rows.zh: 一只Manduca sexta烟草天蛾幼虫正在植株上部的一片叶子上取食。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 烟草螟；一种幼虫危害烟草等干燥植物制品的小蛾（Ephestia elutella）
rows.en: The laboratory identified the small brown insect as a tobacco moth.
rows.zh: 实验室把那只褐色小昆虫鉴定为烟草螟。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 烟草植株；烟草属植物
rows.en: The students measured the height of each tobacco plant in the greenhouse.
rows.zh: 学生们测量了温室里每株烟草的高度。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 托比人物酒壶或酒杯；常塑成戴三角帽的矮胖男子形象的器皿
rows.en: The toby jug on the shelf showed a stout man in a three-cornered hat.
rows.zh: 架上的托比人物酒壶塑成了一个戴三角帽的矮胖男子。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 代币强化制；以可兑换奖励的代币强化目标行为的制度
rows.en: In the classroom's token economy, pupils could exchange earned tokens for extra art time.
rows.zh: 在班级的代币强化制中，学生可以把挣得的代币换成额外的美术活动时间。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 吐鲁香树；吐鲁香膏树（Myroxylon balsamum）
rows.en: The label identified the tolu tree by its botanical name, Myroxylon balsamum.
rows.zh: 标签用植物学名Myroxylon balsamum标明了这株吐鲁香树。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 番茄果实夜蛾幼虫；美洲棉铃虫幼虫（Helicoverpa zea）
rows.en: The tomato fruitworm had chewed a hole into the ripening fruit.
rows.zh: 那只Helicoverpa zea幼虫在逐渐成熟的番茄上咬出了一个洞。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 牙槽；牙齿嵌入的骨性窝
rows.en: The dentist pointed to the empty tooth socket on the X-ray.
rows.zh: 牙医指出了X光片上那处空的牙槽。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 齿鲸；具有牙齿的鲸类
rows.en: The guide explained why a sperm whale is classed as a toothed whale.
rows.zh: 向导解释了为什么抹香鲸被归为齿鲸。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 高筒靴；常带异色或异质上缘的长靴
rows.en: His top boot had a pale leather cuff above the black shaft.
rows.zh: 他的高筒靴在黑色靴筒上方有一圈浅色皮革靴口。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 上侧；最上面的表面
rows.en: The top side of the slab was polished, but the underside remained rough.
rows.zh: 石板的上表面磨光了，下表面仍很粗糙。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 小腿长的女式紧身裤；斗牛士式七分紧身裤
rows.en: She wore black toreador pants with a loose white shirt.
rows.zh: 她穿着黑色的小腿长紧身裤，配一件宽松白衬衫。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 龙卷风地下避难室；躲避风暴的地下室
rows.en: Before the storm arrived, the caretaker unlocked the tornado cellar.
rows.zh: 风暴来临前，管理员打开了龙卷风地下避难室的门锁。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 斑纹似玳瑁的蛱蝶类（tortoiseshell类蝴蝶）
rows.en: A tortoiseshell butterfly warmed itself on the sunlit garden wall.
rows.zh: 一只玳瑁斑纹的蛱蝶停在阳光照着的花园墙上取暖。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 顺便插入；随口加进谈话中
rows.en: Before the meeting ended, she managed to toss in one useful suggestion.
rows.zh: 会议结束前，她设法顺便提了一条有用的建议。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 焓的旧称；内能加上压强与体积乘积的热力学量
rows.en: The old steam table uses total heat as the heading for its enthalpy values.
rows.zh: 那份旧蒸汽表用total heat作为焓值一栏的标题。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 敞篷旅游车；有折叠车篷的旧式多人敞篷汽车
rows.en: The restored touring car carried four passengers with its folding top lowered.
rows.zh: 那辆修复后的旧式敞篷旅游车放下了折叠车篷，载着四名乘客。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种直立生长的欧洲十字花科植物（本例指Arabis turrita）
rows.en: Tower mustard grew beside the old wall, its stiff stems rising above the surrounding herbs.
rows.zh: Arabis turrita十字花科植物长在旧墙旁，挺直的茎高出周围草本。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 毒素—抗毒素混合制剂（旧式免疫制剂）
rows.en: The museum label describes toxin-antitoxin as an early diphtheria immunization mixture.
rows.zh: 博物馆标签把毒素—抗毒素混合剂介绍为一种早期白喉免疫制剂。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 玩具士兵；士兵造型的小玩偶
rows.en: A toy soldier had fallen behind the bookcase during the move.
rows.zh: 搬家时，一个玩具士兵掉到了书柜后面。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 无轨电车；从架空电线取电的公共汽车
rows.en: The trackless trolley crossed the square beneath a web of overhead wires.
rows.zh: 无轨电车从架空电线网下穿过广场。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 收藏交换卡；可收集和交换的图像卡片
rows.en: She kept her rarest trading card in a transparent protective sleeve.
rows.zh: 她把最稀有的收藏卡放在透明保护套里。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 行为事项豁免；就作证涉及的有关行为免受起诉的豁免
rows.en: The witness agreed to testify after being granted transactional immunity for the conduct under investigation.
rows.zh: 证人就受调查的相关行为获授不起诉豁免后，同意作证。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 公共交通线路
rows.en: The new transit line connects the railway station with the university campus.
rows.zh: 新的公共交通线路连接火车站与大学校园。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 捕兽陷阱线；沿一定线路设置的一系列陷阱
rows.en: The ranger marked the abandoned trap line on the survey map.
rows.zh: 护林员在调查地图上标出了那条废弃的捕兽陷阱线。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 诱挡战术；先放防守者冲过开球线再将其挡开的美式足球进攻战术
rows.en: The coach replayed the trap play to show how the blocker opened a path for the runner.
rows.zh: 教练重放了那次诱挡战术，展示阻挡队员如何为持球跑者打开通道。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 沿着某一路线行进
rows.en: The cyclists will travel along the canal before turning toward the hills.
rows.zh: 骑行者将沿着运河前进，然后转向山丘。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种树状石松（Lycopodium obscurum）
rows.en: Tree clubmoss covered a small patch of the shaded forest floor.
rows.zh: 一小片阴暗林地上长满了Lycopodium obscurum石松。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 树棉；木本棉属植物（本例指Gossypium arboreum）
rows.en: The gardener planted tree cotton for its pale yellow blossoms.
rows.zh: 园丁种下Gossypium arboreum树棉，欣赏其淡黄色花朵。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 林木培育；树木的栽植和养护经营
rows.en: The family combined tree farming with a small dairy business.
rows.zh: 这家人既经营林木培育，也做小规模奶牛养殖。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种高大灌木状锦葵科植物（旧名Lavatera arborea）
rows.en: The tree mallow beside the ruined wall carried large red-purple flowers.
rows.zh: 断墙旁那株旧名Lavatera arborea的锦葵科灌木，开着红紫色的大花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 三色彩色显像管；通过三原色组合显示彩色图像的电视显像管
rows.en: The diagram shows how the tricolour tube produces a colour television picture.
rows.zh: 示意图展示了三色显像管如何产生彩色电视图像。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 洞口边的支承搁栅；承接横挡梁端部以围出楼梯等洞口的搁栅
rows.en: The carpenter marked the trimmer joist beside the new staircase opening.
rows.zh: 木匠在新楼梯洞口旁的支承搁栅上做了标记。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 美洲猪牙花（Erythronium americanum）；一种黄花猪牙花
rows.en: A trout lily in the pressed collection still showed traces of yellow on its petals.
rows.zh: 压制标本中的那株美洲猪牙花，花瓣上仍留有黄色的痕迹。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美忍冬属藤本（Lonicera sempervirens，花常为红或橙色）
rows.en: Trumpet honeysuckle climbed the trellis beside the porch.
rows.zh: Lonicera sempervirens忍冬藤沿着门廊旁的花架攀爬。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 簇羽海鹦；眼上具有黄色长羽簇的北太平洋海鸟
rows.en: A tufted puffin stood at the cliff edge with its yellow plumes blowing in the wind.
rows.zh: 一只簇羽海鹦站在崖边，黄色羽簇随风飘动。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种攀缘野豌豆（Vicia cracca）
rows.en: Tufted vetch had climbed through the hedge and covered it with clusters of flowers.
rows.zh: Vicia cracca野豌豆攀进树篱，花簇布满了篱面。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种黄花墨西哥附生兰（旧名Encyclia citrina或Cattleya citrina）
rows.en: The tulip orchid hung from its mount with the yellow flowers facing downward.
rows.zh: 那株黄花附生兰悬在附生板上，花朵朝下。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 北美鹅掌楸（Liriodendron tulipifera）；郁金香树
rows.en: The tulip tree rose above the neighbouring trees in the park.
rows.zh: 公园里，那棵北美鹅掌楸高出了周围的树木。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种土耳其产低矮铺地菊科草本（Tripleurospermum tchihatchewii）
rows.en: The turfing daisy formed a low mat of small white flowers between the stones.
rows.zh: Tripleurospermum tchihatchewii菊科草本在石块间铺成一片低矮的小白花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 接客卖淫（非正式用语）
rows.en: The outreach worker asked the woman whether anyone had pressured her to turn a trick.
rows.zh: 外展工作者询问那名女子，是否有人曾施压让她接客卖淫。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 转向指示灯；车辆转弯信号灯
rows.en: The driver switched on the turn indicator before leaving the roundabout.
rows.zh: 驾驶员驶离环岛前打开了转向指示灯。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 在极小空间内转向；转弯半径很小（美式口语）
rows.en: The little boat can turn on a dime inside the narrow harbour.
rows.zh: 这条小船能在狭窄的港内以很小的半径转向。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 产生性兴奋的（非正式）
rows.en: She felt turned on by her partner's voice over the phone.
rows.zh: 电话里伴侣的声音让她产生了性兴奋。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 模糊地带；两种类别或状态之间的过渡区域
rows.en: The proposal lies in a twilight zone between public art and commercial advertising.
rows.zh: 这个提案处于公共艺术与商业广告之间的模糊地带。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 系泊；将到港船只用绳索固定的过程
rows.en: The tying up of the ferry took longer than usual in the strong wind.
rows.zh: 大风中，渡轮系泊所用的时间比平常更长。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 尺静脉；前臂尺侧的静脉
rows.en: The anatomy diagram labels the ulnar vein in the forearm.
rows.zh: 解剖图标出了前臂的尺静脉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 越权的；超出法定权限的（拉丁语法律用语）
rows.en: The court declared the board's decision ultra vires.
rows.zh: 法院认定董事会的决定超出了法定权限。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种北美木兰（Magnolia tripetala，叶片在枝端呈伞状聚集）
rows.en: The umbrella tree spread its large leaves above the garden bench.
rows.zh: 那棵Magnolia tripetala木兰在花园长椅上方舒展着大叶片。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 未分割共有权益；对整项共有财产的权益
rows.en: The deed gave each sister an undivided interest in the whole property.
rows.zh: 契据赋予每位姐妹对整处房产的未分割共有权益。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 非自责分；按记分规则不计入投手自责分的失分（棒球）
rows.en: The scorer recorded an unearned run after an error kept the inning alive.
rows.zh: 一次失误使该局得以延续，随后记分员记下了一分非自责失分。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 统一资源定位符（URL）；用于定位并访问资源的地址标识
rows.en: I copied the uniform resource locator from the browser's address bar into the report.
rows.zh: 我把统一资源定位符从浏览器地址栏复制进了报告。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 大学推广教育；大学面向非在校注册学生提供的教育服务
rows.en: He studied local history through university extension while working full time.
rows.zh: 他全职工作期间，通过大学推广教育学习地方史。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 一种北美白花菊科多年生植物（旧名Aster ptarmicoides）
rows.en: The upland white aster flowered in loose clusters beside the dry path.
rows.zh: 干燥小径旁，那株旧名Aster ptarmicoides的菊科植物开出了疏松的白色花簇。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 城市；人口密集的城市区域（本例指整个城市聚居区）
rows.en: The railway turned the small port into a busy urban center.
rows.zh: 铁路使这座小港口发展成了繁忙的城市聚居区。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 城市游击队员；在城镇活动的游击战人员
rows.en: The novel's narrator becomes an urban guerrilla operating in the capital.
rows.zh: 小说中的叙述者成了一名在首都活动的城市游击队员。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 泌尿器官；泌尿系统的器官
rows.en: The lesson identified the kidney as a urinary organ.
rows.zh: 课堂上把肾脏列为泌尿器官。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 泌尿小管；肾单位和集合管构成的肾内管道系统
rows.en: The lecturer traced the route of fluid through the uriniferous tubule on the diagram.
rows.zh: 讲师在图上描出了液体流经泌尿小管的路线。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 可胜任多个位置的棒球选手；多面手球员
rows.en: The manager valued him as a utility man who could play both the infield and the outfield.
rows.zh: 经理看重他这名多面手球员，因为他既能守内野，也能守外野。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 蒸气相对密度（本例在相同温压下，以空气为1作比较）
rows.en: The safety data sheet lists a vapour density greater than one, using air as the reference.
rows.zh: 安全数据表列出的蒸气相对密度大于一，并以空气为参照。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 车辆交通；某地来往车辆的总体流动
rows.en: The square is closed to vehicular traffic during the weekend market.
rows.zh: 周末集市期间，广场禁止车辆通行。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 绒毛剪股颖类草（本例指Agrostis canina）
rows.en: Velvet bent grass formed a fine, dense patch beside the path.
rows.zh: 小径旁的Agrostis canina剪股颖类草长成了一片细密的草丛。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 尾穗苋（Amaranthus caudatus）；花序下垂的苋属植物
rows.en: The velvet flower's long tassels hung over the rim of the planter.
rows.zh: 那株尾穗苋的长穗垂过了种植盆的边缘。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 蜗小管静脉；蜗水管静脉（解剖拉丁名）
rows.en: The anatomical chart labels the vena canaliculi cochleae beside the cochlear aqueduct.
rows.zh: 解剖图在蜗水管旁标出了蜗小管静脉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 腘静脉；膝后区域的静脉（拉丁名）
rows.en: The surgeon identified the vena poplitea behind the knee on the scan.
rows.zh: 外科医生在扫描图像中辨认出了膝后方的腘静脉。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 春花矮生鸢尾（Iris verna）
rows.en: The vernal iris opened its blue-lilac flowers before the taller plants filled the border.
rows.zh: 花境里较高的植物长满之前，Iris verna矮生鸢尾先开出了蓝紫色的花。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 宗座代牧；代表教宗管理尚未成立正式教区地区的教会负责人
rows.en: A vicar apostolic visited the scattered mission communities by boat.
rows.zh: 一位宗座代牧乘船走访分散的传教团体。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 取景器；相机中供瞄准和构图的装置
rows.en: The photographer kept both eyes open while checking the scene through the viewfinder.
rows.zh: 摄影师透过取景器查看画面时，两只眼睛都睁着。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 漆树属的一种灌木（本例指Rhus glabra）
rows.en: The vinegar tree at the edge of the field had clusters of red fruit.
rows.zh: 田地边缘那株Rhus glabra漆树属灌木结着一簇簇红果。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 中音谱号；第三线为中央C的C谱号（常用于中提琴）
rows.en: She checked the viola clef before copying the notes into her part.
rows.zh: 她先核对了中音谱号，再把音符抄进自己的分谱。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 柔音中提琴；一种常带共鸣弦的古弓弦乐器（viola d'amore）
rows.en: The player tuned the sympathetic strings of the viola d'amore before the concert.
rows.zh: 演奏者在音乐会前调好了柔音中提琴的共鸣弦。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 臂持式古提琴；用手臂支撑演奏的历史提琴类乐器（viola da braccio）
rows.en: In the engraving, the musician supports a viola da braccio on his arm.
rows.zh: 版画中，乐师用手臂托着一件臂持式古提琴。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 华夫饼烤模；华夫饼机
rows.en: The waffle iron left a crisp grid pattern on both sides of the batter.
rows.zh: 华夫饼烤模把面糊两面烤出了酥脆的方格纹。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 马车轮箍；包在木轮外缘的金属轮圈
rows.en: The wagon tire had come loose from the wooden wheel.
rows.zh: 木车轮外缘的金属轮箍已经松脱了。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 叶尖能着地生根的蕨（Asplenium rhizophyllum）
rows.en: The walking fern had rooted where a long frond touched the damp soil.
rows.zh: 一片长叶触到湿土的地方，那株Asplenium rhizophyllum蕨已经生根。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 大眼梭鲈；walleye（一种淡水鱼）
rows.en: The lake survey recorded a walleyed pike near the mouth of the river.
rows.zh: 湖泊调查在河口附近记录到了一条大眼梭鲈。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 战时婴儿；战争期间出生的人
rows.en: The family album describes him as a war baby, born just before the fighting ended.
rows.zh: 家庭相册把他称为战时婴儿：他出生时，战斗已接近尾声。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 洗手不管；宣布不再负责（常接of）
rows.en: If they ignore the safety review, I'll wash my hands of the project.
rows.zh: 如果他们无视安全审查，我就和这个项目撇清责任。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 白费力气；徒劳的努力
rows.en: Rearranging the same files for a third time felt like a waste of energy.
rows.zh: 第三次重新整理同一批文件，让人觉得是在白费力气。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 浪费自己的时间；白费工夫
rows.en: Don't waste your time searching the attic; the spare chairs are in the garage.
rows.zh: 别白费时间翻找阁楼了，备用椅子在车库里。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 水手御寒用的针织便帽
rows.en: Before stepping onto the cold deck, Mara pulled her watch cap down over her ears.
rows.zh: 走上寒冷的甲板之前，玛拉把针织水手帽往下拉，盖住了耳朵。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 守夜礼拜，尤指除夕夜举行的礼拜
rows.en: The small chapel remained open for a watch night that ended just after midnight.
rows.zh: 小礼拜堂一直开着门，举行的守夜礼拜在午夜刚过时结束。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 水生山核桃（Carya aquatica，北美的一种山核桃树）
rows.en: A young water bitternut was growing beside the flooded trail.
rows.zh: 一株幼小的水生山核桃长在被水淹没的小径旁。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 大薸（Pistia stratiotes，一种浮水植物，亦称水浮莲）
rows.en: The pond keeper lifted a clump of water cabbage out of the narrow channel.
rows.zh: 池塘管理员从狭窄的水道里捞起了一丛大薸。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Montia lamprosperma 的英文俗名，一种小型草本植物
rows.en: The botanist knelt beside the water chickweed to examine its tiny leaves.
rows.zh: 植物学家在那株 Montia lamprosperma 旁跪下，查看它细小的叶片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 美洲黄莲（Nelumbo lutea，一种开淡黄色花的水生植物）
rows.en: A water chinquapin opened its pale yellow flower above the broad leaves.
rows.zh: 一株美洲黄莲在宽大的叶片上方绽开了淡黄色的花。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 水资源保护；节约用水
rows.en: The school made water conservation part of its plan to reduce waste.
rows.zh: 学校把节约用水纳入了减少浪费的计划。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 水毛茛（Ranunculus aquatilis，一种水生毛茛）
rows.en: White flowers of water crowfoot dotted the quiet edge of the stream.
rows.zh: 水毛茛的白花点缀在溪流平静的边缘。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 美洲榆（Ulmus americana）的一个英文别名
rows.en: The old water elm shaded nearly the entire front lawn.
rows.zh: 那棵老美洲榆几乎遮住了整个前院草坪。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Hottonia inflata，一种北美水生草本植物
rows.en: The drawing shows a water gillyflower with its white flowers above the water.
rows.zh: 画中一株 Hottonia inflata 的白花伸出水面。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 水生山核桃（Carya aquatica）
rows.en: The survey team marked a large water hickory near the riverbank.
rows.zh: 调查小组给河岸附近的一棵大水生山核桃做了标记。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 美洲地笋（Lycopus americanus，一种多年生草本植物）
rows.en: We found water horehound growing among the taller herbs on the bank.
rows.zh: 我们发现美洲地笋长在岸边较高的草本植物之间。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 樟叶西番莲的可食黄色果实
rows.en: She cut the water lemon in half and scooped out the pulp.
rows.zh: 她把樟叶西番莲的黄色果实切成两半，舀出了果肉。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 河乌，一类会潜水觅食的小型鸟
rows.en: A water ouzel disappeared beneath the rushing stream and emerged beside a rock.
rows.zh: 一只河乌钻入湍急的溪水，又在一块岩石旁露了出来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 泽芹（Sium suave，一种生于浅水中的伞形科植物）
rows.en: The field guide helped us identify the white-flowered water parsnip beside the marsh.
rows.zh: 野外指南帮助我们认出了沼泽旁开白花的泽芹。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 泽泻（Alisma plantago-aquatica，一种沼泽植物）
rows.en: A water plantain had taken root at the muddy edge of the pond.
rows.zh: 一株泽泻在池塘泥泞的边缘扎了根。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 水蓝宝石，深蓝色堇青石的旧称
rows.en: The jeweller placed the water sapphire beside a card identifying it as cordierite.
rows.zh: 珠宝商把那颗水蓝宝石放在一张标明它是堇青石的卡片旁。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 水堇（Hottonia palustris，一种水生植物）
rows.en: The water violet had several delicate flowers above its submerged foliage.
rows.zh: 那株水堇在水下的叶丛上方开着几朵娇小的花。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 西瓜皮椒草（Peperomia argyreia，一种观叶植物）
rows.en: He moved the watermelon begonia to a shelf where its striped leaves could be seen clearly.
rows.zh: 他把西瓜皮椒草移到一个能清楚看到它条纹叶片的架子上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 编枝覆泥的建筑材料；荆条泥料
rows.en: The builders filled the timber frame with wattle and daub.
rows.zh: 工匠们用编枝覆泥的材料填满了木框架。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 球兰（Hoya carnosa，一种攀援植物）
rows.en: The wax plant sent a new shoot around the thin support.
rows.zh: 那株球兰的新枝绕上了细支架。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 单编结；用于临时连接绳索的绳结（sheet bend）
rows.en: The instructor loosened the weaver's hitch so that everyone could see how the two ropes crossed.
rows.zh: 教练松开了单编结，让大家看清两根绳子是怎样交叉的。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 幕衣蛾（Tineola bisselliella，一种会结丝网的衣蛾）
rows.en: The conservator found a webbing clothes moth inside the box of wool samples.
rows.zh: 文物保护人员在装着羊毛样品的盒子里发现了一只幕衣蛾。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 参加婚礼的一群人；婚礼队伍
rows.en: The photographer asked the wedding party to gather beside the steps.
rows.zh: 摄影师请婚礼队伍的人在台阶旁集合。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 牛腰脊肉中靠近臀部的部分
rows.en: The butcher wrapped the wedge bone separately from the other cuts of beef.
rows.zh: 肉贩把靠近臀部的那块牛腰脊肉与其他牛肉部位分开包好。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 举止规矩的；表现良好的
rows.en: The children were well behaved throughout the long ceremony.
rows.zh: 孩子们在整个漫长的仪式中都表现得很规矩。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 涌出；大量流出
rows.en: Clear water began to well out of the crack in the rock.
rows.zh: 清水开始从岩石的裂缝中涌出。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 西部低地大猩猩（Gorilla gorilla gorilla）
rows.en: The keeper watched the western lowland gorilla carry a branch into the shade.
rows.zh: 饲养员看着那只西部低地大猩猩把一根树枝带到阴凉处。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 西式蛋饼三明治（夹西式煎蛋饼的三明治）
rows.en: I ordered a western sandwich and asked for the toast to be lightly browned.
rows.zh: 我点了一份西式蛋饼三明治，并请他们把吐司烤得略微焦黄。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Piranga ludoviciana，北美西部的一种鸣禽
rows.en: A western tanager paused on the branch while we adjusted the binoculars.
rows.zh: 我们调整双筒望远镜时，一只 Piranga ludoviciana 停在了树枝上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 西部白松（Pinus monticola，北美的一种松树）
rows.en: The western white pine at the bend in the path was taller than the surrounding trees.
rows.zh: 小径拐弯处的西部白松比周围的树都高。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 一粒完整的小麦籽粒
rows.en: She picked up a wheat berry and pointed out the crease along one side.
rows.zh: 她拿起一粒完整的麦粒，指出了它一侧的凹沟。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 搅打至松软的奶油；打发奶油
rows.en: A spoonful of whipped cream slowly melted into the hot chocolate.
rows.zh: 一匙打发奶油慢慢融进了热巧克力里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 传声穹顶；能把特定位置的低声传到远处的穹顶空间
rows.en: At the whispering dome, we could hear a quiet voice from the opposite side.
rows.zh: 在传声穹顶下，我们能听到对面传来的轻声说话。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 铁路沿线的小镇；小站所在的社区
rows.en: The train passed through a whistle stop with a single shop beside the tracks.
rows.zh: 火车经过一个铁路沿线小镇，铁轨旁只有一家商店。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白带蛱蝶（本例指欧亚种 Limenitis camilla）
rows.en: A white admiral settled on a leaf just beyond the shaded path.
rows.zh: 一只 Limenitis camilla 白带蛱蝶停在了阴凉小径旁的一片叶子上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白果类叶升麻（旧学名 Actaea alba），一种结有毒白色浆果的草本植物
rows.en: The guide pointed to the white baneberry and told the group to leave its berries untouched.
rows.zh: 向导指着那株白果类叶升麻，告诉大家不要碰它的浆果。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Actaea alba 的英文俗名，一种结白色有毒浆果的北美草本植物
rows.en: A cluster of white bead grew behind the low fence in the woodland garden.
rows.zh: 林地花园的矮篱笆后长着一丛结白色有毒浆果的 Actaea alba。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白色种子的食用菜豆；白芸豆
rows.en: A single white bean had fallen from the open bag onto the counter.
rows.zh: 一粒白芸豆从敞开的袋子里掉到了操作台上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白花麦瓶草（Silene latifolia，亦曾称 Lychnis alba）
rows.en: The white campion opened its flowers as the evening light began to fade.
rows.zh: 暮色渐暗时，那株白花麦瓶草展开了花朵。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白刺盖太阳鱼（Pomoxis annularis，一种淡水鱼）
rows.en: The biologist measured the white crappie before returning it to the lake.
rows.zh: 生物学家测量了那条白刺盖太阳鱼，随后把它放回了湖里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 大西洋白柏（Chamaecyparis thyoides，一种北美柏树）
rows.en: The white cypress beside the boardwalk still had a narrow, dense crown.
rows.zh: 木栈道旁那棵大西洋白柏仍有着狭窄而浓密的树冠。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白柏松（Callitris glaucophylla，澳大利亚的一种柏科树木）
rows.en: A white cypress pine stood alone at the edge of the clearing.
rows.zh: 一棵白柏松独自长在林间空地的边缘。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白流苏兰（词典旧学名 Habenaria albiflora），一种北美湿地兰
rows.en: The photographer waited for the white fringed orchis to stop swaying in the breeze.
rows.zh: 摄影师等着那株白流苏兰不再随微风摇摆。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 浪尖泛白的波浪；白浪
rows.en: A white horse broke across the dark surface of the bay.
rows.zh: 一道白浪在海湾深色的水面上翻涌开来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白鲻（Mugil curema，一种银白色鲻鱼）
rows.en: A white mullet flashed beneath the surface beside the pier.
rows.zh: 码头旁水面下一条白鲻一闪而过。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白色野羊（本例为北美的 Dall sheep，词典旧名 Ovis montana dalli）
rows.en: The climbers noticed a white sheep standing on a ledge above the valley.
rows.zh: 登山者注意到一只白色野羊站在山谷上方的岩架上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 吉贝（Ceiba pentandra，一种热带大乔木）
rows.en: The white silk-cotton tree cast a broad shadow across the courtyard.
rows.zh: 那棵吉贝树在庭院里投下了一大片阴影。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白花草木樨（Melilotus alba）
rows.en: Bees moved from flower to flower on the white sweet clover beside the field.
rows.zh: 蜜蜂在田边白花草木樨的一朵朵花之间飞来飞去。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白尾飞机；已制造但尚无确定买主的飞机
rows.en: The manufacturer found a buyer for a white tail that had been parked outside the assembly hall.
rows.zh: 制造商为一架停在装配厂房外、尚无确定买主的白尾飞机找到了买家。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白色芜菁的肉质根
rows.en: He peeled the white turnip and cut it into thick wedges.
rows.zh: 他削去白芜菁的皮，把它切成厚块。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Aster divaricatus，一种开白花的北美林地紫菀类植物
rows.en: The white wood aster spread into a small patch beneath the trees.
rows.zh: 那种开白花的 Aster divaricatus 在树下长成了一小片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 薯蓣属植物 Dioscorea alata（white yam 的一个词典义）
rows.en: The farmer set aside a white yam for the crop display at the village hall.
rows.zh: 农民留出了一株 Dioscorea alata，准备参加村礼堂的作物展示。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白皮北美松（Pinus albicaulis），北美西部的一种松树
rows.en: A bent whitebark pine rose above the low shrubs on the ridge.
rows.zh: 山脊上的低矮灌木丛中耸立着一棵弯曲的 Pinus albicaulis。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Pinus albicaulis 的英文别名，一种北美西部松树
rows.en: The botanist collected fallen needles beneath the whitebarked pine.
rows.zh: 植物学家在那棵 Pinus albicaulis 下收集了掉落的松针。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 扇尾沙锥（Gallinago gallinago）的一个英文别名
rows.en: A whole snipe rose suddenly from the wet grass and flew across the ditch.
rows.zh: 一只扇尾沙锥突然从湿草中飞起，越过了水沟。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Aster acuminatus，一种叶片看似轮生的北美多年生植物
rows.en: The whorled aster was almost hidden among the ferns beside the path.
rows.zh: 那株 Aster acuminatus 几乎藏在了小径旁的蕨类植物中。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 风轮菜属草本 Clinopodium vulgare 的英文俗名
rows.en: She rubbed a leaf of wild basil between her fingers and noticed its scent.
rows.zh: 她用手指揉了揉 Clinopodium vulgare 的一片叶子，闻到了它的香味。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 野生芹（Apium graveolens，wild celery 的一个植物义）
rows.en: The researcher compared the leaves of wild celery with those of the cultivated plants.
rows.zh: 研究人员把野生芹的叶子与栽培植株的叶子作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Canella winterana，一种树皮芳香的常绿灌木或小乔木
rows.en: The gardener planted a wild cinnamon near the sunny wall.
rows.zh: 园丁在向阳的墙边种了一株 Canella winterana。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Camassia scilloides，一种北美卡马夏属植物
rows.en: A patch of wild hyacinth brightened the clearing beside the woodland trail.
rows.zh: 一片 Camassia scilloides 为林间小径旁的空地增添了色彩。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 赝靛属（Baptisia）的植物；假靛蓝
rows.en: The gardener left the wild indigo undisturbed when she cleared the neighboring bed.
rows.zh: 园丁清理旁边的花坛时，没有动那株赝靛属植物。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Galium mollugo，一种开小白花的拉拉藤属草本植物
rows.en: Wild madder formed a loose mass of small white flowers along the hedge.
rows.zh: 篱笆边的 Galium mollugo 长成了疏松的一片，开着小小的白花。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Elaeagnus latifolia，一种果实似橄榄的胡颓子属灌木或攀援植物
rows.en: The botanist photographed the red fruit on the wild olive.
rows.zh: 植物学家拍下了那株 Elaeagnus latifolia 上的红色果实。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 野生葱属植物，通常有可食的鳞茎
rows.en: A wild onion pushed its narrow leaves through a crack beside the path.
rows.zh: 一株野生葱属植物从小径旁的裂缝里伸出了细长的叶子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Kiggelaria africana，一种常绿灌木或乔木
rows.en: The wild peach screened the garden bench from the road.
rows.zh: 那株 Kiggelaria africana 挡住了从道路望向花园长椅的视线。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 野米，北美水生禾草的可食籽粒
rows.en: The soup contained mushrooms and a handful of wild rice.
rows.zh: 汤里有蘑菇和一把野米。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 裸茎楤木（Aralia nudicaulis），一种北美多年生草本植物
rows.en: Wild sarsaparilla grew in a broad patch beyond the fallen log.
rows.zh: 倒下的树干那边长着一大片裸茎楤木。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Lysiloma latisiliqua，一种结长扁荚果的热带豆科树木
rows.en: The wild tamarind spread its branches over the low stone wall.
rows.zh: 那棵 Lysiloma latisiliqua 的枝条伸展到了矮石墙上方。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Trilisa odoratissima，一种叶有香草气味的美国东南部草本植物
rows.en: The dried leaves of wild vanilla still had a noticeable fragrance.
rows.zh: Trilisa odoratissima 的干叶仍有明显的香气。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 杨柳科（Salicaceae），包括柳属和杨属等植物
rows.en: The lesson placed both poplars and willows in the willow family.
rows.zh: 这节课把杨树和柳树都归入了杨柳科。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 萎蔫病；以植株萎蔫、干缩为特征的植物病害
rows.en: Several young plants showed signs of wilt disease before the leaves had fallen.
rows.zh: 几株幼苗在落叶之前就表现出了萎蔫病的迹象。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 糖棕（Borassus flabellifer），wine palm 的一个植物义
rows.en: The wine palm towered above the smaller trees beside the road.
rows.zh: 路旁的糖棕高高耸立在较小的树木之上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 冬菟葵（Eranthis hyemalis，一种早春开黄花的多年生植物）
rows.en: The first winter aconite appeared beside the path while snow still lay in the shade.
rows.zh: 阴处还留着积雪时，小径旁已经出现了第一株冬菟葵。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 冬生金针菇类真菌（本例指 Flammulina velutipes）
rows.en: The student drew the winter mushroom with its smooth cap and darkening stalk.
rows.zh: 学生画下了那朵 Flammulina velutipes，画出了它光滑的菌盖和逐渐变深的菌柄。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 冬香薄荷（Satureja montana）用作调味料的叶片
rows.en: She added a little winter savory to the stuffing before it went into the oven.
rows.zh: 她在馅料放进烤箱之前，加了一点冬香薄荷叶。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 牛筋草（Eleusine indica，wire grass 的一个植物义）
rows.en: Wire grass had rooted in the hard ground beside the gate.
rows.zh: 牛筋草已经在大门旁坚硬的地面上扎了根。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 无线局域网（wireless fidelity 为某些旧词典使用的称法）
rows.en: The old networking glossary uses 'wireless fidelity' as another name for a wireless local area network.
rows.zh: 那本旧网络术语表把 wireless fidelity 用作无线局域网的另一个名称。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 识破；了解……的内情（非正式）
rows.en: The cashier was wise to the trick and checked the note carefully.
rows.zh: 收银员识破了这个把戏，仔细检查了那张纸币。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 偃麦草（词典名 Agropyron repens，witch grass 的一个植物义）
rows.en: The gardener traced the roots of witch grass beneath the flower bed.
rows.zh: 园丁顺着花坛下面偃麦草的根追查它的生长范围。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 退居室；正式接待客人的客厅（旧称）
rows.en: After dinner, the guests moved into the withdrawing room for conversation.
rows.zh: 晚餐后，客人们移步到正式会客的客厅里交谈。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 乳浆大戟（Euphorbia esula），一种多年生大戟属植物
rows.en: The field crew mapped a patch of wolf's milk along the roadside.
rows.zh: 野外工作队在地图上标出了路旁的一片乳浆大戟。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 馄饨；抄手
rows.en: A won ton slipped from his spoon and splashed back into the broth.
rows.zh: 一只馄饨从他的勺子上滑落，溅回了汤里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Geum urbanum，一种开小黄花的水杨梅属草本植物
rows.en: The wood avens had small yellow flowers above its hairy leaves.
rows.zh: 那株 Geum urbanum 在带毛的叶片上方开着小黄花。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 新西兰秧鸡（weka，一种不会飞的秧鸡）
rows.en: A wood hen walked out from under the ferns and crossed the track.
rows.zh: 一只新西兰秧鸡从蕨丛下走出来，穿过了小路。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 费城百合（Lilium philadelphicum），一种北美百合
rows.en: The wood lily carried an orange flower marked with dark spots.
rows.zh: 那株费城百合开着一朵带深色斑点的橙色花。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 鼠妇；陆生等足类小型甲壳动物
rows.en: A wood louse crawled away when I lifted the damp log.
rows.zh: 我抬起潮湿的木头时，一只鼠妇爬走了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 东绿霸鹟（Contopus virens），一种北美林地霸鹟
rows.en: A wood pewee returned to the same bare branch after catching an insect.
rows.zh: 一只东绿霸鹟捉到昆虫后，又回到了同一根光秃的树枝上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 林鸫（Hylocichla mustelina），一种北美鸣禽
rows.en: The song of a wood thrush reached us from deep among the trees.
rows.zh: 一只林鸫的鸣声从树林深处传到了我们耳边。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Lithophragma affine，一种加州多年生草本植物
rows.en: The woodland star had opened several white flowers beside the rock.
rows.zh: 岩石旁那株 Lithophragma affine 已经开了几朵白花。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 欧白英（Solanum dulcamara），一种有毒的多年生茄属藤本植物
rows.en: Woody nightshade had climbed through the old fence at the back of the garden.
rows.zh: 欧白英已经沿着花园后面的旧篱笆攀爬起来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Scirpus cyperinus，一种生有绒毛状小穗的北美莎草科植物
rows.en: The wool grass bent beneath the weight of its clustered seed heads.
rows.zh: Scirpus cyperinus 的茎被成簇的穗头压弯了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 绵毛熊果（Arctostaphylos tomentosa），一种加州灌木
rows.en: The young twigs of the woolly manzanita felt soft through the thin glove.
rows.zh: 隔着薄手套摸去，那株绵毛熊果的嫩枝很柔软。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Cirsium flodmanii，一种叶有白色绒毛的北美蓟类植物
rows.en: A woolly thistle stood above the shorter plants beside the fence.
rows.zh: 一株 Cirsium flodmanii 高出篱笆旁其他较矮的植物。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 详细拟订；逐步推敲完善
rows.en: The working out of the final design took longer than the team had expected.
rows.zh: 最终设计的详细拟订比团队预想的花了更长时间。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 文字系统；书写体系
rows.en: The museum display explained how the writing system represented the sounds of the language.
rows.zh: 博物馆的展板解释了这种文字系统如何表示该语言的语音。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 待印的文字材料；文字稿件
rows.en: The editor checked the written matter before the illustrations were added.
rows.zh: 编辑在加入插图之前检查了文字稿件。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 欧洲山榆（Ulmus glabra，亦称无毛榆）
rows.en: The old wych elm sheltered a bench at the corner of the garden.
rows.zh: 花园角落那棵老欧洲山榆为一张长椅遮了阴。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 长豇豆（Vigna unguiculata sesquipedalis），一种豆科作物
rows.en: A yard-long bean climbed the bamboo frame beside the vegetable bed.
rows.zh: 一株长豇豆沿着菜畦旁的竹架向上攀爬。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 黄鲈（词典名 Morone interrupta），一种北美淡水鲈类鱼
rows.en: The researcher counted the fin rays of the yellow bass under a bright lamp.
rows.zh: 研究人员在明亮的灯下数了那条黄鲈的鳍条。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 可用于制取染料或颜料的鼠李类果实
rows.en: The dyer crushed a yellow berry to show where the pigment came from.
rows.zh: 染色工碾碎了一颗可制染料的鼠李类果实，展示颜料的来源。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 北美黄柏（词典名 Chamaecyparis nootkatensis），一种北美针叶树
rows.en: The yellow cedar stood above the smaller evergreens on the slope.
rows.zh: 那棵 Chamaecyparis nootkatensis 高出山坡上较小的常绿树。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 钝叶酸模（Rumex obtusifolius，yellow dock 的一个植物义）
rows.en: A yellow dock had spread its broad leaves over the edge of the path.
rows.zh: 一株钝叶酸模把宽大的叶子伸展到了小径边上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Lonicera flava，一种开黄花的攀援忍冬
rows.en: The yellow honeysuckle twined around the wooden post near the gate.
rows.zh: 那株 Lonicera flava 绕着门旁的木柱攀援。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 常绿钩吻（Gelsemium sempervirens），一种开黄花的有毒藤本植物
rows.en: The yellow jasmine covered part of the fence with yellow flowers.
rows.zh: 常绿钩吻的黄花覆盖了篱笆的一部分。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 黄连花类植物 Lysimachia vulgaris
rows.en: Yellow loosestrife grew in a thick patch beside the narrow stream.
rows.zh: 溪流旁长着浓密的一片 Lysimachia vulgaris。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 黄酸枣（Spondias mombin）的黄色果实
rows.en: She placed a ripe yellow mombin beside the other tropical fruit.
rows.zh: 她把一枚成熟的黄酸枣果实放在其他热带水果旁。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 美洲黑栎（Quercus velutina），yellow oak 的一个树木义
rows.en: The forester marked the yellow oak before measuring its trunk.
rows.zh: 林务员在测量树干之前，给那棵美洲黑栎做了标记。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 北美鹅掌楸（Liriodendron tulipifera）
rows.en: The yellow poplar had dropped several large leaves onto the lawn.
rows.zh: 那棵北美鹅掌楸的几片大叶子已经落在草坪上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 天蓝苜蓿（Medicago lupulina），一种开小黄花的草本植物
rows.en: Yellow trefoil grew close to the ground along the sunny bank.
rows.zh: 天蓝苜蓿贴着向阳的岸边地面生长。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 埃及伊蚊（Aedes aegypti）
rows.en: The entomologist placed the yellow-fever mosquito under the microscope.
rows.zh: 昆虫学家把那只埃及伊蚊放到了显微镜下。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 黄尾鲽（Limanda ferruginea），一种美洲比目鱼
rows.en: The fisheries officer recorded the length of the yellowtail flounder.
rows.zh: 渔业官员记录了那条黄尾鲽的长度。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 你说对了；可不是嘛（表示赞同的非正式回应）
rows.en: 'That climb was exhausting.' 'You said it! My legs are still shaking.'
rows.zh: “那段攀登太累了。”“可不是嘛！我的腿还在发抖。”
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 零息债券；存续期间不支付定期利息的债券
rows.en: The report listed a zero-coupon bond among the company’s long-term investments.
rows.zh: 报告把一只零息债券列在了公司的长期投资中。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 怂恿某人；起哄鼓动某人
rows.en: His friends tried to egg him on, but he refused to climb onto the roof.
rows.zh: 朋友们试图起哄怂恿他，但他拒绝爬上屋顶。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 不再喜欢某事物；对某事物失去兴趣（英式用法）
rows.en: I began to go off sweet drinks when I started making my own tea.
rows.zh: 我开始自己泡茶后，就渐渐不再喜欢甜饮料了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 耽误某人；使某人不能继续前进
rows.en: Please don't hold us up with another argument about the route.
rows.zh: 请别再为路线争论，耽误我们的行程。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 漫无边际的；东拉西扯的；缺乏明确方向的
rows.en: His meandering answer left us unsure what he had actually decided.
rows.zh: 他东拉西扯的回答让我们仍不清楚他到底作出了什么决定。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 恳求、央求某人
rows.en: She went to plead with the landlord for another week to move her belongings.
rows.zh: 她去恳求房东再给她一个星期搬走自己的物品。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 萨拉人，中非的一个民族群体的成员
rows.en: The interview was translated with help from a Sara who spoke both languages.
rows.zh: 这段访谈在一位会说两种语言的萨拉人的帮助下完成了翻译。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 北安普敦郡；Northamptonshire 的简称
rows.en: The map labels the county Northampton rather than Northamptonshire.
rows.zh: 这张地图用 Northampton 这个简称标注北安普敦郡，而没有写 Northamptonshire。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 白金汉，英格兰白金汉郡的一座城镇
rows.en: We crossed the river in Buckingham before stopping for lunch.
rows.zh: 我们在白金汉镇过了河，然后停下来吃午饭。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 明顿瓷器，英国 Stoke-on-Trent 出产的优质瓷器
rows.en: The cabinet held Minton alongside several pieces of local pottery.
rows.zh: 柜子里摆着明顿瓷器，旁边还有几件当地陶器。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 伯里尔·伯纳德·克罗恩（美国医师，Burrill Bernard Crohn）
rows.en: The lecture described Crohn's work on diseases of the intestine.
rows.zh: 这场讲座介绍了医师克罗恩对肠道疾病的研究。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 约翰·索斯比（John Sotheby，英国拍卖商）
rows.en: The company history explains how Sotheby became involved in the auction business.
rows.zh: 这部公司史解释了索斯比是怎样参与拍卖业务的。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 曼莫汉·辛格（印度前总理 Manmohan Singh）
rows.en: The biography follows Singh from his university years to his time as prime minister.
rows.zh: 这部传记讲述了辛格从大学时代到担任总理期间的经历。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 格雷厄姆·古奇（英国板球运动员 Graham Gooch）
rows.en: The article discussed Gooch's approach to batting against fast bowlers.
rows.zh: 这篇文章讨论了古奇应对快速投球手时的击球方式。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 莱斯特郡，英格兰中部的郡
rows.en: The route crosses Leicestershire before turning towards the coast.
rows.zh: 这条路线穿过莱斯特郡，然后转向海岸。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 生有灌木的沼泽地或湿地（英式英语）
rows.en: A narrow boardwalk led into the carr beyond the meadow.
rows.zh: 一条狭窄的木栈道通向草甸那边长有灌木的湿地。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 德里，北爱尔兰的城市，亦称 Londonderry
rows.en: The letter was posted in Derry before the family left for the coast.
rows.zh: 这封信在一家人动身前往海岸之前，从德里寄出。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿基坦，法国西南部的地区
rows.en: The author devoted a chapter to Aquitaine and its historic towns.
rows.zh: 作者用了一章介绍阿基坦地区及其历史城镇。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 航天任务控制中的制导官（guidance officer，NASA 旧称 Guido）
rows.en: During the simulation, the Guido checked the updated guidance data.
rows.zh: 模拟过程中，制导官检查了更新后的制导数据。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 格拉纳达，西班牙东南部的城市
rows.en: They booked two nights in Granada before continuing their journey.
rows.zh: 他们在继续旅程之前，预订了在格拉纳达住两晚。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 披头士乐队的一名成员
rows.en: The fan put a photograph of her favourite Beatle above her desk.
rows.zh: 那位歌迷把一张自己最喜欢的披头士成员的照片贴在书桌上方。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 特里·维纳布尔斯（Terry Venables，英国足球运动员、教练）
rows.en: The archive includes an interview with Venables about his years as a manager.
rows.zh: 档案中收录了一段关于维纳布尔斯执教经历的访谈。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 奥利维蒂，意大利的办公设备及技术企业、品牌
rows.en: The brochure traces Olivetti’s development from typewriters to digital technology.
rows.zh: 这本宣传册追溯了奥利维蒂从打字机到数字技术的发展。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 马哈茂德，姓氏（Mahmoud）
rows.en: Mr. Mahmoud brought the repaired radio back the following morning.
rows.zh: 马哈茂德先生第二天早晨把修好的收音机送了回来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 贝德福德郡，英格兰的郡
rows.en: The school in Bedfordshire received the parcel a day later.
rows.zh: 贝德福德郡的那所学校晚一天收到了包裹。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 克鲁，英格兰柴郡的一座城镇
rows.en: Our train stopped at Crewe, where we changed for the next part of the journey.
rows.zh: 我们的火车在克鲁停下，我们在那里换车，继续下一段行程。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 霍顿，苏斯博士作品中的大象角色（Horton）
rows.en: The children drew Horton with a tiny flower curled in his trunk.
rows.zh: 孩子们画出了霍顿，画中他用鼻子卷着一朵小花。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 达米恩·赫斯特（英国艺术家 Damien Hirst）
rows.en: The gallery devoted one room to Hirst's work.
rows.zh: 美术馆用一个展厅陈列赫斯特的作品。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 锯齿修整器，用于扩大磨损锯片齿间空隙的工具
rows.en: The repair shop kept a gummer beside the rack of worn saw blades.
rows.zh: 修理店把一台锯齿修整器放在磨损锯片架旁。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 戈登·斯特拉坎（Gordon Strachan，苏格兰足球运动员、教练）
rows.en: The article looks back at Strachan’s playing career in Scotland and England.
rows.zh: 这篇文章回顾了斯特拉坎在苏格兰和英格兰踢球的经历。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 多尼戈尔粗花呢，一种带彩色结子的粗花呢
rows.en: The tailor cut a length of Donegal for the new jacket.
rows.zh: 裁缝为新夹克裁下了一段多尼戈尔粗花呢。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 弗里德里希·尼采（德国哲学家 Friedrich Nietzsche）
rows.en: The seminar began with a short passage from Nietzsche.
rows.zh: 研讨课以尼采作品中的一小段文字开始。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布朗德，一种旧亮度单位，与 apostilb 相等
rows.en: Luminance readings in blondels filled the old laboratory notebook.
rows.zh: 那本旧实验室笔记本里写满了以布朗德为单位的亮度读数。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 百慕大，北大西洋的一组岛屿
rows.en: The postcard from Bermuda showed a stretch of pale sand and blue water.
rows.zh: 从百慕大寄来的明信片上是一片浅色沙滩和蓝色海水。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 约翰·威廉·沃特豪斯（John William Waterhouse，英国画家）
rows.en: The curator compared Waterhouse’s treatment of the story with that of another painter.
rows.zh: 策展人把沃特豪斯对这个故事的描绘与另一位画家的处理作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 亨廷登，英格兰剑桥郡的一座城镇
rows.en: We left Huntingdon early enough to reach the meeting before noon.
rows.zh: 我们很早就离开了亨廷登，赶在中午之前抵达会场。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 罗奇代尔，英格兰大曼彻斯特的一座城镇
rows.en: The exhibition in Rochdale traced the town’s industrial past.
rows.zh: 罗奇代尔的这场展览追溯了该镇的工业历史。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 车臣语，一种北高加索语言
rows.en: The recording begins with a short conversation in Chechen.
rows.zh: 这段录音以一小段车臣语对话开始。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 惠特利，英国 Armstrong Whitworth Whitley 轰炸机的型号名
rows.en: The museum displayed a photograph of a Whitley parked beside its crew.
rows.zh: 博物馆展出了一张惠特利轰炸机停在机组人员旁边的照片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 巴布亚，新几内亚东南部的地区
rows.en: The historian compared two early maps of Papua.
rows.zh: 历史学家比较了两张早期的巴布亚地区地图。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布劳顿，姓氏（Broughton）
rows.en: Ms. Broughton waited until everyone had a copy before starting the meeting.
rows.zh: 布劳顿女士等到每个人都拿到一份材料后，才开始开会。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 黑格，姓氏（Haig）
rows.en: The final design was based on a sketch by Haig.
rows.zh: 最终设计以黑格的一张草图为基础。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 林顿，男性名字（Linton）
rows.en: Linton folded the letter and put it back into the envelope.
rows.zh: 林顿把信折好，放回了信封里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯诺登尼亚，威尔士西北部的山块、山地（最高峰为 Snowdon）
rows.en: Low cloud hid the higher slopes of Snowdonia during the morning walk.
rows.zh: 早晨徒步时，低云遮住了斯诺登尼亚较高的山坡。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 罗森塔尔，德国瓷器品牌、制造商（Rosenthal）
rows.en: The catalogue gives Rosenthal as the maker of the vase.
rows.zh: 目录把罗森塔尔列为这个花瓶的制造商。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 朗科恩，英格兰西北部的一座城镇
rows.en: The delivery was sent to an address in Runcorn.
rows.zh: 这批货物被送往朗科恩的一个地址。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 蒙特罗斯，苏格兰东部的一座港镇
rows.en: The boat reached Montrose shortly before the rain began.
rows.zh: 船在开始下雨前不久抵达了蒙特罗斯。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯特普尔顿，姓氏（Stapleton）
rows.en: Dr. Stapleton asked the students to check the units in their calculations.
rows.zh: 斯特普尔顿博士让学生检查计算中的单位。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯皮罗·西奥多·阿格纽（Spiro Theodore Agnew，美国前副总统）
rows.en: The documentary examined Agnew’s years in national politics.
rows.zh: 这部纪录片考察了阿格纽参与美国全国政治的那些年。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 欧内斯特·贝文（Ernest Bevin，英国政治家、工会领袖）
rows.en: The historian compared Bevin’s public speeches with his private letters.
rows.zh: 历史学家把贝文的公开演讲与他的私人信件作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 罗伊斯顿，英格兰赫特福德郡的一座集镇
rows.en: The baker in Royston had sold the last loaf by noon.
rows.zh: 到中午时，罗伊斯顿的面包师已经卖掉了最后一条面包。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 海菲尔德，姓氏（Highfield）
rows.en: Highfield’s spare umbrella saved us from a long wait in the rain.
rows.zh: 海菲尔德的备用雨伞让我们不必在雨中久等。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 乔·奥顿（Joe Orton，英国剧作家）
rows.en: The theatre group chose a play by Orton for its next production.
rows.zh: 剧团选了奥顿的一部剧本，作为下一出要排演的戏。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡里克，姓氏（Carrick）
rows.en: Carrick turned down the music so that everyone could hear the announcement.
rows.zh: 卡里克把音乐调低，好让大家听清通知。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 邦；印度的一个邦（印度英语）
rows.en: The historian compared the revenue records of one pradesh with those of its neighbours.
rows.zh: 历史学家把一个邦的财政收入记录与邻邦的记录作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 普卢默，姓氏（Plummer）
rows.en: Plummer’s quiet remark brought the argument to an end.
rows.zh: 普卢默轻声说的一句话结束了这场争论。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 盖乌斯·马略（Gaius Marius，古罗马将领、执政官）
rows.en: The chapter examines Marius’s rivalry with other Roman leaders.
rows.zh: 这一章探讨了马略与其他罗马领袖之间的竞争。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 华金·罗德里戈（Joaquín Rodrigo，西班牙作曲家）
rows.en: The guitarist chose a piece by Rodrigo for the final recital.
rows.zh: 吉他手选了罗德里戈的一首作品，在最后一场独奏会上演奏。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 豪泽，姓氏（Hauser）
rows.en: Hauser counted the empty seats before letting the waiting group enter.
rows.zh: 豪泽数了数空座位，然后让等候的一行人进去。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 马顿，新西兰朗伊蒂凯地区的一座城镇
rows.en: The bus dropped us in Marton, where we waited outside the library.
rows.zh: 公交车把我们送到马顿，我们在那里等在图书馆外。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 拔示巴，《旧约》中的人物，大卫之妻、所罗门之母
rows.en: The painting depicts Bathsheba beside a pool in a walled garden.
rows.zh: 这幅画描绘了拔示巴站在一座围墙花园中的水池旁。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 仅停留在设想中的；未经实现或检验的；考虑不充分的（黑客用语）
rows.en: The design remained a gedanken proposal until someone built a working prototype.
rows.zh: 在有人做出能运行的原型之前，这个设计一直只是未经实现检验的设想。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布朗普顿，折叠自行车制造商、品牌（Brompton）
rows.en: She folded the bike made by Brompton before carrying it upstairs.
rows.zh: 她把布朗普顿制造的自行车折叠起来，然后搬上楼。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 纽因顿，美国康涅狄格州的一座城镇
rows.en: The community garden in Newington needed more volunteers for the spring planting.
rows.zh: 纽因顿的社区花园需要更多志愿者参与春季种植。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 达特福德，英格兰的一座城镇
rows.en: The library in Dartford hosted an evening of readings by local writers.
rows.zh: 达特福德的图书馆举办了一场当地作家的晚间朗读活动。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 普里查德，姓氏（Pritchard）
rows.en: Pritchard put the wet maps on a shelf to dry.
rows.zh: 普里查德把湿地图放到架子上晾干。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 大卫·加里克（David Garrick，英国演员、剧院经理）
rows.en: The exhibition included a portrait of Garrick in theatrical costume.
rows.zh: 展览中有一幅加里克身着戏服的肖像。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 埃德蒙·泰勒·惠特克（Edmund Taylor Whittaker，英国数学家）
rows.en: The library holds an early edition of Whittaker’s textbook on analysis.
rows.zh: 图书馆藏有惠特克分析学教材的一部早期版本。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 杰弗里·辛顿（Geoffrey Hinton，计算机科学研究者）
rows.en: The course assigned a paper by Hinton on neural networks.
rows.zh: 这门课程布置了辛顿的一篇神经网络论文供学生阅读。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 约翰·巴肯（John Buchan，苏格兰作家、政治家）
rows.en: She packed a novel by Buchan for the overnight train journey.
rows.zh: 她带了一本巴肯的小说，准备在通宵火车旅途中阅读。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 洛克伍德，姓氏（Lockwood）
rows.en: The neighbours thanked Mrs. Lockwood for keeping an eye on the empty house.
rows.zh: 邻居们感谢洛克伍德夫人帮忙照看空房子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿伦德尔，英格兰西萨塞克斯的一座城镇
rows.en: The coach stopped in Arundel long enough for us to walk towards the castle.
rows.zh: 大巴在阿伦德尔停留了一段时间，足够让我们朝城堡方向走一走。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 科比，英格兰北安普敦郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The parcel arrived at the depot in Corby on Monday morning.
rows.zh: 包裹在星期一早晨抵达了科比的货运站。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡佩尔，姓氏（Capel）
rows.en: Capel checked the cupboard one more time before ordering replacement parts.
rows.zh: 卡佩尔在订购替换零件之前，又检查了一遍橱柜。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 巴勃罗，男性名字，西班牙语中 Paul 的形式（Pablo）
rows.en: Pablo checked the address twice before sending the invitation.
rows.zh: 巴勃罗在寄出邀请函之前，把地址核对了两遍。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 梅德韦河，英格兰东南部的一条河流
rows.en: The old bridge crossed the Medway just beyond the town centre.
rows.zh: 那座老桥在市中心不远处横跨梅德韦河。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 霍斯金斯，姓氏（Hoskins）
rows.en: Hoskins returned the borrowed tools in a carefully labelled box.
rows.zh: 霍斯金斯把借来的工具放在一个仔细贴好标签的箱子里归还了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯派塞，姓氏（Spicer）
rows.en: Ms. Spicer noticed that two pages were missing from the draft.
rows.zh: 斯派塞女士发现草稿中少了两页。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 弗朗切斯科，男性名字，Francis 的意大利语形式（Francesco）
rows.en: Francesco rehearsed the opening bars until he could play them from memory.
rows.zh: 弗朗切斯科反复练习开头几小节，直到能够凭记忆演奏。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 康奈尔，姓氏（Connell）
rows.en: Connell stayed at the station until the lost bag was found.
rows.zh: 康奈尔一直留在车站，直到丢失的包被找到。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 奥本，苏格兰西部的一座港镇
rows.en: We watched the harbour lights come on in Oban.
rows.zh: 我们在奥本看着港口的灯一盏盏亮起。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 宾利，英格兰的一座城镇（Bingley）
rows.en: The old photograph showed Bingley before the new shops were built.
rows.zh: 那张旧照片展现了新商店建成之前的宾利。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 哈伍德，姓氏（Harwood）
rows.en: Harwood replaced the broken handle before returning the case.
rows.zh: 哈伍德在归还箱子之前换掉了坏掉的提手。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 格雷夫森德，英格兰肯特郡泰晤士河畔的一座港镇
rows.en: The ship was photographed at Gravesend on a grey winter afternoon.
rows.zh: 一个灰蒙蒙的冬日下午，有人在格雷夫森德拍下了这艘船。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 考特尼，姓氏（Courtenay）
rows.en: The chair beside Courtenay had been left for the interpreter.
rows.zh: 考特尼旁边的椅子留给了口译员。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 史蒂夫·雷德格雷夫（Steve Redgrave，英国赛艇运动员）
rows.en: The display traced Redgrave’s career through photographs from several Olympic Games.
rows.zh: 展览用几届奥运会的照片展示了雷德格雷夫的运动生涯。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 马林斯，姓氏（Mullins）
rows.en: Mullins took the back road to avoid the queue at the bridge.
rows.zh: 马林斯走了后面的小路，避开桥边的车队。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 沃金顿，英格兰坎布里亚的一座城镇
rows.en: The exhibition in Workington explored the town’s industrial past.
rows.zh: 沃金顿的这场展览探讨了该镇的工业历史。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 马修·博尔顿（Matthew Boulton，英国工程师、制造商）
rows.en: The museum displayed a letter in which Boulton discussed a steam engine.
rows.zh: 博物馆展出了一封博尔顿讨论蒸汽机的信。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 拉迪亚德，男性名字（Rudyard）
rows.en: Rudyard offered to take the late shift so his colleague could go home.
rows.zh: 拉迪亚德主动提出值晚班，好让同事回家。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 圣艾丹（Saint Aidan，在诺森布里亚传教的爱尔兰传教士）
rows.en: The guide explained why Aidan is associated with Lindisfarne.
rows.zh: 导游解释了艾丹为何与林迪斯法恩有关。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 霍利黑德，威尔士安格尔西地区的一座港镇
rows.en: The ferry timetable was pinned to the wall of our room in Holyhead.
rows.zh: 渡轮时刻表钉在我们位于霍利黑德的房间墙上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 埃蒂安，姓氏（Etienne）
rows.en: Professor Etienne carried a stack of notebooks into the lecture room.
rows.zh: 埃蒂安教授抱着一摞笔记本走进教室。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布里德灵顿，英格兰约克郡的一座沿海城镇
rows.en: A sudden shower sent us into a café in Bridlington.
rows.zh: 一阵突来的雨把我们赶进了布里德灵顿的一家咖啡馆。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿尔弗雷多式的；配有黄油、奶油和帕尔马干酪等制成的酱汁的（食物）
rows.en: She served pasta Alfredo with a small green salad.
rows.zh: 她端上了配阿尔弗雷多酱汁的意面和一小份蔬菜沙拉。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 莫雷尔，姓氏（Morrell）
rows.en: Morrell had saved the receipt in case the lamp needed to be returned.
rows.zh: 莫雷尔保留了收据，以防需要退掉那盏灯。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 麦当劳快餐品牌名称 McDonald’s 的无撇号记录写法（McDonalds）
rows.en: The faded receipt printed the restaurant’s name as McDonalds.
rows.zh: 那张褪色的收据把餐厅名称印作 McDonalds。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 劳德代尔，姓氏（Lauderdale）
rows.en: The instructions were clear enough for Lauderdale to finish the repair alone.
rows.zh: 说明足够清楚，劳德代尔能够独自完成维修。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 霍利鲁德，位于爱丁堡的苏格兰议会大楼
rows.en: The architecture students sketched Holyrood from across the road.
rows.zh: 建筑系学生从马路对面画下了霍利鲁德议会大楼的速写。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 吉尔克里斯特，姓氏（Gilchrist）
rows.en: Gilchrist passed the microphone to the next speaker.
rows.zh: 吉尔克里斯特把麦克风递给了下一位发言者。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 波茨，姓氏（Potts）
rows.en: Potts kept a spare set of keys in the office drawer.
rows.zh: 波茨在办公室抽屉里放了一套备用钥匙。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 丁沃尔，苏格兰北部的一座集镇
rows.en: We bought bread in Dingwall before driving farther north.
rows.zh: 我们在丁沃尔买了面包，然后继续向北开车。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 天哪；上帝啊（God 的非正式发音拼写，表示惊讶、烦恼等）
rows.en: 'Gawd, this box is heavier than it looks!' he said, setting it down.
rows.zh: “天哪，这箱子比看起来重多了！”他说着，把箱子放了下来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 安斯沃思，姓氏（Ainsworth）
rows.en: Ainsworth’s notes helped us reconstruct the order of events.
rows.zh: 安斯沃思的笔记帮助我们重建了事件的先后顺序。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 多尔蒂，姓氏（Doherty）
rows.en: Doherty left a message explaining where the parcels had been stored.
rows.zh: 多尔蒂留了一条消息，说明包裹存放在哪里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 克劳利，姓氏（Crowley）
rows.en: The class listened while Crowley described the damaged photograph.
rows.zh: 克劳利描述那张受损照片时，全班都在听。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 塞特福德，英格兰诺福克郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The children visited a small bookshop in Thetford after school.
rows.zh: 孩子们放学后去了塞特福德的一家小书店。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 霍舍姆，英格兰西萨塞克斯的一座城镇
rows.en: The team from Horsham arrived early enough to warm up before the match.
rows.zh: 来自霍舍姆的队伍到得很早，比赛前有足够时间热身。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 韦灵伯勒，英格兰北安普敦郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The repair shop in Wellingborough agreed to keep the bicycle overnight.
rows.zh: 韦灵伯勒的维修店同意把自行车留在店里过夜。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 普罗瑟，姓氏（Prosser）
rows.en: Prosser offered to check the figures before the report went to the printer.
rows.zh: 普罗瑟主动提出在报告送去印刷前核对数字。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡多根，姓氏（Cadogan）
rows.en: Cadogan was halfway through the demonstration when the lights went out.
rows.zh: 卡多根的演示进行到一半时，灯灭了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布莱奇利，英格兰米尔顿凯恩斯地区的一座城镇
rows.en: The club hired a minibus to bring its members from Bletchley.
rows.zh: 俱乐部租了一辆小巴，把成员们从布莱奇利接来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 瑞士的法语名称（Suisse）
rows.en: The bilingual map gave Suisse as the French name for Switzerland.
rows.zh: 那张双语地图列出了瑞士的法语名称 Suisse。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卢西亚诺，姓氏（Luciano）
rows.en: Ms. Luciano asked for a quieter table near the back of the restaurant.
rows.zh: 卢西亚诺女士要求安排餐厅后部一张较安静的桌子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 希灵登，伦敦西部的一个自治市
rows.en: The survey asked families in Hillingdon about their use of local parks.
rows.zh: 调查询问了希灵登的家庭如何使用当地公园。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 克里斯蒂，姓氏（Christy）
rows.en: Christy carried the seedlings indoors when the temperature began to fall.
rows.zh: 气温开始下降时，克里斯蒂把幼苗搬进了室内。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿拉伯复兴社会党或其主义的
rows.en: The historian compared Baathist rhetoric in two speeches from the 1960s.
rows.zh: 历史学家比较了二十世纪六十年代两次演讲中的阿拉伯复兴社会党言辞。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 德怀尔，姓氏（Dwyer）
rows.en: Dwyer suggested moving the discussion to a quieter room.
rows.zh: 德怀尔建议把讨论移到更安静的房间。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 瑟索，苏格兰凯思内斯地区的一座城镇
rows.en: A cold wind followed us through the streets of Thurso.
rows.zh: 寒风伴着我们走过瑟索的街道。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 比彻姆，姓氏（Beauchamp）
rows.en: Mrs. Beauchamp wrapped the bowl in newspaper before putting it in the box.
rows.zh: 比彻姆夫人把碗用报纸包好后，才放进箱子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 比亚里茨，法国西南部比斯开湾沿岸的一座城镇
rows.en: The postcard from Biarritz showed waves breaking along the shore.
rows.zh: 从比亚里茨寄来的明信片上，海浪正拍打着岸边。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 纽黑文，英格兰东萨塞克斯的一座港镇（Newhaven）
rows.en: The repair crew waited in Newhaven for a replacement pump to arrive.
rows.zh: 维修人员在纽黑文等待替换用的水泵运到。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 怀特黑文，英格兰坎布里亚西海岸的一座城镇
rows.en: The harbour lights in Whitehaven reflected on the wet pavement.
rows.zh: 怀特黑文的港口灯光映在湿漉漉的人行道上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 里布尔河，英格兰西北部的一条河流
rows.en: After the rain, the Ribble carried muddy water beneath the bridge.
rows.zh: 雨后，里布尔河浑浊的河水从桥下流过。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 赫斯顿，姓氏（Heston）
rows.en: Heston’s detailed directions brought us straight to the back entrance.
rows.zh: 按照赫斯顿详细的指引，我们直接来到了后门。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 查特利，姓氏（Chatterley）
rows.en: Chatterley paused at the doorway to wipe the mud from his boots.
rows.zh: 查特利在门口停下，擦掉靴子上的泥。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 约翰·休斯顿（John Huston，美国电影导演）
rows.en: The film club compared two early films directed by Huston.
rows.zh: 电影俱乐部比较了休斯顿执导的两部早期电影。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 中部美洲地区诸民族、语言或文化的
rows.en: The course examines Mesoamerican art through pottery and carved stone.
rows.zh: 这门课程通过陶器和石雕考察中部美洲的艺术。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 诺斯利，英格兰利物浦附近的一个都市自治市
rows.en: The study compared bus access in Knowsley with access in nearby boroughs.
rows.zh: 这项研究比较了诺斯利与相邻自治市的公交便利程度。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 肖勒姆，英格兰的海滨城镇 Shoreham-by-Sea 的简称
rows.en: The cyclists stopped in Shoreham to repair a puncture.
rows.zh: 骑行者们在肖勒姆停下来修补被扎破的轮胎。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 德国的德语名称（Deutschland）
rows.en: The German stamp bore the name Deutschland beneath the picture.
rows.zh: 那枚德国邮票的图案下面印着国名 Deutschland。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 比钦，姓氏（Beeching）
rows.en: Beeching returned the borrowed camera with a new strap attached.
rows.zh: 比钦归还借来的相机时，给它装上了一条新背带。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 罗伯特·奥尔特曼（Robert Altman，美国电影导演）
rows.en: Altman’s films prompted a lively discussion after the screening.
rows.zh: 奥尔特曼的电影在放映后引发了一场热烈的讨论。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布里顿，姓氏（Brittain）
rows.en: Brittain found the missing paragraph in an earlier version of the file.
rows.zh: 布里顿在文件的较早版本中找到了缺失的那一段。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 金德斯利，姓氏（Kindersley）
rows.en: The envelope was addressed to Professor Kindersley at the old campus.
rows.zh: 信封收件人写的是旧校区的金德斯利教授。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 纽基，英格兰康沃尔大西洋沿岸的一座城镇
rows.en: The sea was rough when our bus reached Newquay.
rows.zh: 我们的公交车到达纽基时，海上波涛汹涌。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 巴拉，姓氏（Barra）
rows.en: Barra unfolded the picnic blanket beneath the largest tree.
rows.zh: 巴拉在最大的一棵树下铺开了野餐毯。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 雷迪奇，英格兰伍斯特郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The volunteers collected donated coats outside a supermarket in Redditch.
rows.zh: 志愿者们在雷迪奇一家超市外收集捐赠的大衣。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 塞萨尔，姓氏（Cesar）
rows.en: Cesar’s careful notes made it easier to repeat the experiment.
rows.zh: 塞萨尔细致的笔记让重复实验更容易了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 费兰，姓氏（Phelan）
rows.en: Phelan waited for the applause to fade before answering the question.
rows.zh: 费兰等掌声平息后才回答问题。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 罗赛斯，苏格兰东部福斯湾沿岸的一座城镇
rows.en: An old photograph showed the dockyard at Rosyth from the water.
rows.zh: 一张旧照片从水面方向拍下了罗赛斯的船坞。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 方丹，姓氏（Fontaine）
rows.en: Fontaine’s suggestion saved us a second journey to the warehouse.
rows.zh: 方丹的建议让我们省去了第二次前往仓库的行程。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 塞尔焦，姓氏（Sergio）
rows.en: Mr. Sergio stayed behind to return the chairs to the storeroom.
rows.zh: 塞尔焦先生留下来，把椅子搬回储藏室。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 佩恩顿，英格兰德文郡的一座海滨城镇
rows.en: The children sent their grandparents a postcard from Paignton.
rows.zh: 孩子们从佩恩顿给祖父母寄了一张明信片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 汤姆林，姓氏（Tomlin）
rows.en: Tomlin divided the remaining food among the volunteers.
rows.zh: 汤姆林把剩余的食物分给了志愿者。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 康奈利，姓氏（Connelly）
rows.en: The lift doors closed before Connelly could reach them.
rows.zh: 康奈利还没赶到，电梯门就关上了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 肯德里克，姓氏（Kendrick）
rows.en: Kendrick had to redraw the diagram after coffee spilled across the page.
rows.zh: 咖啡洒满纸页后，肯德里克不得不重新画那张图。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 霍奇金森，姓氏（Hodgkinson）
rows.en: Hodgkinson lowered her voice so the children in the next room could sleep.
rows.zh: 霍奇金森压低了声音，好让隔壁房间的孩子们睡觉。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 约翰·威廉·阿尔科克（John William Alcock，英国飞行员）
rows.en: The aviation display explained how Alcock prepared for the Atlantic crossing.
rows.zh: 航空展区介绍了阿尔科克如何为飞越大西洋作准备。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 诺斯威奇，英格兰柴郡的一座集镇
rows.en: The shop in Northwich set aside the last copy of the book for her.
rows.zh: 诺斯威奇的那家店为她留出了最后一本该书。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 里尔，威尔士北部登比郡的一座海滨城镇（Rhyl）
rows.en: Rain swept across Rhyl while we waited inside the station.
rows.zh: 我们在车站里等候时，雨横扫里尔。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 洛马克斯，姓氏（Lomax）
rows.en: Lomax took one last photograph before the clouds hid the summit.
rows.zh: 云层遮住山顶之前，洛马克斯又拍了最后一张照片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 坎诺克，英格兰斯塔福德郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The community centre in Cannock opened its hall for the winter clothing drive.
rows.zh: 坎诺克的社区中心开放了礼堂，供冬衣募集活动使用。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 托尼·杰克林（Tony Jacklin，英国高尔夫球运动员）
rows.en: The sports archive includes an interview with Jacklin about putting under pressure.
rows.zh: 体育档案中收有一段杰克林谈在压力下推杆的访谈。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 西尔维奥，男性名字（Silvio）
rows.en: Silvio counted the tickets twice before putting them in his pocket.
rows.zh: 西尔维奥把票数了两遍，才放进口袋。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 黛米，女性名字（Demi）
rows.en: Demi saved the front seat for her grandmother.
rows.zh: 黛米给奶奶留了前排的座位。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 科马克，姓氏（Cormack）
rows.en: Cormack borrowed a ruler to straighten the lines on the poster.
rows.zh: 科马克借了一把尺子，把海报上的线条画直。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 圣瓦茨拉夫，十世纪波希米亚公爵及主保圣人（Wenceslas，亦作 Wenceslaus）
rows.en: The chapel window depicted Wenceslas holding a banner.
rows.zh: 小教堂的窗画描绘了手持旗帜的瓦茨拉夫。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 特伦，苏格兰南艾尔郡海岸的一座城镇（Troon）
rows.en: The musicians spent the night in Troon after the concert.
rows.zh: 音乐家们在音乐会后留宿特伦。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 霍布豪斯，姓氏（Hobhouse）
rows.en: Hobhouse listened to both proposals before offering a compromise.
rows.zh: 霍布豪斯听完两项提议后，提出了一个折中办法。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 苏莱曼一世，奥斯曼帝国苏丹，1520—1566年在位
rows.en: The lecture examined Suleiman’s support for the arts at his court.
rows.zh: 讲座探讨了苏莱曼对其宫廷艺术的支持。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 奥德·查尔斯·文盖特（Orde Charles Wingate，英国军人）
rows.en: The historian questioned how Wingate’s plans were presented in the wartime reports.
rows.zh: 历史学家质疑战时报告是如何描述文盖特的计划的。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 温斯凯尔，英国坎布里亚的一处历史核设施场址，现为塞拉菲尔德场区的一部分
rows.en: The historian used photographs of Windscale to illustrate the early nuclear industry.
rows.zh: 历史学家用温斯凯尔的照片介绍早期核工业。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡那封，威尔士西北部的一座港镇
rows.en: We could see the castle as we approached Caernarfon.
rows.zh: 接近卡那封时，我们已经能看见那座城堡。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 纳贝斯克，饼干等食品的品牌、历史公司名称（Nabisco）
rows.en: The collector found an old Nabisco tin at the back of the cupboard.
rows.zh: 收藏者在橱柜深处找到了一只旧纳贝斯克食品罐。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 豪登，姓氏（Howden）
rows.en: Howden left the parcel with a neighbour because nobody was home.
rows.zh: 因为家里没人，豪登把包裹交给了邻居。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 雷迪，姓氏（Reddy）
rows.en: Reddy checked that the gate was shut before letting the dog into the garden.
rows.zh: 雷迪先确认门已经关好，才让狗进入花园。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡里克弗格斯，北爱尔兰安特里姆郡的一座城镇
rows.en: A painting of Carrickfergus hung above the fireplace.
rows.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一幅描绘卡里克弗格斯的画。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 苏美尔人，古代苏美尔居民中的一员
rows.en: The story follows a Sumerian who keeps records for a temple.
rows.zh: 故事讲述了一位为神庙记账的苏美尔人的经历。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 奥姆斯柯克，英格兰西兰开夏的一座集镇
rows.en: The market in Ormskirk was busy by the time we arrived.
rows.zh: 我们到达时，奥姆斯柯克的市场已经很热闹了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 奥塔戈，新西兰南岛南部的一个地区
rows.en: The photographer spent the autumn travelling through Otago.
rows.zh: 摄影师整个秋天都在奥塔戈地区旅行。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 保罗·安东尼·萨缪尔森（Paul Anthony Samuelson，美国经济学家）
rows.en: The lecturer asked us to explain Samuelson’s argument in our own words.
rows.zh: 讲师让我们用自己的话解释萨缪尔森的论点。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 亚历山大，男性名字，Alexander 的俄语形式（Aleksandr）
rows.en: Aleksandr put the repaired violin carefully back into its case.
rows.zh: 亚历山大小心地把修好的小提琴放回琴盒。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 康塞特，英格兰达勒姆郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The delivery van broke down on the way to Consett.
rows.zh: 送货车在前往康塞特的路上抛锚了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 皮诺葡萄，若干用于酿酒的紫色或白色葡萄品种的统称
rows.en: The vineyard planted Pinot on the cooler slope above the road.
rows.zh: 葡萄园在道路上方较凉爽的坡地种植了皮诺葡萄。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 明托，姓氏（Minto）
rows.en: Minto kept the receipt in case the lamp had to be returned.
rows.zh: 明托留着收据，以防需要退还那盏灯。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 丹尼森，姓氏（Dennison）
rows.en: Dennison moved the meeting outside when the room became too warm.
rows.zh: 房间太热后，丹尼森把会议移到了室外。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布雷尔号，一艘于1993年在设得兰群岛搁浅的油轮（Braer）
rows.en: The maritime museum kept a file of newspaper reports about the Braer.
rows.zh: 海事博物馆保存了一份有关布雷尔号的报纸报道档案。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 萨利纳斯，美国加利福尼亚州的一座城市
rows.en: The family rented a small house in Salinas while their home was being repaired.
rows.zh: 自家房屋维修期间，这家人在萨利纳斯租了一栋小房子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 德米特里，男性名字的一种俄语转写形式（Dmitry）
rows.en: Dmitry ran back to the classroom to collect his forgotten notebook.
rows.zh: 德米特里跑回教室，去取忘带的笔记本。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 福伊，英格兰康沃尔的一个海滨聚落、度假地
rows.en: A steep lane took us down to the waterfront in Fowey.
rows.zh: 一条陡峭的小巷把我们带到了福伊的水边。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 巴勒特，苏格兰阿伯丁郡的一座村镇（Ballater）
rows.en: The walkers bought fresh bread in Ballater before heading into the hills.
rows.zh: 徒步者们在巴勒特买了新鲜面包，然后走向群山。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 萨阿德，姓氏（Saad）
rows.en: Saad brought an extra pair of gloves for the volunteer who had forgotten hers.
rows.zh: 萨阿德为那位忘带手套的女志愿者多带了一双。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 里根的支持者或追随者
rows.en: The interview featured a Reaganite who had kept his old campaign badges.
rows.zh: 访谈中的一位里根支持者一直保存着自己旧时的竞选徽章。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯泰夫利，姓氏（Staveley）
rows.en: The organiser asked Staveley to introduce the visiting musicians.
rows.zh: 组织者请斯泰夫利介绍来访的音乐家。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 雷纳，姓氏（Reina）
rows.en: Reina found a seat near the window and opened the folder.
rows.zh: 雷纳找了个靠窗的座位，打开了文件夹。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 贾迈勒，男性名字的埃及阿拉伯语转写形式（Gamal）
rows.en: Gamal slowed his pace so that the younger children could keep up.
rows.zh: 贾迈勒放慢脚步，让年幼的孩子们跟得上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 《Flashman》，乔治·麦克唐纳·弗雷泽的一部长篇小说
rows.en: She borrowed Flashman from the library for a long train journey.
rows.zh: 为了打发漫长的火车旅程，她从图书馆借了《Flashman》。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 制模时围在物体周围、限定模具外缘的围壁
rows.en: She built a clay cottle around the ornament before making the mould.
rows.zh: 她制作模具前，先用黏土在饰物周围筑了一圈围壁。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 贝宾顿，英格兰默西塞德郡威勒尔地区的一座城镇
rows.en: The bus from Bebington arrived just before the rain began.
rows.zh: 从贝宾顿开来的公交车在下雨前刚好到了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 灰泥工；抹灰工（旧用语）
rows.en: The pargeter repaired the plaster around the damaged doorway.
rows.zh: 灰泥工修补了受损门口周围的灰泥。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 许多；大量（模拟非正式口语 lot of 或 lots of 的拼写）
rows.en: 'That's a lotta boxes for one small room,' she said.
rows.zh: “这么小的房间放这么多箱子啊。”她说。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 拉比娅，人名的一种转写形式（Rabia）
rows.en: Rabia shortened the straps until the backpack sat comfortably.
rows.zh: 拉比娅把背带调短，直到背包背着舒服为止。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 轻薄透明的性质或状态（尤指织物）
rows.en: The sheerness of the curtains allowed the morning light to fill the room.
rows.zh: 窗帘轻薄透明，让晨光洒满了房间。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 索托，姓氏（Soto）
rows.en: Soto kept a spare set of keys in the office drawer.
rows.zh: 索托在办公室抽屉里放了一套备用钥匙。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布莱基，姓氏（Blackie）
rows.en: Ms. Blackie opened the hall early so the performers could rehearse.
rows.zh: 布莱基女士提前打开礼堂，好让表演者排练。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 一种南部非洲羚羊（Pelea capreolus；reebok 是 rhebok 的异体拼写）
rows.en: A reebok stood on the rocky slope, its grey coat blending with the stones.
rows.zh: 一只羚羊站在岩石坡上，灰色的皮毛与石块融为一体。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 雇佣兵；受雇为外国军队作战的人（非正式用语）
rows.en: In the novel, the merc refuses payment and leaves the camp before dawn.
rows.zh: 小说中，那名雇佣兵拒绝收取报酬，在黎明前离开了营地。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 蒂姆斯，姓氏（Timms）
rows.en: Timms switched off the projector after the last student had left.
rows.zh: 最后一名学生离开后，蒂姆斯关掉了投影仪。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 普里斯，姓氏（Preece）
rows.en: Preece placed a clean cloth under the vase to protect the table.
rows.zh: 普里斯在花瓶下面放了一块干净的布，保护桌面。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 马丁代尔，姓氏（Martindale）
rows.en: Martindale’s first attempt was uneven, but the second fitted perfectly.
rows.zh: 马丁代尔第一次做得不平整，但第二次的成品严丝合缝。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布兰卡，姓氏（Blanca）
rows.en: Ms. Blanca checked the guest list before opening the doors.
rows.zh: 布兰卡女士开门前，核对了来宾名单。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 特兰西瓦尼亚地区或其居民的
rows.en: The choir added a Transylvanian folk song to its programme.
rows.zh: 合唱团在节目中加入了一首特兰西瓦尼亚民歌。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿拉莫斯，墨西哥索诺拉州的一座城镇（Alamos）
rows.en: The family spent the afternoon exploring the old streets of Alamos.
rows.zh: 这家人花了一下午游览阿拉莫斯的老街。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 用十二口钟演奏的换序鸣钟法（钟乐术语）
rows.en: The ringers practised maximus once all twelve bells were ready.
rows.zh: 十二口钟全部准备好后，鸣钟者们练习了十二钟换序鸣钟法。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 比尔·克林顿或其政治、执政时期的
rows.en: The seminar compared Clintonian economic policy with earlier approaches.
rows.zh: 研讨会把克林顿时期的经济政策与此前的做法作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 滑动竖桁帆；固定在可沿短桅上下滑动的竖桁上的三角帆（航海用语）
rows.en: The sailor lowered the gunter as the wind began to strengthen.
rows.zh: 风开始增强时，水手降下了滑动竖桁帆。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 贪婪的；吝啬的（苏格兰用语，gair 的较少见异体）
rows.en: The gare landlord refused to mend the leaking roof.
rows.zh: 那个吝啬的房东拒绝修补漏水的屋顶。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 马尼拉纸，一种结实、浅褐色的纸或薄纸板
rows.en: She cut the manilla into strips to make labels for the storage boxes.
rows.zh: 她把马尼拉纸裁成纸条，给储物箱制作标签。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 施瓦茨，姓氏（Schwarz）
rows.en: Schwarz reached for a pencil to mark the missing measurements.
rows.zh: 施瓦茨伸手拿起铅笔，标出缺失的测量数据。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 牛轭湖；弯曲河道被截断后留下的弧形湖泊（英式用语）
rows.en: Reeds had spread across the shallow end of the mortlake.
rows.zh: 芦苇已经蔓延到那片牛轭湖的浅水一端。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 班加罗尔，印度南部的一座城市
rows.en: The interview took place in Bangalore while she was visiting her older sister.
rows.zh: 她探望姐姐期间，在班加罗尔接受了这次采访。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 南海城，英格兰朴次茅斯的一个海滨地区（Southsea）
