rows.en: The wind drove us off the beach at Southsea and into a sheltered café.
rows.zh: 风把我们从南海城的海滩赶进了一家避风的咖啡馆。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 铁桥镇，英格兰什罗普郡的河畔城镇（Ironbridge）
rows.en: We stopped in Ironbridge to sketch the houses above the river.
rows.zh: 我们在铁桥镇停下来，画河边高处的房屋。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 冰川竖井；冰面融水流入冰川内部的管状通道
rows.en: The survey team mapped a moulin near the centre of the glacier.
rows.zh: 勘测队标绘了冰川中部附近的一处冰川竖井。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 道尔顿，英国陶器制造商的名称（Doulton）
rows.en: The curator compared the vase with other pieces made by Doulton.
rows.zh: 策展人把这只花瓶与道尔顿制作的其他器物作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 德鲁克，姓氏（Drucker）
rows.en: Drucker marked the uneven floor with tape so nobody would trip.
rows.zh: 德鲁克用胶带标出了不平的地板，以免有人绊倒。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 邦吉，英格兰的一座城镇（Bungay）
rows.en: The notice invited residents of Bungay to help plant trees on Saturday.
rows.zh: 这则通知邀请邦吉居民在星期六来帮助植树。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 深褐绿色的
rows.en: She chose a breen jacket that looked almost brown in the evening light.
rows.zh: 她选了一件深褐绿色的夹克，在傍晚的光线下几乎显得是棕色。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 韦德伯恩，姓氏（Wedderburn）
rows.en: Wedderburn asked for a second estimate before agreeing to the repairs.
rows.zh: 韦德伯恩在同意维修前，要求再提供一份报价。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 克龙比式大衣，通常为羊毛制、四分之三长度的外套
rows.en: His Crombie was still damp when he hung it beside the door.
rows.zh: 他把克龙比式大衣挂在门边时，大衣还潮着。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 不幸的人们；可怜的人们（miserable 作名词的复数，旧用法）
rows.en: In the old tale, a monk brings bread to the miserables outside the city gate.
rows.zh: 在那则古老的故事里，一位修道士给城门外的可怜人送去面包。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 达达尼尔，美国阿肯色州的一座城市（Dardanelle）
rows.en: The van broke down just outside Dardanelle on the way home.
rows.zh: 回家途中，面包车在达达尼尔城外不远处抛锚了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 康斯坦丁，姓氏（Constantin）
rows.en: Constantin left a note explaining where the spare blankets were stored.
rows.zh: 康斯坦丁留了张便条，说明备用毛毯放在哪里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 莫亚，英国建筑师约翰·伊达尔戈·莫亚（Hidalgo Moya，1920—1994）
rows.en: The architecture students discussed Moya’s use of space in a college building.
rows.zh: 建筑系学生讨论了莫亚在一座学院建筑中对空间的运用。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 圣劳伦斯河或其附近地区的
rows.en: The survey covered several Laurentian communities along the river.
rows.zh: 这项调查涵盖了圣劳伦斯河沿岸的几个社区。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 耶胡迪，男性名字的希伯来语转写形式（Yehudi）
rows.en: Yehudi waited until the room was quiet before beginning his story.
rows.zh: 耶胡迪等房间安静下来，才开始讲故事。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 奥斯卡，男性名字（Oskar）
rows.en: Oskar held the paper against the window to trace the outline.
rows.zh: 奥斯卡把纸贴在窗上，描出轮廓。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 三井物产，日本贸易及投资公司 Mitsui & Co. 的简称
rows.en: The student used Mitsui’s annual report to practise reading company accounts.
rows.zh: 这名学生用三井物产的年报练习阅读公司财务报表。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 丹吉尼斯，英格兰肯特郡南海岸的低平砾石岬
rows.en: The photographers waited at Dungeness for the fog to lift.
rows.zh: 摄影师们在丹吉尼斯等待雾散去。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿希尔，姓氏（Achille）
rows.en: Achille offered to carry the heavy box up the stairs.
rows.zh: 阿希尔主动提出把沉重的箱子搬上楼。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 萨赫勒，撒哈拉沙漠以南的非洲地区
rows.en: The documentary follows herders moving across the Sahel.
rows.zh: 这部纪录片跟随牧民穿越萨赫勒地区。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 科夫，姓氏（Corfe）
rows.en: Corfe labelled the cables before disconnecting the equipment.
rows.zh: 科夫断开设备连接之前，先给电缆贴好了标签。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 希克曼，姓氏（Hickman）
rows.en: Hickman kept the small wooden box because it had belonged to his grandfather.
rows.zh: 希克曼留着那个小木盒，因为它曾属于他的祖父。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 珀纳斯，威尔士卡迪夫以南的一座海滨城镇
rows.en: The choir hired a small hall in Penarth for its rehearsal.
rows.zh: 合唱团在珀纳斯租了一间小礼堂排练。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 消息；情报（俚语）
rows.en: Have you heard any griff about the band’s next concert?
rows.zh: 你听到过关于这支乐队下一场音乐会的什么消息吗？
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 朗塞斯顿，澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州的一座城市
rows.en: The suitcase arrived in Launceston a day after its owner.
rows.zh: 那只手提箱比主人晚一天抵达朗塞斯顿。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 比迪福德，英格兰北德文的一座港镇
rows.en: Fishing boats lay alongside the quay at Bideford.
rows.zh: 渔船停靠在比迪福德的码头边。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 西里西亚或其居民的
rows.en: The museum displayed Silesian pottery beside photographs of the workshops.
rows.zh: 博物馆在西里西亚陶器旁展出了陶器作坊的照片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 莫尔兹比，姓氏（Moresby）
rows.en: Moresby repaired the torn map with a narrow strip of tape.
rows.zh: 莫尔兹比用一条窄胶带修补了撕破的地图。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡尔斯鲁厄，德国西南部的一座城市
rows.en: The engineering students met in Karlsruhe before travelling to the conference.
rows.zh: 工科学生们先在卡尔斯鲁厄会合，然后前往会议地点。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 勒费弗尔，姓氏（Lefebvre）
rows.en: Lefebvre’s last-minute correction prevented an error on the invitation.
rows.zh: 勒费弗尔最后一刻的更正避免了邀请函上的一个错误。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 哈弗灵，伦敦的一个自治市（Havering）
rows.en: The exhibition brought together photographs taken across Havering.
rows.zh: 这场展览汇集了在哈弗灵各处拍摄的照片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 菲什加德，威尔士彭布罗克郡的一座海滨城镇
rows.en: The guidebook devoted a page to the old streets of Fishguard.
rows.zh: 那本旅行指南用一页介绍了菲什加德的老街。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 筛；用筛子筛过（面粉等；boult 为 bolt 的异体）
rows.en: The apprentice learned to boult the flour through a fine sieve.
rows.zh: 学徒学会了用细筛筛面粉。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 贝尼托，姓氏（Benito）
rows.en: Mr. Benito helped the children lift the model onto the table.
rows.zh: 贝尼托先生帮孩子们把模型抬到桌上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 古德里奇，姓氏（Goodrich）
rows.en: Goodrich held the ladder steady while her colleague checked the gutter.
rows.zh: 同事检查排水槽时，古德里奇稳稳扶住梯子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 皮特·蒙德里安（Piet Mondrian，荷兰画家）
rows.en: The students compared Mondrian’s use of colour with that of another abstract painter.
rows.zh: 学生们把蒙德里安的色彩运用与另一位抽象画家作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 一批酿成的啤酒；一次酿造所产的啤酒
rows.en: The brewer kept a sample from each gyle for comparison.
rows.zh: 酿酒师保留了每批啤酒的样品，以便比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 埃尔莫尔，姓氏（Elmore）
rows.en: Elmore had left enough space in the car for the folding table.
rows.zh: 埃尔莫尔在车里留出了足够空间来放折叠桌。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 科斯比，姓氏（Cosby）
rows.en: The committee accepted Cosby’s suggestion to open the hall earlier.
rows.zh: 委员会采纳了科斯比关于提早开放礼堂的建议。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 比尤德利，英格兰伍斯特郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The weekend market brought visitors into Bewdley despite the cold weather.
rows.zh: 尽管天气寒冷，周末集市仍把游客吸引到了比尤德利。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 唐顿，姓氏（Downton）
rows.en: Downton opened the shutters to let the room air before the guests arrived.
rows.zh: 客人到来前，唐顿打开百叶窗，让房间通通风。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 沃顿，姓氏（Wotton）
rows.en: Wotton reached the platform just as the departure was announced.
rows.zh: 沃顿刚到站台，就听到了发车广播。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 伊格尔顿，姓氏（Eagleton）
rows.en: The photographer asked Eagleton to stand a little farther from the wall.
rows.zh: 摄影师请伊格尔顿站得离墙稍远一些。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 朗森，姓氏（Ronson）
rows.en: Ronson slipped the concert tickets between the pages of his notebook.
rows.zh: 朗森把音乐会门票夹进了笔记本的书页间。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布里奇曼，姓氏（Bridgeman）
rows.en: Bridgeman’s photographs showed how much the garden had changed.
rows.zh: 布里奇曼的照片显示，花园已经发生了很大变化。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 康尼马拉，爱尔兰共和国西部戈尔韦郡的一个沿海地区
rows.en: Mist covered the hills of Connemara when we woke.
rows.zh: 我们醒来时，雾笼罩着康尼马拉的群山。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 切森特，英格兰赫特福德郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The sports club in Cheshunt needed a larger room for its annual meeting.
rows.zh: 切森特的体育俱乐部需要一间更大的房间来开年会。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 廷茅斯，英格兰西南部的一座海滨城镇
rows.en: The wind carried sand along the promenade at Teignmouth.
rows.zh: 风裹着沙子，沿廷茅斯的海滨步道吹过。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布里格豪斯，英格兰西约克郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The school band from Brighouse arrived with a van full of instruments.
rows.zh: 来自布里格豪斯的学校乐队带着满满一车乐器抵达了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 杰里米·帕克斯曼（Jeremy Paxman，英国记者、节目主持人、作家）
rows.en: The class watched an interview by Paxman and discussed the follow-up questions.
rows.zh: 全班观看了帕克斯曼主持的一次访谈，并讨论了其中的追问。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 托马斯·博德利（Thomas Bodley，博德利图书馆的重建者、赞助人）
rows.en: The display explained how Bodley helped rebuild the library’s collection.
rows.zh: 展览介绍了博德利如何帮助重建图书馆的馆藏。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 萨顿斯，英国种子及园艺产品供应商、品牌（Suttons）
rows.en: She ordered the vegetable seeds from Suttons and saved the empty packets in a notebook.
rows.zh: 她从萨顿斯订购了蔬菜种子，把用空的包装袋留在笔记本里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 皮克顿，姓氏（Picton）
rows.en: Picton found the broken tile while clearing leaves from the path.
rows.zh: 皮克顿清理小路上的落叶时，发现了一块破裂的砖。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 《机械战警》（Robocop，1987 年的科幻动作电影）
rows.en: We watched Robocop and then discussed its portrayal of corporate power.
rows.zh: 我们看了《机械战警》，然后讨论了影片对企业权力的描绘。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 吉尔贝托，姓氏（Gilberto）
rows.en: Gilberto recognised the village in the faded photograph.
rows.zh: 吉尔贝托认出了那张褪色照片中的村庄。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿克尔，姓氏（Arkle）
rows.en: Mrs. Arkle sent the choir a recording of the rehearsal.
rows.zh: 阿克尔夫人给合唱团发去了一段排练录音。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯特雷克，姓氏（Straker）
rows.en: Straker held the ladder while his colleague replaced the bulb.
rows.zh: 同事更换灯泡时，斯特雷克扶着梯子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 沙普，英格兰坎布里亚的一座村庄（Shap）
rows.en: The team left its spare equipment in Shap before setting out on foot.
rows.zh: 队伍徒步出发前，把备用设备留在了沙普。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 波茨坦居民；来自德国波茨坦的人（Potsdamer）
rows.en: A Potsdamer lent the visiting musician a spare bicycle.
rows.zh: 一位波茨坦居民借给来访的乐手一辆备用自行车。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 毛雷尔，姓氏（Maurer）
rows.en: Maurer set a timer so the group would not miss the last bus.
rows.zh: 毛雷尔设了一个计时提醒，免得大家错过末班公交车。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 拉米雷斯，姓氏（Ramirez）
rows.en: Ramirez moved the fragile vase away from the edge of the table.
rows.zh: 拉米雷斯把易碎的花瓶从桌沿移开了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 约翰·马尔科维奇（John Malkovich，演员、导演）
rows.en: The programme included a short interview about Malkovich’s work in the theatre.
rows.zh: 节目中有一段关于马尔科维奇戏剧工作的简短访谈。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 沙迦，阿拉伯联合酋长国的一个酋长国
rows.en: The report compared educational projects in Sharjah with those in neighbouring emirates.
rows.zh: 报告把沙迦的教育项目与相邻酋长国的项目作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 罗慕伦人，《星际迷航》中虚构族群的一员
rows.en: In the episode, a Romulan arrives with a message for the captain.
rows.zh: 这一集中，一名罗慕伦人带着给舰长的消息到来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 曼德尔，姓氏（Mandel）
rows.en: Mandel found room for one more chair at the table.
rows.zh: 曼德尔在桌边又腾出了放一把椅子的空间。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布里克瑟姆，英格兰德文郡的一座渔港城镇
rows.en: At dawn, the boats began returning to Brixham.
rows.zh: 黎明时，船只开始返回布里克瑟姆。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 圆盘形建筑装饰（besant 为 bezant 的异体）
rows.en: A row of besants decorated the stone arch above the door.
rows.zh: 门上方的石拱饰有一排圆盘形装饰。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 所罗门群岛，太平洋上的一个岛群
rows.en: The atlas places the Solomons east of New Guinea.
rows.zh: 地图册把所罗门群岛标在新几内亚以东。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 班普顿，姓氏（Bampton）
rows.en: Bampton asked the driver to stop beside the village noticeboard.
rows.zh: 班普顿请司机在村里的公告栏旁停车。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 威尔希尔，美国金融服务公司的名称（Wilshire）
rows.en: The report cited research published by Wilshire.
rows.zh: 这份报告引用了威尔希尔发布的研究。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 德里斯科尔，姓氏（Driscoll）
rows.en: Driscoll volunteered to keep score during the children’s game.
rows.zh: 德里斯科尔自愿为孩子们的比赛记分。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 大卫·柯南伯格（David Cronenberg，加拿大电影导演）
rows.en: The retrospective paired Cronenberg’s early films with interviews recorded much later.
rows.zh: 这场回顾展把柯南伯格的早期电影与多年后录制的访谈搭配展出。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 凯瑟琳，女性名字，Catherine 的异体（Catharine）
rows.en: Catharine put a bookmark beside the passage she wanted to discuss.
rows.zh: 凯瑟琳在想讨论的段落旁夹了一张书签。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 珑骧，法国皮具及手袋品牌（Longchamp）
rows.en: She took the bag back to Longchamp to ask about repairing the handle.
rows.zh: 她把包拿回珑骧，询问能否修理提手。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 哈弗福韦斯特，威尔士彭布罗克郡的一座城镇
rows.en: The walkers reached Haverfordwest just as the shops were closing.
rows.zh: 徒步者们到达哈弗福韦斯特时，商店正要关门。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 从天然岩体或沉积层切取的大块建筑石材（可为凝灰岩、熔岩、石灰岩等）
rows.en: The mason selected pale sillar for the wall around the courtyard.
rows.zh: 石匠为庭院围墙选用了浅色的大块建筑石材。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斋浦尔，印度拉贾斯坦邦的一座城市
rows.en: Her sketchbook was filled with scenes from Jaipur.
rows.zh: 她的速写本里画满了斋浦尔的景象。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 格拉姆斯，苏格兰安格斯的一座村庄（Glamis）
rows.en: The coach stopped in Glamis while the driver checked the route.
rows.zh: 司机查看路线时，长途客车在格拉姆斯停了下来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡里尔，可用于男性或女性的名字（Caryl）
rows.en: Caryl stayed behind to help pack away the exhibition.
rows.zh: 卡里尔留下来帮忙收拾展览用品。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 贝格，姓氏（Begg）
rows.en: Begg recognised the handwriting on the envelope immediately.
rows.zh: 贝格立刻认出了信封上的笔迹。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 克莱门斯，女性名字（Clemence）
rows.en: Clemence left the window open to hear the birds in the garden.
rows.zh: 克莱门斯开着窗，好听到花园里的鸟鸣。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 海景村，英格兰怀特岛的一座海滨村庄（Seaview）
rows.en: We walked back to Seaview with our shoes full of sand.
rows.zh: 我们鞋里灌满了沙子，走回了海景村。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 乔治-欧仁·奥斯曼（Georges-Eugène Haussmann，法国城市规划者）
rows.en: The essay considers the streets that disappeared during Haussmann’s rebuilding of Paris.
rows.zh: 这篇文章考察了奥斯曼改建巴黎期间消失的街道。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 荷兰的荷兰语名称（Nederland）
rows.en: Nederland appeared in the Dutch-language address on the envelope.
rows.zh: 信封上的荷兰语地址中出现了国名 Nederland。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯特罗姆内斯，苏格兰奥克尼群岛梅恩兰岛上的一座沿海城镇
rows.en: The harbour at Stromness was quiet after the last boat had left.
rows.zh: 最后一艘船离开后，斯特罗姆内斯的港口安静了下来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 弗里曼斯，英国零售品牌（Freemans）
rows.en: Her mother kept a well-thumbed catalogue from Freemans in the kitchen drawer.
rows.zh: 她母亲在厨房抽屉里留着一本翻旧了的弗里曼斯商品目录。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 以法莲，《旧约》中约瑟的一个儿子，也是以色列一个支派的祖先
rows.en: The illustration shows Ephraim receiving a blessing from Jacob.
rows.zh: 这幅插图描绘了以法莲接受雅各祝福的情景。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡塔尼亚，意大利西西里岛东部的一座港口城市
rows.en: The cargo arrived in Catania before the paperwork was ready.
rows.zh: 货物在文件准备好之前就抵达了卡塔尼亚。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 伯拉，英国画家爱德华·约翰·伯拉（Edward Burra，1905—1976）
rows.en: The exhibition catalogue reproduced several paintings by Burra.
rows.zh: 展览图录复制了伯拉的几幅画作。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 比尔斯顿，英格兰伍尔弗汉普顿的一座城镇
rows.en: The theatre group rehearsed in Bilston before taking the play on tour.
rows.zh: 剧团巡演之前，在比尔斯顿排练了这出戏。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 三星式，洛克希德 L-1011 客机的型号名称（TriStar）
rows.en: The aviation enthusiast found a photograph of a TriStar in an old album.
rows.zh: 这位航空爱好者在旧相册里找到了一张三星式客机的照片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯泰滕，姓氏（Staten）
rows.en: Staten brought a folding chair so she could sit beside the river.
rows.zh: 斯泰滕带了一把折叠椅，好坐在河边。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 莫伊尔，北爱尔兰安特里姆郡东北部的旧行政区名（Moyle）
rows.en: The researcher compared housing surveys from Moyle and neighbouring districts in the early 2000s.
rows.zh: 研究者比较了二十一世纪初莫伊尔及其邻近行政区的住房调查。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 马里亚诺，姓氏（Mariano）
rows.en: Ms. Mariano sorted the returned books before the library opened.
rows.zh: 图书馆开门前，马里亚诺女士把归还的书分好了类。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 廷托山，苏格兰南拉纳克郡的一座山（Tinto）
rows.en: Clouds hid Tinto while the walkers waited beside the path.
rows.zh: 徒步者们在小路旁等候时，云层遮住了廷托山。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 美拉尼西亚，大洋洲西南部的一个岛屿地区
rows.en: The collection includes woven baskets from several parts of Melanesia.
rows.zh: 这批藏品包括来自美拉尼西亚不同地区的编织篮。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 一般性的事物或概念（旧哲学用语，generale；复数 generalia）
rows.en: The treatise moves from a single example to a generale that applies to many cases.
rows.zh: 这部论著从单个例子转向适用于许多情况的一般概念。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 克莱夫登，英国白金汉郡的乡间宅邸及庄园（Cliveden）
rows.en: The guide showed us a photograph of Cliveden before the gardens were restored.
rows.zh: 导游给我们看了一张花园修复之前的克莱夫登照片。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 玛丽亚姆，女性名字（Mariam）
rows.en: Mariam checked the length of the fabric before cutting it.
rows.zh: 玛丽亚姆裁布之前，先检查了布料的长度。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 兰多弗里，威尔士卡马森郡的一座集镇（Llandovery）
rows.en: The walkers reached Llandovery with enough daylight to find a place to stay.
rows.zh: 徒步者们到达兰多弗里时，天还亮着，来得及找地方住宿。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 澳大利亚海域的一种有棘鱼，学名 Centropogon australis（fortescue）
rows.en: A fortescue rested among the plants on the floor of the bay.
rows.zh: 一条 fortescue 鱼停在海湾底部的水草间。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 戴维娜，女性名字（Davina）
rows.en: Davina volunteered to read the instructions aloud to the group.
rows.zh: 戴维娜主动提出为大家朗读说明。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 班恩河，北爱尔兰的一条河流（Bann）
rows.en: Mist hung over the Bann as the rowing crew prepared its boat.
rows.zh: 赛艇队准备船只时，雾气笼罩着班恩河。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 博马里斯，威尔士安格尔西岛的一座海滨城镇
rows.en: We found a quiet room overlooking the water in Beaumaris.
rows.zh: 我们在博马里斯找到了一间面朝水面的安静客房。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 鲁道尔福，姓氏（Rodolfo）
rows.en: Mr. Rodolfo offered the visitor a chair while she waited.
rows.zh: 来访者等候时，鲁道尔福先生给她搬来了一把椅子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 灰色熔岩的一种旧分类名称（greystone；此处采用 Scrope 对介于粗面岩与玄武岩之间一类熔岩的历史用法）
rows.en: The nineteenth-century geologist labelled the lava specimen greystone.
rows.zh: 那位十九世纪地质学家把那块熔岩标本标为 greystone。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 克雷西达，特洛伊故事中与特洛伊罗斯相恋的女性人物
rows.en: The actress read Cressida’s speech several times before the rehearsal.
rows.zh: 这位女演员在排练前把克雷西达的台词读了好几遍。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 迦克墩宗教会议的；与公元451年该会议有关的
rows.en: The lecture placed Chalcedonian debates in their wider political setting.
rows.zh: 讲座把迦克墩宗教会议的争论放在更广泛的政治背景中分析。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 福柯哲学的；与米歇尔·福柯思想有关或具有其特点的（Foucauldian 的较少见异体）
rows.en: The seminar offered a Foucaultian reading of the school’s disciplinary rules.
rows.zh: 研讨课从福柯思想的角度解读了学校的纪律规定。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 塔特萨尔斯，英国纯血马拍卖公司的名称（Tattersalls）
rows.en: The breeder requested a catalogue from Tattersalls before planning the trip.
rows.zh: 育马者安排行程前，向塔特萨尔斯索取了一份拍卖目录。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 唐恩，姓氏（Donn）
rows.en: Donn kept the old address book even after most of the numbers had changed.
rows.zh: 虽然大多数号码都变了，唐恩仍留着那本旧通讯录。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 尼亚萨兰，马拉维在 1964 年以前使用的旧称
rows.en: The archive holds letters sent from Nyasaland in the 1930s.
rows.zh: 档案馆保存着二十世纪三十年代从尼亚萨兰寄出的信件。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 卡斯帕，男性名字，Caspar 的一种形式（Kasper）
rows.en: Kasper brought a spare torch for the walk home.
rows.zh: 卡斯帕为走路回家带了一支备用手电筒。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 编造虚构情境，借此逃避不想参加的约会或活动
rows.en: He began to bunbury whenever another formal dinner appeared in his diary.
rows.zh: 每当日程本上又出现一场正式晚宴，他就开始编造借口躲避。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 大力水手，漫画中的水手角色（Popeye）
rows.en: The child chose a lunchbox with Popeye on the lid.
rows.zh: 孩子选了一个盖子上印着大力水手的饭盒。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 奥斯古德，姓氏（Osgood）
rows.en: Osgood inspected the frame carefully before hanging the picture.
rows.zh: 奥斯古德挂画之前，仔细检查了画框。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 诺尔顿，姓氏（Knowlton）
rows.en: Knowlton’s patient explanation helped the new volunteers find their way around.
rows.zh: 诺尔顿耐心的解释帮助新志愿者熟悉了环境。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 钳子；夹钳（常用复数 pinchers，同 pincers）
rows.en: She lifted the hot wire with a pair of pinchers.
rows.zh: 她用一把钳子夹起了那根热金属丝。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 盖勒，姓氏（Geller）
rows.en: Geller spread the drawings across the floor so everyone could see them.
rows.zh: 盖勒把图纸铺在地板上，好让大家都能看见。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 考尔斯，姓氏（Cowles）
rows.en: Cowles checked the lock twice before leaving the workshop.
rows.zh: 考尔斯离开工坊前，检查了两次门锁。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 斯佩特，姓氏（Speight）
rows.en: Speight noticed that the parcel had been delivered to the wrong floor.
rows.zh: 斯佩特发现包裹被送错了楼层。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Penta，瑞典的一种早期船用发动机名称，后来成为发动机品牌名
rows.en: The museum displayed an early Penta engine beside its original instruction booklet.
rows.zh: 博物馆把一台早期 Penta 发动机和原使用手册陈列在一起。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 哈姆丹，姓氏（Hamdan）
rows.en: Hamdan waited until the road was clear before opening the gate.
rows.zh: 哈姆丹等道路畅通后才打开大门。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 布莱克沃尔，伦敦塔哈姆莱茨的一片地区（Blackwall）
rows.en: The photographer returned to Blackwall to finish the series.
rows.zh: 摄影师返回布莱克沃尔，完成那组照片的拍摄。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 后桅后方靠近船艉的一根小桅杆，装有三角帆或斜桁帆（旧航海用语）
rows.en: The model maker added a bonaventure behind the ship’s mizzenmast.
rows.zh: 模型制作者在船的后桅后方加上了一根艉部小桅杆。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 巴登，姓氏（Barden）
rows.en: Barden saved the longest question for the end of the interview.
rows.zh: 巴登把最长的问题留到采访最后再问。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 雄猴（印度英语用语）
rows.en: A bandar sat on the wall while the other monkeys searched the courtyard.
rows.zh: 一只雄猴坐在墙头，其他猴子在院子里搜寻。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 泽娜，女性名字（Zena）
rows.en: Zena spread a towel on the bench before setting down the wet bag.
rows.zh: 泽娜先在长椅上铺了条毛巾，再放下湿袋子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 荷兰或其居民的（同 Netherlandish）
rows.en: The archive holds several examples of Netherland printing from the seventeenth century.
rows.zh: 档案馆藏有几件十七世纪荷兰印刷品。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 安德烈亚·曼特尼亚（Andrea Mantegna，意大利画家、版画家）
rows.en: The curator pointed out how Mantegna arranged the figures in the fresco.
rows.zh: 策展人指出了曼特尼亚在壁画中如何安排人物。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 德基穆斯，古罗马男性个人名（Decimus）
rows.en: In the story, Decimus hides a message beneath a wax tablet.
rows.zh: 故事中，德基穆斯把一封信藏在蜡板下面。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 波斯考尔，威尔士南海岸的一座城镇
rows.en: The family returned to Porthcawl to collect the bag they had left behind.
rows.zh: 这家人返回波斯考尔，去取他们落下的包。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 科尔宾，姓氏（Corbin）
rows.en: Corbin drew a small map to show us where the footpath began.
rows.zh: 科尔宾画了一张小地图，告诉我们步道从哪里开始。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 查珀尔敦，英格兰谢菲尔德北部的一片城区（Chapeltown）
rows.en: The missing parcel turned up at a shop in Chapeltown.
rows.zh: 丢失的包裹在查珀尔敦的一家商店找到了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 俾路支斯坦，巴基斯坦西南部和伊朗东南部的一个地区
rows.en: The travel account describes a long journey across Baluchistan.
rows.zh: 这篇游记描述了一段横越俾路支斯坦的漫长旅程。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 参加化装民俗戏表演；穿戴面具或服装演出（mumm 是 mum 的异体拼写）
rows.en: The villagers gathered to mumm in the Christmas play.
rows.zh: 村民们聚在一起，参加圣诞节化装民俗戏的表演。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 蒙特祖马二世，十六世纪初的阿兹特克统治者（Montezuma）
rows.en: The students compared two portraits of Montezuma before discussing the conquest.
rows.zh: 学生们在讨论征服战争之前，比较了两幅蒙特祖马的肖像。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 弗朗赛；本例指提琴制作、鉴定与交易专家 Jacques Français，馆藏记录亦写作 Francais
rows.en: The researcher consulted Francais’s archive while studying the history of violin dealing.
rows.zh: 研究者在研究提琴交易史时，查阅了弗朗赛的档案。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 代托纳，道奇汽车曾使用的车型名称（Daytona）
rows.en: The mechanic found a parts catalogue for the old Daytona.
rows.zh: 修理工找到了那辆旧代托纳汽车的零件目录。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 巴西的葡萄牙语名称、拼法（Brasil）
rows.en: The Portuguese caption identified the country as Brasil.
rows.zh: 葡萄牙语图注把这个国家写作 Brasil。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 安提瓜字体，一类源于早期欧洲印刷传统的衬线字体
rows.en: The designer chose an Antiqua for the title page of the historical novel.
rows.zh: 设计师为那部历史小说的扉页选用了一种安提瓜衬线字体。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 朝鲜，Korea 的历史英语拼法（Corea；此处指半岛历史国家，不特指现代韩国）
rows.en: The historian traced a nineteenth-century traveller’s route through Corea.
rows.zh: 历史学家追踪了一位十九世纪旅行者穿越朝鲜的路线。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 塔尔，英国农业改良者杰思罗·塔尔（Jethro Tull，1674—1741）
rows.en: The history project compared farming before and after Tull’s seed drill.
rows.zh: 这个历史课题比较了塔尔的条播机出现前后的农业。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 伊里安，新几内亚的印度尼西亚语名称（Irian）
rows.en: The student used an Indonesian atlas to locate Irian.
rows.zh: 学生用一本印度尼西亚语地图集查找伊里安的位置。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 康德，姓氏（Conder）
rows.en: Conder tied a bright ribbon to the suitcase handle so it would be easy to spot.
rows.zh: 康德在行李箱提手上系了一条鲜艳的丝带，方便辨认。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 埃尔南德斯，姓氏（Hernandez）
rows.en: Hernandez asked for a second tray when more guests arrived.
rows.zh: 更多客人到来后，埃尔南德斯又要了一个托盘。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿曼，以色列军事情报机构（A’man）
rows.en: The historian compared two reports prepared by A’man during the same period.
rows.zh: 历史学家比较了阿曼情报机构在同一时期编写的两份报告。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Aateck，一种旧农用杀菌剂的商品名
rows.en: The old gardener remembered buying Aateck from the village supplier.
rows.zh: 那位老园丁还记得曾向村里的供应商购买 Aateck 杀菌剂。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿特拉姆，含阿特拉津的除草剂商品名（Aatram）
rows.en: The researcher found Aatram listed among the herbicides in an old farm inventory.
rows.zh: 研究者在一份旧农场清单的除草剂栏目中找到了阿特拉姆。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿伯茨福德，苏格兰作家沃尔特·司各特的故居及庄园
rows.en: The conservator examined the books at Abbotsford for signs of damp.
rows.zh: 修复人员检查了阿伯茨福德的藏书，看有没有受潮迹象。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 迷信或附会之说（罕见德语借词，aberglaube）
rows.en: Her study traced the aberglaube attached to the old bridge.
rows.zh: 她的研究追溯了附会于那座旧桥的迷信传说。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 以亚伯拉罕相关的宗教观念为背景或依据地（学术用语）
rows.en: The essay interprets the covenant Abrahamically, linking it to the story of Abraham.
rows.zh: 这篇文章从亚伯拉罕相关的宗教观念出发解释该圣约，将它与亚伯拉罕的故事联系起来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿布鲁佐地区的（本例用于当地罗姆语）
rows.en: The linguist compared Abruzzian Romani with recordings from Calabria.
rows.zh: 语言学家把阿布鲁佐地区的罗姆语与来自卡拉布里亚的录音作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿基，英国为西非黄金海岸铸造的一种旧银币（ackey）
rows.en: The dealer placed the ackey in a padded box beside the other silver coins.
rows.zh: 商人把那枚阿基放进衬有软垫的盒子，摆在其他银币旁边。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 亚速尔群岛葡萄牙语名称的无重音符号写法（Acores）
rows.en: The shipping ledger recorded the next destination as Acores.
rows.zh: 航运账簿把下一站目的地记为 Acores。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Acroclinium 属，菊科植物的一个旧属名，现作为 Rhodanthe 的异名
rows.en: The botanist found an Acroclinium specimen among the herbarium’s older collections.
rows.zh: 植物学家在植物标本馆的较早馆藏中找到了一份 Acroclinium 属标本。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Acrylaglas，玻璃纤维增强苯乙烯—丙烯腈材料的旧商品名
rows.en: The engineer requested a sample of Acrylaglas for the trial batch.
rows.zh: 工程师为试制批次索取了一份 Acrylaglas 材料样品。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 安得利，含甲基嘧啶磷的杀虫剂商品名（Actellic）
rows.en: The storekeeper checked the label on the unopened container of Actellic.
rows.zh: 仓库管理员查看了那只尚未开封的安得利杀虫剂容器上的标签。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 海葵目；Actiniaria 的分类学异名 Actinaria
rows.en: The collection includes several preserved members of Actinaria.
rows.zh: 这批藏品包括几件保存下来的海葵目标本。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 眉刷蕨属（Actiniopteris），一个蕨类植物属
rows.en: A new Actiniopteris specimen was placed beside the older fern collections.
rows.zh: 一份新的眉刷蕨属标本被放在较早收藏的蕨类标本旁。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 具有建筑师罗伯特·亚当设计风格的（Adamish）
rows.en: Her design for the drawing room was deliberately Adamish.
rows.zh: 她为客厅所做的设计刻意采用了罗伯特·亚当的风格。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 《Adelaidean》，阿德莱德大学出版的刊物
rows.en: She found the interview in an old issue of Adelaidean.
rows.zh: 她在一期旧的《Adelaidean》中找到了那篇访谈。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 美国纽约州阿迪朗达克地区的居民或当地人（Adirondacker）
rows.en: An Adirondacker showed the visitors how to recognise the old logging trails.
rows.zh: 一位阿迪朗达克当地人教游客们辨认旧伐木小道。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿扎尔人，格鲁吉亚人中的一个地方族群成员（Adjar）
rows.en: The memoir was written by an Adjar who had grown up near Batumi.
rows.zh: 这部回忆录出自一位在巴统附近长大的阿扎尔人之手。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Admiro，番茄的一种栽培品种名
rows.en: The seedling tray contained Admiro tomatoes and two other varieties.
rows.zh: 育苗盘里有 Admiro 番茄以及另外两个品种的番茄苗。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 亚得里亚海的（Adriatic 的废弃异体，旧时用于 Adriatical sea）
rows.en: Their small fleet found shelter after days on the Adriatical sea.
rows.zh: 他们的小船队在亚得里亚海上航行数日后，找到了避风处。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 处理负责任的成年人日常事务的行为或实践（非正式用语）
rows.en: For him, adulting meant learning to schedule appointments without reminders.
rows.zh: 对他来说，承担成年人的日常责任意味着学会无需提醒就安排好预约。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 旧大陆鹫科；某些旧分类中单列的旧大陆鹫类群 Aegypiidae
rows.en: The older catalogue placed the vulture specimen in Aegypiidae.
rows.zh: 那份较早的目录把这件兀鹫标本归入了旧大陆鹫科。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 象鸟目（Aepyorniformes），已灭绝的大型不能飞的鸟类组成的类群
rows.en: The fossil display included a leg bone from a bird assigned to Aepyorniformes.
rows.zh: 化石展览中有一块归入象鸟目的鸟类腿骨。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: AeroLog，Polaris Microsystems 的飞行日志软件名称
rows.en: The pilot entered yesterday’s flight in AeroLog before closing the laptop.
rows.zh: 飞行员合上笔记本电脑之前，把昨天的飞行记录输入了 AeroLog。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿埃隆合金，一种含铜的铝合金（旧合金名 Aeron）
rows.en: The laboratory kept a small sample of Aeron from the original casting.
rows.zh: 实验室保留了从原铸件中取得的一小块阿埃隆铜铝合金样品。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 伊索寓言的；具有伊索寓言特点的（Aesopical）
rows.en: The tale ends with an Aesopical lesson about the cost of boasting.
rows.zh: 故事最后以一则伊索寓言式的教训说明夸口的代价。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 以伊索寓言式的方式；借寓言表达（少见用法）
rows.en: He described the boardroom dispute Aesopically, as a contest between a fox and a crow.
rows.zh: 他借伊索寓言式的表达，把董事会的争执描绘成狐狸与乌鸦之间的较量。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 埃塞尔伯特（Aethelbert，亦作Ethelbert/Æthelbert；本例指肯特国王）
rows.en: The timeline places Aethelbert beside Augustine of Canterbury.
rows.zh: 这条时间线把肯特国王埃塞尔伯特与坎特伯雷的奥古斯丁列在一起。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: Aetna；提供健康保险等产品和服务的美国品牌及相关公司名称
rows.en: She called Aetna to ask for another copy of her insurance card.
rows.zh: 她致电Aetna，要求补发一张保险卡。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Aetosauria；晚三叠世一类四足、体表具骨质甲片的主龙类爬行动物
rows.en: The display compared the armour of Aetosauria with that of other Triassic reptiles.
rows.zh: 展板比较了Aetosauria类群与其他三叠纪爬行动物的甲片。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: （古苏格兰语）神态；举止（affer）
rows.en: His sombre affer discouraged anyone from approaching him.
rows.zh: 他那阴郁的神态让人不敢靠近。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 非洲语言成分；源自非洲语言的词语、结构或用法（本例义）
rows.en: The linguist identified an Africanism in the island's everyday speech.
rows.zh: 这位语言学家在岛上居民的日常语言中识别出一种源自非洲语言的用法。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 非洲研究专家；研究非洲语言、文化或事务的学者（本例义）
rows.en: An Africanist joined the panel to discuss the region's political history.
rows.zh: 一位非洲研究专家加入讨论小组，探讨该地区的政治史。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 非裔美国人的（历史用语）
rows.en: She compared two nineteenth-century accounts of Africo-American education.
rows.zh: 她比较了两份十九世纪关于非裔美国人教育的记述。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿非利卡人社会；南非阿非利卡人这一群体的总称，不等于所有南非白人
rows.en: The historian examined debates within Afrikanerdom about language and education.
rows.zh: 这位历史学者研究了阿非利卡人社会内部关于语言和教育的争论。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 接受英国殖民文化价值或举止的黑人；某些后殖民论述中的标签 Afro-Saxon
rows.en: His opponents called him an Afro-Saxon, accusing him of copying the old colonial elite.
rows.zh: 反对者给他贴上“Afro-Saxon”的标签，指责他模仿昔日的殖民精英。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 非洲未来主义的；从黑人文化经验出发想象未来、融合艺术与科技等元素的
rows.en: The gallery opened an Afrofuturist exhibition blending technology, history and imagined futures.
rows.zh: 画廊举办了一场非洲未来主义展览，将科技、历史与想象中的未来融合在一起。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: Afugan；以pyrazophos为活性成分的杀菌剂商品名（本例为历史产品名）
rows.en: The report compared residues from Afugan-treated plants with those from untreated controls.
rows.zh: 该报告比较了用Afugan处理的植物与未处理对照植物中的残留。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 甲氧乙基氯化汞的别名或商品名 Agallol
rows.en: The inventory listed Agallol among the old mercury-containing chemicals.
rows.zh: 清单将Agallol列在那些旧的含汞化学品之中。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: ADAMA的一种除草剂商品名 Agil
rows.en: An unopened bottle of Agil stood on the storeroom shelf.
rows.zh: 库房的架子上放着一瓶尚未开封的Agil除草剂。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 一种以苏云金芽孢杆菌为基础的微生物杀虫剂的商品名 Agritol
rows.en: The old purchase ledger listed Agritol beside several other microbial insecticides.
rows.zh: 旧采购账簿将Agritol与其他几种微生物杀虫剂列在一起。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿拉罗迪人的；阿拉罗迪语的（Alarodian）
rows.en: The catalogue places the Alarodian material in a separate section on ancient peoples.
rows.zh: 目录将有关阿拉罗迪人的材料放在古代族群的单独一节中。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 艾五混剂；一种混合型杀虫剂（本例取PubChem所列Aldrex混剂记录）
rows.en: The laboratory analysed an old Aldrex sample as a mixture rather than as a single pure compound.
rows.zh: 实验室把一份旧Aldrex样品作为混合物而非单一纯化合物进行了分析。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: Algeripithecus属；已灭绝的一属早期灵长类动物
rows.en: The team compared the fossil teeth with published specimens of Algeripithecus.
rows.zh: 研究团队将这些牙齿化石与已发表的Algeripithecus属标本作了比较。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 自称为阿里与法蒂玛后裔的人（本例为家系身份义，不等于所有什叶派信徒）
rows.en: The historian identified the traveller as an Alid on the basis of his genealogy.
rows.zh: 这位历史学者根据那名旅行者的家谱，将他归入自称阿里与法蒂玛后裔者之列。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 主要产于美洲的一个草本植物属（属名 Allionia）
rows.en: She pressed a flowering specimen of Allionia between two sheets of newspaper.
rows.zh: 她将一份开着花的Allionia属植物标本夹在两张报纸之间。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 紫茉莉科的另一科名（Allioniaceae；又称 Nyctaginaceae）
rows.en: An old label filed this plant under Allioniaceae rather than the name used in the new catalogue.
rows.zh: 一张旧标签将这种植物归在Allioniaceae科名下，所用名称与新目录不同。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Almit；焊料生产企业使用的注册商号
rows.en: The engineer requested an updated solder specification from Almit.
rows.zh: 工程师向Almit索取了一份更新后的焊料规格书。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 用于铝等材料接合的一种旧式焊料，商品名 Alunize
rows.en: The workshop kept a few sticks of Alunize in a labelled metal drawer.
rows.zh: 车间把几根Alunize焊料放在一个贴有标签的金属抽屉里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿迈松；威尔士神话中的农耕神 Amaethon
rows.en: As a child, she was fascinated by the Welsh stories about Amaethon.
rows.zh: 她小时候对那些关于阿迈松的威尔士故事十分着迷。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 植物文献中用于 fly poison 这类植物的属名（Amianthum）
rows.en: An old plant list recorded the specimen as Amianthum.
rows.zh: 一份旧植物名录将这份标本记作Amianthum。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿米克（姓氏 Amick）
rows.en: Ms Amick asked the librarian to reserve the two books for her.
rows.zh: 阿米克女士请图书管理员为她留好那两本书。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 一种聚酰胺（尼龙）纤维的商品名 Amilon
rows.en: The technician set aside a length of Amilon for the next netting trial.
rows.zh: 技术员留出了一段Amilon尼龙纤维，准备在下一次制网试验中使用。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 玉筋鱼科的鱼类属（属名 Ammodytes）
rows.en: Most of the fish in the trawl sample were identified as Ammodytes.
rows.zh: 拖网样本中的大部分鱼被鉴定为Ammodytes属。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 曾用于把肺鱼类与总鳍鱼类合在一起的旧鱼类分类群名 Amphibioidei
rows.en: In his notes on fish classification, he used Amphibioidei for the older grouping.
rows.zh: 在鱼类分类笔记中，他用Amphibioidei指称那个旧分类群。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 瘿蜂的一个属，部分成员形成栎树上的虫瘿（属名 Amphibolips）
rows.en: She opened an oak gall and found an Amphibolips larva inside.
rows.zh: 她剖开一个栎树虫瘿，在里面发现了一只Amphibolips属幼虫。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 多毛类蛰龙介科中曾采用的一个亚科名（Amphitritinae）
rows.en: She used the illustrated key to assign the marine worm to Amphitritinae.
rows.zh: 她利用图示检索表，将那条海生蠕虫归入Amphitritinae亚科。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 阿姆斯特丹人；阿姆斯特丹的居民（Amsterdammer）
rows.en: A friendly Amsterdammer showed us a quieter route along the canal.
rows.zh: 一位友善的阿姆斯特丹居民给我们指了一条沿运河走的较安静路线。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 螽斯科的一个昆虫属（属名 Anabrus）
rows.en: Fieldworkers found several Anabrus specimens along the edge of the pasture.
rows.zh: 野外调查人员在牧场边缘找到了几只Anabrus属昆虫标本。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 菊科草本植物的一个属（属名 Anacyclus，包括 Spanish pellitory）
rows.en: The gardener sowed Anacyclus in a shallow tray beside the greenhouse.
rows.zh: 园丁在温室旁的浅盘里播下了Anacyclus属植物的种子。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: Analmatic自动分析系统；一种旧式实验室分析设备的名称
rows.en: The technician checked the Analmatic before loading the next rack of samples.
rows.zh: 技术员在装入下一架样本前检查了Analmatic自动分析设备。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 安达曼群岛的；安达曼群岛居民或语言的（Andaman）
rows.en: Several Andaman villages were marked on the survey map.
rows.zh: 调查地图上标出了安达曼群岛的几个村庄。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 曾用于林地白花植物 rue anemone 的属名，现并入唐松草属（Anemonella）
rows.en: The nursery catalogue still listed rue anemone under Anemonella.
rows.zh: 那份苗圃目录仍将rue anemone列在Anemonella属名下。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 包括 yerba mansa 的一个植物属（属名 Anemopsis）
rows.en: A clump of Anemopsis had outgrown the small bed beside the path.
rows.zh: 路旁那块小花圃已经容不下那一丛Anemopsis属植物了。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 一种聚酯纤维的商品名 Angelrest
rows.en: She compared a sample of Angelrest with the cotton filling from the old cushion.
rows.zh: 她将一份Angelrest聚酯纤维样品与旧靠垫里的棉填料作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: （古语）英国圣公会的；圣公会的（Anglical）
rows.en: The family kept an Anglical prayer book among its oldest possessions.
rows.zh: 这家人最古老的一批物品中有一本圣公会祈祷书。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 向英国圣公会体制或传统转化；圣公会化（Anglicanization）
rows.en: Her study links the Anglicanization of the colony to the building of new parish churches.
rows.zh: 她的研究将该殖民地的圣公会化与新堂区教堂的兴建联系起来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 圣公会内强调其大公教会传承的教义与礼拜实践；安立甘公教传统
rows.en: Her dissertation examines the influence of Anglo-Catholicism on parish worship.
rows.zh: 她的学位论文研究安立甘公教传统对堂区礼拜的影响。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 英语和弗里斯语的；英弗里斯语支的（AngloFrisian）
rows.en: The seminar compared AngloFrisian sound changes with developments in Old Saxon.
rows.zh: 研讨课将英弗里斯语的音变与古撒克逊语的发展作了比较。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 英语使用者及其文化所构成的世界或共同体；英语世界（Anglophony）
rows.en: The course explores the literature of Anglophony beyond Britain and the United States.
rows.zh: 这门课程探讨英国和美国以外英语世界的文学。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 包含角叫鸭的鸟类属（属名 Anhima）
rows.en: The marsh checklist included Anhima, but none was seen during the morning survey.
rows.zh: 沼泽鸟类名录包括Anhima属，但上午调查时没有见到这种鸟。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 异尖线虫科；包括 Anisakis 等属的一科线虫（科名 Anisakidae）
rows.en: The laboratory report placed the preserved larvae in Anisakidae.
rows.zh: 实验室报告将这些保存的幼虫归入异尖线虫科。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 环节动物门，包括蚯蚓、沙蚕和水蛭等
rows.en: The students placed both the earthworm and the leech in Annelida.
rows.zh: 学生们把蚯蚓和水蛭都归入环节动物门。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 安玛丽（女子名 Annemarie）
rows.en: Annemarie left her keys on the kitchen table before going out.
rows.zh: 安玛丽出门前把钥匙留在了厨房的桌子上。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 由无足蜥蜴组成的一科爬行动物（科名 Anniellidae）
rows.en: The report distinguishes Anniellidae from the snakes found at the same site.
rows.zh: 报告将Anniellidae科的无足蜥蜴与同一地点发现的蛇区分开来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 番荔枝科；主要包括热带乔木或灌木的一科植物（Annonaceae）
rows.en: Several trees in the tropical fruit garden belong to Annonaceae.
rows.zh: 热带果园里的几棵树属于番荔枝科。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 轮叶属；木贼类化石植物的一个属名（Annularia）
rows.en: A clear Annularia fossil was visible on the newly split slab.
rows.zh: 新劈开的石板上可以清楚地看到一块轮叶属植物化石。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 蜱类研究中曾作为独立属使用的属名 Anocentor
rows.en: The identification key treated Anocentor as a separate tick genus.
rows.zh: 那份鉴定检索表将Anocentor作为一个独立的蜱属处理。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 薄壳淡水蚌的一个属；无齿蚌属（Anodonta）
rows.en: An Anodonta shell lay half buried in the mud at the water’s edge.
rows.zh: 水边有一只无齿蚌属的贝壳，半埋在淤泥里。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 开唇兰属；亚洲兰科植物的一个属（Anoectochilus）
rows.en: The grower moved the young Anoectochilus plants away from the afternoon sun.
rows.zh: 种植者把幼小的开唇兰属植物移到了下午晒不到太阳的地方。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 凤尾蕨科的一个蕨类植物属（属名 Anogramma）
rows.en: The first Anogramma fronds appeared between two damp stones.
rows.zh: 最初几片Anogramma属蕨叶从两块潮湿的石头之间长了出来。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 金龟子类甲虫的一个属，其幼虫主要取食植物根部（属名 Anomala）
rows.en: When she lifted the damaged turf, she found Anomala grubs among the roots.
rows.zh: 她掀起受损的草皮时，在根部之间发现了Anomala属的蛴螬。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 有孔虫分类中曾采用的一个总科名（Anomalinacea）
rows.en: The palaeontologist sorted the tiny tests according to the older scheme for Anomalinacea.
rows.zh: 古生物学家按照Anomalinacea的旧分类体系，对那些微小的有孔虫壳体进行了分类。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 包含灯眼鱼的一个鱼类科（科名 Anomalopidae）
rows.en: The display brought together preserved specimens from several genera of Anomalopidae.
rows.zh: 展览汇集了Anomalopidae科中几个属保存下来的标本。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 包括 saddle oysters 的一个双壳贝类科（科名 Anomiidae）
rows.en: The drawer held a small collection of Anomiidae shells from the bay.
rows.zh: 抽屉里放着一小批从海湾采集来的Anomiidae科贝壳。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 蛙类的一个历史分类群，曾用作包含锄足蟾类等的亚目名（Anomocoela）
rows.en: His lecture traced how the treatment of Anomocoela had changed between two classifications of frogs.
rows.zh: 他的讲座梳理了两套蛙类分类体系对Anomocoela这一类群的处理有何变化。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 古腹足类分类中曾采用的一个已灭绝总科名（Anomphalacea）
rows.en: She photographed the Anomphalacea fossils before returning them to storage.
rows.zh: 她先给那些Anomphalacea总科的化石拍了照，然后将它们放回库房。
rows.author: prepare

rows.meaningZh: 无甲目；包括仙女虾、卤虫等无背甲小型水生甲壳动物的类群
rows.en: The pond survey recorded Anostraca only after the winter rains.
rows.zh: 池塘调查直到冬雨过后才记录到无甲目动物。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 安普（Anpu）；旧埃及学英语文献中埃及神阿努比斯的名称
rows.en: The illustrated guide shows Anpu at the entrance to the tomb.
rows.zh: 图解指南把安普画在墓室入口处。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 安庆；中国安徽省的城市，旧译Anking
rows.en: Our train reached Anqing just before the afternoon rain began.
rows.zh: 我们的火车刚抵达安庆，午后的雨便下了起来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Ansar；二甲胂酸（cacodylic acid、dimethylarsinic acid）的名称之一，CAS75-60-5（本例化学记录义）
rows.en: The archived Ansar sample had a separate entry in the laboratory inventory.
rows.zh: 留存的Ansar二甲胂酸样品在实验室清单中单独列有一项。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 安斯巴赫；德国巴伐利亚州城市
rows.en: A postcard from Ansbach arrived with a sketch of the town's streets.
rows.zh: 一张来自安斯巴赫的明信片寄到了，上面画着城镇街道的速写。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 雁鸭亚目；旧分类中与雁鸭科范围相当的类群名称
rows.en: In the old classification chart, Anseres appears above the duck family.
rows.zh: 在那张旧分类表中，Anseres这一亚目名称列在雁鸭科上方。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 雁鸭科的一亚科名称Anserinae；成员范围随分类体系而异
rows.en: The taxonomic appendix discusses the limits of Anserinae within the duck family.
rows.zh: 分类学附录讨论了雁鸭科内部Anserinae这一亚科的范围。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 海羊齿属Antedon；海羊齿科的无柄海百合类棘皮动物属
rows.en: The diver photographed Antedon gripping the rock with its small cirri.
rows.zh: 潜水员拍下了Antedon属海羊齿用细小卷枝攀附岩石的情景。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 海羊齿科Antedonidae；一类无柄海百合所属的科
rows.en: The collection's tray of Antedonidae included specimens from three coastal surveys.
rows.zh: 收藏中装有海羊齿科标本的托盘里，放着三次沿海调查采得的标本。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 菊科Antennaria属；一类小型、常被绒毛的多年生草本
rows.en: The pale flower heads of Antennaria brightened the dry rock garden.
rows.zh: 干燥的岩石花园里，Antennaria属植物浅色的花头增添了亮色。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 躄鱼科Antennariidae；一类擅长伪装的海水鱼所属的科
rows.en: Fish in Antennariidae were almost invisible against the sponge-covered reef.
rows.zh: 海绵覆盖的礁石前，躄鱼科的鱼几乎难以辨认。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 天蚕蛾科Antheraea属；包括幼虫可吐丝的若干大型蛾类
rows.en: The rearing room held Antheraea larvae at several stages of growth.
rows.zh: 饲养室里养着不同生长阶段的Antheraea属幼虫。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 植物属Anthericum；旧大陆的一类多年生草本，旧文献分类位置可有差异
rows.en: Several pots of Anthericum stood near the greenhouse door.
rows.zh: 温室门口附近摆着几盆Anthericum属植物。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 菊科植物旧属名Antheropeas；现有数据库将其列为Eriophyllum属的异名
rows.en: A pencilled note linked Antheropeas to Eriophyllum in her copy of the flora.
rows.zh: 她那册植物志里，一条铅笔批注把Antheropeas与Eriophyllum联系了起来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蚁形甲科Anthicidae；鞘翅目甲虫的一科
rows.en: The entomologist sorted the small beetles into a separate tray marked Anthicidae.
rows.zh: 昆虫学家把那些小甲虫分到一个标有Anthicidae的单独托盘中。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 切叶蜂科Anthidium属；包括采集植物毛茸筑巢的若干蜂类
rows.en: An Anthidium bee paused on the hairy leaf before pulling away a tuft of fibres.
rows.zh: 一只Anthidium属蜂在带绒毛的叶片上停了下来，随后扯走了一小撮纤维。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 花象属Anthonomus；象甲科中包含若干作物害虫的甲虫属
rows.en: The enlarged photograph showed the snout of an Anthonomus weevil.
rows.zh: 放大的照片显示了一只Anthonomus属象甲的吻部。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 有机磷化合物IPSP的名称之一（PubChem CID22083，CAS5827-05-4）
rows.en: The archived Aphidan sample was submitted for chemical identification.
rows.zh: 留存的Aphidan样品被送去作化学鉴定。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鹬科鸟类旧属名Aphriza；现有数据库将其列为Calidris属的异名
rows.en: The museum retained Aphriza on its original specimen labels but added updated identifications.
rows.zh: 博物馆保留了原标本签上的Aphriza名称，同时补上了更新后的鉴定信息。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Apiezon；M&I Materials生产的真空润滑脂、密封材料等产品系列品牌
rows.en: The maintenance log recorded the type of Apiezon used on the vacuum seal.
rows.zh: 维修日志记下了真空密封处所用Apiezon产品的型号。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 海兔科Aplysiidae；海洋腹足类软体动物的一科
rows.en: Aplysiidae were photographed in a shallow tank during the survey.
rows.zh: 调查期间，海兔科动物在一个浅水槽中被拍了照。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Apodacea；历史海参分类中的无足亚纲名称，旧方案下包括Apodida和Molpadiida
rows.en: The seminar compared the old Apodacea grouping with later sea-cucumber classifications.
rows.zh: 研讨会比较了旧的Apodacea类群划分与后来的海参分类体系。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蜜蜂总科Apoidea；膜翅目中包含蜜蜂等昆虫的总科名称
rows.en: The survey compared Apoidea caught in the meadow with those from the orchard.
rows.zh: 调查比较了在草地里捕获的蜜蜂总科昆虫与在果园里捕获的同类昆虫。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 鼠尾掌属Aporocactus；仙人掌科植物属，具有细长下垂的茎
rows.en: The hanging stems of Aporocactus reached below the greenhouse bench.
rows.zh: Aporocactus属植物下垂的茎一直伸到了温室栽培台下方。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 阿基塔尼亚；古代高卢西南部的地域名称
rows.en: The history atlas places Aquitania north of the Pyrenees.
rows.zh: 那本历史地图集把阿基塔尼亚标在比利牛斯山以北。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 阿拉伯语成分；出现在其他语言中的阿拉伯语词语、表达或特点
rows.en: The editor kept the Arabism because no English word conveyed quite the same idea.
rows.zh: 编辑保留了那个源自阿拉伯语的词，因为没有哪个英语词能表达完全相同的意思。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Aramus属；美洲湿地中长喙涉禽的属名，属秧鹤科Aramidae
rows.en: We watched an Aramus bird searching the shallows for food at first light.
rows.zh: 天刚亮，我们就看着一只Aramus属的鸟在浅水里觅食。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 园蛛类的历史属名Aranea；现列为Araneus属的晚出异名
rows.en: The old label read Aranea, and the newer catalogue placed the specimen under Araneus.
rows.zh: 旧标签上写的是Aranea，而较新的目录把该标本归在Araneus属下。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Araujia属；南美的一类缠绕藤本植物，属夹竹桃科
rows.en: The gardener untangled an Araujia stem from the wire fence.
rows.zh: 园丁把一根Araujia属植物的藤茎从铁丝围栏上解了下来。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Archimycetes；旧真菌分类中使用过的亚纲名称，并非现代古菌Archaea
rows.en: A pencilled question mark beside Archimycetes showed where the student had struggled with the old classification.
rows.zh: Archimycetes旁的一个铅笔问号，显示学生在这套旧分类中遇到了疑惑。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 传统单子叶植物分类中的亚纲名Arecidae；包含棕榈等类群
rows.en: She turned to the Arecidae section of the flora after checking its classification scheme.
rows.zh: 核对分类框架后，她翻到了植物志中的Arecidae部分。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 黑翻石鹬（Arenaria melanocephala），北美太平洋沿岸的鸟类
rows.en: The observer photographed Arenaria melanocephala on the wave-washed rocks.
rows.zh: 观察者在浪潮冲刷的岩石上拍下了黑翻石鹬Arenaria melanocephala。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Argasoid；一种以铜为主要成分的仿银合金名称（历史材料名）
rows.en: The conservator recorded Argasoid as the material of the silver-coloured fitting.
rows.zh: 修复人员把那件银色配件的材质记为Argasoid合金。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 园蛛科的旧科名Argiopidae；现列作Araneidae的异名
rows.en: The older paper uses Argiopidae for the orb-weaver family listed as Araneidae in the new catalogue.
rows.zh: 较早的论文用Argiopidae作为园蛛科的名称，而新目录使用Araneidae。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 亚裔英国人；家庭源自亚洲、尤指南亚的英国人
rows.en: Her new novel follows a British Asian who moves from London to a remote village.
rows.zh: 她的新小说讲述了一位亚裔英国人从伦敦搬到偏远村庄的故事。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 新年假日；尤指元旦（New Year's Day 的简称）
rows.en: All three cousins joined us for lunch on New Year's.
rows.zh: 三位表亲元旦那天都来和我们一起吃了午饭。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 星期四（Thursday 的书面缩写）
rows.en: The rota gives me every Thurs off for the next month.
rows.zh: 下个月的排班表把每个星期四都安排为我的休息日。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 立场强硬的；不愿妥协的
rows.en: The committee rejected the negotiator's hard-line approach.
rows.zh: 委员会否决了那位谈判者的强硬做法。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 逞男子气概的；刻意表现传统男性强硬形象的
rows.en: The manager dropped his macho manner when he realised nobody was impressed.
rows.zh: 经理发现没人买账后，便收起了那副逞男子气概的派头。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 波本威士忌；一种美国威士忌（本例为酒类义）
rows.en: She bought a small bottle of bourbon as a gift for her grandfather.
rows.zh: 她买了一小瓶波本威士忌作为送给祖父的礼物。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 半独立式住宅；与相邻住宅共用一面墙的房屋（英式口语）
rows.en: They bought a small semi at the end of the street.
rows.zh: 他们在街道尽头买了一栋小型半独立式住宅。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 浅蓝绿色；水绿色（本例为颜色义）
rows.en: The walls were painted a pale aqua to brighten the narrow hall.
rows.zh: 墙壁刷成了浅浅的水绿色，让狭窄的门厅明亮一些。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 开球；比赛开始时的发球（本例为足球）
rows.en: The kick-off was delayed while officials checked the damaged goal.
rows.zh: 工作人员检查受损球门期间，开球时间被推迟了。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 长途的；远距离的
rows.en: They packed extra snacks for the long-haul flight.
rows.zh: 他们为那趟长途航班多准备了一些零食。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 罗伯特（Henry M. Robert）；《罗伯特议事规则》的作者（本例人名）
rows.en: Before the meeting, she compared Robert's rules with the club's older procedures.
rows.zh: 开会前，她把罗伯特的议事规则与俱乐部较早的程序作了比较。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 达林顿（Sidney Darlington）；研究半导体电路的工程师（本例人名）
rows.en: The lecture placed Darlington's circuit work in the wider history of semiconductor design.
rows.zh: 这堂课把达林顿的电路研究放在半导体设计的整体历史中来讨论。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 公司；corporation的书面缩写Corp.，常见于公司名称
rows.en: The letterhead printed the company's name with Corp. at the end.
rows.zh: 信笺抬头把Corp.印在公司名称的末尾。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 戈登（Gordon Bell）；本例在访谈讨论语境中以Gordon称呼这位计算机研究者
rows.en: The students compared Gordon's account of digital memory with their own note-taking habits.
rows.zh: 学生们把戈登关于数字记忆的介绍与自己的记笔记习惯作了比较。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Alex；Vincent Cate发表的全球文件系统原型名称，可访问远程匿名FTP文件
rows.en: The engineer kept Alex running on an old workstation throughout the demonstration.
rows.zh: 工程师在整个演示期间，让Alex一直运行在一台旧工作站上。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Watson；IBM研发、参加2011年Jeopardy!电视问答比赛的问答计算机系统
rows.en: The documentary revisits Watson's televised quiz match.
rows.zh: 这部纪录片回顾了Watson参加的那场电视问答比赛。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 纽曼（Max Newman）；从事拓扑学、理论计算机科学及战时密码破译的数学家（本例人名）
rows.en: The chapter follows Newman's move from wartime codebreaking to university research.
rows.zh: 这一章讲述了纽曼如何从战时密码破译转向大学研究。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 吉布森（William Gibson）；小说Neuromancer等作品的作者（本例人名）
rows.en: Her essay reads Gibson's fiction alongside accounts of everyday life online.
rows.zh: 她的文章把吉布森的小说与有关日常网络生活的记述放在一起解读。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蜜蜂花属Melissa；唇形科的一属草本植物（本例属名义）
rows.en: The herb garden set aside a bed for Melissa near the shaded wall.
rows.zh: 香草园在背阴墙边留出一块地，种植Melissa属植物。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: ruin的旧拼写：毁灭、败落（早期现代英语文献用法）
rows.en: In the historical novel, another war brings the once-rich city to ruine.
rows.zh: 历史小说里，又一场战争使这座昔日富庶的城市走向毁灭。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 阿姆斯特朗（William Ward Armstrong）；1974年数据库关系依赖结构论文作者（本例人名）
rows.en: The reading list includes Armstrong's 1974 paper on database relationships.
rows.zh: 阅读书目包括阿姆斯特朗1974年关于数据库关系的论文。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: stella试铸币；美国1879、1880年试制的约四美元面额硬币名称（历史钱币义）
rows.en: The collector hoped to see a stella among the museum's nineteenth-century coins.
rows.zh: 这位收藏者希望能在博物馆的十九世纪钱币中见到一枚stella试铸币。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 蔷薇属Rosa；包括多种直立或攀援、常有皮刺的灌木的植物属
rows.en: The climber belonged to Rosa, though its cultivar label had faded.
rows.zh: 那株攀援植物属于蔷薇属，但它的栽培品种标签已经褪色了。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （旧用）檀木；本例取red saunders红檀木材料义
rows.en: The inventory listed red saunders separately from the oak and walnut.
rows.zh: 清单把红檀木与橡木、胡桃木分列。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 拉姆齐（Frank Plumpton Ramsey）；与组合数学中的拉姆齐理论有关的英国数学家（本例人名）
rows.en: The seminar ended with a discussion of Ramsey's work on combinatorial problems.
rows.zh: 研讨会最后讨论了拉姆齐关于组合问题的研究。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: Franklin；本例指Franklin Computer公司及其20世纪80年代微型计算机品牌
rows.en: The collector found a Franklin computer with its original keyboard.
rows.zh: 收藏者找到了一台保留着原装键盘的Franklin微型计算机。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 瓦格纳的音乐；本例以作曲家姓名指代其音乐作品
rows.en: The radio played Wagner while she prepared dinner.
rows.zh: 她准备晚餐时，收音机正播放瓦格纳的音乐。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 克尔（Roy P. Kerr）；发表旋转质量引力场研究、提出克尔解的理论研究者（本例人名）
rows.en: The professor sketched the geometry of Kerr's rotating black-hole solution on the board.
rows.zh: 教授在黑板上画出了克尔旋转黑洞解的几何示意图。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 韦伯；磁通量的国际单位，符号Wb，不等于电荷单位库仑
rows.en: The instrument displays magnetic flux in webers.
rows.zh: 这台仪器以韦伯为单位显示磁通量。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: 豪华轿车（limousine 的口语简称）
rows.en: Three musicians squeezed into the limo with their instrument cases.
rows.zh: 三位音乐家带着乐器箱挤进了那辆豪华轿车。
rows.author: root
rows.originalReviewer: d38_source_author_resume; different principal from Root author

rows.meaningZh: 费拉里（Domenico Ferrari）；从事计算机系统性能和网络研究的学者（本例人名）
rows.en: The literature review highlights Ferrari's early work on computer-system performance.
rows.zh: 文献综述着重介绍了费拉里早期关于计算机系统性能的研究。
rows.author: source

rows.meaningZh: （极具冒犯性的种族辱称）针对黑人的侮辱性用语；本例只作批判性引述
rows.en: She quoted the slur 'nigger' as evidence of the abuse she had faced.
rows.zh: 她引用了极具侮辱性的种族词语“nigger”，作为自己曾遭辱骂的证据。
rows.author: source
