rows.meaningZh: 同前所述的人或事物；同一作者或同一出处（主要用于书目、引注）
rows.en: The editor used idem in the second footnote instead of repeating the author's name.
rows.zh: 编辑在第二条脚注中用 idem 代替再次写出作者的姓名。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 入罪化；通过法律使某种行为成为犯罪
rows.en: The debate focused on the criminalization of conduct that had previously been lawful.
rows.zh: 辩论的焦点是把此前合法的行为规定为犯罪。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 按考德这一体积单位计量的薪柴；堆放的柴木
rows.en: They stacked the cordwood under a tarpaulin before the rain.
rows.zh: 下雨前，他们把薪柴堆在了防水布下面。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 挖掘隧道；tunnel 的现在分词（本例为美式拼写）
rows.en: Workers were tunneling beneath the railway line.
rows.zh: 工人们正在铁路线下方挖掘隧道。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 钾猪毛菜等盐生植物；saltwort 的名称之一（本例为植物义，不是化学元素钾）
rows.en: The botanist recorded patches of kali growing above the beach.
rows.zh: 植物学家记录了海滩上方成片生长的盐生猪毛菜。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 鲁米那；苯巴比妥的一种旧商品名（本例为药品商标名）
rows.en: The museum's pharmacy display included a box labelled Luminal.
rows.zh: 博物馆的药房展柜中有一盒标着鲁米那商标的药品。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 黑质；substantia nigra在神经科学语境中的简称，不是族群称呼
rows.en: The researchers compared neuron counts in the nigra with those in nearby brain regions.
rows.zh: 研究人员比较了黑质与附近脑区的神经元数量。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 向近端；朝向身体中心或肢体附着端的方向
rows.en: The swelling extended proximally from the wrist towards the elbow.
rows.zh: 肿胀从手腕向近端延伸，朝肘部扩展。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 含类维生素A物质的；由类维生素A物质衍生的（如 retinoic acid，维甲酸）
rows.en: The research assistant checked the label on the vial of retinoic acid.
rows.zh: 研究助理查看了那瓶维甲酸上的标签。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 泄密者；暗中向外提供内部信息的人（本例不是漏水器件义）
rows.en: The editor refused to reveal the identity of the leaker.
rows.zh: 编辑拒绝透露泄密者的身份。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 超氧化物；含超氧阴离子的化合物（不是过氧化物）
rows.en: The chemist compared the structure of potassium superoxide with that of potassium peroxide.
rows.zh: 化学家比较了超氧化钾和过氧化钾的结构。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 西格妮，女性名字（Signe）
rows.en: Signe set the blue bowl beside the window to examine its glaze.
rows.zh: 西格妮把蓝碗放在窗边，查看碗面的釉色。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 嗜眠性脑炎的旧称（nona）
rows.en: The historian found several cases recorded as nona in the old hospital register.
rows.zh: 历史学家在旧医院登记册里发现了数例记作嗜眠性脑炎的病例。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 双耳细颈陶罐；古代常用于盛酒或油的容器
rows.en: The amphora still had traces of a painted pattern around its neck.
rows.zh: 那只双耳细颈陶罐的颈部仍留有彩绘图案的痕迹。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 异构形式；本例指由同一基因产生的某种蛋白质形式
rows.en: The antibody detected one isoform but not the other.
rows.zh: 这种抗体检测出了一种蛋白质异构形式，却没有检测出另一种。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 健谈而热情的性格；坦率热络的态度（本例为性情义）
rows.en: His usual expansiveness disappeared when the interviewer asked about his childhood.
rows.zh: 采访者问起他的童年时，他平日里那种热情健谈的劲头消失了。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 爷爷；外公；grandpa的非正式拼写形式
rows.en: My grampa showed me how to mend the garden gate.
rows.zh: 我爷爷教我怎样修理花园的门。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 三线卦；由三条阴爻或阳爻组成的卦象（本例为易经相关义）
rows.en: The teacher drew a trigram with three unbroken lines.
rows.zh: 老师画了一个由三条完整阳爻组成的三线卦。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 自动装填枪械；能够自行装填下一发弹药的枪（本例为枪械义）
rows.en: The museum displayed an early autoloader beside a manually loaded rifle.
rows.zh: 博物馆把一支早期自动装填枪与一支手动装填步枪并列展示。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 以魅力诱惑他人的女子（常见于文学或角色描写，可带贬义）
rows.en: The actor struggled to make the role of the seductress believable.
rows.zh: 那位演员很难把这个以魅力诱惑他人的女性角色演得令人信服。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 花葶；从基部长出的无叶花梗（本例为植物学义）
rows.en: A single flower opened at the tip of the tall scape.
rows.zh: 高高的无叶花葶顶端开出了一朵花。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 调平装置；使表面或设备达到水平的器件（本例为工具义）
rows.en: The technician adjusted the leveler until the platform was horizontal.
rows.zh: 技术员调整调平装置，直到平台处于水平状态。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 鲀鱼；能使身体膨胀的一类鱼（本例为动物义）
rows.en: Divers photographed a puffer resting near the reef.
rows.zh: 潜水员拍下了一条在珊瑚礁附近休息的鲀鱼。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 长寿饮食法的；与宏观养生饮食法有关的（不表示已证实有延寿效果）
rows.en: The cookbook includes several macrobiotic recipes based on whole grains.
rows.zh: 这本食谱收录了几种以全谷物为主的长寿饮食法菜谱。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 围手术期的；与手术前后及手术期间有关的
rows.en: The nurse explained the perioperative care plan at the pre-surgery appointment.
rows.zh: 护士在术前就诊时解释了围手术期护理计划。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 维A类的；与维生素A类似物有关的（本例为化合物修饰义）
rows.en: The researcher compared two retinoid compounds in the cell cultures.
rows.zh: 研究人员在细胞培养物中比较了两种维A类化合物。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 阿提拉；5世纪的匈人统治者（本例为历史人名）
rows.en: The historian contrasted Roman accounts of Attila with later legends.
rows.zh: 这位历史学者将罗马人关于阿提拉的记述与后来的传说作了对照。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 斯庞，姓氏（Spong）
rows.en: Spong had to duck under the beam to reach the attic window.
rows.zh: 斯庞得低头从横梁下钻过去，才能走到阁楼窗边。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 涉及排泄物或排泄功能的粗俗内容的（本例为文体义）
rows.en: The review criticised the play for relying too heavily on scatological humour.
rows.zh: 评论批评这出戏过于依赖屎尿笑话式的粗俗幽默。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 格列柯；画家El Greco的简称（本例为人名，不是表示希腊的构词成分Greco-）
rows.en: The exhibition compared Greco's portraits with those of his contemporaries.
rows.zh: 展览将格列柯的肖像画与同时代画家的作品作了比较。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 反噬；某项行动造成的意外不利后果（本例为比喻义）
rows.en: The minister faced blowback after the leaked memo contradicted his public statement.
rows.zh: 泄露的备忘录与部长的公开声明相矛盾，使他遭到了反噬。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 完成课程或项目并获授证书、学位等资格的人（本例为教育统计用语）
rows.en: Each completer received a certificate after finishing the training programme.
rows.zh: 每位完成培训项目的学员都获颁了证书。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 百叶片；门窗等平行斜片中的一片，用于通风并挡雨
rows.en: A damaged louver allowed rain to enter the ventilation shaft.
rows.zh: 一片损坏的百叶片让雨水进入了通风井。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 格兰马草；一种用作牧草的禾本科植物（grama 的异体拼写）
rows.en: The cattle grazed on gramma after the summer rain.
rows.zh: 夏雨过后，牛群在啃食格兰马牧草。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 时间跨度；两个事件之间或某项过程持续的一段时间（本例为普通名词义）
rows.en: The two surveys covered the same timespan but used different sampling methods.
rows.zh: 这两次调查涵盖了同一时间段，但采用了不同的抽样方法。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 角宿一；室女座最亮的恒星，实为一个紧密的双星系统（本例为天文义）
rows.en: Spica was low in the eastern sky when the observers began their session.
rows.zh: 观测者开始观测时，角宿一位于东方低空。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 纳米机器；通过纳米技术构建、在极微小尺度运作的机器，不必是计算机
rows.en: The team tested whether the nanomachine could move a tiny load across the surface.
rows.zh: 研究团队测试了这台纳米机器能否在表面移动一个微小的负载。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 异质的；由不同种类成分组成的（heterogeneous 的异体，本例为混合物义）
rows.en: The samples formed a heterogenous mixture of sand, clay and organic matter.
rows.zh: 这些样品构成了由沙、黏土和有机质组成的异质混合物。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 圣餐变体说；天主教关于圣餐饼酒实体变化的教义（本例为宗教义）
rows.en: The lecturer explained transubstantiation during a discussion of the Eucharist.
rows.zh: 讲师在讨论圣餐礼时解释了圣餐变体说。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 通奸的已婚女子（旧式、带谴责意味的性别化称谓）
rows.en: The court drama centres on a woman accused of being an adulteress.
rows.zh: 这部法庭剧围绕一名被指控通奸的已婚女子展开。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 轴子；物理学提出的一类假想粒子，不能当作已被确认发现的粒子
rows.en: The experiment searched for an axion signal but found no statistically significant excess.
rows.zh: 这项实验寻找了轴子信号，但没有发现统计上显著的超出预期背景的信号。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 不择手段的讼棍；以不道德手法行事的人，尤指律师或政客（贬义）
rows.en: The client regretted trusting a shyster who had promised an easy victory.
rows.zh: 那位委托人后悔相信了一个许诺能轻松胜诉的讼棍。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 穴位按压法；用手指对身体特定部位施压的方法
rows.en: The workshop demonstrated acupressure using pressure from the fingertips.
rows.zh: 工作坊演示了用指尖施压的穴位按压法。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 集运商；把多批小宗货物合并运输的承运或货运服务商（本例义）
rows.en: The consolidator combined several small shipments into one container.
rows.zh: 集运商把几批小宗货物合并装入一个集装箱。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 杰弗里斯（Harold Jeffreys；本例指研究概率与科学推断的学者）
rows.en: Jeffreys' work on probability is covered in the final lecture.
rows.zh: 最后一讲介绍了杰弗里斯在概率论方面的工作。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 尚未测绘的；未在地图上标明的（本例为地域义）
rows.en: The expedition avoided the unmapped valley beyond the ridge.
rows.zh: 探险队避开了山脊另一侧尚未测绘的山谷。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 疏忽；缺乏关心和照料（本例为对他人需求不留心的意思）
rows.en: His inattentiveness to the children's needs worried the social worker.
rows.zh: 他对孩子们需求的忽视令社工担忧。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 生育三烯酚；维生素E相关化合物中的一类，与生育酚有别
rows.en: The analysis measured each tocotrienol separately from the tocopherols in the oil.
rows.zh: 这项分析对油中的各种生育三烯酚与生育酚分别进行了测定。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 反复无常；凭一时兴致而任意行事的性格
rows.en: The manager's capriciousness made it difficult to plan the weekly rota.
rows.zh: 经理的反复无常让每周的排班变得很困难。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 卖主；商贩（vendor 的异体拼写）
rows.en: The fruit vender lowered the price as the market began to close.
rows.zh: 集市开始收摊时，水果商贩降低了售价。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 立体定向的；利用空间定位来精确确定目标或器械位置的（本例为医学义）
rows.en: The stereotactic frame helped the team position the instrument precisely.
rows.zh: 立体定向框架帮助团队精确定位器械。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 龇牙咧嘴的僵硬表情；固定的怪笑
rows.en: His smile hardened into a rictus when he heard the accusation.
rows.zh: 听到指控时，他的笑容僵成了龇牙咧嘴的怪笑。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 苯二氮䓬类药物；一类可用于抗焦虑、镇静等用途的中枢神经系统抑制药
rows.en: The doctor reviewed her benzodiazepine prescription during the medication check.
rows.zh: 医生在用药核查时复查了她的苯二氮䓬类药物处方。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 海水神仙鱼；本例选 Pomacanthus 属的观赏鱼义
rows.en: The aquarist moved the angelfish to a larger saltwater tank.
rows.zh: 水族饲养员把那条海水神仙鱼移进了更大的海水缸。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 火箭或航天器发射台（本例为航天义）
rows.en: The rocket stood on the launchpad while engineers checked the weather forecast.
rows.zh: 工程师查看天气预报时，火箭矗立在发射台上。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 润滑工；给机械或零件加润滑脂的人（本例为机械工作义）
rows.en: The greaser lubricated the bearings before the machine was restarted.
rows.zh: 机器重新启动前，润滑工给轴承加了润滑脂。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 辅助医疗的；与协助医生、护士工作的专业人员有关的
rows.en: Paramedical staff helped prepare the patient for transport.
rows.zh: 辅助医疗人员协助做好了转运病人的准备。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 地球静止轨道的；在轨道上相对于地面位置保持不变的
rows.en: The antenna remained pointed at the same geostationary satellite.
rows.zh: 天线始终对准同一颗地球静止轨道卫星。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 屏幕边框；围绕显示区域的外框（本例为电子设备义）
rows.en: She wiped the dust from the bezel without touching the display.
rows.zh: 她擦掉了屏幕边框上的灰尘，没有碰到显示区域。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 恶魔学；对恶魔或恶魔信仰的系统研究
rows.en: Her dissertation traced the influence of demonology on seventeenth-century trials.
rows.zh: 她的学位论文追溯了恶魔学对十七世纪审判的影响。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 素描本；供绘画用的空白纸本
rows.en: He opened his sketchpad and drew the roofline of the station.
rows.zh: 他打开素描本，画下了车站屋顶的轮廓。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 可执行性；能够通过法律强制实现的效力（本例为合同条款义）
rows.en: The dispute concerned the enforceability of a clause in the contract.
rows.zh: 争议涉及合同中一项条款的可执行性。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 卡瓦酒；一种西班牙起泡葡萄酒（本例为酒类义）
rows.en: They opened a bottle of cava to celebrate the end of the project.
rows.zh: 他们开了一瓶卡瓦起泡葡萄酒，庆祝项目结束。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 阿玛，多贡人传统信仰中与创世有关的至高神（Amma）
rows.en: The lecturer compared different accounts of how Amma created the world.
rows.zh: 讲师比较了关于阿玛创造世界的不同叙述。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 精神障碍；思想或情绪的紊乱（本例为精神医学用语）
rows.en: The researcher compared accounts of folie in two nineteenth-century psychiatric casebooks.
rows.zh: 研究者比较了两本十九世纪精神医学病例集对精神障碍的记述。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 旧时对有肛交性行为者的称谓，尤曾用于辱称男同性恋者（带贬义或冒犯意味）
rows.en: In the trial record, sodomite was used as an accusation rather than as a neutral description.
rows.zh: 在这份审判记录中，sodomite 被用作指控性的称谓，而非中性描述。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 角度的精确测量（本例选测量义）
rows.en: Accurate angulation helped the surveyors establish the direction of the new tunnel.
rows.zh: 精确的角度测量帮助测量员确定了新隧道的方向。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 未压缩的（本例指计算机文件或数据）
rows.en: The editor kept an uncompressed copy of the recording for later work.
rows.zh: 编辑保留了一份未压缩的录音副本，供后续工作使用。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 李斯特菌；李斯特菌属的细菌（本例为细菌名称）
rows.en: The lab's report listed Listeria among the bacteria it had identified.
rows.zh: 实验室报告将李斯特菌列在已鉴定出的细菌之中。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 蒌叶；胡椒属藤本植物 Piper betle（本例为植物义，不指槟榔果）
rows.en: The gardener trained the betel vine up a wooden support.
rows.zh: 园丁引导蒌叶藤沿着木支架攀爬。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 表观遗传的；涉及不改变 DNA 序列而影响基因活动的变化
rows.en: The study compared epigenetic changes in cells with identical DNA sequences.
rows.zh: 这项研究比较了具有相同 DNA 序列的细胞中的表观遗传变化。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 窄发带；束在头上的带状饰物（taenia 的异体，本例选发带义）
rows.en: A narrow tenia held the actor's hair away from his face.
rows.zh: 一条窄发带束住了那名演员的头发，使头发不挡住脸。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 悲痛；哀伤（文学或诗歌用语）
rows.en: A note of dolor runs through the poem about the abandoned house.
rows.zh: 那首描写废弃房屋的诗贯穿着哀伤的情绪。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 反乌托邦；生活受压迫、匮乏或恐惧支配的假想社会（本例为社会义）
rows.en: The novel imagines a dystopia where every private conversation is monitored.
rows.zh: 小说设想了一个连私人交谈都受到监控的反乌托邦社会。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 《阿依达》，威尔第创作的歌剧（Aida）
rows.en: The library's recording of Aida came with a libretto in three languages.
rows.zh: 图书馆收藏的《阿依达》录音附有三种语言的歌剧脚本。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 痘苗病毒（本例选病毒义；与引起天花的 variola virus 不同）
rows.en: Her research focused on vaccinia rather than on the virus that causes smallpox.
rows.zh: 她的研究关注痘苗病毒，而不是引起天花的病毒。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 沙眼；由沙眼衣原体引起的眼部感染
rows.en: The health survey included a separate section on trachoma and other eye infections.
rows.zh: 这项健康调查单列一节讨论沙眼及其他眼部感染。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 单极子；本例指具有单一磁极的假想粒子，即磁单极子
rows.en: The experiment searched for a magnetic monopole without finding a convincing signal.
rows.zh: 这项实验搜寻了磁单极子，但没有发现有说服力的信号。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 机加工木制构件；在木工厂加工的木制品
rows.en: The carpenter matched the new millwork to the house's original door frames.
rows.zh: 木匠让新制的机加工木构件与房屋原有的门框相配。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 小孩；小家伙（非正式用语，本例为儿童义）
rows.en: The nipper fell asleep before his father finished the bedtime story.
rows.zh: 爸爸还没讲完睡前故事，小家伙就睡着了。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: Kitemark 认证标志；英国标准协会 BSI 的认证标志（商标名称）
rows.en: The buyer checked the Kitemark licence number printed below the symbol.
rows.zh: 买家核对了标志下方印着的 Kitemark 认证许可编号。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 分枝杆菌属；本例为细菌属名
rows.en: The identification report placed the isolate in the genus Mycobacterium.
rows.zh: 鉴定报告将该分离株归入分枝杆菌属。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 多项描记器绘出的记录图；多种生理变化的描记图
rows.en: The technician marked the interruption on the polygram before filing it.
rows.zh: 技术员在归档前，先在多项生理描记图上标出了记录中断的位置。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 同侧步马；同一侧两腿一起移动的马（本例为马的步态义）
rows.en: The pacer moved smoothly around the track, lifting the legs on one side together.
rows.zh: 那匹同侧步马平稳地绕着跑道行进，同一侧的两条腿一起抬起。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 净的；扣除各项费用后剩余的（net 的异体拼写）
rows.en: Her nett pay came to £480 after the deductions.
rows.zh: 扣除各项费用后，她的实发工资为480英镑。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 未经烧制的（本例指黏土制品）
rows.en: The unfired clay bowl was too fragile to pack with the finished pottery.
rows.zh: 这个未经烧制的黏土碗太脆弱，不能和已烧成的陶器一起装箱。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 安布罗斯·埃弗里特·伯恩赛德（Ambrose Everett Burnside，美国南北战争时期的将军）
rows.en: The exhibit used a battlefield map to explain Burnside's defeat at Fredericksburg.
rows.zh: 展览用一张战场地图解释伯恩赛德在弗雷德里克斯堡战败的经过。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 致癌性；导致癌症的能力或倾向
rows.en: Researchers assessed the carcinogenicity of the solvent before it was approved for industrial use.
rows.zh: 研究人员在这种溶剂获准用于工业之前评估了它的致癌性。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 异装现象；穿着通常与另一性别相关联的服装的做法（旧用，可能含冒犯意味；现代常用 cross-dressing）
rows.en: The exhibition examined transvestism in the history of stage performance.
rows.zh: 展览考察了舞台表演史中的异装现象。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 非视觉的；不依靠视觉的（本例为感官义）
rows.en: The museum added nonvisual cues, including textures and sound, to the exhibition.
rows.zh: 博物馆为展览增添了非视觉提示，包括不同质感和声音。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 通胀放缓；通货膨胀率下降，区别于整体物价持续下降的通缩
rows.en: The fall in annual inflation from 7% to 5% was disinflation, even though prices were still rising.
rows.zh: 年通胀率从7%降至5%属于通胀放缓，尽管物价仍在上涨。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 管弦乐编曲者；为管弦乐队配器的人
rows.en: The orchestrator gave the melody to the cellos and added a quiet horn part.
rows.zh: 管弦乐编曲者把旋律交给大提琴声部，并加入轻柔的圆号声部。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 哈里森·施密特（Harrison Schmitt，美国地质学家、阿波罗17号宇航员）
rows.en: The students paused the film to discuss Schmitt's description of the lunar rocks.
rows.zh: 学生们暂停影片，讨论施密特对月岩的描述。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 暂准的；尚未最终生效的（法律用语，本例用于 decree nisi）
rows.en: The archive contained a decree nisi and the later order that made it absolute.
rows.zh: 档案中保存着一份暂准判令及随后使其最终生效的命令。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 取消选中；取消对某一选项的选择（本例为计算机操作义）
rows.en: Click the checkbox again to deselect the option before saving.
rows.zh: 保存前，再点一次复选框以取消选中该选项。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 微型盒式录音带；用于小型录音机的微型磁带盒
rows.en: She found a microcassette containing an interview she had recorded years earlier.
rows.zh: 她找到了一盒微型录音带，里面录着她多年前录制的一次访谈。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: Cereus 属；仙人掌科植物的一个属（本例为属名）
rows.en: The greenhouse label identified the plant as a member of the genus Cereus.
rows.zh: 温室中的标签将这株植物标为 Cereus 属植物。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 牙齿正畸的；与矫正牙齿及咬合有关的
rows.en: The dentist referred him for an orthodontic assessment of his crowded teeth.
rows.zh: 牙医转诊他接受牙齿拥挤的正畸评估。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 求等面积正方形；作出与给定图形等面积的正方形（本例为几何义）
rows.en: The student attempted the quadrature of the rectangle using only a ruler and compasses.
rows.zh: 学生试图只用直尺和圆规作出一个与该长方形等面积的正方形。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 马斯特曼，姓氏（Masterman）
rows.en: Masterman moved the meeting indoors when the first drops of rain fell.
rows.zh: 最初几滴雨落下时，马斯特曼把会议转移到室内。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 育空河；流经加拿大和阿拉斯加的河流（本例为河流名）
rows.en: They crossed the Yukon by ferry before continuing north.
rows.zh: 他们乘渡船渡过育空河，然后继续北行。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 缺乏明确形式或结构；无条理（本例指文章结构）
rows.en: The draft's formlessness made the argument difficult to follow.
rows.zh: 初稿缺乏清晰结构，使论证难以理解。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 恋尸欲；对尸体的性吸引（专业用语）
rows.en: The forensic textbook discussed necrophilia in a chapter on sexual disorders.
rows.zh: 这本法医学教材在讨论性障碍的一章中谈到了恋尸欲。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 迪娜，女性名字（Dina）
rows.en: Dina left her sketchbook on the train and went back to look for it.
rows.zh: 迪娜把速写本落在了火车上，又回去寻找。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 不说话；说不出话（本例为缄默义；描述言语残障时该词可能不合宜）
rows.en: His unexpected dumbness left the interviewer waiting for an answer.
rows.zh: 他出乎意料地一言不发，让采访者等着他的回答。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 间性的；具有不符合典型男性或女性身体定义的先天性别特征变异的
rows.en: The clinic consulted intersex people when revising its information leaflet.
rows.zh: 诊所在修订说明手册时征求了间性人士的意见。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 性化；将人主要作为性吸引对象来呈现或评价（本例为文化和媒体义）
rows.en: The essay criticised the sexualization of women in advertisements for everyday products.
rows.zh: 这篇文章批评了日用品广告中将女性性化的现象。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 拼合式模拟人像；根据目击描述组合面部特征得到的画像（原为 Identikit 商标）
rows.en: The witness helped the police produce an identikit of the suspect.
rows.zh: 目击者协助警方拼出了嫌疑人的模拟画像。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 胸锁乳突肌；位于颈部、参与头颈转动的成对肌肉
rows.en: The physiotherapist checked his sternocleidomastoid while he slowly turned his head.
rows.zh: 他缓慢转头时，物理治疗师检查了他的胸锁乳突肌。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 和弦的；由和弦构成的（本例为音乐义）
rows.en: The pianist added a quiet chordal accompaniment beneath the melody.
rows.zh: 钢琴家在旋律下方加入了轻柔的和弦伴奏。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 诺如病毒；可引起急性胃肠炎的一类病毒
rows.en: The school reported a norovirus outbreak after several pupils developed stomach symptoms.
rows.zh: 几名学生出现胃肠道症状后，学校报告了一起诺如病毒暴发。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 规避；设法绕开限制或障碍
rows.en: The audit uncovered deliberate circumvention of the purchasing rules.
rows.zh: 审计发现了故意规避采购规定的行为。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 狂蝇幼虫，尤指寄生在马体内的种类（bott，bot 的较少用拼法）
rows.en: The preserved bott was large enough to examine without a microscope.
rows.zh: 那只保存下来的狂蝇幼虫大得不用显微镜就能观察。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 涡轮风扇发动机；借助涡轮驱动风扇产生推力的喷气发动机
rows.en: The engineer inspected the turbofan before the aircraft returned to service.
rows.zh: 飞机恢复运行前，工程师检查了涡轮风扇发动机。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 微型机械；具有微小机械结构的装置（本例为微机电装置义，不等同于微型计算机）
rows.en: Under the microscope, the students watched a micromachine turn a tiny gear.
rows.zh: 学生们通过显微镜观察一台微型机械转动一个微小齿轮。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 逐步操作说明；详细演示（本例为软件使用说明义）
rows.en: The walkthrough showed me how to restore a deleted folder.
rows.zh: 这份逐步操作说明教我如何恢复已删除的文件夹。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 皮层小人；表示身体各部位在大脑皮层中对应区域的示意人形（本例为神经科学义）
rows.en: Students located the hand region on a diagram of the sensory homunculus.
rows.zh: 学生们在感觉皮层小人图上找到了手部对应的区域。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 会阴切开术；分娩时对会阴作切口的手术
rows.en: At the follow-up appointment, she asked the midwife about her episiotomy scar.
rows.zh: 复诊时，她向助产士询问了自己的会阴切开术瘢痕情况。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 测量人员；进行测量的人（本例为人员义）
rows.en: Each measurer recorded the child's height twice to check the reading.
rows.zh: 每名测量人员都记录了两次孩子的身高，以核对读数。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 维护者；负责维持或维护工作的人（本例为软件项目人员义）
rows.en: The software maintainer reviewed the patch before the next release.
rows.zh: 软件维护者在下一个版本发布前审查了这个补丁。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 无耻而阴险的女人（贬义、性别化的辱称）
rows.en: The critic challenged the novel's portrayal of its heroine as a jezebel.
rows.zh: 评论者质疑小说将女主人公描绘为无耻而阴险的女人的做法。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 康复医学专科医生；物理医学与康复医学医师
rows.en: After the spinal injury, a physiatrist coordinated his rehabilitation plan.
rows.zh: 脊柱受伤后，一名康复医学专科医生统筹了他的康复方案。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 未署名的；未在演职员名单中列出的（本例为电影义）
rows.en: She made an uncredited appearance in the film's opening scene.
rows.zh: 她在电影开场一幕中出演，但未在演职员名单中署名。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 与男童发生性行为的成年男子（正式用语，不等同于泛指同性恋者）
rows.en: The article condemned the pederast's exploitation of boys.
rows.zh: 这篇文章谴责了那名成年男子对男童的性侵害。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 在牧草地继续饲养、供后续育肥的幼牛（本例为肉牛业义）
rows.en: The rancher bought a stocker to graze on the spring pasture.
rows.zh: 牧场主买了一头供后续育肥的幼牛，让它在春季牧场上放牧。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 祭台台面；祭坛的水平桌面（教会建筑用语，源于拉丁语）
rows.en: The restorer examined a crack in the stone mensa of the altar.
rows.zh: 修复师检查了祭坛石质台面上的一道裂缝。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 通过指定沟通渠道进行管理（本例为管理用语义）
rows.en: The report recommended channelization of requests through a single office.
rows.zh: 报告建议让各项请求经由一个统一办公室处理。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 爱占便宜的人；总想从别人那里白拿东西的人（非正式、贬义）
rows.en: He stopped inviting the moocher who never paid for a meal.
rows.zh: 他不再邀请那个吃饭从不付钱、总爱占便宜的人。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 便条；凭单；收据（主要用于英式英语，本例为收据义）
rows.en: The clerk gave her a chitty for the equipment she had returned.
rows.zh: 办事员给她开了一张已归还设备的收据。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 生物圈二号封闭居住实验的成员（本例为该项目的人员称谓）
rows.en: One biospherian recorded how the crops changed during the sealed experiment.
rows.zh: 一名生物圈二号实验成员记录了封闭实验期间作物的变化。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 格鲁克；作曲家 Christoph Willibald Gluck（本例为具名人物）
rows.en: The programme included an aria from an opera by Gluck.
rows.zh: 节目中包括了格鲁克一部歌剧里的咏叹调。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 可折叠的；能够折起来存放的
rows.en: The foldable chair fitted behind the wardrobe when it was not in use.
rows.zh: 这把折叠椅不用时可以收在衣柜后面。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 感官的；涉及或源于感觉的（本例为一般感官义）
rows.en: The workshop used sand, fabric and music to create a rich sensorial experience.
rows.zh: 工作坊利用沙子、织物和音乐营造丰富的感官体验。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 槲皮素；一种黄酮醇类化合物
rows.en: The analysis measured quercetin separately from its glycosides.
rows.zh: 这项分析分别测定了槲皮素及其糖苷。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 诉讼；请求法律救济的程序（法律用语，源于拉丁语）
rows.en: The clerk entered the causa in the court's register.
rows.zh: 书记员把这起诉讼登记在法院的登记簿上。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 分部；分项；某一部分的下级组成部分
rows.en: Each section of the manual contains several numbered subparts.
rows.zh: 手册的每一节都包含几个带编号的下级小节。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 分页器；沿穿孔线分开表格纸的设备（本例为纸张处理设备义）
rows.en: The burster separated the printed forms along their perforations.
rows.zh: 分页器沿着穿孔线将印好的表格纸分开。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 八位组；由八个二进制位组成的单位（本例为计算机义）
rows.en: In this format, the first octet records the message type.
rows.zh: 在这种格式中，第一个八位组记录消息类型。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 征税官员；负责征收税款的人
rows.en: The taxer faced protests when the new levy was announced.
rows.zh: 新税项宣布后，征税官员遭到了抗议。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 断层成像的；与获得内部截面图像有关的
rows.en: The team compared tomographic images taken before and after the procedure.
rows.zh: 团队比较了操作前后取得的断层图像。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 超级乐队；由原本已各自成名的音乐人组成的乐队（本例为音乐义）
rows.en: The guitarist formed a supergroup with musicians from three other bands.
rows.zh: 这位吉他手与来自另外三支乐队的音乐人组建了一支超级乐队。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 唇裂（旧称，现被视为冒犯；现代通常用 cleft lip）
rows.en: The old medical record used harelip where a modern report would say cleft lip.
rows.zh: 旧病历使用了 harelip 一词，现代报告则会使用 cleft lip（唇裂）。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 四面斜坡的（本例指四坡屋顶）
rows.en: The cottage had a hipped roof with no vertical gable ends.
rows.zh: 这间乡舍的屋顶四面倾斜，没有垂直的山墙端面。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 感质；某一种主观体验所特有的感受性质（qualia 的单数，哲学与心理学用语）
rows.en: The philosopher used the bitterness of coffee as an example of a quale.
rows.zh: 哲学家以咖啡的苦味作为一种感质的例子。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 淫猥；猥亵的言行或性质
rows.en: Several reviewers objected to the lewdness of the jokes in the performance.
rows.zh: 几位评论者反对演出中那些笑话的淫猥内容。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 频闪的；与周期性闪光有关的
rows.en: At one flash setting, the rotating blades appeared motionless in the stroboscopic light.
rows.zh: 在一种闪光设置下，旋转的叶片在频闪光照中看起来静止不动。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 淡水龟；本例指河栖的 Pseudemys concinna
rows.en: A cooter slid from the log into the river as we approached.
rows.zh: 我们走近时，一只河栖淡水龟从圆木上滑进了河里。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 鸨母；经营妓院的女人（旧式或文学用语，本例为经营者义）
rows.en: The play's bawd arranges meetings between wealthy clients and the women she controls.
rows.zh: 剧中的鸨母为富有的客人与她控制的女人安排会面。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 布卢姆；本例指计算机科学家 Manuel Blum
rows.en: The seminar discussed Blum's contributions to computational complexity.
rows.zh: 研讨课讨论了布卢姆对计算复杂性研究的贡献。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 文恩；本例指逻辑学家 John Venn，以文氏图著称
rows.en: Venn used overlapping circles to represent relations between sets.
rows.zh: 文恩用相互重叠的圆表示集合之间的关系。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 血管炎；血管发生炎症的一类病症
rows.en: The specialist explained which blood vessels were affected by the vasculitis.
rows.zh: 专科医生解释了哪些血管受到了血管炎的影响。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 德鲁兹教徒；德鲁兹宗教群体的成员
rows.en: My neighbour is a Druze who grew up in Lebanon.
rows.zh: 我的邻居是一名在黎巴嫩长大的德鲁兹教徒。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 指法谱；用指法位置等信息表示演奏方法的记谱法
rows.en: She read the guitar tablature rather than the staff notation.
rows.zh: 她读的是吉他指法谱，而不是五线谱。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 滴露；清洁和消毒用品品牌 Dettol
rows.en: The shop had sold out of the small bottles of Dettol.
rows.zh: 那家商店的小瓶装滴露已经售罄。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 润湿器；使物体湿润的装置（本例为信封封口用具义）
rows.en: The clerk pressed each envelope against the dampener before sealing it.
rows.zh: 办事员在封口前，把每个信封贴在润湿器上润湿。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 微生物群；本例指肠道中的细菌等微生物
rows.en: The study compared the intestinal microflora of the two groups.
rows.zh: 研究比较了两组的肠道微生物群。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 未清理的；尚未移除障碍物的（本例为路径义）
rows.en: The uncleared path was blocked by fallen branches.
rows.zh: 这条尚未清理的小路被掉落的树枝堵住了。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 叉子圆柏；沙地柏，Juniperus sabina（本例为植物义）
rows.en: The savin spread low across the rocky slope.
rows.zh: 那株叉子圆柏在多石的坡地上低矮地向四周伸展。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 超临界的；本例指流体处于超过其临界温度和临界压力的状态
rows.en: The study compared the solvent properties of liquid and supercritical carbon dioxide.
rows.zh: 这项研究比较了液态二氧化碳和超临界二氧化碳的溶剂性质。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 缺乏商业吸引力的；不利于商业成功的（本例为商业可行性义）
rows.en: The publisher admired the manuscript but considered its subject uncommercial.
rows.zh: 出版商欣赏这份书稿，却认为它的题材缺乏商业吸引力。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 虚己论的；与基督自我倒空的神学观念有关的（基督教神学用语）
rows.en: The seminar compared kenotic and non-kenotic accounts of the incarnation.
rows.zh: 研讨课比较了关于道成肉身的虚己论解释与不采用虚己论的解释。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 一钠的；在化学式中含一个钠原子的（化学用语）
rows.en: The label listed monosodium glutamate among the ingredients.
rows.zh: 标签将谷氨酸一钠列为一种配料。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 马尔堡病毒病（本例为疾病名称的简称）
rows.en: The briefing compared Marburg with other viral haemorrhagic fevers.
rows.zh: 情况介绍比较了马尔堡病毒病与其他病毒性出血热。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 顶嘴；无礼的回嘴（非正式用语）
rows.en: The teacher asked for an explanation, not backtalk.
rows.zh: 老师要求作出解释，而不是无礼地顶嘴。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 充电器；为可充电电池补充电能的装置
rows.en: The recharger stopped working after the cable came loose.
rows.zh: 电缆松脱后，充电器停止了工作。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 分配器；管理内存分配的程序对象（本例为 C++ 内存管理义）
rows.en: The custom allocator reserved memory for the new container.
rows.zh: 这个自定义分配器为新容器分配了内存。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 子状态机；供其他状态机引用的状态机（本例为 UML 建模义）
rows.en: The model reused the same submachine in two different states.
rows.zh: 这个模型在两个不同的状态中复用了同一个子状态机。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 精神贯注；精神分析理论中对某人、事物或观念的心理能量投入
rows.en: The analyst interpreted his attachment to the house as a strong cathexis.
rows.zh: 分析师将他对那所房子的依恋解释为强烈的精神贯注。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 下延笔画；小写字母伸到基线下方的部分（排印用语）
rows.en: The descender of the letter g dipped below the ruled line.
rows.zh: 字母 g 的下延笔画伸到了横线下方。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 蕴涵；前提为真时结论必定为真的逻辑关系（本例为逻辑义）
rows.en: The tutor used a counterexample to disprove the claimed entailment.
rows.zh: 导师用一个反例推翻了所声称的逻辑蕴涵关系。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 胸花；别在衣服扣眼或翻领上的花（本例为服饰义）
rows.en: He chose a blue ribbon to match the white boutonniere on his jacket.
rows.zh: 他选了一条蓝色缎带，来搭配夹克上的白色胸花。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 卡菲尔高粱；一种籽粒高粱（本例只选作物名称义）
rows.en: The trial compared kafir with two other grain sorghums.
rows.zh: 这项试验比较了卡菲尔高粱与另外两种籽粒高粱。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 四分位间的；位于上下四分位数之间的（本例用于 interquartile range，四分位距）
rows.en: The interquartile range was small even though one observation was unusually high.
rows.zh: 尽管有一个观测值异常偏高，四分位距仍然很小。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 伏打；意大利物理学家 Alessandro Volta（本例为具名人物）
rows.en: Volta's early battery is discussed in the museum guide.
rows.zh: 博物馆指南介绍了伏打的早期电池。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 一种地中海地区的刺柏属植物，Juniperus oxycedrus（本例为植物义）
rows.en: A mature cade shaded the stone wall at the edge of the garden.
rows.zh: 一株成年的 Juniperus oxycedrus 为花园边缘的石墙投下了阴影。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 涡轮喷气发动机；以涡轮驱动压气机的喷气发动机（本例为发动机义）
rows.en: The museum displayed a cutaway turbojet beside a diagram of its compressor.
rows.zh: 博物馆在一幅压气机示意图旁陈列了一台剖开的涡轮喷气发动机。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 麻风病患者（古旧称谓，现代宜使用 person with leprosy 等中性表达）
rows.en: A lazar appears briefly in the medieval tale, asking the travellers for food.
rows.zh: 那篇中世纪故事里，一名麻风病患者短暂出场，向旅人讨要食物。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 美狄亚，希腊神话中帮助伊阿宋取得金羊毛的科尔喀斯公主（Medea）
rows.en: The seminar compared the ways different plays portray Medea.
rows.zh: 研讨课比较了不同戏剧塑造美狄亚的方式。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 生物地球化学；研究生物过程与地球环境中化学物质循环关系的学科
rows.en: Her research in biogeochemistry tracks how carbon moves between soil, plants and the atmosphere.
rows.zh: 她的生物地球化学研究追踪碳如何在土壤、植物和大气之间迁移。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 重新进入；再次参加（本例为再次进入场所义）
rows.en: After the alarm stopped, staff were allowed to reenter the building.
rows.zh: 警报停止后，工作人员获准重新进入大楼。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 契据；法律文书；法律事实（旧法律用语）
rows.en: The archivist placed the damaged fait between two sheets of protective paper.
rows.zh: 档案员把那份受损的契据夹在两张保护纸之间。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 糟蹋；劣化；使原有事物的品质败坏（本例为改编作品义）
rows.en: Fans criticised the film as a bastardization of the original novel.
rows.zh: 影迷批评这部电影糟蹋了原著小说。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 愚蠢可憎的（冒犯性用语；本例仅转述并反对这种辱骂）
rows.en: The reviewer called the proposal cretinous, a description the chair rejected as insulting.
rows.zh: 评审者把这项提案骂作愚蠢可憎，主席认为这种说法具有侮辱性，表示反对。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 飞球接力赛；犬只跨越障碍、取球返回的团队接力运动（本例义）
rows.en: The club added a second flyball team after more dogs completed training.
rows.zh: 更多狗完成训练后，俱乐部又组建了一支飞球接力赛队伍。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 无人值守的；尤指信标等自动装置无人现场看管的
rows.en: The unwatched beacon continued sending its signal through the night.
rows.zh: 这座无人值守的信标整夜持续发出信号。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 替代性的；起代替作用的
rows.en: The agreement allowed a substitutionary payment when delivery was impossible.
rows.zh: 协议允许在无法交货时以付款作为替代。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 政策制定；决定、拟订政策的活动，而非制定政策的人
rows.en: Local residents were invited to take part in policymaking on public transport.
rows.zh: 当地居民受邀参与公共交通政策的制定。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 向内生长；长入（罕用，不及物）
rows.en: The narrow gaps allowed roots to ingrow between the stones.
rows.zh: 那些狭窄的缝隙使根能够长入石块之间。
rows.author: role

rows.meaningZh: 非婚生身份（旧时法律及历史用语，含歧视色彩；用于理解历史文献）
rows.en: The historian studied how bastardy affected inheritance in the period.
rows.zh: 这位历史学者研究了那个时期非婚生身份对继承的影响。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 轻质石油溶剂；从石油得到的易挥发烃类混合物，不是纯苯
rows.en: The laboratory stored the benzine in a cabinet for flammable liquids.
rows.zh: 实验室把这种轻质石油溶剂存放在易燃液体储存柜里。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 布鲁克（Tony Brooker，开发早期Autocode语言的计算机科学家）
rows.en: Brooker's work on Autocode is discussed in the chapter on early programming languages.
rows.zh: 讨论早期编程语言的那一章介绍了布鲁克在Autocode方面的工作。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: out of的非正式语音拼写，常用于口语对白；本例表示没有、用完
rows.en: "We're outa milk again," he called from the kitchen.
rows.zh: “我们又没牛奶了，”他在厨房里喊道。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 重新交付委员会审议；把法案交回原委员会处理的程序（本例义）
rows.en: The motion called for recommitment of the bill to the committee for further review.
rows.zh: 该动议要求将法案重新交回委员会，作进一步审议。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 盖博（Dennis Gabor；这里指研究全息技术的物理学家）
rows.en: The exhibition explains how Gabor developed the idea of holography.
rows.zh: 这场展览介绍了盖博如何发展出全息技术的构想。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 红陶；以红色黏土烧制的陶器（本例义，不与紫砂完全等同）
rows.en: The redware jug had a small chip along its rim.
rows.zh: 那只红陶壶的壶口边缘有一处小缺口。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 手性；物体或原子空间排列不能与其镜像重合的几何性质
rows.en: The exercise used left- and right-handed molecular models to illustrate chirality.
rows.zh: 这项练习用互为左右手关系的分子模型来说明手性。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 富营养的；指水体营养盐丰富、生物生产力高的（本例为生态学义）
rows.en: The survey classified the shallow lake as eutrophic because of its high nutrient levels.
rows.zh: 由于营养盐含量高，这次调查把该浅水湖划为富营养型湖泊。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 低语般的细微声响；沙沙声、窃窃声（本例为一般声音义）
rows.en: A soft susurration of leaves filled the garden as the breeze returned.
rows.zh: 微风再次吹来，花园里响起树叶轻柔的沙沙声。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 双膦酸盐；可抑制骨吸收、用于某些骨相关疾病的一类药物或物质
rows.en: The pharmacist explained why the prescribed bisphosphonate was being used to slow bone loss.
rows.zh: 药剂师解释了为何要使用所开的双膦酸盐药物来减缓骨质流失。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 变形宽银幕的；涉及对影像进行不同比例光学压缩的（本例为摄影义）
rows.en: The crew chose an anamorphic lens for the wide-screen scene.
rows.zh: 摄制组选用了变形宽银幕镜头来拍摄这个宽画幅场景。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 非国有化；把国有企业或资产转为私有的过程（本例义）
rows.en: The proposal for denationalization would transfer the airline to private ownership.
rows.zh: 这项非国有化提案将把该航空公司转为私有。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 可评估的；能够按一定标准进行评价的（本例为一般评价义）
rows.en: All twenty projects were evaluable under the same published criteria.
rows.zh: 这二十个项目都可以按照同一套已公布的标准进行评估。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 寻求普遍规律的；着眼于跨个体共同原则的（本例为研究方法义）
rows.en: Her nomothetic approach looked for patterns shared across many communities.
rows.zh: 她采用寻求普遍规律的方法，寻找许多社群共有的模式。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 卡尔曼（Rudolf Kalman，与状态估计和卡尔曼滤波研究相关的数学家）
rows.en: The lecture traced Kalman's contribution to modern state estimation.
rows.zh: 这堂课回顾了卡尔曼对现代状态估计的贡献。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 可信性；值得相信或接受的性质（较少见的名词）
rows.en: The committee questioned the creditability of the anonymous account.
rows.zh: 委员会质疑那份匿名叙述的可信性。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 昂丹司琼；用于预防某些治疗或手术相关恶心、呕吐的止吐药通用名
rows.en: The nurse checked the ondansetron order before giving the patient the anti-nausea medicine.
rows.zh: 护士在给病人使用止吐药之前，核对了昂丹司琼的医嘱。
rows.author: root

rows.meaningZh: 金合欢胶；阿拉伯胶（旧称）
rows.en: The printer weighed the acacin before adding it to the ink mixture.
rows.zh: 印刷工把金合欢胶称重后，才加入油墨混合物。

rows.en: The pathologist distinguished acephalism from incomplete development of the skull.

rows.en: The description of acephalostomia noted a mouth-like opening at the upper end of the trunk.

rows.en: The pharmacist prepared an acerotous ointment because the formula called for no wax.

rows.meaningZh: 5α-雄甾烷-3,17-二酮的别名（本例PubChem所记化合物）
rows.en: The table records androstanedion as a synonym of 5-alpha-androstane-3,17-dione.
rows.zh: 表格将androstanedion记为5α-雄甾烷-3,17-二酮的同义名称。
rows.author: d38_source_author_resume

rows.meaningZh: 阳极电紧张的（生理学用语）
rows.en: The diagram marks an anelectrotonic region near the anode.
rows.zh: 示意图在阳极附近标出了一个阳极电紧张区域。
rows.author: d38_source_author_resume

rows.meaningZh: 吸入疗法（历史医学用语）
rows.en: The old handbook classified treatment by inhalation as anemopathy.
rows.zh: 旧手册把吸入治疗归为anemopathy。
rows.author: d38_source_author_resume

rows.meaningZh: 血液生成不足所致的贫血（旧医学用语）
rows.en: The historical text discusses anemotrophy as anaemia caused by inadequate blood formation.
rows.zh: 历史文献将anemotrophy描述为血液生成不足所致的贫血。
rows.author: d38_source_author_resume

rows.meaningZh: 血液中水分不足（旧医学用语）
rows.en: The historical dictionary used anemydria for a deficiency of water in the blood.
rows.zh: 这部历史词典用anemydria指血液中水分不足。
rows.author: d38_source_author_resume

rows.meaningZh: 血液计数中嗜酸性粒细胞缺如（所引研究指计数为零）
rows.en: The report used aneosinophilia for a zero eosinophil count.
rows.zh: 报告用aneosinophilia表示嗜酸性粒细胞计数为零。
rows.author: d38_source_author_resume

rows.meaningZh: 兴奋性不足（旧医学用语，相当于inirritabilitas）
rows.en: The historical lexicon describes anerethisia as deficient physiological irritability.
rows.zh: 这部历史词典把anerethisia描述为生理兴奋性不足。
rows.author: d38_source_author_resume

rows.meaningZh: 功能活动缺失（旧医学术语）
rows.en: The case notes recorded anergasia in the affected tissue despite repeated stimulation.
rows.zh: 病历记载，受影响的组织尽管受到反复刺激，仍缺乏功能活动。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 器质性精神障碍的；与器质性缺损相关的（历史精神病学分类用语）
rows.en: The lecturer placed anergastic reactions in the organic-defect category of the historical classification.
rows.zh: 讲师把这套历史分类中的anergastic反应归入器质性缺损一类。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: Anesin；一种含氯丁醇的溶液的历史商品名（并非单指纯氯丁醇）
rows.en: A faded label identified the solution in the bottle as Anesin.
rows.zh: 一张褪色的标签标明，瓶中的溶液是Anesin。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 抑动情性黄体内分泌物的旧称（采用1932年文献的历史用法，不作为现代激素身份鉴定）
rows.en: The 1932 account described anestrin as a luteal secretion acting in opposition to the follicular hormone.
rows.zh: 1932年的那份论述把anestrin描述为与卵泡激素作用相反的黄体内分泌物。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 道德抑制缺乏；缺少伦理或道德约束的状态（旧心理学术语）
rows.en: The essay questioned whether anethopathy was a useful clinical concept or chiefly a moral judgment.
rows.zh: 这篇文章质疑，道德抑制缺乏究竟是有用的临床概念，还是主要属于道德判断。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 起缓和、安抚或镇痛作用的（旧医学用语）
rows.en: The physician described the preparation as anetic, intended to soothe the patient's discomfort.
rows.zh: 医生把这种制剂描述为具有缓和作用，意在减轻患者的不适。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 被包被的子实层在腔内发育成熟、随后包被破裂而暴露的真菌发育方式（angiocarpy）
rows.en: The lecture used a sequence of fungal sections to show the enclosed stages of angiocarpy.
rows.zh: 讲课时用一系列真菌切片展示了子实层包被内发育的各个阶段。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 毛细血管扩张型皮肤结节病斑块；angiolupoid（旧称，现归入皮肤结节病的一种表现）
rows.en: The dermatologist photographed the angiolupoid on the patient's forehead before writing the case report.
rows.zh: 皮肤科医生在撰写病例报告前，拍下了患者前额的毛细血管扩张型结节病斑块。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 血管或淋巴管疾病的旧统称（angiosis）
rows.en: The index used angiosis as a broad heading for diseases of blood vessels and lymphatic vessels.
rows.zh: 索引用angiosis作为血管和淋巴管疾病的宽泛分类标题。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: Angiostomidae科；曾用于包含Angiostoma、Strongyloides等线虫的一种历史科级分类
rows.en: The museum's catalogue retained Angiostomidae as the family name used in the original study.
rows.zh: 博物馆的目录保留了原研究所用的Angiostomidae这一科名。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 使血管壁张力增强的（生理学用语）
rows.en: The experiment compared the angiotonic effects of the two extracts on isolated blood vessels.
rows.zh: 实验比较了两种提取物对离体血管产生的增强管壁张力作用。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 下反角；飞机机翼自翼根向翼尖下倾的角度（航空义）
rows.en: Viewed from the front, the model's anhedral was clearly visible.
rows.zh: 从正面看，模型机翼的下反角清晰可见。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 安徽紫草乌碱甲；anhweiaconitine，一种最初从安徽产紫草乌根中分离出的生物碱
rows.en: The chemist compared the new sample's spectrum with the reference data for anhweiaconitine.
rows.zh: 化学家把新样品的谱图与安徽紫草乌碱甲的参考数据进行了比较。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 未水合状态（anhydration的一个旧医学用法）
rows.en: The report distinguished anhydration from the later uptake of water by the material.
rows.zh: 报告将该材料尚未水合的状态与其后吸收水分的过程区分开来。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 观念活动缺乏；缺少思维观念（旧心理学用语，并非缺少人生理想）
rows.en: The seminar discussed anideation as a disturbance of thinking.
rows.zh: 研讨课把观念活动缺乏作为一种思维障碍来讨论。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: anil-quinoline；带有anil亚胺基团的喹啉类化合物（历史化学文献用法）
rows.en: An anil-quinoline derivative was set aside for further spectral analysis.
rows.zh: 一种带有anil亚胺基团的喹啉衍生物被留作进一步谱图分析。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 易被苯胺染料染色的；嗜苯胺染料的（组织学用语）
rows.en: The pathologist chose an aniline stain to reveal the anilinophil structures.
rows.zh: 病理学家选择了一种苯胺染料，以显示那些易被这类染料着色的结构。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 对甲氧基苯基丙酮；1-(4-methoxyphenyl)propan-2-one（anisacetone）
rows.en: The analyst checked the chromatogram for a small peak corresponding to anisacetone.
rows.zh: 分析人员查看色谱图，寻找对应于对甲氧基苯基丙酮的小峰。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 时间间隔不相等的；不等时的（本例信号时序义）
rows.en: The receiver logged the anisochronous pulses with a separate timestamp for each arrival.
rows.zh: 接收器为每个到达的脉冲单独记录时间戳，记下了这些间隔不等的脉冲。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 脉搏快速且快慢不匀的（旧医学形容词）
rows.en: The old case notes describe an anisotachys pulse that varied from one minute to the next.
rows.zh: 旧病历描述了一种快速且快慢不匀的脉搏，其速率每分钟都在变化。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: anisyl；曾被假定存在于茴香及其衍生物中的基团的旧称（采用1900年Gould词典用法）
rows.en: In the old glossary, anisyl is treated as a hypothetical radical rather than an isolated substance.
rows.zh: 旧词汇表把anisyl视为一种假定基团，而非已分离出的物质。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 二水硫酸钙的一种名称（annaline；此处采用新西兰EPA化学品名录用法）
rows.en: The inventory listed annaline under the entry for calcium sulfate dihydrate.
rows.zh: 名录把annaline列在二水硫酸钙的条目下。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 胭脂树橙色素；从Bixa orellana种子取得的色素（annato，annatto的一种写法）
rows.en: The cheese maker added annato to give the batch a warmer orange colour.
rows.zh: 制酪师加入胭脂树橙色素，使这批奶酪呈现出更暖的橙色。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 增环反应；向已有分子稠合一个新环的反应（annulation的另一用语）
rows.en: The proposed annelation would add a second ring to the starting molecule.
rows.zh: 所提出的增环反应将为起始分子再稠合一个环。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: annerdite；samarskite与columbite平行连生混合物的一种旧名称（USGS历史用法）
rows.en: The curator checked the old annerdite label against the catalogue's description of intergrown minerals.
rows.zh: 馆员对照目录中对连生矿物的描述，核查了旧的annerdite标签。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 子宫附件炎；卵巢、输卵管等子宫附件的炎症（annexitis）
rows.en: The case report noted annexitis involving the left ovary and fallopian tube.
rows.zh: 病例报告记载了累及左侧卵巢和输卵管的子宫附件炎。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 碘化百里香酚（dithymol diiodide，Aristol）的一种旧称
rows.en: The pharmacist found annidalin listed among the antiseptics in an old stock book.
rows.zh: 药剂师在一本旧库存簿中发现，annidalin被列在防腐消毒剂之中。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 经年石松宁；annotinine，一种石松类生物碱
rows.en: The team reserved a portion of the annotinine sample for structural analysis.
rows.zh: 研究团队留出一部分经年石松宁样品，用于结构分析。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 胭脂树橙色素；annatto的一种历史写法（annotta）
rows.en: The textile conservator identified annotta as the dye named in the faded recipe.
rows.zh: 纺织品修复人员认出，褪色配方里记载的染料annotta就是胭脂树橙色素。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 胭脂树橙色素；用胭脂树种子表面色素层制成的染料（annotto）
rows.en: A little annotto gave the butter a deeper yellow colour.
rows.zh: 少量胭脂树橙色素使黄油呈现出更浓的黄色。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 爱戏弄他人、惹人烦的人（本例指人）
rows.en: The office annoyer kept hiding people's mugs until everyone lost patience with him.
rows.zh: 办公室里那个爱捉弄人的家伙总把别人的杯子藏起来，直到大家都对他失去了耐心。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 环斑病毒科；按植物病症划分病毒时采用的一种历史科名（Annulaceae）
rows.en: The old chart grouped tobacco ringspot virus under Annulaceae.
rows.zh: 那张旧分类表把烟草环斑病毒归入了历史分类中的环斑病毒科。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 环螺旋状的（本例形容肌梭的感觉神经末梢）
rows.en: The drawing shows an annulo-spiral nerve ending wrapped around the central region of a muscle spindle.
rows.zh: 图中画出一个环螺旋状神经末梢，缠绕在肌梭的中央区域。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 有环的；身体由环状节段组成的（本例形态学义）
rows.en: The student drew the worm's annulose body before adding the finer details.
rows.zh: 学生先画出蠕虫环节状的身体，然后补上更细致的部分。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: Anobiidae科；甲虫的一种历史科级分类名称
rows.en: The curator filed the beetle under Anobiidae in the older collection catalogue.
rows.zh: 馆员在较早的藏品目录中，把这只甲虫归在Anobiidae科之下。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 催吐的；引起呕吐的（旧医学形容词）
rows.en: The old formulary classified the preparation as anocathartic rather than as a sedative.
rows.zh: 旧处方集把这种制剂归为催吐制剂，而不是镇静剂。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 在胸部或上腹部相连的（描述联体形态的旧术语）
rows.en: The diagram shows an anoceliadelphous pair joined across the upper abdomen.
rows.zh: 示意图画出了一对在上腹部相连的个体。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛门与尾骨的；涉及肛门和尾骨两者的
rows.en: The anatomy model marked the anococcygeal ligament in blue.
rows.zh: 解剖模型用蓝色标出了肛尾韧带。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛管皮肤上皮；肛管齿状线以下的上皮组织（anoderm）
rows.en: The small tear was confined to the anoderm.
rows.zh: 这处小裂口仅限于肛管的皮肤上皮。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 嗅觉缺失；anosmia的一种旧称（anodmia）
rows.en: Her anodmia persisted after the other symptoms had faded.
rows.zh: 其他症状消退后，她的嗅觉缺失仍然持续。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 先天性无牙症；因牙齿未发育而导致全部牙齿缺失
rows.en: The dentist explained how anodontia differs from losing teeth later in life.
rows.zh: 牙医解释了先天性无牙症与后天掉牙的区别。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 先天性无牙症；anodontia的同义用语（anodontism）
rows.en: Anodontism was recorded in the family history, so the dentist asked about relatives with congenitally missing teeth.
rows.zh: 家族史中记载了先天性无牙症，因此牙医询问了亲属中先天缺牙的情况。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 氯乙烷的一种名称（anodynon；CAS75-00-3）
rows.en: The chemical index cross-referenced anodynon to ethyl chloride.
rows.zh: 化学索引把anodynon交叉指引至氯乙烷。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: 不包含自觉认知内容的；无意识到自己正在知晓或记忆的（本例意识研究义）
rows.en: The researcher distinguished an anoetic response from a consciously recalled memory.
rows.zh: 研究者将一种不包含自觉认知内容的反应与有意识回想起的记忆区分开来。
rows.author: role original author
rows.originalReviewer: root independent reader; different from Role original author

rows.meaningZh: anoia；曾用于描述严重理解能力缺失的旧医学术语
rows.en: The editor replaced the obsolete label anoia with a more precise description of the person's difficulties.
rows.zh: 编辑用更准确的文字描述此人的困难，替换了anoia这个过时标签。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 对丙烯基苯酚（anol；p-propenylphenol）
rows.en: The chemist measured how anol behaved in solutions of different acidity.
rows.zh: 化学家测量了对丙烯基苯酚在不同酸度溶液中的表现。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: anolobine；一种阿朴啡型生物碱（此处对应FDA登记的(-)-anolobine）
rows.en: Only a few milligrams of anolobine remained for the final analysis.
rows.zh: 只剩几毫克anolobine可供最后的分析。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 异常三色视觉；三类视锥细胞仍存在、其中一类颜色敏感性异常的一种色觉异常（anomalopia）
rows.en: The colour-matching test revealed anomalopia even though she could still distinguish many colours.
rows.zh: 尽管她仍能分辨许多颜色，颜色匹配测试还是显示出异常三色视觉。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 异齿类；兽孔类中的一类化石动物（Anomodontia）
rows.en: The fossil display placed Anomodontia among the major groups of therapsids.
rows.zh: 化石展览把异齿类列为兽孔类的主要类群之一。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 无肩的（旧形态学用语）
rows.en: An anomous fetus was illustrated in the chapter on rare congenital malformations.
rows.zh: 讲述罕见先天畸形的章节中画有一个无肩胎体。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: anonaceine；早期文献报道从Xylopia aethiopica果实中取得的一种生物碱
rows.en: The review traced reports of anonaceine back to early work on Xylopia fruits.
rows.zh: 这篇综述把有关anonaceine的报道追溯到早期对Xylopia属植物果实的研究。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 番荔枝碱；一种阿朴啡型生物碱（anonaine）
rows.en: The laboratory compared the anonaine sample with a separately stored reference standard.
rows.zh: 实验室把番荔枝碱样品与单独存放的参考标准品作了比较。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 环己酮的一种名称（anone；CAS108-94-1）
rows.en: The solvent analysis found anone but no cyclohexanol in the sample.
rows.zh: 溶剂分析在样品中检出了环己酮，没有检出环己醇。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 无甲症；指甲或趾甲缺如
rows.en: The report documented anonychia affecting several fingers.
rows.zh: 报告记载了累及数个手指的无甲症。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 上斜视；眼球向上偏斜（anoopsia的旧用法）
rows.en: The old ophthalmic record described the upward deviation of one eye as anoopsia.
rows.zh: 旧眼科病历把一眼向上偏斜的情况记为上斜视。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 杀按蚊剂；能够杀灭按蚊的物质（anophelicide）
rows.en: The trial compared the new anophelicide with an untreated control.
rows.zh: 试验将这种新杀按蚊剂与未经处理的对照组作了比较。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 先天性无眼；出生时一眼或双眼缺如（anophthalmia）
rows.en: The specialist explained the diagnosis of unilateral anophthalmia to the baby's parents.
rows.zh: 专科医生向婴儿的父母解释了单侧先天性无眼的诊断。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 先天性眼球缺如（anophthalmus；本例指病况）
rows.en: The embryology seminar included a case of congenital anophthalmus affecting only one eye.
rows.zh: 胚胎学研讨课讨论了一例仅累及一眼的先天性眼球缺如病例。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 失明；视觉缺失（anopia的一个义项）
rows.en: His anopia prevented him from reading the printed notice without assistance.
rows.zh: 由于失明，他无法在无人帮助的情况下阅读那张印刷通知。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛门成形术；修复或形成肛门开口的手术
rows.en: The surgeon discussed the planned anoplasty with the child's parents.
rows.zh: 外科医生与孩子的父母讨论了拟进行的肛门成形术。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 裸头绦虫属（Anoplocephala）
rows.en: The veterinary guide included Anoplocephala among the tapeworm genera found in horses.
rows.zh: 兽医指南把裸头绦虫属列入可见于马体内的绦虫属。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 裸头绦虫科（Anoplocephalidae）
rows.en: The taxonomic table placed the specimen in Anoplocephalidae.
rows.zh: 分类表把该标本归入了裸头绦虫科。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: Anoplopoma属；包括sablefish（黑鳕）的一属鱼类
rows.en: The catalogue gave Anoplopoma as the genus of the sablefish specimen.
rows.zh: 目录把这件黑鳕标本的属名记为Anoplopoma。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 吸虱类；吸食哺乳动物血液的虱类分类群（Anoplura）
rows.en: The entomology practical used a separate key to identify specimens of Anoplura.
rows.zh: 昆虫学实习课用一份专门的检索表鉴定吸虱类标本。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 视力缺失或受抑制（anopsia的一个义项）
rows.en: The ophthalmologist recorded anopsia in the affected part of the visual field.
rows.zh: 眼科医生记录了受影响视野区域的视觉缺失。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛门与耻骨的；涉及两者的
rows.en: The trainee marked the anopubic distance on the pelvic diagram.
rows.zh: 实习生在骨盆示意图上标出了肛门至耻骨的距离。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 无睾丸的；睾丸组织缺如的（本例形容病况）
rows.en: The study distinguished anorchid patients from those whose testes had failed to descend.
rows.zh: 研究把睾丸缺如的患者与睾丸未下降的患者区分开来。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 无睾丸的（anorchidic；本例形容实验动物）
rows.en: The study compared anorchidic mice with an untreated control group.
rows.zh: 研究将无睾小鼠与未经处理的对照组作了比较。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 食欲抑制剂；使食欲降低的药物（anoretic）
rows.en: The review discussed the risks associated with each anoretic.
rows.zh: 综述讨论了每一种食欲抑制剂所涉及的风险。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 不含器官的（采用旧生物学用法的anorganic）
rows.en: The old text called the simple tissue anorganic because it contained no distinct organs.
rows.zh: 旧文献称这种简单组织为无器官的，因为其中没有独立的器官。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 无机结构学；研究无机结构的学科（旧用语）
rows.en: His notes on anorganology included sketches of mineral crystal forms.
rows.zh: 他的无机结构学笔记中画有矿物晶形的草图。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 性高潮缺失；无法达到性高潮（anorgasmy）
rows.en: She raised her concerns about anorgasmy during the consultation.
rows.zh: 她在就诊时谈到了自己对性高潮缺失的担忧。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 不伴性高潮的；未达到性高潮的（anorgastic）
rows.en: The questionnaire recorded whether the sexual experiences had been anorgastic.
rows.zh: 问卷记录了这些性生活经历是否没有达到性高潮。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 反常的；不符合常态或规则的（anormal，旧用语）
rows.en: The nineteenth-century report described the plant's growth as anormal.
rows.zh: 十九世纪的那份报告把这种植物的生长描述为异常。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 浆液分泌不足；浆液性物质分泌减少（旧医学术语）
rows.en: The pathologist used anorrhorrhea to describe the gland's diminished serous secretion.
rows.zh: 病理学家把该腺体浆液分泌减少的情况记为anorrhorrhea。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 歪长石；钠、钾、铝硅酸盐长石矿物（anorthoclase）
rows.en: The thin section contained several grains of anorthoclase.
rows.zh: 薄片中含有几颗歪长石颗粒。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 视物变形；直线看起来弯曲的视觉异常（anorthopia的一个义项）
rows.en: Because of anorthopia, the straight edge of the door appeared bent to him.
rows.zh: 由于视物变形，他看见门的直边像是弯曲的。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 利用旋转圆盘使变形图案显现为可辨认图像的一种光学装置（anorthoscope）
rows.en: Visitors turned the anorthoscope and watched the distorted drawing resolve into a recognizable picture.
rows.zh: 参观者转动这台光学装置，看着变形图案显现为可以辨认的图像。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 勃起能力缺失或障碍（anorthosis的一种旧医学用法）
rows.en: The old medical index placed anorthosis among disorders of erectile function.
rows.zh: 旧医学索引把anorthosis列在勃起功能障碍一类。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛门镜检查；利用肛门镜观察肛门及直肠下部的检查
rows.en: The clinic sent her an information sheet about anoscopy before the appointment.
rows.zh: 就诊前，诊所寄给她一份有关肛门镜检查的说明单。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛门、直肠及乙状结肠内镜检查的
rows.en: The anosigmoidoscopic report described a small inflamed area in the rectum.
rows.zh: 肛门直肠乙状结肠内镜检查报告描述了直肠内一小片发炎区域。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛门、直肠及乙状结肠内镜检查
rows.en: She asked whether sedation would be needed for the anosigmoidoscopy.
rows.zh: 她询问这次肛门直肠乙状结肠内镜检查是否需要镇静。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 病觉淡漠；对自身疾病漠不关心
rows.en: Although he acknowledged the paralysis, his lack of concern suggested anosodiaphoria.
rows.zh: 虽然他承认自己有瘫痪，但他对此漠不关心，表现出病觉淡漠的迹象。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 疾病失认症；对自身疾病或病损缺乏认识
rows.en: Because of anosognosia, he insisted that his weak left arm was working normally.
rows.zh: 由于疾病失认症，他坚称自己无力的左臂功能一切正常。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 嗅觉缺失（旧医用名词）
rows.en: After the injury, anosphrasia left her unable to detect the scent of coffee.
rows.zh: 受伤后，她因嗅觉缺失而闻不到咖啡的香气。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛门脊髓的；与控制肛门括约肌的脊髓中枢有关的
rows.en: The lecture linked the anospinal center with control of the anal sphincter.
rows.zh: 讲座将肛门脊髓中枢与肛门括约肌的控制联系起来。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 骨形成不全；骨骼发育不良（旧医用名词）
rows.en: Anosteoplasia had left several bones of the limb poorly developed.
rows.zh: 骨形成不全使这条肢体的多块骨骼发育欠佳。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 骨发育不全；骨化不全（旧医用名词）
rows.en: Radiographs showed anostosis in several bones of the developing limb.
rows.zh: X线片显示，正在发育的肢体有多块骨骼骨化不全。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 无耳畸形；先天性耳廓缺如
rows.en: The specialist explained that anotia meant the baby's external ear had not formed.
rows.zh: 专科医生解释说，无耳畸形意味着婴儿的外耳没有发育形成。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: Anotron：一种历史辉光放电整流管的名称，无加热灯丝
rows.en: The restorer found an Anotron in the power supply of the old radio.
rows.zh: 修复师在那台旧收音机的电源装置中发现了一支 Anotron 整流管。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 无耳畸形个体（旧胚胎学名词）
rows.en: The nineteenth-century specimen register described an earless fetus as an anotus.
rows.zh: 那份十九世纪标本登记册把一个无耳胎儿记作无耳畸形个体。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 卵巢缺失；卵巢缺如（旧医用名词）
rows.en: The examination confirmed anovaria rather than merely inactive ovaries.
rows.zh: 检查证实是卵巢缺失，而不只是卵巢活动不足。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 卵巢缺失；卵巢缺如（旧医用名词）
rows.en: The pathology report recorded anovarism in the young heifer.
rows.zh: 病理报告记载这头小母牛存在卵巢缺失。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 肛门和膀胱的；同时涉及肛门与膀胱的
rows.en: The diagram marks the anovesical fistula with a red arrow.
rows.zh: 图中用红色箭头标出了肛门膀胱瘘。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 不排卵的；未伴有排卵的
rows.en: The veterinarian found that the cow was still anovular several weeks after calving.
rows.zh: 兽医发现，这头奶牛在产犊数周后仍未排卵。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 无排卵的；未伴有排卵的
rows.en: A menstrual cycle can be anovulatory even when bleeding occurs.
rows.zh: 即使出现出血，一个月经周期也可能没有排卵。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 光电血氧计（一种历史仪器）
rows.en: The anoxia photometer was clipped to the volunteer's ear before the breathing test.
rows.zh: 呼吸测试前，光电血氧计被夹在志愿者的耳部。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 醋酸不溶性蛋白成分（Le Conte 旧分类中的名称）
rows.en: In Le Conte's terminology, the fraction left undissolved in glacial acetic acid was called anoxoluin.
rows.zh: 按勒孔特的术语，未溶于冰醋酸的那部分称为醋酸不溶性蛋白成分。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 醋酸不溶性蛋白成分（旧称，与 anoxoluin 并列记载）
rows.en: The old analysis distinguished anoxolyin from the acid-soluble fraction.
rows.zh: 那项旧分析把醋酸不溶性蛋白成分与酸溶性部分区分开来。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 生长或代谢不利用分子氧的
rows.en: The anoxybiontic organisms grew in the sealed culture without consuming molecular oxygen.
rows.zh: 这些不利用分子氧的生物在密封培养物中生长，没有消耗分子氧。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 袢；环状结构（ansa 的复数，解剖学）
rows.en: On the enlarged drawing, the ansae appear as small connecting loops between the nerves.
rows.zh: 在放大图上，可以看到神经之间呈小环状的连接袢。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 袢状的；环袢形的
rows.en: The sketch shows an ansiform channel rather than a straight one.
rows.zh: 草图显示的是一条环袢形通道，而不是一条直通道。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: Ansolysen：酒石酸喷托铵制剂的旧商品名，一种神经节阻断药
rows.en: The pharmacy archive preserves a 1950s leaflet advertising Ansolysen.
rows.zh: 药房档案保存着一份二十世纪五十年代宣传 Ansolysen 的传单。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 电子设备发出的应答信息；识别应答
rows.en: The terminal displayed its answerback when the operator requested identification.
rows.zh: 操作员请求识别信息时，终端显示了应答信息。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 糖酸钙（葡糖二酸钙）的别名（Antacidin；本例采用现代化学名称义）
rows.en: The pharmacist checked the jar of antacidin against the stock list.
rows.zh: 药剂师对照库存清单核查了那瓶糖酸钙。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: antacidine；历史词典记作 calcium saccharate 的旧制剂名（具体现代化学身份未核定）
rows.en: The old invoice lists antacidine separately from sodium bicarbonate.
rows.zh: 旧发票把名为 antacidine 的制剂与碳酸氢钠分开列出。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 咬合；上下牙的接触或对合（旧牙科用语）
rows.en: The dentist checked the antagonization of the artificial teeth before finishing the denture.
rows.zh: 牙医在完成假牙前检查了人工牙的咬合情况。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 挑衅者；激起他人敌意的人
rows.en: Every discussion turned sour when the group's habitual antagonizer began mocking the others.
rows.zh: 每当组里那个惯于挑衅的人开始嘲笑别人，讨论就会变得不愉快。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 止痛的；缓解疼痛的（旧医用语）
rows.en: The trial compared the antalgesic effects of the two preparations.
rows.zh: 试验比较了这两种制剂的止痛效果。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 止痛药类（旧医药分类名，复数）
rows.en: The physician grouped the pain-relieving medicines under antalgica in his notes.
rows.zh: 这位医生在笔记中把缓解疼痛的药物归在 antalgica 一类。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 抑制性欲的（旧医用语）
rows.en: The review found little evidence for the herb's supposed antaphroditic action.
rows.zh: 综述发现，几乎没有证据支持这种草药所谓的抑制性欲作用。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 据称可预防或缓解中风的（旧医用语）
rows.en: The advertisement praised the mixture's antapoplectic properties.
rows.zh: 广告宣称这种混合物具有预防或缓解中风的功效。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 恢复体力的；减轻衰弱的（旧医用语）
rows.en: The spa brochure promised an antasthenic effect from the mineral baths.
rows.zh: 温泉宣传册声称矿泉浴能恢复体力。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 安他唑啉；一种组胺 H1 受体拮抗剂
rows.en: The laboratory used antazoline as a reference compound in the receptor assay.
rows.zh: 实验室在受体测定中使用安他唑啉作为参比化合物。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 接见室前的等候室；前厅
rows.en: Visitors waited in the antechamber while the meeting ran late.
rows.zh: 会议延长了时间，来访者在前厅等候。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 发热前的；发热前期的
rows.en: The patient's diary described chills during the antefebrile period.
rows.zh: 病人的日记记述了发热前期出现的寒战。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 垂体前叶；腺垂体
rows.en: The image shows the antehypophysis in front of the posterior pituitary lobe.
rows.zh: 图像显示，垂体前叶位于垂体后叶的前方。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 止吐药；缓解恶心和呕吐的药物（旧称）
rows.en: She asked the nurse whether an antemetic could help with the nausea.
rows.zh: 她询问护士，止吐药能否帮助缓解恶心。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 天线与振荡器一体化的低功率发射装置
rows.en: The compact radio used an antennamitter to keep the antenna and oscillator in one assembly.
rows.zh: 这台小型无线电设备使用天线振荡一体发射装置，将天线和振荡器集成在一个组件中。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 防治梦魇的（旧医用语）
rows.en: The old herbal listed the infusion as an antephialtic remedy.
rows.zh: 那本旧草药书把这种浸剂列为防治梦魇的药物。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 垂体前叶的；与垂体前叶有关的
rows.en: Our endocrinology seminar covers disorders of antepituitary hormone secretion.
rows.zh: 我们的内分泌学研讨课涉及垂体前叶激素分泌紊乱。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 前置；把通常应居后的词放在另一词前面（语法）
rows.en: The translation preserves the unusual anteposition of the adjective.
rows.zh: 译文保留了这个形容词不寻常的前置位置。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 尿道球腺；考珀腺（旧称）
rows.en: The diagram shows a duct running from the anteprostate to the urethra.
rows.zh: 图中显示，一条导管从尿道球腺通向尿道。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 尿道球腺炎；考珀腺炎（旧称）
rows.en: The old case report described anteprostatitis without inflammation of the prostate itself.
rows.zh: 那篇旧病例报告描述的是尿道球腺炎，而前列腺本身没有发炎。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 发热前的；体温升高之前的（旧医用语）
rows.en: Headache was noted in the antepyretic phase, before the temperature rose.
rows.zh: 头痛出现在体温升高之前的发热前期。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 缓和刺激的；起安抚作用的（旧医用语）
rows.en: The author attributed an anterethic action to the lotion.
rows.zh: 作者认为这种洗剂具有缓和刺激的作用。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 施加相反作用力的；相互拮抗的
rows.en: In the demonstration, the two springs exerted antergic forces on the central plate.
rows.zh: 在演示中，两根弹簧对中央板施加方向相反的作用力。
rows.author: role original author

rows.meaningZh: 钢轨防爬器；限制钢轨沿线路纵向移动的装置
rows.en: The survey report noted a missing anti-creeper beneath the rail.
rows.zh: 检查报告指出，钢轨下方缺了一个防爬器。
rows.author: prepare
rows.originalReviewer: d40_general_language_review (/root/d40_general_language_review), independent of Prepare original author

rows.meaningZh: 燃气发动机供气稳压装置；用于抑制供气波动的设备（本例采用历史燃气设备义）
rows.en: The museum catalogue lists an anti-fluctuator among the gas engine’s surviving parts.
rows.zh: 博物馆目录把一个供气稳压器列在这台燃气发动机现存的部件之中。
rows.author: prepare
rows.originalReviewer: d40_general_language_review (/root/d40_general_language_review), independent of Prepare original author

rows.meaningZh: 阻焊剂；限制焊料流到不需要焊接部位的材料
rows.en: The supplier’s catalogue lists anti-flux beside the soldering fluxes.
rows.zh: 供应商目录把阻焊剂列在焊接用助焊剂旁边。
rows.author: prepare
rows.originalReviewer: d40_general_language_review (/root/d40_general_language_review), independent of Prepare original author

rows.meaningZh: 抗黄疸的；旧医学中指用于对抗黄疸的
rows.en: The historian questioned the book’s anti-icteric claims.
rows.zh: 历史研究者质疑那本书所声称的抗黄疸功效。
rows.author: prepare
rows.originalReviewer: d40_general_language_review (/root/d40_general_language_review), independent of Prepare original author

rows.meaningZh: 对抗或逃避宿主免疫防御的（本例指病原体的免疫逃避策略）
rows.en: The lecturer contrasted the pathogen’s anti-immune tactics with the host’s defences.
rows.zh: 讲师将这种病原体逃避免疫防御的策略与宿主的防御措施作了对比。
rows.author: prepare
rows.originalReviewer: d40_general_language_review (/root/d40_general_language_review), independent of Prepare original author

rows.meaningZh: 锅炉防垢剂；防止蒸汽锅炉内表面形成水垢的物质
rows.en: The purchasing clerk found two invoices for the same anti-incrustator.
rows.zh: 采购文员发现，同一种锅炉防垢剂有两张发票。
rows.author: prepare
rows.originalReviewer: d40_general_language_review (/root/d40_general_language_review), independent of Prepare original author

rows.meaningZh: 防止或减少电磁感应干扰的（本例修饰电缆设计）
rows.en: The museum label describes the cable’s anti-induction design.
rows.zh: 博物馆标签介绍了这根电缆的防感应干扰设计。
rows.author: prepare
rows.originalReviewer: d40_general_language_review (/root/d40_general_language_review), independent of Prepare original author

rows.meaningZh: 抗炎的；用于减轻炎症的
rows.en: The librarian filed the review under anti-inflammatory medicines.

rows.zh: 在这部历史小说中，一位宗教无关紧要论者主张，那项有争议的仪式并非基督教信仰所必需。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 涉及信仰及实践中非必要事项的〔宗教〕
rows.en: The theologian distinguished adiaphoristic questions from matters he considered essential to salvation.
rows.zh: 这位神学家把涉及信仰实践中非必要事项的问题，与他认为关系到救赎的事项区分开来。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 阿丁克拉印花布〔加纳阿散蒂文化的印花织物〕
rows.en: He chose a strip of adinkra for the collar of his jacket.
rows.zh: 他挑了一条阿丁克拉印花布，用来做夹克的领子。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 己二酸酯〔一种由己二酸形成的酯〕
rows.en: The chemist selected a different adipate to use as the plasticiser.
rows.zh: 这位化学家选了另一种己二酸酯作为增塑剂。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 己二酸的〔化学，常用于adipic acid一词〕
rows.en: The laboratory kept its adipic acid in a clearly labelled container.
rows.zh: 实验室把己二酸放在一个标签清晰的容器里。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 似尸蜡的〔少用〕
rows.en: The forensic examiner described a pale, adipocerous layer on the remains.
rows.zh: 法医描述了遗骸上一层苍白、似尸蜡的物质。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 脂肪消化〔旧生理学用语〕
rows.en: The physiologist compared the rates of adipolysis in the two samples.
rows.zh: 这位生理学家比较了两个样本的脂肪消化速率。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 脂肪多的状态；肥胖程度
rows.en: The study compared the mice's adiposeness at the beginning and end of winter.
rows.zh: 研究比较了这些小鼠在冬季开始和结束时的肥胖程度。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 阿底提〔印度神话中的女神〕
rows.en: The artist painted the goddess Aditi beneath a sky filled with stars.
rows.zh: 画家把女神阿底提画在布满星辰的天空下。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 休会；延期〔旧用〕
rows.en: In the historical drama, the delegates protest against another adjournal of the council.
rows.zh: 在这出历史剧中，代表们反对议事会再次休会。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 司法裁决；判决〔旧式用语〕
rows.en: Both parties agreed to abide by the court's adjudgment.
rows.zh: 双方同意遵守法院的裁决。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 辅助地；作为补充地〔正式〕
rows.en: We use the smaller screen adjunctively during live demonstrations.
rows.zh: 在现场演示中，我们把较小的屏幕用作辅助。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 附加地；作为附属补充地〔少用〕
rows.en: The data tables appear adjunctly at the end of the essay.
rows.zh: 数据表作为补充出现在文章末尾。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 恳切请求者（郑重恳求他人的人）
rows.en: In the play, the adjurer kneels before the king and pleads for the prisoner's life.
rows.zh: 在这出戏中，那位恳切请求者跪在国王面前，为囚犯求一条生路。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 以可调节的方式
rows.en: The shelf is adjustably mounted on two vertical rails.
rows.zh: 搁板以可调节的方式安装在两根竖直导轨上。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 佐剂〔疫苗中帮助增强免疫反应的成分；复数〕
rows.en: The researchers compared two adjuvants without changing the antigen in the experimental vaccine.
rows.zh: 研究人员比较了两种佐剂，实验性疫苗中的抗原保持不变。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 阿德金斯〔人名〕
rows.en: Adkins opened the meeting by asking everyone to introduce themselves.
rows.zh: 阿德金斯请大家逐一自我介绍，以此开始了会议。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 薏苡
rows.en: The farmer left one row of adlay unharvested for the students to examine.
rows.zh: 农民留下一行未收割的薏苡，让学生们观察。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 行政上的；有关行政管理的〔少用〕
rows.en: His work was largely administerial, involving records, schedules and routine correspondence.
rows.zh: 他的工作主要是行政事务，包括档案、日程安排和日常往来信件。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 艾特米拿〔奥地利球队名，Admira〕
rows.en: The Admira supporters stayed in the stands until the final whistle.
rows.zh: 艾特米拿队的支持者一直留在看台上，直到终场哨声响起。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 值得钦佩之处；令人赞赏的性质〔少用〕
rows.en: Nobody doubted the admirability of her aim, but her methods remained controversial.
rows.zh: 没人怀疑她的目标值得钦佩，但她的方法仍有争议。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 令人钦佩的性质；可赞赏之处
rows.en: The admirableness of her conduct was obvious even to her critics.
rows.zh: 连批评她的人也看得出她的行为值得钦佩。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 表示钦佩或赞叹的〔少用〕
rows.en: He gave the restored ceiling an admirative glance.
rows.zh: 他赞赏地看了一眼修复后的天花板。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 承认者；坦承某事的人〔少用〕
rows.en: The first admitter of a mistake should not become the only person held responsible.
rows.zh: 第一个承认错误的人不应成为唯一承担责任的人。
rows.author: d37_author_source9

rows.meaningZh: 告诫者；训诫者
rows.en: The teacher was a patient admonisher, never raising her voice.
rows.zh: 这位教师总是耐心地告诫别人，从不提高嗓门。
rows.author: d37_author_source9
